postings.title: Business Intelligence Specialist
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

Business Intelligence Specialist (0,8 - 1 FTE, Hengelo)
‘The goal is to turn data into information and information into insight’
The Enterprise Information Management team of Thales in the Netherlands is looking for an experienced BI specialist to further professionalize information management.

About the job
Thales in the Netherlands has committed to the objective to become a ‘data-driven company’, where facts and unambiguous information are leading in decision making. As BI specialist, you will be responsible for gathering the requested business information and designing clear dashboards for our internal customer, the business user. At the start of the week, you check the sprint backlog to see what tasks are assigned to you. You align with the product owner and business analyst of the team and you are in touch with the business user to sharpen the information specifications. Together with the solution architect and data manager, you investigate which data is required to build the dashboard and together you determine how much time it will take to extract and validate the data. You are capable of executing ETL activities yourself. In the meantime, you start designing one component of the new dashboard in PowerBI. You are in close contact with the business user to agree upon the visual design. At the end of the sprint, which takes two weeks, you deliver the new component of the new dashboard, and in the next sprint you will extend your work with a new component.

You play an important role in the internal digital transformation journey of Thales in the Netherlands. There is a lot of work to be done; you are a ‘go-getter’ and consider this assignment, which we accepted as a team, to be a journey full of chances and possibilities. You are flexible and know how to work around challenges along the way. You are someone who dares to challenge the status quo and someone who brings new energy to our team. Also, you have strong communication skills and you know to address different audiences.

The most important activities are:
- Develop and design dashboards in PowerBI to meet the information demands of the business user
- ETL activities to extract and format data for the dashboards which need to be developed
- Contribute to the improvement of our work processes

Must have
- Holds a relevant Bachelor degree in IT, Business & IT or similar;
- Has knowledge of PowerBI
- Has experience with an ETL tool, preverably SSIS
- Has experience with an cubes, preverably SSAS tabular

Nice to have
- Has knowlegdge and experience with Kimball dimensional data modelling
- Can align the business information request with the technical possibilities
- Is proactive, flexible, a go-getter, and enthusiastic
- Knowledge of SQL and Mendix is a pre
- Good understanding of the Dutch language

What’s in it for you
- A challenging role in a high tech, innovative environment with room for initiative and new ideas.
- Opportunities for personal and professional growth, including technical and international development.
- Collaboration with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and nationalities.
- A modern, flexible workspace with a healthy work life balance.
- Hybrid working possibilities, typically aiming for a 60/40 home office balance where the role allows.
- Competitive salary based on vakgroep 55/ 60 CLA Metalektro-HP, travel allowance, and customizable employment conditions (e.g., PTO exchange, mobility options, fitness, relocation support).
- 40 days of paid time off per year.

Diversity Statement
We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! postings.description:
Lieu : Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

Dans le cadre de la modernisation de nos processus financiers et de notre trajectoire de transformation digitale (SAP S/4HANA, automatisation des clôtures, conformité à la réforme de la facturation électronique), nous recherchons un(e) Product Owner BlackLine pour piloter et faire évoluer notre plateforme de Financial Close Automation.
Vous serez l'interlocuteur(trice) clé entre les équipes Finance, Comptabilité et IT pour garantir que BlackLine réponde aux enjeux métiers.

Dans ce cadre vos principales missions seront :

Pilotage de la solution BlackLine et déploiement international
- Définir et prioriser la roadmap produit BlackLine en lien avec les équipes Finance, Comptabilité, Contrôle de Gestion et Opérations.
- Piloter l'intégration de BlackLine avec l'écosystème SAP S/4HANA existant pour le programme Zenith tout en participant au design général, applicable pour les autres entités / ERPs
- Rédiger et gérer le backlog (user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles, critères d'acceptation)
- Garantir la conformité des processus de clôture avec les exigences réglementaires (IFRS, PCG, contrôle interne)
- Accompagner les filiales dans la conduite du changement et l'adoption de la solution. (formations, communications, support)
Gestion des parties prenantes
- Être le garant d'une bonne coordination entre les entités visant à l'application des process finance du Groupe dans les outils déployés, en particulier BlackLine
- Être le relais entre les entités opérationnelles et la fiabilité de la communication financière du groupe
- Collaboration en proximité des experts SI qui apportent une expertise technique outil (rédaction de backlog, spécifications fonctionnelles, critères d'acceptation)
- Coordonner avec les autres chantiers de digitalisation Finance (Basware, Generix, eACQ) pour assurer la cohérence du SI Finance
Administration et gouvernance de la plateforme
- Définir et mettre en place l'organisation cible pour l'administration et la gouvernance de la plateforme BlackLine à l'échelle du Groupe
- Définir les rôles, utilisateurs, profils, règles et workflows de la plateforme BlackLine
- Superviser la qualité des données et la performance de la solution
- Définir et maintenir les règles de gouvernance de la plateforme
- Garantir le respect des exigences de contrôle interne et de conformité
Amélioration continue
- Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation et d'optimisation des processus de clôture financière
- Assurer une veille sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités proposées par BlackLine (notamment les modules IA à venir)
- Suivre les KPIs d'adoption et proposer des axes d'amélioration continue

Votre profil :

Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure (Master 2 ou équivalent) dans le domaine des Systèmes d'Information et/ou Finance et possédez une expérience de 5 à 10 ans minimum sur une fonction similaire. Vous êtes bilingue en anglais afin d'évoluer au sein d'un environnement international.

Vous avez un excellent relationnel, doté(e) d'un esprit de synthèse et collaboratif et d'une grande autonomie. Vous avez la capacité à travailler en transverse, à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à animer des ateliers de conduite du changement.

postings.title: C++ Software Engineer – Electro-Optical (Radar Core Processing)
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C++ Software Engineer – Electro-Optical (Radar Core Processing)
About Us
Thales Nederland is a top provider of high-tech jobs, active in the Aerospace, Defense, and Security sectors. We design extremely modern radar systems and optical sensors that form part of complete, integrated defense systems. Within the Engineering cluster, our software engineering department is responsible for the software that makes these radar systems tick. These complex systems are used worldwide to protect lives in critical situations.

The Team: Electro-Optical (RCP)
The Electro-Optical team sits within the Radar Core Processing (RCP) department. While traditional radar relies on radio waves for long-range detection, our team focuses on the integration and processing of optical cameras to provide critical short-range surveillance and highly accurate tracking capabilities. We build the software powering a diverse range of cutting-edge defense systems, distinguishing between dedicated electro-optical surveillance products (like Gatekeeper) and precision tracking systems (like MiRADOR). Furthermore, we develop solutions that fuse these domains, seamlessly combining optical sensor data with traditional radar technology (such as in our STIR systems) to deliver comprehensive, multi-domain situational awareness. We are a specialized team that bridges the gap between complex software algorithms and physical hardware, ensuring optical data is flawlessly integrated into the wider defense ecosystem.

The Role
We are looking for a C++ developer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, complex mathematics, and hardware integration.
In this role, you will focus heavily on image and video processing, writing the C++ code that interprets what our optical sensors see. Because this involves transforming high volumes of raw visual data in real-time, you will frequently work with heavy mathematical computations, particularly matrix operations. While this is primarily a software development position, it is highly hands-on; you will regularly step away from your desk to test, verify, and fine-tune your code directly on the actual physical hardware and camera systems.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance C++ software tailored for real-time image and video processing.
- Translate complex mathematical models into efficient, production-ready code.
- Integrate software algorithms with physical optical camera hardware, conducting hands-on testing and verification to ensure real-world accuracy and reliability.
- Optimize video processing pipelines and data flows, utilizing the Gstreamer library.
- Leverage GPU acceleration (CUDA) to maximize the speed and efficiency of our electro-optical processing capabilities.
- Collaborate with broader RCP teams to ensure optical data seamlessly integrates with tracking, extraction, and fire control systems.

About You
We are looking for a strong C++ developer who has a deep interest in making sense of visual data. You should have:
- Solid, proven experience in modern C++ software engineering.
- A strong affinity for and background in image and/or video processing.
- Solid mathematical capabilities, with specific comfort and experience implementing matrix operations in code.
- A hands-on engineering mindset; you enjoy seeing your software run on actual physical hardware rather than just in a simulation.
- Experience with GPU programming, specifically CUDA.
- Preferred but not strictly required: Familiarity with building and managing media pipelines using the Gstreamer library.

What We Offer
- An interesting job in a high-tech environment at our Hengelo campus.
- An open and flexible working environment where work-life balance is considered very important.
- 40 leave days per year.
- Travel expenses and a flexible benefits à la carte package.
- Options to personalize your benefits, including the purchase/sale of leave hours, internet costs, a bicycle plan, company fitness, trade union contributions, or relocation costs.
- Dedicated opportunities for continuous skill development, including active participation in our internal monthly "Learning Moments" professional development initiatives.
- A lot of room for your personal development and own initiatives.

postings.description:
Lieu : Toulouse, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

L’évolution du marché des satellites de télécommunications GEO conduit Thales Alenia Space à réaliser des projets intégrant différents types de charges utiles, des solutions legacy aux solutions entièrement flexibles (Software Defined Satellite), en fonction des besoins des clients et des contrats.

Dans ce contexte, et pour les programmes C/D de la Business Line Télécommunications, nous recherchons un Payload Program and Engineering Delivery Manager.

Au sein d’une équipe cœur Payload d’environ 10 personnes, et en interaction avec les différentes parties prenantes, le défi du poste porte à la fois sur l’exécution du contrat client pour le sous-système Payload, depuis la notification du contrat jusqu’à la livraison du satellite en orbite, et sur le pilotage des activités d’ingénierie associées à la Payload.

Vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes :

- Assurer l’interface programmatique avec le client, l’équipe projet TAS et, plus largement, l’ensemble des responsables impliqués dans les activités Payload, en interne comme auprès des partenaires externes de TAS
- Être responsable des engagements contractuels et d’ingénierie de la Payload et, dans ce cadre, piloter les revues et livrables associés dans le respect des délais, en interne comme auprès du client
- Piloter les arbitrages relatifs à la Payload, avec l’appui des experts concernés, en prenant en compte l’ensemble des dimensions techniques et programmatiques, et valider la décision finale avec le support du Project Manager
- Être responsable du planning et des coûts du sous-système Payload, dans le périmètre défini par l’organisation, et assurer le reporting nécessaire auprès du Project Manager. À ce titre, définir les priorités des activités d’ingénierie et allouer les ressources en conséquence
- Piloter les risques et opportunités liés à la Payload en coordination avec l’équipe et assurer le reporting nécessaire auprès du Project Manager
- Assurer la capitalisation des connaissances tout au long du projet et partager les faits marquants avec vos pairs et au sein du département Engineering Télécommunications

Votre profil

Disposez-vous d’une expérience technique dans le domaine des charges utiles de télécommunications ?

Avez-vous une solide expérience en gestion de projet et dans la relation client ?

Avez-vous un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer et de négocier avec vos partenaires et clients ?

Disposez-vous d’une bonne connaissance des satellites de télécommunications et des aspects système « End to End » ?

Êtes-vous orienté vers la performance et la satisfaction client ?

Disposez-vous d’excellentes qualités relationnelles et êtes-vous reconnu pour votre capacité à écouter, convaincre et mobiliser différentes parties
prenantes ?

Faites-vous preuve d’initiative et disposez-vous de bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et d’adaptation ?

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Le mot de l’equipe

« Vous êtes passionné par le spatial, et plus particulièrement par les charges utiles de télécommunications et la gestion de projet ? Vous souhaitez continuer à travailler sur des projets intégrant des solutions techniques à forte valeur ajoutée, au sein d’équipes colocalisées et multidisciplinaires ? Nous serons ravis d’échanger avec vous sur cette opportunité ainsi que sur les perspectives d’évolution offertes par Thales Alenia Space. »

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Certification Officer

Halifax, N.S., (CAN.), Hybrid

Position Summary

We have a current vacancy for a Certification Officer to join our team supporting Royal Canadian Navy programs.

The Certification Officer will be responsible to manage the certification activities associated with the Royal Canadian Navy Arctic and Offshore Patrol Vessels (AOPV), Joint Support Ship (JSS) class vessels managed by Thales under the AOPS & JSS In-Service Support (AJISS) contract, and Minor Warships and Auxiliary Vessels managed by Thales under the MWAV contract.

In this position, you will be the main point of contact for the Classification Society surveyor and support the Service Delivery team with planning and executing the activities associated with Classification Society scheduled surveys and inspections. You will also advise the Service Delivery team and Engineering team on matters relating to certification requirements for corrective maintenance, planned maintenance and engineering changes, and act as the point of contact for all certification-related inquiries, ensuring efficient communication between DND departments (NMRA, FTA, MEPM), the approved Classification Society, and Thales departments (Engineering, Supportability, Service Delivery, Procurement).

Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility
The Certification Officer will report to the Certification Manager within TCDS and support the management and coordination of certification activities across AOPS, JSS, and MWAV fleets. This includes, but is not limited to:
- Identifying all re-certification activities (including Classification Society scheduled surveys and material re-certification) and ensuring they are captured within the Class maintenance program planning tool.
- Supporting Thales Service Delivery with certification-related activities, including Classification Society periodic and annual surveys and inspections, and coordinating schedules with Class, Ship Staff, and internal teams.
- Liaising with Classification Society personnel during surveys and inspections, technical issues, and engineering changes impacting Class compliance.
- Assessing the impact of new ship defects and engineering changes on certification, including participation in Technical Risk assessments and management of Conditions of Class mitigation and resolution.
- Maintaining certification tracking tools, including certification issue trackers and deliverable lists for AOPV, JSS, and MWAV vessels.
- Reviewing the Captain’s Ship Book to ensure certificates are kept up to date and aligned with the Technical Data Package, while serving as the point of contact with DND on certification issues.

Minimum Qualifications
The candidate must meet each of the following criteria:
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with Classification Society rules and regulations (Lloyd’s Register, ABS, DNV) for the Classification of Ships, Naval Ship Classification Rules, and Commercial Ship Rules.
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Maritime Organization (IMO).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code).
- Language: English (essential).

Preferred Qualifications

Ce poste est donc fait pour vous, alors venez nous rejoindre !

Le Campus de Gennevilliers est le cœur des activités de conception, de développement et de soutien des grands systèmes de défense : radiocommunications, réseaux et systèmes d’infrastructure résilients, communications par satellite, combat collaboratif et cybersécurité. Le Campus de Gennevilliers est le cœur des activités de conception, de développement et de soutien des grands systèmes de défense : radiocommunications, réseaux et systèmes d’infrastructure résilients, communications par satellite, combat collaboratif et cybersécurité. Dans le cadre des programmes d’infrastructure de défense, de systèmes d’informations et de commandements, Thales est particulièrement actif sur la sécurité globale du système dans le but de le prémunir d’éventuelles attaques cyber.

Thales définit, maîtrise et contrôle la sécurisation du système via ses activités d’ingénierie de sécurité en matière de définition système, de conception d’architecture sécurisée et d’homologation. Thales assure également la définition, conception et réalisation de solutions de cybersécurité, avec notamment des équipements de haut niveau de sécurité (sondes, équipements de chiffrement, solutions de Data Centric Security, sécurisation du cloud, superviseur de sécurité, …).

Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons un chef de service Systèmes critiques et Sécurité du cloud F/H), basé à Gennevilliers (92), avec des déplacements réguliers en Ile de France ou en Bretagne.
Vous rejoignez une équipe de chefs de services impliqués sur d’autres verticales business mais avec des synergies métiers et technologiques.

postings.title: Chief Information Security Officer Asia
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Position Summary
The CISO is responsible for all aspects of information security and cyber security across IT, OT and Product with the help of PSO Teams, including developing, deploying and maintaining a robust security strategy with solid security policies, protocols and procedures across enterprise security architecture, security operations center, datacenter security, and network security including cloud and applications security with appropriate security measures and initiatives.
This role also advises senior leaders and other stakeholders on the further development, implementation and management of a countrywide IT security infrastructure that contains appropriate control objectives for system integrity, availability, reliability, resilience, confidentiality and assurance to company, industry and international standards.
Country coordination: engage country CISO contacts network.
Regional CISO also contributes to deployment of product security policy performed by GPSO (Global Product Security Officer).
Across the different entities composing the Group organization, a network of local CISOs has been defined to ensure adequate management and implementation of security governance and strategy across business unit, region and country levels. This CISO community has a functional reporting line with the Group Chief Information Security Officer. They are consulted and/or informed regarding security policy implementation and its evolution.
In each country, a national CISO office should exist:
- To ensure compliance with local law and regulations

- To maintain relationship with cybersecurity national authorities (cyber agencies, defense agencies, law enforcement…)

- To animate information protection through the network of legal entities representatives

At region levels, local CISO can:
- Develop their own local security policy and directives to comply with local law or regulation as long as they use the group policy as a baseline and only improve the level of security requirements

- Assess IS/IT project risks, organize the accreditation of IS across entities

- Monitor security operations including incident detection through SOC activities

- Manage incident response in coordination with Thales CERT and/or central incident response team support

Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
- Ensure strategic alignment of the region approach (IS/IT, OT & product with help of the PSO team) regarding Cyber Security (and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, Thales Group standards and alignment with business objectives)

- Ensure security program & action plans are in place and actions implemented to manage the risk of adverse impacts from any external or internal attack on the region's IT/IS are reduced to an acceptable level

- Ensure appropriate budget and resources are allocated to support the security program at Thales region level

- Be a member of the Group Information System Security Community – sets and approves IS security policy decisions and exceptions for Thales Group

- Manage and validate security derogations on regional scope

- Ensure security incidents are coordinated and managed with the Central Security body through DGDI CISO

- Coordinate regionally under the supervision of the Cert Incident Response Activities

- Gain acceptance of proposed security solutions by the various security accrediting bodies within DGDI CISO

- Respect Group IS/IT standards and strategy

- Review strategies, operational changes and projects to ensure appropriate security controls are applied

- Review proposed enterprise architecture strategies and designs to ensure new risks are not introduced, and suggest changes that increase functionality and help reduce existing risks

- Provide KPIs to central Security team to ensure consistency of cybersecurity within the region

- Maintain/coordinate an understanding of current and emerging security threats that may affect the company now or in the future

- Undertake/coordinate forensic investigations and analysis as required on Thales computer assets in support of HR led investigations

- Liaise with Legal regarding regulatory topics and export control requirements in systems and manage any e-discovery requirements that Thales is required to undertake

- Undertake governance responsibilities for technology based on defense regulations, laws and policies, and report Thales' state of compliance to Governmental Boards in charge

- Engage and represent Thales in professional industry forums so that external opinion of Thales Security program remains highly regarded

- Provide regular updates to the Asia CIO and DGDI CISO regarding achievements, issues and goals

- Review and ensure follow up of remediation plans with country CISO

- Lead the businesses for ISO 27k projects and other local regulatory certifications, e.g. Cyber Trust Mark in Singapore

- Produce/adapt all documents related to user awareness

- Support HR for onboarding process and cyber related documents

- Support Regional Company for cyber related maturity plans of Key Industrial Partners

Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience & Education
- Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in Information Technology and/or Information Security (or equivalent experience)

- 5+ years of leadership experience overseeing security initiatives in a large, preferably global enterprise

- Obtained one or more of the following certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC, PMP or other related certifications

- Demonstrable experience of emergency preparedness, critical incident management, business continuity and disaster recovery

- Experienced with large IT infrastructure and/or IT security projects, e.g. firewall deployment, NAC implementation, web proxy upgrade etc.

- Prior experience with information security framework, secure network architecture and design, cloud computing, and secure application architecture/design

- Proven experience leading a dispersed, multi-site team

- Strong working knowledge of information security technologies, markets and vendors including firewall, intrusion detection, assessment and monitoring tools, encryption, certificate authority, and cloud networks

- Experienced in developing policies and procedures for identity and access management, security programs, security standards, requirement definition, and project management plans

- Adept at creating business cases and user cases including the ramifications of various system, network and application security decisions and recommendations

- Articulate with strong verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: CIAM Technical Consultant
postings.description:
Location: Remote Netherlands, Netherlands

CIAM TECHNICAL CONSULTANT
ALL ACRONYMS ARE CREATED EQUAL. BUT SOME ARE MORE EQUAL THAN OTHERS.

CIAM is one of those ‘extra-ordinary’ ones. After all, in an industry filled with acronyms, granting customers easy access to digital services while protecting their credentials isn’t a nice to have; it’s a prerequisite for success. And Thales OneWelcome delivers just that. For 100+ major European players across a diverse range of regulated and unregulated sectors. Moreover, our recent acquisition by security giant Thales (80K new colleagues!) puts us in a superb position to accelerate our growth. Both in our current markets and beyond. So if you are into Customer Identity & Access Management AND want to join a company that has the potential to become a global CIAM thought leader, buckle up, and press the APPLY button.

AS OUR CIAM CONSULTANT, YOU’LL
Quickly claim your rightful position in the Client Services department. You’ll work on customer-facing project with architects and fellow consultants. Together you’ll sign off of best-of-breed CIAM solutions for corporate clients. It’s up to you to ensure that each change implementation meets or (better yet) exceeds the client’s expectations. Leverage your analytical powers and consulting skills to determine what customers think they want, and what they actually need to realize their strategic ambitions. That calls for lots of interaction with lots of stakeholders. The ‘usual suspects’ include client-side architects/developers and business users. After all, they can often provide invaluable empirical information on the needs of their CIAM end users.

CIAM interacts with an extensive spectrum of systems and solutions, so liaising with external vendors (e.g., engineers who build customer portals) is often in scope, too. And while you’ll tend to focus on ‘hardcore’ topics (think flow, integration, et cetera), we definitely welcome your UX/UI insights. Additionally, we expect you to be security obsessed. Our CIAM solutions need to work as advertised for every client. And, by extension, for their customers. Lastly, while we’re open to showing ambitious juniors the CIAM ropes, we’ll really roll out the red carpet for seasoned more experienced consultants.

JOB REQUIREMENTS
- Relevant experience. A track record in CIAM would meet with cheers, but if your list ‘been there, done that’ acronyms only includes the IAM part, we can work with that too.
- Alternatively, we’ll gladly discuss the role over coffee if you have e-tail Checkout experience and/ or a background in customer journey mapping.
- You don’t have to be intimately familiar with all of the following, but the more, the merrier: OWASP, OSI, xml, json, SAML, oAUTH, OIDC, java Phyton, bash, linux, docker, sql, Kubernetes, aws, archimate, node, html/css/csp and JavaScript.
- Solid analytical skills: without those, you’ll quickly get lost in the client woods
- CIAM may be your favorite acronym, but API is a close second
- The confidence to lead a fruitful discussions with client-side counterparts, including senior management
- A proven ability to translate intricate use cases into clear-cut stories
- A security-first mindset: if you consider security a nice bonus, sorry we are not a match

Une aisance dans l’utilisation des données de performance et des outils de reporting ou de visualisation pour analyser les résultats et éclairer les décisions est également un plus.
Une expérience dans le secteur aéronautique ou de la défense constitue un réel atout.

Du pragmatisme, de la méthode et une forte orientation vers les résultats et leur pérennisation
De l’autonomie, de l’initiative et une capacité à travailler en collectif dans un environnement en transformation

Nous ne recherchons pas seulement un expert des outils Lean. Nous recherchons un coach de terrain capable de comprendre les enjeux opérationnels et clients, de faire progresser les équipes et de transformer les difficultés rencontrées en améliorations concrètes et durables.

postings.title: Commercial Manager
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

YOUR BENEFITS
- Competitive remuneration + Super + Bonus + Free Medical Insurance.

- ThalesFlex – Hybrid work environment.

- Fitness Passport Discount – Access to a network of Gyms across AUS

- Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance).

- Modernised Paid Parental Leave.

- Veterans Leave.

- Novated Lease options.

- Family support through our partnership with Parents at Work.

YOUR ROLE

As Commercial Manager, you’ll provide strategic commercial guidance across our key sustainment contracts, working hand-in-glove with Project and Bid teams to land negotiation outcomes that protect both delivery and margin.

You’ll own contract compliance, manage IP and technology risk, and be the commercial voice in project status reviews, trusted to make the calls that keep complex, long-running programs on track.

Key Responsibilities:

- Drive commercial strategy across major sustainment contracts, shaping negotiation positions that protect delivery, margin, and long-term client relationships.

- Lead resolution of complex contractual and commercial disputes, including claims management, to minimise risk exposure and keep programs on track.

- Partner with Bid and Project Managers as the senior commercial authority, shaping solutions, pricing strategy, and risk positioning from opportunity through to delivery.

- Act as the trusted commercial advisor to business stakeholders, translating contractual complexity into clear, decisive guidance for program leadership.

- Own end-to-end contract governance, ensuring compliance and audit-readiness across a portfolio of high-value, long-running agreements.

- Hold Project Managers accountable to milestone and contractual commitments, intervening early where delivery risk threatens contract performance.

- Maintain commercial data integrity and reporting rigour, giving leadership accurate visibility into contract health and KPI performance.

On day one in this role, we'll expect you to bring the following skills, experience and behaviours:

- Bachelor's degree or similar in Commerce, Engineering, Law, or related discipline.

- Demonstrated track record managing complex defence contracts, backed by deep sustainment or through-life support industry experience

- Must have strong working knowledge of ASDEFCON contract framework and bid negotiation

- Advanced negotiation, analytical and financial acumen, comfortable in operating at pace on high-value, high risk agreements

- Sound commercial judgement across project delivery, contract law and pricing strategy

- Eligible for Defence Security Clearance (Baseline or above).

Good to Know

A Defence security clearance is required for this role; applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role.The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

The U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR) are applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.
Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and (role dependent) medical checks.

It’s easy to dismiss the perfect opportunity if you don’t see yourself as the perfect fit. If this role feels right – no matter your background or personal circumstances – please introduce yourself or join our community. We’re committed to supporting a diverse workplace, and that starts here.

We’re proud to be endorsed by WORK180 as an Employer for All Women, but we know there’s always more we can do. We’ll continue to foster industry partnerships, employee resource groups (ERGs) and development opportunities to make Thales a genuinely equitable employer, for everyone.

Read more about our WORK180 endorsement.

postings.title: Communications Intern (Jan 2027 Intake)
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

About Thales in Singapore
Thales established its presence in Singapore in 1973 to support the expansion of aerospace-related activities in the Asia-Pacific region. Over the years, the company has expanded and today is involved in the main sectors of Aerospace (including Air Traffic Management), Defence & Security and Digital Identity & Security (DIS). Thales also has an established Research, Technology and Innovation (RTI) footprint in Singapore, housing a Research and Technology team (one of five for the Thales Group worldwide), an Innovation Hub and the Digital Factory in Asia.
For the Digital Identity & Security business, Thales operates the Group’s largest multi-module DIS Manufacturing Competence Centre in Singapore, together with an Engineering Competence Centre working on research and product development for multiple sectors, including banking, telecommunications and automotive. In Aerospace, the largest avionics manufacturing site for the Thales Group is located in Singapore.
Thales employs over 2,000 people of over thirty nationalities in Singapore, across three locations in Singapore, which includes 28 Changi North Rise (CNR), 12 Ayer Rajah Crescent (ARC) and Suntec City.

About the Internship
The Communications team is looking to engage an intern, who’s bursting with creative ideas and enthusiasm, to support us in upcoming projects that help enhance the Thales brand in Singapore and throughout the Asia region. The intern will work closely with the Communications team and with other business functions to communicate across multiple channels (internal & external) on a diverse array of topics cutting across all business sectors that Thales is involved in. This is a great opportunity to be exposed to a wide variety of communications activities, from writing to content generation, video production and editing, design to events management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:
- Content generation and design work of short-form articles like internal articles, social media posts, video descriptions, posters and more
- Pre-event and on-ground support at exhibitions, trade shows, conferences and internal events
- Creation of simple video and digital content, including filming and editing
- Liaison with Communications and HR on employer branding-related projects
- Maintain and enhance current Thales intranet site
- Administrative support and inventory management

Required skills and competencies:
- Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English
- Enthusiastic and proactive with a can-do attitude and ability to multi-task
- Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively across different teams and groups
- Proficient in the Microsoft Office portfolio, and comfortable with Photoshop or any other video-editing software
- Experience with creative design and/or Content Management Systems (CMS) would be a plus

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

- You will work inside an enthusiast multi-discipline engineering team which will give you the opportunity to evolve and enlarge your skills.

Education

- 3 or more years of experience in hardware and mechanical development
- The candidate should be fluent in French, Dutch or English. Strong knowledge of French and English is required.

- Knowledge of a range of components that are used in electronic and mechanical design, both analog and digital applications.
- Experience in circuit design as well as mechanical design is a plus.
- An experience in a circuit board and logistics assembly line is a plus.

This role offers practical exposure to advanced reliability and maintenance practices in a collaborative engineering environment.

Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans le domaine de la Navigation par satellite au sein du programme EGNOS.
EGNOS, un des programmes phares de l’Union européenne dans le domaine spatial, est conçu pour apporter des gains de performances aux systèmes globaux de navigation par satellite (GNSS). Il améliore la précision, la fiabilité et l’intégrité des signaux de positionnement par satellite, de manière à fournir des données de navigation plus précises et dignes de confiance au profit de nombreux secteurs d’activités. Le service « Safety of Life » d’EGNOS est essentiel pour l’industrie du transport aérien, car il permet, entre autres, d’effectuer des approches de précision sur les aéroports européens, sans équipement d’aide au guidage au sol. Déployé depuis 2005 et opérationnel en « service ouvert » depuis 2009, le système EGNOS actuel a été développé sous la maîtrise d’œuvre de Thales Alenia Space et est géré par l’EUSPA
Le Consortium Manager EGNOS est responsable des sous-système EGNOS pour les offres, les projets en développement et les services de maintenance.

postings.title: Consultant CSIRT
postings.description:
Les entreprises et les gouvernements comptent sur Thales pour apporter de la confiance aux milliards d’interactions numériques qu’ils établissent avec les utilisateurs. L’Activité Mondiale Identité & Sécurité Numériques (DIS) fournit des technologies et services (des logiciels sécurisés en passant par la biométrie ou encore le cryptage), qui permettent aux entreprises ainsi qu’aux gouvernements de vérifier des identités, et de protéger les données afin qu’elles restent sûres.

QUI ÊTES-VOUS ?
PROFIL
- Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master 2 (BAC +5) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un parcours universitaire, avec une expérience significative d'au moins 5 ans dans un SOC ou un CERT/CSIRT.
- Vous avez de bonnes capacités d'analyse et un sens aigu de la gestion de crise.
- Vous êtes méthodique et autonome, capable de garder votre sang-froid en situation d'incident.
- Vous êtes un(e) leader motivé(e), prêt(e) à engager et à développer son équipe en favorisant la collaboration et les approches stimulantes.
- Vous avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles : vous avez déjà été en contact direct avec la clientèle, y compris en situation de crise, et vous sentez prêt(e) à voyager très régulièrement.
- Vous êtes un communicateur(ice) efficace, capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques pour des interlocuteurs non-techniques.
- Vous êtes flexible, proactif(ve) et avez une excellente résistance au stress.
- Vous êtes méticuleux(se) et avez le souci du détail.
- Vous êtes axé(e) client : vous voulez lui apporter de la valeur et le rassurer en situation sensible.
- Vous êtes titulaire d’un permis de conduire.
- Vous avez un niveau minimum B2 en anglais (français et luxembourgeois est un plus).
COMPÉTENCES
- Vous possédez des Certifications dans le domaine de la cybersécurité (GCFA, GCFE, GREM, CDSA…).
- Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils et techniques d'investigation numérique sur systèmes, réseaux et environnements cloud (ex. Velociraptor, grep, dissect, Volatility, OpenSearch…).
- Vous avez de l'expérience en analyse de malwares (statique et dynamique).
- Vous connaissez le framework MITRE ATT&CK et savez mener des activités de Threat Hunting (Defender, Sentinel, TrendMicro…).
- Vous connaissez les différents artéfacts forensiques (Prefetch, UserAssist, MFT, Registres…).
- Vous avez des notions de threat intelligence (CTI) et de suivi des TTPs des groupes d'attaquants.
- Vous savez rédiger des rapports d'incident (en anglais) clairs et des recommandations de remédiation exploitables.
- Vous maitrisez le scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash) pour maintenir les outils du CERT.
- Vous êtes à l’aise pour piloter plusieurs incidents en même temps.
CE QUE NOUS POUVONS FAIRE ENSEMBLE
En tant que Consultant CSIRT Senior chez Thales, vous aurez la charge de :
- Assurer l’acquisition, l'analyse et la qualification des incidents de sécurité.
- Piloter la réponse aux incidents : Préparation, Scoping, Intelligence development & containment, Remediation.
- Analyser des malwares et échantillons suspects pour extraire des IOCs.
- Mener des activités de threat hunting via des hypothèses sur les infrastructures clients.
- Rédiger des rapports d'incident, comprenant un résumé managérial, une timeline et des recommandations.
- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des playbooks et procédures de réponse à incident.
- Assurer une astreinte / un support lors de la gestion de crises cyber pour les clients.
- Collaborer avec les équipes SOC, Threat Intelligence et les clients pour améliorer la posture de détection.
- Piloter et venir en aide aux L1/L2 lors d’un incident.
VOTRE CARRIÈRE CHEZ THALES
Différentes opportunités vous permettront de découvrir d'autres domaines ou sites. Vous pourrez évoluer et développer vos compétences dans différents domaines :
- Explorez un espace attentif au développement personnel.
- Développez vos talents dans un autre domaine du groupe Thales, en découvrant de nouveaux produits, de nouveaux clients, un nouveau pays ou en vous orientant vers une solution plus complexe.
- Choisissez entre une expertise technique ou un parcours de leadership.
- Construisez une carrière internationale au sein d'un groupe d'ingénierie de premier plan.

Contracts Manager
Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

We are looking for a Contracts Manager to join our established Commercial team within our A2IS business, based in Crawley.
This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a diverse portfolio of high-value contracts and bids, working with customers including the UK Ministry of Defence, leading UK prime contractors, international organisations and overseas governments. You’ll play a key role throughout the full contract lifecycle, from capture and bid through to negotiation, contract award, delivery and closure, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders across the business.

As our business continues to grow rapidly, you’ll have excellent opportunities to develop your commercial expertise, take on increased responsibility and progress your career within a dynamic and supportive environment.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (A2IS)
Our purpose is to protect and defend, creating integrated solutions that bring together insight, coordination and decisive action. We respond rapidly with systems that support detection, fire control, engagement and mission sustainment. Our expertise covers Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International), Air Operations & Services, and Space.

Main Responsibilities
- Lead the commercial management of contracts and bids throughout the full contract lifecycle, from capture and proposal development through to delivery and contract closure.
- Establish and maintain strong customer commercial relationships, ensuring commercial considerations are embedded across capture, bid and delivery activities.
- Draft, review, assess and negotiate contracts, proposals, quotations, amendments, orders and terms and conditions in line with agreed strategy and customer requirements.
- Own contractual baselines and change management, ensuring contractual compliance and providing proactive commercial guidance to integrated bid and project teams.
- Identify, assess and manage commercial risk, including contractual, liability and pricing risks, while providing commercial influence across multidisciplinary teams to support successful business outcomes.

Ideal Experience & Skills
- Proven experience in contract management across both pre-award and post-award phases, with strong contract, letter and proposal drafting and assessment skills.
- Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify contractual, commercial and compliance issues and develop appropriate solutions.
- Strong commercial awareness, including experience of risk management, liability assessment and pricing.
- A collaborative team player and confident communicator, able to build effective customer relationships and influence stakeholders across multidisciplinary teams.
- A proactive, self-starting approach with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to balance strategic commercial thinking with a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach.

Security Clearance Requirement
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.
Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels

postings.description:
Location: Reading, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Location: Doncaster/Reading (other Thales sites could be considered)

We are looking for an experienced Cryptographic Services Architect to join our Secure Communications & Information Systems business. This is a unique opportunity to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of cutting-edge cryptographic solutions across a portfolio of secure and mission-critical projects.

Working within our established Cryptographic Services Practice, you will play a pivotal role in shaping secure solutions that support customers operating in highly regulated and security-sensitive environments. From bid and proposal stages through to design, implementation, and service transition, you will provide technical leadership and expertise across Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Key Management Services, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), and emerging post-quantum cryptography initiatives.

This role offers the perfect blend of architecture, engineering, customer engagement, and strategic leadership.

What You'll Be Doing

Architecture & Technical Leadership
- Lead the cryptographic architecture for bids, proposals, and project delivery.
- Define secure, scalable, and compliant solutions aligned with customer requirements and industry best practice.
- Produce high-quality architectural documentation including High-Level Designs (HLDs), solution designs, requirements specifications, and testing artefacts.
- Present technical solutions confidently to customers, senior stakeholders, and technical review boards.
- Support the transition from bid to delivery, ensuring architectural integrity throughout the project lifecycle.

Cryptographic Solution Design
- Design and integrate enterprise cryptographic services including:- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
- Certificate Lifecycle Management
- Key Management Systems
- Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
- Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) migration strategies

- Advise customers on cryptographic agility, future security requirements, and quantum-readiness.
- Lead integration, deployment, testing, and acceptance activities across customer environments.
- Drive continuous improvement across architecture practices, standards, and tooling.

Stakeholder & Project Collaboration
- Work closely with bid teams, project managers, engineers, security specialists, and customer stakeholders.
- Identify technical risks and develop effective mitigation strategies.
- Support knowledge transfer into operational support teams.
- Mentor engineers and promote knowledge sharing across the cryptographic services community.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise PKI and cryptographic solutions.
- Strong understanding of:- Certificate Authorities (CA)
- Certificate lifecycle management
- Root of trust architectures
- Digital certificates and digital signatures
- Hands-on experience with enterprise PKI platforms such as:- Keyfactor
- EJBCA
- Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS)
- Azure Certificate Services
- Evertrust

- Experience leading technical solutions across bids, proposals, and complex programmes.
- Strong technical documentation and stakeholder communication skills.
- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business-focused recommendations.
- Experience working across the full project lifecycle from bid through delivery and into service.

Desirable Experience
- Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) planning and migration.
- Cryptographic standards and frameworks including NCSC, NIST, ETSI, ISO and IEC standards.
- Scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
- Identity & Access Management (IAM) integration.
- Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) or Operational Technology (OT) environments.
- Application and cloud security technologies.

Qualifications
- Degree-qualified in Engineering, Cyber Security, Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Experience in PKI administration, cryptographic systems design, or cryptographic services delivery.
- Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are highly desirable.

Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of secure communications, helping customers solve some of their most complex security challenges. You'll have the chance to influence strategic solutions, work with emerging technologies, and play a key role in advancing cryptographic capabilities in an increasingly security-conscious and post-quantum world.
If you're passionate about security architecture, cryptographic services, and delivering innovative solutions that matter, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Customer Service Officer
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

OUR BENEFITS
- Permanent Part Time (3 days per week)
- $76,871 + Super (Pro rated to 3 days per week)
- Fitness Passport Discount – Access to a network of Gyms across
- Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance)
- Modernised Paid Parental Leave
- Veterans Leave
- Family support through our partnership with Parents at Work
- Personal & professional training development opportunities

OUR TEAM

Our Explosive Ordnance Services team enables the Australian Defence Force through storage, distribution, maintenance and disposal of these systems, all across Australia. As a turnkey solution, we offer the opportunity to gain a holistic understanding of our business operations, creating huge opportunities for growth.

Within our logistics services business there are 17+ depots throughout Australia, allowing various development and progression opportunities.

YOUR ROLE

This is an exciting opportunity for a Customer Service Officer / Inventory Coordinator to join our team at our Darwin RAAF site. You will be responsible for managing the inventory functions by operating our stock control computer system, whilst providing great customer service to our customer, the Australian Defence Force (ADF).

This role is exciting, challenging and rewarding; no two days will be the same! As the first point of contact for our customer, the ADF, you will need a positive attitude, be an active listener with excellent attention to detail and the ability to think on your feet. In turn, we will provide you with the training and support needed to succeed.

Based on the Darwin RAAF site, on Larrakia land, your role purpose will be :
- Ensuring accurate operation of the electronic and manual inventory stock management system
- Instruct and train staff as required and to ensure quality standards are maintained
- Planning and controlling work activities, including resource allocation and time management
- Maintain all Technical Publications relevant to the operation of the Inventory Office
- Building & maintaining relationships with both internal and external clients
- Demonstrating a personal commitment to all matters relating to health and safety

YOUR EXPERIENCE

- Relevant experience in a similar environment
- Excellent communication skills at all levels
- Knowledge of inventory management systems would be desirable
- Experience within the Defence and/or Logistics environment would be highly advantageous

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY

After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process.

Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/.
In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role. The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

#LI-DZ1

It’s easy to dismiss the perfect opportunity if you don’t see yourself as the perfect fit. If this role feels right – no matter your background or personal circumstances – please introduce yourself or join our community. We’re committed to supporting a diverse workplace, and that starts here.

We’re proud to be endorsed by WORK180 as an Employer for All Women, but we know there’s always more we can do. We’ll continue to foster industry partnerships, employee resource groups (ERGs) and development opportunities to make Thales a genuinely equitable employer, for everyone.

Read more about our WORK180 endorsement.

postings.title: Customer Success Manager
postings.location: Makati City, National Capital Region, Philippines
postings.description:
Location: Maynila, Philippines

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In the Philippines, Thales has been a trusted partner for over 20 years, supporting key customers across civil aviation, defence, and digital identity and security sectors. From banking and telecommunications to government services, Thales continues to provide solutions in technological advancements that bolster national security and enhance local defence capabilities.

Overview: The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for maintaining and growing relationships with our key customers, driving a positive experience for them. The Customer Success Manager will work closely with the customer to ensure that they are getting the most value out of our product, and will work with internal teams to drive adoption and expansion of our product within the customer's organization.
Key Responsibilities:

CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT
- Act as the main point of contact for newly won or existing SaaS customers, building and maintaining strong relationships
- Support customers from implementation through the Adopt, Expand and Renew sales cycles of contracted services to drive long-term account success and value
- Collaborate with Land Sales team to ensure optimal responsibility transition from the Land towards the Adopt phase of our customer engagements
- Be accountable for successful customer onboarding journey by working closely with Thales delivery teams and the customer, to drive a smooth integration and adoption of our services, and ensure a fast project completion in order to maximize revenue generation
- Lead and manage critical conflict resolution, to ensure excellent customer service and experience with Thales
- Become the voice of customer, and provide feedback to internal teams in regards to the needs and recommendations on new products and services definition

ENGAGE (THROUGH DATA)
- Leverage on customer and platform data to track services usage, and work with the customer to identify areas for improvement, training needs, product enhancements that drive customer satisfaction, retention and trigger opportunities for sales expansion
- Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer expectations, and proactively propose to the customer better ways to optimize the use of our products, maximizing the value for both our customer and ourselves

DRIVE SUCCESS
- Become an expert on each client’s business and market segment, develop a trusted advisor relationship with customers and executive sponsors, build a plan to support customer and Thales to achieve the success for the partnership
- Prepare and educate customers on new features and releases by collaborating with various internal teams within Thales
- Identify and nurture sales expansion opportunities within the current contract scope with our customers, until effective closing
- Collaborate with Land Sales team in identifying and building a plan for up-sell opportunities for new products and services within the scope of your customer portfolio
- Report on key SaaS metrics, such as services adoption, expansion, and retention to the Sales Management team for regular business reviews
- Responsible for providing revenues forecasts through our CRM tool for the platform services subscribed by our customers, and as well contribute to the project resources forecasts exercise

RENEW
- Conduct periodic customer health-checks, and when necessary, conduct surveys, to proactively identify and address any potential risks to the relationship
- Identify renewal risks and collaborate with internal teams(SRE, CRE) to remediate them ahead of renewal negotiations
- Lead and close the contract and price renewals with customers, through a strong collaboration with Thales teams (Finance, Legal, Product Line, and others) to maximize value and minimize risks for Thales

Qualifications:
- He/She should have 5 years and more experience minimum in a sales or Account Executive position within the Financial Institutions and/or FinTech industry with the ability to coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders in a complex sale process.
- He/She should have an understanding and experience with payment ecosystem (tokenization/ digital wallet) in Philippines
- Strong business understanding of SaaS solutions, preferably cloud technology and agile delivery models and how they apply to the financial services industry in Philippines market.
- Awareness on Payment Cards and Personalization industry
- Degree in Business, Marketing or Engineering or another relevant field of study; or equivalent work experience.
- Data-driven, strategic thinker with experience analyzing and synthesizing information and then leveraging that insight to drive customer engagement, actions, and improvements
- Exceptionally strong customer service skills, , including issue tracking, triaging and crisis management, managing large customers portfolios
- Strong leadership skills with a focus on influencing decision making by using data points.
- Strong analytical/problem-solving skills; demonstrated success in driving complex strategies and projects.
- Outstanding organizational skills and agility.
- Ability to travel domestically up to 50% of the time.
- Proficiency in English.
- Ability to Create and maintain trusted and lasting relationships and influence key decision makers, particularly at C-suite level in Financial Institutions.
- Proven ability to identify expansion and upsell opportunities.
Ability to work well in a team-oriented envi

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Dans notre division avionique en charge du soutien clients, vous intégrez les équipes en charge de la relation clients de la zone Europe de l’Ouest et Afrique du Nord en tant que Customer Support Manager (F/H). Votre portefeuille clients est constitué de compagnies aériennes, centres de réparation et de maintenance, avionneurs, brokers et loueurs d’avions. Les produits supportés sont des équipements avioniques embarqués et de divertissement cabine. Votre rôle est d’assurer l’interface directe avec les équipes en charge de la relation client, du support technique, des programmes en service, de la finance et du recouvrement, des contrats, du retrofit, de la logistique dans le but ultime de la satisfaction client.
Vos principales missions :
- Être à l’écoute des clients concernant les problèmes techniques et non techniques et proposer des solutions sur mesure en collaboration avec divers services internes (résolution de problèmes).

- Superviser nos engagements contractuels et soutenir les besoins opérationnels.

- Contribuer au développement de la satisfaction client, collaborer avec l’équipe de gestion des comptes pour coordonner les solutions à proposer.

- Transmettre les problèmes/suggestions des clients en interne pour améliorer les services de Thales.

Ce poste nécessite des déplacements réguliers en Europe.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 dans le domaine du commerce ou équivalent et justifiez d’une solide expérience dans le domaine aéronautique ?
Vous maîtrisez la gestion de la relation client et des contrats ?
Vous parlez couramment anglais ?
Idéalement, vous avez de bonnes connaissances de nos produits avioniques et de divertissement (IFE) ?
Votre approche proactive axée sur la réussite client vous permet d’être efficace dans la résolution de problèmes ?
Vous avez de bonnes connaissances des outils de CRM (SalesForce, …) ?
Vous avez le sens du service et une approche orientée client ?
Très bonne communication, écoute active, sens de l’organisation et du détail, autonomie et esprit d’équipe sont autant d’atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

CANDIDATES THAT WOULD IMPRESS US

PROFILE:

You graduated with a Master of Engineering or Computer Science or in University, and you have significant experience in IT & security domain
You are methodical and autonomous
You are a self-motivated leader, willing to engage and develop your team using collaborative work and challenging approaches
You have excellent interpersonal skills and have experience in a direct customer facing role and ready to travel very regularly
You are an effective communicator
You are flexible, pro-active and excellent resistance to stress
You are meticulous and pay attention to detail
You are customer focused, you want to deliver value or solutions to the customer
You have good analytical skills with business acumen
COMPETENCIES:

You are familiar with the main risk analysis methods (EBIOS, ISO 27005), regulatory constraints (LPM, NIS, RGPD, II 901, IGI 1300) and security standards (ISO 27000, NIST, ANSSI, etc)
You are able to identify, analyse and evaluate cybersecurity and information risks
You have knowledge of Authentication and Identity management solutions
You have experience in database administration (mainly Oracle, MySQL and MS SQL)
You can demonstrate knowledge in programming background and experience (Java, C++, .NET, SQL, XML)
You have a good sense of IT security awareness
You have basic knowledge and background in Cryptography and Security, including PKI, digital signature, encryption, certificates, HSM and cryptographic APIs (PKCS#11, OpenSSL,…)

LIFE AS A THALES CYBERSECURITY CONSULTING ROLE

As a Cybersecurity Consulting Role within Thales, you will:

Conduct audits and consulting services in the field of cybersecurity (architecture reviews and recommendations, compliance with best practices, etc.)
Carry out risk assessments, define cybersecurity governance strategies, processes and security policies for our internal and external customers
Provide advice and recommendations on improving the security level
Implement security methods and processes to perform security risk analysis
Assist in the integration of security standards and provide expertise in the implementation of cybersecurity projects
Analyse the functional and technical needs of our clients to provide them with insight into the security solutions adapted to their needs
Check compliance with applicable regulations, standards, policies and guidance on cybersecurity and information risk management (PCI DSS, NIST, ISO 27000, Privacy, etc)
Support the development of appropriate and proportionate documentation to inform risk management decisions, ensuring these are expressed in terms meaningful to the business

YOUR CAREER AT THALES

Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas:

Room and attention to personal development
Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

CCNL Met/Ind – B3 Category
€ 41.424,25 - € 51.823,67
