postings.title: E2 Manager
postings.description:
Lieu : Toulouse, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Votre destination pour une maîtrise totale du ciel ! De la conception à l'installation, nous créons des systèmes de contrôle aérien de pointe ! Nous rendons l'accès à l'espace aérien fluide, équitable et durable.

Au sein de Thales AMS (Airspace Mobility Solutions), leader mondial des solutions de gestion du trafic aérien, vous rejoignez l'équipe Global Business Efficiency & Engineering Operations. Vous évoluez dans un environnement international avec des équipes réparties en France, au Portugal, en Italie, en Roumanie, aux États-Unis, en Inde, à Singapour et en Australie, au sein d'une organisation Agile à l'échelle.

En tant qu'E2 Manager (Engineering Environment Manager), vous êtes responsable de la performance, de la transformation et de l'évolution des environnements d'ingénierie Software et Système utilisés par l'ensemble des produits, projets et services d'AMS.
À ce titre, vous :
- Pilotez le déploiement et l'évolution des environnements d'ingénierie en cohérence avec la stratégie d'ingénierie du Groupe ;
- Définissez l'architecture des workbenchs et des outils d'ingénierie, tout en garantissant leur cohérence et leur performance ;
- Assurez l'interface entre les équipes d'ingénierie et les fonctions IS/IT afin de garantir la disponibilité, la sécurité et l'efficacité des solutions ;
- Accompagnez les équipes à travers des actions de formation, de coaching et de support sur les processus et pratiques d'ingénierie ;
- Définissez et pilotez le budget E2 ainsi que le portefeuille de licences associé ;
- Animez un réseau international d'experts afin de favoriser la convergence des pratiques, la simplification et la rationalisation des environnements d'ingénierie à l'échelle mondiale.
Votre profil
Vous souhaitez contribuer à la transformation des pratiques d'ingénierie dans un environnement international et à forte dimension technologique ?
Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un Master 2 dans les domaines de l'informatique, de l'électronique, de l'aéronautique ou d'une discipline équivalente, vous justifiez d'une expérience solide dans les pratiques d'ingénierie appliquées à des projets complexes.
Vous avez développé des compétences en :
- Ingénierie systèmes et gestion de programmes complexes ;
- Pilotage d'environnements de développement et d'intégration dans des contextes critiques ;
- Méthodologies Lean et Agile à l'échelle ;
- DevSecOps, intégration continue et déploiement continu ;
- Technologies telles que GitLab CI, Jira, Jenkins et les outils collaboratifs d'ingénierie ;
- Architectures Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes et environnements Cloud Ready / Cloud Native.
Vous êtes reconnu pour votre crédibilité technique, votre leadership transverse, votre capacité d'analyse, votre aptitude à influencer et votre aisance relationnelle dans des contextes complexes et multiculturels ?
Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif, aimez accompagner les équipes dans leur montée en compétence et souhaitez jouer un rôle de mentor auprès de vos interlocuteurs ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous.
La connaissance des environnements AMS constituera un atout supplémentaire pour accélérer votre prise de fonction et contribuer à la transformation de nos pratiques d'ingénierie à l'échelle mondiale.
Thales reconnaît tous les talents, la diversité est notre meilleur atout !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Electrical Engineer
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

OUR BENEFITS
- Family Friendly Workplace Certified company with Competitive Remuneration.

- Fitness Passport Discount + Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance).

- Modernised Paid Parental Leave.

- Veterans Leave.

- Personal & professional training, development and internal growth opportunities.

OUR TEAM
As part of our VTS business, our PRV team is primarily focused on the design, manufacture, delivery and support of protected mobility vehicles on a global scale. We are very proud of everything we do in support of both the Bushmaster and Hawkei platforms as we all work together towards our purpose. Most importantly – be a part of a positive team culture that is focused on our people.

Thales Australia is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of critical capability for Defence Land vehicle programs. This is a 12 month Fixed-Term Contract role which can be based at our Bendigo site.

The Electrical / C4I Engineer is responsible for the design, integration, verification, and support of Command, Control, Communications, Computers and Intelligence (C4I) systems within complex Defence programs. This role applies electrical and communications engineering expertise to deliver reliable, secure, interoperable, and operationally effective solutions that meet customer and mission requirements.

Working within multidisciplinary teams, the successful candidate will contribute to system design, integration, testing, and certification activities while managing technical risks and ensuring compliance with engineering standards and customer requirements.

YOUR ROLE:
- Design, develop, integrate, and support C4I systems and subsystems.

- Develop electrical and communications engineering solutions for complex operational environments.

- Produce and review technical drawings, 3D models, schematics, and engineering documentation using CAD software.

- Develop and maintain engineering artefacts including requirements, specifications, interface definitions, design descriptions, and test procedures.

- Conduct engineering activities across the system lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, integration, verification, validation, and acceptance.

- Support the design and integration of tactical and strategic communications systems.

- Analyse communications architectures, networks, RF systems, data links, and associated infrastructure.

- Ensure communications solutions meet performance, interoperability, cybersecurity, and operational requirements.

- Plan and execute integration, test, verification, validation, and acceptance activities.

- Investigate and resolve technical issues identified during development, integration, testing, and operational deployment.

- Support platform, network, and mission system integration activities.

- Collaborate with customers, suppliers, project teams, and end users to deliver effective technical outcomes.

- Provide technical advice and recommendations to project and engineering leadership.

- Participate in design reviews, technical working groups, and customer engagements.

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:
- Demonstrated experience in Electrical Engineering within Defence, communications, or complex integrated systems environments.

- Experience integrating military C4I systems onto land platforms.

- Knowledge of RF systems, electrical power systems, and networked communications.

- Experience working with radios, amplifiers, filters, couplers, and antennas.

- Proficiency in CAD software, particularly Creo Parametric and Creo Schematic.

- Experience supporting Verification and Validation (V&V), testing, certification, and acceptance activities.

- Tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

- Experience handling Australian and US Government classified information and Australian export-controlled information.

- Australian Citizenship is required to be eligible to obtain an NV1 Security Clearance.

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY:
After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process. Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

As a Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance. To learn more about clearances please visit http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/

postings.title: Electrical Lead Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

Electrical Lead Engineer
Over het team
Binnen de afdeling MEE (Mechanical & Electrical Engineering) is het team Electrical Design verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp en de integratie van alle (elektrische) subsystemen die samen een radar- of gevechtsmanagementsysteem vormen. De producten die we ontwerpen, worden over de hele wereld gebruikt om een toekomst te bouwen waarop we allemaal kunnen vertrouwen.
De ontwikkeling van deze systemen vereist een multidisciplinaire aanpak met behulp van state-of-the-art technologie, initiatief en teamwork. Onze producten werken en worden onderhouden onder extreme omstandigheden. Dit vereist dat we verder kijken, en de technische grenzen van componenten opzoeken om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan.
Binnen deze grote organisatie zijn we onze persoonlijke aanpak niet uit het oog verloren. We hebben een leuke werkomgeving, fijne collega’s en zijn erg flexibel.
Over jouw toekomstige baan
Wil jij jouw leiderschap, technische en teamwork vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen? We zijn op zoek naar iemand die het elektrische focuspunt van een van onze productsegmenten kan zijn.
Ben jij in staat om meerdere Electrical Engineers te coachen, begeleiden en te ondersteunen waarbij je creativiteit en persoonlijk initiatief bevorderd? De Electrical Lead Engineer leidt een divers team van (junior-medior-senior) engineers om producten op te leveren. We maken onze elektrische schema’s in Eplan en beheren onze producten in ons PLM-systeem Windchill. Waarbij we altijd op zoek zijn naar manieren om onze werkmethodes en software te optimaliseren.
Creëer jij kansen en zet jij jouw invloed in om belangrijke projectmijlpalen te halen? De Electrical Lead Engineer werkt nauw samen met de Hardware Architect en de Work Package Manager om de radar en combat managementsystemen van de toekomst te ontwerpen binnen tijd en budget.
Je bent in staat om te anticiperen op project- of klantwensen en snel originele, verregaande oplossingen te formuleren. Je werkt samen met de Hardware Engineers in je team, Lead Engineers uit andere disciplines en de Hardware Architect om de oplossing te ontwerpen.
Op een typische dag ga je: bespreken en documenteren van jouw design keuzes. Coach je engineers uit je team en help je met technische problemen of normen. Rapporteert over team voortgang aan jou projectmanager. Troubleshoot je een probleem in een van je designs of prototypes.

Waarom ben jij een goede match
- Hebt een HBO of WO-diploma, in de richting van Elektrotechniek of Mechatronica.

- Wordt gezocht voor de meest kritische, complexe problemen.

- Teambuilding en (technische)mentorschap vaardigheden.

- Komt opdagen om de wereld beter te maken door betere producten te bouwen.

- Weet de balans te slaan tussen perfectie en tempo. Je levert op tijd en binnen budget.

- Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden heeft in zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

- Deze positie vereist dat je een Nederlandse security clearance kunt krijgen.

Wat krijg jij ervoor terug
- Een uitdagende baan in een leuk team binnen onze hightech, innovatieve werkomgeving. Inclusief alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën.

- Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, commercieel of internationaal vlak.

- Waardevolle internationale samenwerkingen met collega’s uit 68 landen.

- Een comfortabele werkplek in een moderne omgeving, met aandacht voor flexibiliteit en de juiste work-life balance.

- Werken kan meestal waar en wanneer je wil om je werk zo goed en efficiënt mogelijk te kunnen doen. Binnen Thales implementeren we het hybride werken, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld twee dagen in de week thuis kunt werken.

- Een goed salaris, passende reiskostenvergoeding en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden te personaliseren: je kunt bijvoorbeeld vrije dagen ruilen voor internetkosten, ons fietsenplan, bedrijfsfitness en verhuiskosten.

- 40 vakantiedagen per jaar. Ja, echt.

Interesse?
Solliciteer nu door hieronder op ‘Apply now’ te klikken!
Om er zeker van te zijn dat we een goede match vormen kunnen we je vragen deel te nemen aan een assessment.

Diversiteitsstatement
We vinden dat je baan de juiste work/life balance moet ondersteunen en het platform is om jóuw ambities waar te maken. Dat betekent dat gelijke kansen, inclusiviteit en een informele cultuur een essentieel onderdeel uitmaken van ons succes. Maar ook dat jouw gezondheid en geluk voor ons erg belangrijk zijn! Daarom bieden we je de flexibiliteit om te doen wat voor jóu belangrijk is; of dat nu parttime werken is, of werken vanuit huis, of de mogelijkheid om flexibel te zijn in je start- en eindtijden, we denken met je mee.

postings.title: Electrical Technician
postings.description:
Location: Den Helder, Netherlands

Over het team:
In de huidige wereld van dreiging is de operationele beschikbaarheid van onze klanten van groot belang en daarmee het verlenen van een goede service. Binnen Thales Hengelo is Services een domein wat sterk groeit en is één van de speerpunten voor de toekomst. De services worden geleverd op de geleverde radarsystemen, waaronder technische assistenties, reparaties, overhauls en modificaties/ upgrades. De totale Services-afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 100 mensen.

Over jouw toekomstige baan:
In de functie van elektromonteur maak je deel uit van een team van monteurs en test engineers die werkzaam zijn namens Thales bij de onderhoudsorganisatie van de Koninklijke Marine (DMI) in Den Helder. De Marine heeft meerdere schepen die zijn uitgerust met high tech radarsystemen van Thales en gedurende de gehele levenscyclus ondersteuning nodig hebben. Daarnaast wordt in Den Helder ook voor de Koninklijke Landmacht de radarsystemen onderhouden. Je bent met het team verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoer van verschillende services activiteiten.

Het onboardingstraject voor de functie vindt plaats bij Thales in Hengelo voor een periode tussen de 6 en 12 maanden afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Gedurende deze periode zul je diverse trainingen volgen en inwerken op de GM200-systeem. In Den Helder zul je daarnaast inwerken op andere systemen van Thales.

Na de eerste 6 tot 12 maanden werk je hoofdzakelijk op het terrein bij de Marine en eventueel op klantlocaties over de hele wereld om onze services aan de klanten te leveren om ervoor te zorgen dat de systemen operationeel beschikbaar blijven. Incidenteel zul je bij Thales in Hengelo werken.

Belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
- Monteren van mechatronische (sub)systemen en kabinetten met zowel statische als dynamische delen.
- Aanbrengen en afwerken van bedrading en bundels in radarsystemen.
- Het uitlijnen van radarsystemen.
- Voert preventief en correctief onderhoud uit op de (sub)systemen.
- Voert diagnoses en reparaties van (sub)systemen.
- Voert alle werkzaamheden volgens de richtlijnen uit, op tijd en gestelde kwaliteit.
- Documenteert alle uitgevoerde werkzaamheden in een bijbehorende rapportage.
- Voert inspecties uit van de (sub)systemen op locatie en brengt advies uit voor verbetering werking van het systeem.
- On-the-job trainingen uitvoeren.
- Zorgt voor een veilige werkomgeving (HSE-richtlijnen).
- Continue verbeteren van processen en leveringsresultaten.
- Rapporteren aan het de Team Leider en Afdelingsmanager van de voortgang van de werkzaamheden.

Waarom ben jij een goede match:
- MBO niveau 3 of 4 in de richting van Elektronica of Mechatronica.
- Enige werkervaring in de machinebouw is een pre.
- Oog voor detail.
- Technische tekeningen lezen.
- Een teamplayer.
- Beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
- Stressbestendig en probleem oplossend vermogen
- Klantgericht en professionaliteit in omgang met de externe klant.
- Beschikbaarheid tot (internationale) reizen.

Wat krijg jij er voor terug:
- Een uitdagende baan in een leuk team binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving. Inclusief alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën.
- Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, commercieel of internationaal vlak.
- Waardevolle internationale samenwerkingen met collega’s en klanten.
- Een comfortabele werkplek in een moderne omgeving, met aandacht voor flexibiliteit en de juiste werk-privé balans.

postings.title: Electro-Optical (EO) Payload Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
The Electro-Optical (EO) Payload Systems Engineer will be responsible for the definition, development, and validation of the image acquisition chain for space-based optical instruments based on space image sensors.

Key responsibilities include:
- System Architecture & Requirements- Define the architecture of the video acquisition chain.
- Derive and specify requirements for the image acquisition chain components based on system-level needs
- Specification of readout electronics hardware.
- Specification of FPGA firmware for detector control and video chain interfacing.
- Interface definition with onboard data handling systems.

- Procurement & Technical Follow-Up- Provide technical support during procurement of image sensors and related electronics.
- Manage supplier technical follow-up and ensure compliance with specifications.

- Laboratory Activities & Validation Test - Support the integration and bring-up of the video acquisition subsystem in laboratory environments.
- Lead the characterization of image sensors and acquisition chain performance.
- Define and specify OGSE/EGSE for sensor testing.
- Develop detailed test plans and measurement protocols.
- Execute test campaigns in ISO-8/ISO-5 cleanroom environments.
- Implement structured image processing pipelines for data analysis.
- Generate comprehensive performance test reports.

- Integration & Support- Support integration of optical sensors into focal planes and interfacing with front-end electronics.
- Provide technical assistance to manufacturing and AIT teams for sensor handling and operation.

- Documentation & Reviews- Prepare technical documentation for internal and external reviews.
- Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and verification activities.

Education and Training
- Master’s degree in Engineering, ideally specialized in Electrical Engineering with a focus on electro-optical systems.
Experience and Skills

Required:
- Minimum 5 years of experience in electronics design, integration and validation.
- Experience with FPGA development (firmware development, timing/sequencing, high-speed interfaces).
- Experience in characterization test plan definition and test bench design.

Strongly Valued:
- Expertise in image sensors and readout electronics, (Visible/IR, CMOS/CCD/microbolometers).
- Practical experience with electro-optical instrumentation for lab and spacecraft-oriented development (sensor control, biasing, synchronization, acquisition).
- Solid understanding of low-noise analog and high-speed digital electronics.
- Familiarity with optical focal plane concepts and performance metrics, including radiometry and MTF (and how these translate into measurable detector/ROIC requirements).
- Experience building and using test/measurement data pipelines for sensor and readout characterization using Python and/or MATLAB

Valued:
- Experience with space qualification processes and environmental testing (TVAC, vibration).
- Familiarity with cleanroom protocols and handling of sensitive optical components.
- Familiarity with ECSS standards and space project lifecycle.
- Knowledge of EMVA Standard 1288 for image sensor characterization.
- Experience with radiation effects on detectors and mitigation strategies.
Soft Skills and Attributes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
- Proactive and autonomous working style.
- Fluent in both Spanish and English (spoken and written); French is a plus
- Service-oriented and committed to meeting project deliverables

What do we offer?
- Flexible schedule, from 8 to 9.30 and 16.30 until 18h.
- Thales Concilia: a set of advantages and free services and others at reduced prices.
- Free and healthy canteen.
- Enjoy discounts and special promotions on products and services thanks to Club Ahorro.
- 22 working days of vacation, 6 days of free disposal and closing days that do not consume vacations at Christmas and Easter.
- Thales Flex: Personalized flexible compensation plan in which you can choose how to distribute your salary (health insurance, childcare vouchers, transportation and training).
- Annual bonus.
- Fixed profit bonus of 739,76€.
- Sharing Thales program: become a Thales shareholder.
- Hybrid work plan.
- Pension Plan with monthly contributions on your behalf to your Pension Plan.
- Wellness Plan: thematic webinars and access to our company clubs.
- Medical and physiotherapy service at the workplace.
- We continuously create an inclusive, respectful and cooperative environment.

#SPACEFORLIFE

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now!

postings.title: Electronic Warfare System Architect
postings.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) UK is a principal supplier of Electronic Warfare (EW), Radar and UAS equipment to the UK armed forces, as well as an exporter of these capabilities worldwide.

We are looking for senior engineers with the skills and experience to enhance our EW portfolio, delivering cutting edge products including:
- Digital Radar Electronic Support Measures (RESM) that provides situational awareness and identify threats even in busy electronic transmission environments
- Radar Electronic Countermeasures (RECM) that can protect assets by denying tactical advantage and distracting incoming threats.

We are seeking EW Systems Architects with experience of working within the field of Electronic Warfare and/or Radar, or related fields such as RESM, CESM, ECM or similar. You will have prior knowledge of the key principles of the domain and can quickly grasp the science and technology that sits behind a modern digital EW suite. You may have a military background, having operated EW equipment in the field, or have worked in the design, development or testing of similar products.

As an EW Systems Architect you’ll be working alongside other engineers, procurement and production teams to drive our EW product line forward, both in terms of Features and Non-Functional characteristics to meet the growing demands of our customers.

Role Description
In an EW System and Solution Architecture Role within Thales, you will:
- Define and recommend candidate architectures for the corresponding level (solution or solution element) to satisfy stakeholder expectations according to the standards and re-use policies, the technology roadmap and the business strategy
- Establish the solution architecture by making trade-offs between stakeholder expectations, technical and technological solutions and costs, risks and schedule, document the associated artefacts (architecture justification in the design and justification file, product breakdown structure, system/segment design document) and approve the resulting lower-level specifications (internal or external)
- Assist in the solution development cycle and in defining the co-engineering approach
- Manage, all along the project life cycle, the assignment of the corresponding level requirements, the management of the performance evaluation and the critical parameters, the definition of the interfaces, the technical negotiation between the different stakeholders (internal or external).

Principal Relationships
- EW Product Line Engineers, Architects and Managers
- EW Project Delivery Teams (including Project Management)
- Domain Technical and Engineering Managers
- Domain Functional Management
- The wider multi-discipline engineering team

Experienced required

Profile
- You graduated with an Engineering or Scientific degree, and you have significant experience in architecture and engineering systems
- You are a leader willing to engage and develop your team through the use of collaborative work and challenging approaches
- You are responsible and show a great sense of initiative
- You are convincing and persuasive
- You like to be involved with the customer
- You have good communication and relationship skills

Competencies
- You are aware of the description of the operational concept
- You have a deep knowledge of the field and its technical strategy
- You are familiar with operational analysis
- You are able to work in co-engineering (Lean Thinking, Obeya...)
- You understand the different actors involved in the project and are able to contextualise and change the perspective (political, economic, social, technical, environmental, legal...)
- You are familiar with Concept, Design, Experimentation and Simulation tools, as well as modelling tools and frameworks
- You are familiar with working with Integration Verification Validation Qualification and Agile methods

Desired Knowledge or Skills
- Experience in EW Domain concepts
- Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
- System Design
- RF Systems (EW, CESM, Comms)
- RF Performance Modelling/Budgets

Your Career at Thales UK
Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your Competencies in different areas:
- Room and attention to personal development
- Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
- Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
- Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

What we can offer
We are committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.

Our packages will include significant bonus, car allowance, a strong pension contribution, private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities. Further support can be provided towards academic and membership attainments.

Security Clearance Statement
This role will require UK Security Check (SC) clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC clearance.
To be eligible for full SC clearance, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) check and SC please refer to the United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) website: United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

postings.title: Electronics Production & Process Engineer (Hybrid)
postings.description:
Location: Madrid, Spain

Thales people architect solutions at the heart of the defence-security continuum. Interoperable and secure information and telecommunications systems for defence, security, and civil operators, are based upon innovative use of radiocommunications, networks, and cybersecurity. We are ground breaking new digital technologies such as 4G mobile communications, cryptography, cloud computing and big data for use in physical protection systems, and critical information systems.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

In Defence and security, armed forces, governments and global organizations entrust Thales with helping them achieve and maintain security, tactical superiority and strategic independence in the face of any type of threat. In an increasingly unpredictable world, governments rely on our expertise to protect their citizens and make the world safer, from designing smart sensors and connecting soldiers on the digital battlefield to delivering solutions that protect states, cities and critical infrastructures.

In Spain, Thales Sistemas is specialized in Command and Control systems, Tactical Communications and Modeling and Simulation addressing solutions in the domain of Defense and Security. Thales is the Spanish leader in tactical Land CIS (Communication and Information Systems) covering all the product life cycle (design, development, production, ILS). Based in Leganés, Thales Sistemas employs a highly specialized workforce of more than 100 people, most of them engineers that participate in the following activities:
- Communications and Information Systems (CIS) to support Command function and Decision Making
- Embedded electronics for military aircraft
- Tactical Communications
- Radio Navigation Aids for air traffic

As an Electronics Production & Process Engineer, you will play a key role in the continuous improvement of our manufacturing systems, ensuring quality, efficiency, and compliance with standards. Your main responsibilities will include:
- Design, implement, and optimize electronic production processes (PCB assembly, testing, and subcontractor management).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalability, reliability, and alignment with product requirements.
- Analyze production data to identify improvement opportunities (lead time reduction, cost savings, defect minimization).
- Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, ESD, etc.).
- Drive automation and digitalization initiatives (PLM/ERP systems, data analysis tools like Power BI/Python).
- Troubleshoot technical issues on the production line and propose innovative solutions for process enhancements.

postings.title: Embedded Software Architect (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Standort: Stuttgart, Germany

We Say HI*

Embedded Software Architect (m/w/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

In Ditzingen erwarten Sie Sicherheitslösungen zur Überwachung und Absicherung von Grenzen und Grenzkontrollen, für den Schutz ziviler und militärischer Einrichtungen sowie für die taktische Kommunikation. Hier sind Sie richtig, wenn Sie gemeinsam mit uns taktische und einsatzerprobte Funkgeräte für die vernetzte Operationsführung im militärischen Einsatz enzwickeln und produzieren wollen. Werden Sie Teil des Thales-Expertenteams für Funkgeräte, Cybersecurity und Kryptographie, für Verschlüsselungskomponenten und Hardware-Security-Module sowie für elektronische Schlüsselmanagementsysteme. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

Ihre Mission als „Embedded Software Architect (m/w/d) “:

- Ableitung und Design der Softwarearchitektur aus der Systemarchitektur für kryptografische Geräte im Bereich Sicherheitstechnik

- Entwicklung modularer und wiederverwendbarer Softwarekomponenten mit abstrakten Schnittstellen für flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten in verschiedenen Projekten

- Berücksichtigung gerätespezifischer Randbedingungen sowie Implementierung von Schutzmaßnahmen für sensible Daten in der Embedded Software

- Ganzheitliche Begleitung des Entwicklungsprozesses von der Angebotsphase über die Spezifikation und Entwicklung bis hin zur Serienproduktion der Geräte

- Technische Erfassung, Analyse und Umsetzung von Kundenanforderungen in robuste Softwarekonzepte und Architekturen

- Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Systemzeichnungen und Konzeptpapiere zur Unterstützung von Entwicklung und Projektabwicklung inklusive Continuous-Integration-Plattformen

- Fachliche Führung und Koordination des Embedded Softwareentwicklungsteams zur Einhaltung von Richtlinien, Erreichung von Meilensteinen und erfolgreicher Bearbeitung von Arbeitspaketen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Hardwareentwicklern, IVVQ-Teams und Projektverantwortlichen

Darauf freuen wir uns:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Nachrichten-/Informationstechnik, Technische Informatik oder vergleichbar

- Langjährige Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler und -architekt mit Schwerpunkt auf hardwarenaher Softwareentwicklung in C/C++ inklusive Templates und komponentenbasierter Programmierung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Aufbau und der Definition von Continuous Integration Toolchains sowie Anwendung moderner Entwicklungstools wie Enterprise Architect, UML, Jira und Confluence

- Praktische Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsprozessen und MethodenKenntnisse und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Zulassungsprojekten, insbesondere CC-Zulassungen und deren spezifischen Prozessen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2025 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.
Für mehr als 85.000 Mitarbeitende in 65 Ländern eröffnen wir zukunftsweisende Perspektiven, verwirklichen individuelle Karrierewege und ermöglichen kreative Freiräume. Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.

Wenn die Zeichen der Zeit auf Veränderung stehen, sind unsere internationalen Teams da, um der Komplexität von heute mit den branchenführenden Technologien von morgen zu begegnen. Sind Sie dabei? Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-BP1

postings.description:
Lieu : Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 81 000 collaborateurs dans 68 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 81 000 collaborateurs dans 68 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à La Ciotat, vous intégrez un site idéalement localisé sur le littoral méditerranéen, au sein d'un environnement international regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques.

Description du projet / rôle / missions

L’équipe Smart Mobility de Thales Cybersecurity Digital Identity recherche un(e) architecte logiciel pour accélérer le développement de ses solutions embarquées autour de la cybersécurité et des clés digitales.
Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des architectures et émettrez des exigences techniques pour garantir que Thales propose des produits et des solutions fiables, sécurisées répondant aux attentes des clients ou partenaires l’écosystème de clés numériques.

Le poste est basé à La Ciotat ou à Meudon, avec la possibilité de télétravailler en partie.

Vous occuperez le rôle de ‘Project Design Authority’ (PDA) pour la ligne de produits embarqués dédiés à la cybersécurité notamment les produits s’inscrivant dans l’écosystème Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC) Digital Key, à date la solution embarquée dans les véhicules basée sur ‘Secure Element’ et les cartes NFC.

A ce titre, vous serez le partenaire technique du Product/Project Manager en charge de :
-Valider tous les choix techniques depuis la conception initiale jusqu’à la livraison suivi de sa maintenance (évolutive ou corrective) tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
-Organiser les revues avec les pairs techniques
-Alerter sur potentiel risques techniques et de conduire les actions correctives
Vous serez la principale interface avec les clients pour ce qui est de la clarification ou de la négociation du scope technique afin de réduire les risques et les coûts.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec
-Les architectes ou experts dans les équipes engineering en charge du développement des produits pour s’assurer que le design est conforme avec les attentes des clients, la politique produit, les exigences réglementaires
-Le Engineering Delivery Manager pour planifier toutes les tâches techniques et identifier les risques dans la Delivery du produit
-Le Cyber Compliance Officer en charge de la conformité avec les exigences cyber.
Vous contribuez aux délivrables et revues corresponds aux jalons nécessaires à la bonne application des process Automotive SPICE (A-SPICE) et Automotive SCMS (ACSMS – ISO/IEC 21434).

Vous occuperez également le rôle de ‘Product Line Architect’ (PLA) sur cette ligne de produits.
En tant que tel, vous serez responsable de l’architecture des différents produits, des choix techniques et de leur roadmap technique. Vous serez le leader technique sur cette gamme de produits, préparerez la partie technique de Product Plan géré par le ‘Product Line Manager’ et participerez aux ‘Product Decision Reviews’.

Vous participerez aux évolutions du standard CCC Digital Key en collaborations avec les différents membres du consortium – fabricants de téléphones, fabricants de véhicules, équipementiers – pour répondre aux nouveaux usages identifiés adressant plus largement les services autour de la mobilités (gestion de flottes, location de véhicules, robot-taxi) et une plus large gamme de véhicules (2-roues, micromobilité, camions, véhicules industriels ou agricoles …)

Votre profil

Vous avez envie de contribuer à l’avenir de la mobilité connectée et sécurisée ?

De formation Ingénieur (ou équivalent), vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture logicielle ou l'architecture de solutions de bout en bout.
Les compétences recherchées pour ce rôle sont les suivantes :
•Aptitude à maîtriser la complexité, à définir les exigences techniques des composants dans le scope de Thales à partir de spécifications complexes au niveau système et à justifier des choix opérés tout en étant à l’écoute des différentes parties prenantes pour mettre en oeuvre les meilleures solutions.
•Capacité à construire des relations de confiances avec les parties prenantes internes ou externe, à donner de la cohérence aux concepts multiples et à les simplifier.
•Bonne connaissance des mécanismes et technologies utilisés dans les Smart Cards et les Secure Elements.
•Maîtrise des principes de cybersécurité, avec l’aptitude à de concevoir des solutions sécurisées et fiables.
•Faculté à partager une vision avec enthousiasme et persuasion pour mobiliser les partenaires internes et externes

Vous appréciez le travail en équipe, faites preuve d’adaptabilité, de rigueur, d’analyse et avez de bonnes capacités de communication. Vous êtes proactif(ve) et force de proposition.
Vous parlez couramment anglais et êtes prêt(e) à effectuer occasionnellement des déplacements en France ou à l’étranger.
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez-nous !

Software Real Time & Embedded Engineering

CANDIDATES THAT WOULD IMPRESS US

PROFILE:
You graduated with a Master of Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or any other related field
You enjoy working within a DevOps/Agile/Scrum team and being plunged into a challenging environment requiring reactivity and resourcefulness
You want to evolve in a "real time" environment with interactions between "low level" technical aspects, close to the hardware, and ensure that the “high level” functionality expected by the solution is maintained
You are willing to work on small or big devices such as Radar, embedded calculator equipment, Smartcards and Wearables, dedicated for the Telecommunications and IOT businesses, mobile...

You know how to develop on embedded OS Software such as Linux, VxWorks, FastOS Linux
You are experienced in embedded software development such as [C or C++ and VB., NET., ADA, Assembly programming]
You are familiar with the use of tools and equipment involved in programming performance (including measuring instruments)
You master the development/adaptation of simulation tools and means necessary to carry out integration/testing activities on platform
You are experienced in embedded system and application design and configuration (both wayside and onboard) and relevant communication protocols and interfaces such as [DDS, ARINC...]
You have substantial knowledge of:
Building a strategy based on your understanding of the business issues involving data processes
Mathematics and statistics
Data technologies
You are able to take into account customer needs
You have working experience/knowledge with cloud provider like AWS or GCP
You have experience with automated deployment and associated technologies (Helm/Yaml/Ansible/Docker)
You are familiar with tools such as JIRA and Confluence
Fluent English (at least C1), both spoken and written.

LIFE AS A THALES SOFTWARE REAL TIME & EMBEDDED ENGINEERING ROLE
As a Software Real Time & Embedded Engineering Role within Thales, you will:
Design, implement and test features with scalability, performance, deployment or operation and end-user experience in mind
Apply coding/implementation best practices to produce elegant, high quality and reusable code
Implement and follow security best practices for web applications
Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge and improve overall product/solution
Keep up-to-date with latest technologies evolution and frameworks
Interact with UX team to implement and verify user experience concepts
Follow the agile methodology used for the project. This includes creation of user stories and corresponding tasks to help create a robust system based on user-centric design
Regularly archive source code into the source code repository for projects
Participate in issue investigation and deployment of applications and new releases in testing/integration environment as needed

YOUR CAREER AT THALES
Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competencies in different areas:
Room and attention to personal development

Embedded Software Research Engineer
We are looking for an Embedded Software Research Engineer to join our Thales Research & Technology (TRT) team in Reading. This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional software development and work on technologies that don't yet exist in today's products. You'll join a small, expert research team where creativity, experimentation and innovation are encouraged, giving you the chance to explore new concepts, develop proof-of-concept demonstrators, and influence future Thales capabilities.

Working across a variety of cutting-edge projects, you'll combine hands-on embedded software development with research, rapid prototyping and technology exploration. No two projects are the same, offering exposure to a diverse range of technical challenges and emerging technologies. If you're motivated by solving complex engineering problems, learning from experienced research engineers, and seeing your ideas shape future defence and security solutions, this role offers an exceptional environment to develop your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

About Thales Research & Technology
The TRT function sits at the heart of Thales UK's innovation capability, supporting growth across our key market sectors and exploring future technologies and opportunities. Our teams undertake cutting-edge research and development activities, helping shape the next generation of solutions across defence, aerospace, security and digital technologies.

Main Responsibilities
- Develop, integrate and test Embedded C software on embedded platforms.
- Develop proof-of-concept demonstrators and pre-production prototypes for future technologies and products.
- Conduct feasibility studies through analysis, experimentation and rapid prototyping activities.
- Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams
- Take ownership of individual technical activities and adapting to new research areas.

Ideal Experience & Skills
- Experience of hands-on software development in C.
- Experience developing for embedded platforms, ideally using ARM-based processors and real-time operating systems (RTOS).
- Understanding of software engineering standards, processes and best practices, such as MISRA, CERT C, Agile methodologies, Git, CI/CD or related tools.
- Ability to analyse complex technical problems and develop innovative, practical solutions.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and within a team.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree (minimum 2:1), Master's degree or PhD in a relevant Computer Science, Software, Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
- Practical experience developing Embedded C through employment, research projects, placements or postgraduate study.

Benefits
- Performance-related bonus (grade dependent)
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- Hybrid working
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts
- Extensive learning, development and career progression opportunities
- Relocation support may be available where applicable

UK Eyes Only
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held; however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years' residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

A trusted, sovereign Google Cloud region operated end-to-end from within Europe by the joint venture between Thales and Google Cloud. Same Google Cloud power (GKE, compute, data, Vertex AI), European jurisdiction, European operators, Thales-grade cybersecurity.

- Solid Linux fundamentals

- LGTM stack at scale (Loki, Tempo, Mimir specifically)

- GitOps in production (ArgoCD or FluxCD)

- ELK-based security monitoring

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

Votre profil :

De formation Bac+5 type école d’ingénieur ou équivalent en électronique, vous avez une expérience de 10 ans minimum dans le pilotage d'équipe pluridisciplinaire d’ingénierie.
Vous souhaitez diriger une équipe technique dans un environnement stimulant.
Vous souhaitez satisfaire vos clients internes et externes, également établir avec eux des relations solides.
Vous êtes convaincant(e) et persuasif(ve).

D’autre part :
Vous avez de bonnes connaissances techniques dans les domaines suivants :
- Amplificateur RF
- Electronique de puissance et haute tension
- Système ou sous-système durcis (contraintes dimensionnelles et environnementales).

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos qualités relationnelles et de leadership, vous permettant de collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes tout en assurant la cohésion de votre organisation, que vous soutenez par une vision globale et stratégique.
Vous êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement technique, et d'en comprendre les enjeux afin de prendre les décisions et définir les compromis les plus appropriés pour la réussite du projet.
Vous avez un sens développé de l’organisation, et vous savez faire preuve de rigueur.
Vous avez prouvé votre engagement, votre volonté d'amélioration continue et vous encouragez la capitalisation et le partage des connaissances.
Vous maîtrisez suffisamment l’anglais pour tenir des conversations techniques face à un client et pour rédiger des documents en anglais.

Votre quotidien :

Vous serez intégré(e) aux équipes projets de la Delivery Unit « Emetteurs et armes à énergie dirigée ». Vous y travaillerez en étroite relation avec les disciplines d’ingénierie en qualité d’Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM).
L’Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM) est le « Partenaire Ingénierie » du Project Manager (PM).
Vous serez responsable de l’organisation, du pilotage et de la livraison des activités d’ingénierie engagées dans le développement d’un produit ou dans le traitement d’obsolescences. Vous serez garant du respect des coûts, du planning des travaux, ainsi que de la qualité des livrables associés.
Vous serez un membre majeur de l'équipe intégrée projet et acteur clé de sa réussite.
Vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes :
- Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement/traitement d’obsolescence (le comment) en cohérence avec les objectifs donnés par le Project Manager (quoi, quand), ainsi que les moyens matériels et humains nécessaires.
- Définir l'environnement d'ingénierie nécessaire au projet (adaptation des processus, évaluation de la sensibilité des données d’ingénierie, pratiques et outils standards).
- Piloter le développement sur tout son cycle, et assurer la gestion des risques et opportunités associés.
- Coordonner la charge de travail globale de l'ingénierie (activités pluridisciplinaires), piloter les responsables de lots (WPM, IVVQM, SysEM…) et définir leurs objectifs.
- Piloter les revues d'ingénierie et d’avancement technique, les livraisons d'ingénierie, alimenter les indicateurs clés de performance de l'ingénierie.
- Valider les documents d'ingénierie des éléments ou composants de niveau inférieur, y compris ceux des sous-traitants et des partenaires.
- Veiller à la conformité du dossier de définition.
- Faciliter le travail collaboratif entre les équipes et les parties prenantes.
- Être garant de la maîtrise de la dette technique et la démarche d’amélioration continue.
- Être garant de l’application des décisions relatives au projet au sein des équipes ingénierie.

Vos interfaces principales sont :
- Le Project Manager (PM) en charge du contrat.
- Le Project Design Authority (PDA).
- Le responsable technique Client.
- Les Heads of Discipline (HoD).
- Les responsables de lots.
- Les services transverses (industrialisation, production, achats, sous-traitants).

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Engineering Deliver Manager
postings.description:
Lieu : Tubize, Belgium

We say HI*
*Human Intelligence – Welcome among Thales Team!

Thales in Belgium is part of an internationally leading technology group in the defence and security, aerospace as well as digital identity and security markets. In a world characterised by uncertainties, we ensure that our customers, partners and employees can pursue new paths with confidence. For a future we can all trust.

Say HI* – to your career as

Engineering Delivery Manager
As the Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM), you are the technical manager of the project, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery of complex engineering systems. You will orchestrate multi-disciplinary teams, enforce best-in-class processes, and drive strategic alignment between technical execution and business objectives.
Your mission is built in three pillars:
Excellence – Upholding world-class technical standards and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Discipline – Structuring workflows, mitigating risks, and maintaining unwavering focus on cost/schedule/quality.
Leadership – Inspiring teams, fostering collaboration, and steering stakeholders toward shared success.
Key responsibilities:

1. Strategic Technical Leadership
- Define and own the engineering delivery strategy, ensuring alignment with project constraints and Thales’ global standards.
- Develop a clear roadmap for engineering activities, balancing innovation with practical execution.
- Champion Agile and process-driven methodologies, tailoring them to maximize efficiency and quality.
2. Execution with Discipline
- Break down project scope into actionable work packages, allocating resources, budgets, and timelines while proactively managing risks and opportunities.
- Monitor progress with data-driven KPIs, ensuring transparency and timely adjustments to stay on track.
- Guarantee technical compliance: Verify that all designs (hardware/software) meet functional requirements and specifications without compromise.
3. Stakeholder & Team Leadership
- Unify cross-functional teams (engineers, subcontractors, customers) under a shared vision, fostering accountability, trust, and collaboration.
- Serve as the primary technical interface for the project managers, and design authorities, translating complex challenges into clear action plans.
- Mentor and develop engineers, providing constructive feedback and supporting their growth within Thales’ competency frameworks.
4. Financial & Risk Management
- Oversee the financial health of technical activities, ensuring alignment with budgetary constraints.
- Anticipate and mitigate risks (technical, schedule, cost) with proactive contingency planning.
- Create a competitive advantage by managing risk, identifying opportunities and fostering continuous improvement

We are looking forward to:

Technical & Professional Expertise
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering (Electronics/Telecommunications preferred).
Experience:
- 7+ years in technical project management or multi-disciplinary engineering leadership.
- Proven ability to deliver complex, high-stakes projects in defense, aerospace, or security sectors.
- Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies, system/software architecture, and IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation, Qualification).
Language Skills: Fluent English (mandatory); French/Dutch (strong plus).
Core Competencies
Pursuit of Excellence:
- High standards for technical delivery, with a focus on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Problem-solving mindset, always seeking optimal solutions to technical challenges.
Discipline & Structure:
- Ability to break down complexity into structured plans, enforce processes, and hold teams accountable.
- Resilience in fast-paced environments with competing priorities.
Leadership & Influence:
- Command respect and drive alignment among diverse stakeholders (engineers, customers, executives).
- Inspire teams with clarity, adaptability, and a results-driven approach.
Collaboration & Communication:
- Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in multi-cultural, multi-disciplinary teams.
- Clear, concise, and persuasive communication in both technical and business contexts.

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 81,000 employees on five continents. The Group is investing in digital and “deep tech” innovations – Big Data, artificial intelligence, connectivity, cybersecurity and quantum technology – to build a future we can all trust.

For more than 20 years, Thales has pursued a robust corporate social responsibility (CSR) policy based on the highest international standards. The principles behind this policy are now captured in the company’s purpose of “building a future we can all trust”, which was adopted in 2020.

Say HI* – Your journey to us
At times of change our international teams are ready to meet the complexity of today with the industry-leading technologies of tomorrow. Will you be part of it? We are looking forward to your online application. Great journeys start here, apply now!

En tant qu'Engineering Delivery Manager, vous serez placé(e) sous la responsabilité directe du Directeur de Projet et serez en contact permanent avec le Chef de Projet côté client.

Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et doté(e) d’un excellent sens du relationnel, vous permettant de coordonner efficacement les échanges avec les clients et les équipes internes.
Vous savez piloter les engagements contractuels, gérer les plannings et suivre les indicateurs de performance.
Votre esprit d’analyse vous permet d’identifier les risques et opportunités pour adapter vos actions en conséquence.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre autonomie, votre proactivité et votre capacité à manager et accompagner une équipe opérationnelle dans un souci constant d’amélioration continue.

postings.title: Engineering Delivery Manager
postings.description:
Location: Glasgow, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME)
We help forces to find the right information at the right time to make the right decision. For over 130 years we’ve proudly led the development of Optronics for military, scientific and commercial use. We cover three sectors: Air, Land and Sea.

Engineering Delivery Manager
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Engineering Delivery Manager within Thales Optronics and Missile Electronics (OME).

This role will be on at least one of our significant development and production projects within OME. As an Engineering Delivery Manager you will work in collaboration with the Programme Managers, the Engineering Delivery Lead, the Head of Engineering Delivery and the wider engineering team to ensure delivery of the engineering development projects.

In this role you will be responsible for:
- leading high performing, multi-discipline engineering teams to generate engineering solutions that meet the Customer needs
- the definition of the engineering delivery strategy and resource profile based on the engineering estimates to ensure the delivery of the project
- managing the interfaces with the overall delivery strategy for the wider programme
- defining the organisation and work breakdown, with the Programme Manager, required to deliver to the Customer needs
- defining and being in charge of meeting cost, schedule and quality of the whole engineering delivery for the programme
- defining the engineering team’s work packages in terms of resources required, budgets assigned to each task, risks and assumptions on these and the timescales to deliver within
- the planning and prioritisation of activities required to deliver the solution to the contract schedule, costs and quality
- day to day management of the engineering team’s activities ensuring proactive management of issues, opportunities and risks
- managing and reporting of the engineering efficiency for the project
- the identification of re-use opportunities across the project
- act as the People Manager for the engineering team on the project and provide feedback into the people manager reviews with the functional discipline leads

The successful candidate will have a strong background in engineering with experience in successfully defining and leading the delivery of multi-disciplinary engineering projects. They will be highly customer focused with excellent communication skills and have the ability to work in a fast moving environment with multiple parallel objectives and have an understanding of systems engineering life cycle, practices and tools. Knowledge and experience of naval, air or land products would be beneficial to this role.

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following, aligned to the Thales Leadership Behavioural Model:
- acting with agility to ensure that the business objectives remain in focus
- dealing with multiple strands of complexity to achieve business objectives
- engaging with stakeholders to achieve a common goal
- creating a competitive advantage by managing risk, identifying opportunities and fostering continuous improvement
- supporting the development of others to ensure we continuously improve for our customers

This role will work closely with the Programme Manager and the Project Design Authority (PDA) for the specific projects. This role will report to the Head of Engineering Delivery.

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Benefits
- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

#LI-MC2
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

Location: Madrid, Spain

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Thales Cybersecurity & Digital Identity is a global leader in digital security, building trust in an increasingly connected world. We design and deliver a wide range of products, software, and services based on two core technologies: digital identification and data protection.

-
Deploy adequate Practices and Tools tailored (for SEM and WPM) to reach the required maturity according to Project/Product delivery challenges

Au sein du Département Radars du secteur Radars Ground Master (GMR), vous intégrerez une équipe d’Ingénierie Système radar dynamique et polyvalente, en charge de Projets radar de surveillance avec ou non des Stations (mobilité, radio, shelter, radôme, etc.).

postings.legal_entity: Thales Canada Inc., Defence and Security
postings.description:
Location: Ottawa, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

This role is in Ottawa
Position Summary
Systems Engineering Technologist

The Systems Engineering Technologist is responsible for supporting Systems Engineering in Lab and in the field. These Lab projects are largely defined as communication and control systems encompassing RF, digital, network and analog sub systems. In addition, in the immediate future, the teardown of Lab facilities and projects at the Chrysalis location and the rebuild at the new facilities in the Palladium Drive location

The Systems Engineering Technologist will ensure project work is executed, monitored and controlled in terms of adherence to budget and schedule, risk management, and quality of deliveries. As required, the candidate will participate in integration or configuration, troubleshooting, verification and validation of subsystems and engineering close-out activities.

The environments the candidate will generally be at the Thales facilities, both at Chrysalis and Palladium Dr, Ottawa, as well as some work at the Gatineau Airport facility. Normal work will be within a Lab environment.

There will be deployment for field work for installation or support activities. The field locations can vary depending on circumstances.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility
The expectations from Systems Engineering Technologist are as follows:

- Ensure all work is carried-out in accordance with company practices and procedures.
- Ensure all work is completed according to Project’s integrated master schedule
- Maintain control of integration tools, test equipment and work area.
- Assist in preparation of drawings (electrical and mechanical) as required
- Read engineering documents, schematics, and technical orders to determine faults and methods of troubleshooting.
- Implement and execute system test cases. Analyze and evaluate test results.
- Troubleshoot systems that do not meet requirements.
- Identify installation risks and prepare mitigation strategies.
- Inspect parts for defects.
- Interact with customer technical and non-technical personnel (military and/or civilian).
- Work in a team environment and independently.

Minimum Requirements
- College diploma in a Technical Program or equivalent with relevant experience.
- English essential
- 1 - 3 years experience in a systems engineering environment, ideally in the Defence industry
- Good level oral and written communication skills required for report writing
- Can read and understand electrical, mechanical drawings and technical document
- Hands on experience on troubleshooting, integration and configuration and testing, cabling, network & electronics systems
- Experience in the use of common electrical test equipment, including DMM, Oscilloscope, etc.
- Experience in the use of common hand and electrical tools

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in electronics systems, RF, networking systems including testing with specialized test equipment is an asset,
- It would be an asset to have knowledge of Canadian requirements for shock and vibration, EMC/EMI, drawing standards and industry design standards.;
- Experience with varied operating systems and technical software such as Labview

Physical Demands
- Onsite work: > 80%, installation and removals, documentation. Some lifting required. Some ladder work required.

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $36,000– $60,000 -$84,000 CAD Annual.
This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

These tools may help screen and assess applications and recommend potential matches based on the requirements within the job description. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.
