Cross-functional collaboration helps us build out Thales’ capabilities – and helps us open up new career opportunities for employees all across the business.

Your role
You will be responsible for partnering with the business to provide environmental regulatory, compliance and assurance advice, expertise and support, helping to deliver effective environmental governance, regulatory compliance and risk-based assurance outcomes that support business objectives.
This role provides environmental subject matter expertise, regulatory guidance, governance support and assurance activities to assist the business in managing environmental risks and meeting applicable Commonwealth, State and Local Government obligations. The role also supports the application of digital technologies, data analytics, artificial intelligence and automation to enhance environmental reporting, compliance monitoring, assurance activities and proactive risk management.
As our Environmental Advisor you will be accountable for:
- Monitor environmental performance and provide support to sites on managing environmental risks and obligations
- Provide advice on environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and corporate compliance obligations, including NGER and AICIS
- Support regulatory reporting and compliance reviews
- Partner with sites to strengthen their first line environmental compliance and risk management practices
- Support the maintenance and continual improvement of the Thales Environmental Management System in line with ISO 14001 requirements
- Assist in the development and implementation of environmental processes, procedures and controls
- Develop and maintain environmental reporting, dashboards and performance analytics to support informed decision-making
- Identify and support opportunities to improve environmental performance through the use of digital technologies, automation and AI-enabled tools
- Partner with site HSE teams to strengthen first-line environmental assurance activities
- Provide practical advice and interpretation of environmental legislative and regulatory requirements
- Engaging with regulators, auditors, government agencies and external stakeholders as required
- Support the presentation of environmental performance, compliance status and assurance outcomes
- Translate environmental and sustainability data into meaningful insights and business decisions

Your experience
To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:
- Ideally have AQF level 7 qualifications in environmental science or management (or similar)
- Ideally have 5-7 years’ demonstrated environmental background with knowledge of Australian environmental legislation, regulatory compliance frameworks and environmental management systems, preferably within industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure or defence-related operations
- Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining ISO 14001 certified management systems
- Experience managing regulatory obligations including NGER, AICIS and environmental licensing requirements
- Proven ability to develop and execute risk-based assurance and audit programs
- Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify trends
- Experience developing performance dashboards and environmental reporting systems
- Demonstrated interest in, and application of, emerging technologies, automation, AI-enabled solutions and digital transformation initiatives
- Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills across all organisational levels
- Ability to work independently while effectively managing competing priorities
- ISO14001 auditor qualifications preferred
- Lead Auditor qualification highly regarded

A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.
Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role. The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

It’s easy to dismiss the perfect opportunity if you don’t see yourself as the perfect fit. If this role feels right – no matter your background or personal circumstances – please introduce yourself or join our community. We’re committed to supporting a diverse workplace, and that starts here.

From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Position Summary
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Global Support Organization and provide World class Support for all Thales products.
Thales is a leading global provider of data protection solutions with more than 40 years’ experience securing the world’s most sensitive information. Our customers—businesses, governments, and technology vendors with a broad range of challenges use Thales e-Security products and services to improve the security of applications that rely on encryption and digital signatures.
By protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive information that flows through today’s traditional, virtualized, and cloud-based infrastructures, Thales helps organizations reduce risk, demonstrate compliance, enhance agility, and pursue strategic goals with greater confidence.
Position Scope

As a member of a collaborative Client Services team, the Escalation Engineer will provide product escalation support to the Client Services Tech support team, for specific product, in constructing complex customer deployments, analyzing for root causes, recommending remediation procedures or best practices and documenting test methods, processes and knowledge bases. In addition, this position is responsible for validating proper interoperability of Thales products with other third-party vendor software/Solutions

This is a multi-disciplined role; the successful candidate should be able to perform hardware/software setup in a variety of lab configurations. This will include various OS platforms, storage products, databases, file systems, security protection software, HA clustering software, etc. The candidate must be a strategic thinker, well organized and able to work within fast-paced engineering environments and is also expected via collaboration with the broader Technical Support, QA and Developer teams to drive continual improvements to our processes and methodologies, all with the goal of continually improving the product quality and customer experience.

This is a dream job for an individual who likes to develop and maintain proficiency across a wide variety of enterprise-class hardware and software products.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

- Work closely with global support engineers on customer escalation issues to ensure timely resolution
- Configure and duplicate the customer’s environment where necessary to replicate the issues for diagnosing
- Identify the root causes and use this information to improve continuously within support & field service teams
- Work closely with global development teams to diagnose issues and validating fixes
- Given the critical nature of the customer issues supported, some after-hours/weekend work will be required. Pparticipation in the 24 x 7 telephone support Rota is mandatory for this position
- Serve as a Thales product support expert who will work closely with other department as required to facilitate training on new product and features and maintaining a database of training videos for support review.
- Work closely with our engineering and product management teams to communicate customer needs, issues, and trends to successfully use Thales products.
- Identify and champion product enhancement requests as customer advocates.
- Create knowledge and support articles, webinars, white papers, and other materials that help customers use Thales products.
- Other duties as assigned
Technical Knowledge/Skills & Experience Required

Essential:
- Operating Systems & Infrastructure
Strong Linux & Windows Server administration skills
System performance analysis (CPU, memory, disk, processes, services)
Log analysis and troubleshooting
Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V)
Basic cloud exposure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Networking fundamentals
TCP/IP, DNS, routing, NAT, VPN concepts
Packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump)
Load balancer concepts
- Database Knowledge
Strong understanding of databases (Oracle, MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, MySQL)
SQL query analysis and troubleshooting
Database performance fundamentals
Understanding of DB connectivity/authentication
Replication and HA concepts
- Security & Compliance Fundamentals
Vulnerability and risk concepts
Encryption fundamentals
Compliance standards awareness (PCI-DSS, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR)
- Diagnostic Tools
Wireshark, tcpdump, curl/Postman, Fiddler, Splunk/Kibana basics, Database tracing tools

Good to have

Basic scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, REST API fundamentals, JSON/XML parsing)
Automation mindset for repetitive diagnostics
Basic Git familiarity

Troubleshooting & Escalation Skills
- Analytical & Troubleshooting skills
- Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
- Complex log correlation
- Crisis Management
- Reproducing customer issues in lab environments
- Performance bottleneck identification
- Clear technical documentation skills
- Strong ownership and accountability mindset
- Ability to independently lead P1/P0 customer escalations
- Mentorship and enablement of Support teams
- Trend analysis and recurrence prevention
- Contribution to KBs, tooling, automation, and process improvements
- Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments and deployment patterns

Educational Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science /engineering or technical field or equivalent experience.

Professional Attributes

Demonstrates the Thales Values:
- Focus on Customers
- Perform through teaming
- Innovate, decide and act quickly
- Develop our people
- Proactive - Develops practical solutions, takes ownership, has a ‘can do' rather than ‘won’t do’ approach
- Technically curious – Regards technology problems as challenges
- Teamwork - Connected to the business, communicates openly, shares information and knowledge, networks internally and externally, persuades rather than pushes, involves colleagues, respects colleagues
- Creative – Connects the technical dots with a goal of building customer value
- Responsive - Always reacts quickly and with a sense of urgency to requests, issues, e-mails or other events in a timely and flexible fashion

Work Environment
- The working environment is generally indoors in environmentally controlled conditions where lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous conditions. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.description:
Location: Orlando, United States of America

Thales people architect solutions that enable two-thirds of planes to take off and land safely. We create in-flight entertainment systems that engross 50 million fliers every year and we develop the avionics that control the world’s largest commercial aircrafts. Our simulators train the next generation of pilots for fighter jets, transporters and search and rescue helicopters. And, together, each and every member of our aerospace team makes a difference.

When you rely on airlines to connect you in flight, you rely on Thales. In an increasingly fast paced world, we make the unpredictable, predictable by connecting and entertain passengers to make your life better. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to passengers and airlines. Whatever it takes.

Executive Assistant
Orlando, Florida (Hybrid)

This role will be based in Melbourne, Florida to start, and is expected to move to Orlando, Florida around September 2026.

Position Summary
Thales is seeking an Executive Assistant in Orlando, Florida. In this role, you will provide executive and administrative support to Executive Committee (ExCom) members. Your support assignment, under general supervision and acting on your own initiative,will include advanced, diversified and confidential duties, responding to requests for information on a wide range of topics and preparing information (reports, presentations, correspondence, etc.) as requested, scheduling appointments, maintaining calendars, and making travel arrangements. The work requires some analysis, creativity and independent judgement. Assignments may involve work of a confidential or complex nature, which require discretion, tact and diplomacy as well as practical knowledge of practices and procedures of the function(s) supporting and knowledge of corporate policy. Due to the visibility of the position, you will need to work well with all levels of company staff, as well as executives and support in customer and partner organization

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Provide support to assigned executive leadership to create and/or edit presentations, reports, spreadsheets, letters and other communications as needed (e.g. KPIs and dashboard/reports for business or operational review and EXCOM meetings, Region, Global Business Unit and Group reporting)

- Prepare all meeting and workshop logistics for assigned executive leadership including video conference, conference room scheduling, catering, agenda creation, collection and distribution of meeting materials, room set up and clean up

- Calendar management of active calendars, which involves resolving multiple conflicts (calendar management may include management of some personal appointments that may conflict with business related meetings)

- Coordinate and arrange complex travel plans (domestic and international), creating itineraries and agendas

- Create and submit expense reports, as well as monitor reports submitted by the Executive’s Direct Reports and notify the Executive of any concerns related to compliance with Company Expense policies

- Proactively compile any materials for upcoming meetings in order for assigned executive leadership to be prepared

- Actively participate in planning and coordinating corporate visitors and customers

Minimum Qualifications
- High school diploma or GED equivalent with a minimum of 6-8 years’ experience assisting at the senior leadership level in a fast-paced environment or Bachelor’s degree with minimum 3-5 years’ of related experience, or Associates degree with 4-6 years of related experience.

- Proficient in Outlook, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and working knowledge of other general office equipment

- Experience with travel scheduling and expense tools

- Strong attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills with a keen sense of urgency about solving problems and seeing work through completion

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to express ideas clearly and concisely with different levels within the organization

- Demonstrated business acumen to understand Leader’s priorities in order to properly arrange tasks in a dynamic environment with frequent interruptions and changing deadlines

Special Position Requirements
- Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

This position will require successfully completing a post-offer background check. Qualified candidates with [a] criminal history will be considered and are not automatically disqualified, consistent with federal law, state law, and local ordinances.
Thales champions inclusion and we believe diversity strengthens the fabric of our culture. Thales is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.

If you need an accommodation or assistance in order to apply for a position with Thales, please contact us at talentacquisition@us.thalesgroup.com.

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between

Total Target Cash (TTC) 52,871.00 - 98,640.00 USD Annual

This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law.

(For Internal candidate, if you need more information, please raise HR request through MyThales)

Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 30 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:

•Elective Health, Dental, Vision, FSA/HSA, Voluntary Life and AD&D, Whole Group Life w/LTC, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Plan, Identity Theft, and Pet Insurance
•Retirement Savings Plan after 30 days of employment with a company contribution and a match, and with no vesting period
•Company paid holidays and Paid Time Off
•Company provided Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability, Employee Assistance Plan, and Well-being Program

En tant qu’Expert en standardisation, vous portez les positions du Groupe au sein d’écosystèmes clés sur des sujets à fort enjeu technologique et business.
Vous évoluez dans un environnement international exigeant, en interaction avec les acteurs majeurs du secteur, où votre capacité à comprendre les enjeux techniques et marché ainsi qu’à influencer les orientations stratégiques fait la différence.
À ce titre, vous contribuez activement à la construction d’un monde numérique plus sûr et plus fluide, en participant au développement de solutions de sécurité innovantes pour les technologies mobiles et cloud.

Dans ce rôle, vos missions et responsabilités sont les suivantes :
- Représenter Thales au sein des organismes de standardisation internationaux (ETSI, GSMA, TCA…) et porter ses positions sur les technologies mobiles et de cybersécurité.

- Influencer les évolutions des standards en contribuant aux discussions techniques et aux décisions collectives.

- Analyser l’impact des changements normatifs sur les produits et identifier les risques et opportunités associés.

- Contribuer à la stratégie d’innovation en proposant de nouvelles solutions et en participant au développement du portefeuille de brevets.

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes R&D, Produits et Business pour aligner les orientations techniques et marché.

- Participer aux actions de lobbying et de construction de consensus dans un environnement international exigeant.

Votre priorité est de développer une expertise reconnue et d’avoir un impact concret sur des décisions techniques ?

Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement alliant innovation, cybersécurité et télécommunications mobiles ?
Issu(e) d’une formation ingénieur (Bac+5) ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans les domaines suivants :
- Les systèmes de communication mobile et les environnements télécoms

- Les standards internationaux (ETSI, GSMA…) et/ou la standardisation

Votre quotidien

Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.

Vous rejoignez la Direction Technique de la Business Line, où chaque expert entretient et fait progresser une de nos compétences clés : opto-électronique, intelligence artificielle, data… Vous y portez l'ingénierie système (sur le périmètre France), avec un rôle spécifique d’expert pour le MBSE et l'objectif de développer les usages de l'IA dans l'ingénierie système pour gagner en efficacité et qualité.
Vous accompagnez les équipes projet et les métiers de la Business Line dans leur démarche MBSE et vous êtes le moteur de leur montée en compétence.

Vous travaillez en binôme avec le Head of Discipline Systems Engineering qui porte la trajectoire de transformation du métier.
Vous développez les usages de l'IA générative appliquée à l'ingénierie systèm.

Force de proposition, vous élargissez le spectre des cas d'usage, montez les proof of concepts, et généralisez dans les projets ceux qui font leurs preuves.
Vous assurez enfin la veille sur l'évolution des pratiques d'ingénierie système et de modélisation, et représentez la Business Line auprès des communautés internes au Groupe et des écosystèmes externes (AFIS, INCOSE, partenaires académiques).

Accompagner les projets et les métiers dans leur démarche MBSE
- Cadrer avec les équipes projet leur architecture système selon la méthode Arcadia, sous Capella et en lien avec les exigences Polarion.
- Apporter aux équipes le support méthodologique et outil dont elles ont besoin au quotidien.
- Évaluer le niveau de maturité MBSE des équipes et définir avec elles la trajectoire pour l'élever.
Faire monter les équipes en compétence
- Concevoir et animer les parcours de formations internes, learning moments et sessions de partage sur l'ingénierie système et le MBSE.
- Coacher les architectes et ingénieurs système, pour qu'ils fassent du modèle un véritable outil de conception.
- Capitaliser les retours d'expérience des projets et en diffuser les bonnes pratiques auprès des équipes.
Faire évoluer les pratiques et le référentiel MBSE
- Décliner les référentiels Groupe sur le périmètre de la Business Line et recommander leur mode d'application et d'ajustement aux projets.
- Porter auprès du Groupe les évolutions que les contraintes des projets rendent nécessaires.
- Faire évoluer les pratiques MBSE de la Business Line au vu des retours des projets et de l'évolution de l'état de l'art.
- Assurer la veille sur les pratiques d'ingénierie système et de modélisation, et représenter la Business Line auprès des communautés internes et des écosystèmes externes (AFIS, INCOSE, partenaires académiques).
Développer les usages de l'IA générative pour l'ingénierie système
- Élargir le spectre des cas d'usage de l'IA sur l'ensemble du périmètre de l'ingénierie système, au service de la qualité et de l'efficacité.
- Monter les proof of concepts et en évaluer l'apport réel pour les projets.
- Généraliser dans les projets les usages qui ont fait leurs preuves.

Votre profil
De formation ingénieur ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une dizaine d'années d'expérience en Ingénierie Système acquise sur des systèmes complexes, et vous pratiquez le MBSE dans les projets. Vous avez évolué en interface avec des équipes projet, méthodes et métiers, et vous savez faire adopter des pratiques par des équipes sur lesquelles vous n'avez pas d'autorité hiérarchique avec pédagogie et sens du service. Votre écoute et votre capacité de synthèse vous permette d’accompagner et faire monter en compétence des équipes projet.
Une connaissance des référentiels, standards et cadres d'architecture en Ingénierie Système (ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288, INCOSE Handbook, NAF) est un plus.

Le mot du manager
Le MBSE n'est pas nouveau chez nous : les projets le pratiquent depuis des années, avec des niveaux de maîtrise très inégaux d'une équipe à l'autre. Le travail ne consiste donc pas à convaincre du bien-fondé de la démarche, mais à aider des équipes qui la pratiquent déjà à résoudre les difficultés concrètes qu'elles rencontrent. Et surtout à leur faire utiliser la modélisation pour ce qu'elle est : un outil pour penser l'architecture, pas seulement un livrable à produire.
Vous serez le seul spécialiste de l'ingénierie système de la Direction Technique, entouré d’experts d’autres disciplines. Vos interlocuteurs seront plutôt ailleurs : dans les projets et les métiers, dans les autres entités du Groupe, et à l'extérieur (partenaires académiques, communautés professionnelles).
Un point à connaître avant de postuler : dans ce rôle transverse, on convainc, on n'impose pas. Votre légitimité viendra de ce que vous apportez aux équipes, pas de votre position.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

We Say HI*

Export Control & Customs Classification Specialist (m/w/d) / Spezialist (m/w/d) Klassifizierung und Einreihung
Am Standort Ditzingen
(Ref. Nr. R0327317)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Ihre Mission als Export Control & Customs Classification Specialist:

- Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich die zolltarifliche Einreihung von Produkten und Handelswaren gemäß internationalen Warennomenklaturen (z. B. HS, KN, TARIC) sowie die exportkontrollrechtliche Klassifizierung von Waren, Software und Technologien nach europäischen, nationalen und internationalen Vorschriften (DE/EU/US). Dabei dokumentieren und begründen Sie die Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar im ERP-System
- Sie prüfen, validieren, geben erhaltene Informationen zur Klassifizierung und Einreihung von Lieferteilen frei und stellen deren ordnungsgemäße Archivierung sicher
- Sie bewerten Produktänderungen, Neuentwicklungen und Kundenanforderungen unter regulatorischen Gesichtspunkten und stimmen sich dabei eng mit den relevanten internen Fachbereichen ab
- Sie aktualisieren eigenverantwortlich und regelmäßig Klassifizierungen sowie Warennummern entsprechend den geltenden rechtlichen Änderungen, außerdem fungieren Sie als Ansprechperson für die technische Abstimmung zu Klassifizierungs- und Einreihungsthemen mit internen Stakeholdern, Lieferanten und Kunden
- Sie beraten interne Fachbereiche bei exportkontroll- und zollrechtlichen Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit der Klassifizierung und Einreihung von Waren
- Sie wirken bei Audits, internen Kontrollen sowie behördlichen Prüfungen mit und unterstützen die Vorbereitung sowie Durchführung entsprechender Maßnahmen, außerdem analysieren Sie rechtliche Änderungen im Bereich Exportkontrolle und Zoll und setzen die daraus resultierenden Anforderungen praxisgerecht um

Darauf freuen wir uns:
- Eine abgeschlossene Hochschulausbildung im zollrechtlichen oder technischen Bereich, eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger fachspezifischer Berufserfahrung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der zolltariflichen Einreihung und exportkontrollrechtliche Klassifizierung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im europäischen und idealerweise internationalen Exportkontrollrecht
- Technisches Verständnis zur Bewertung von Produkten und deren Struktur sowie ein sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und sehr gute Kenntnisse im MS Office und SAP R3/HANA

postings.title: FIELD LOGISTIC REPRESENTATIVE
postings.description:
Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

For over 50 years, Thales has been a trusted partner of the United Arab Emirates, providing innovative and cutting-edge solutions in Defence, Aeropsace and Cyber & Digital, aligned with the nation’s long-term vision. With a strong local presence and more than 500 employees across three offices, Thales is deeply embedded within the UAE’s ecosystem. Thales Emarat Technologies plays a pivotal role as a key industrial enabler, fostering national sovereignty, self-reliance, and innovation. Through localization, strategic collaboration, and exporting ‘Made in the Emirates’ technologies to global markets, we contribute significantly to the UAE’s ambitious growth and development while helping build a future we call all trust.

JOB OBJECTIVE
As a Field Logistic Representative (FLR) supporting the RAFALE program in the UAE, you are responsible for coordinating all logistics activities related to equipment delivery, acceptance, inventory management, transportation and repair flows. You ensure the availability of customer assets while maintaining compliance with contractual, company and regulatory requirements, and act as the primary logistics interface between the customer, local stakeholders and Thales support teams.
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
- Coordinate the receipt, delivery and acceptance of customer equipment, including the management of Delivery and Acceptance Certificates.
- Ensure all logistics transactions are accurately recorded in Thales logistics information systems.
- Monitor inventory levels, equipment consumption and stock availability to support operational readiness.
- Identify potential shortages and proactively report associated risks to the Team Leader.
- Coordinate repair, overhaul and warranty return logistics, including shipment preparation and administrative activities.
- Prepare and verify shipping documentation in compliance with import/export regulations and company procedures.
- Coordinate transportation activities with freight forwarders, customs authorities and local stakeholders.
- Monitor logistics performance and provide regular operational and inventory reports.
- Support customers by resolving logistics related issues and ensuring effective communication throughout the logistics process.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure efficient execution of logistics activities and continuous service improvement.
- Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, export control requirements and Thales quality standards

WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
- Minimum 6 years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics or Industrial Support.
- Proven experience in international transportation, import/export and logistics operations.
- Experience in inventory management, warehouse operations and material control.
- Experience coordinating repair and reverse logistics activities.
- Experience working in a customer-facing environment.
- Experience within the aerospace, defense or high-technology industry is considered an advantage.

QUALIFICATION, CERTIFICATION & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS
- Master's Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering or a related discipline
- Professional certification in Supply Chain or Logistics (APICS, CILT or equivalent) is an advantage.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
- Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an advantage.
CORE COMPETENCIES
- Results oriented with strong commitment
- Attention to detail & accuracy
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills are necessary, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and customer oriented.
- Planning, organization & forecasting
- Proactive & Continuous Improvement mindset
- Analytical thinking, problem solving & ability to manage multiple priorities
- Autonomy & accountability

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

In this role, you’ll oversees all maintenance, repair, and operational activities across dedicated customer sites and Royal Australian Navy (RAN) platforms. This critical role ensures that high-value equipment in both submarine and land-based environments operates smoothly and reliably.

Additionally, you will support the Ship Repair Services domain, delivering technical expertise and maintenance for electronics and weapons systems across Western Australia (WA).

This is a permanent opportunity based out of Rockingham, WA.

Your Responsibilities:
- Lead maintenance and repair activities on Collins Class Submarines.

- Deliver all engineering tasks safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

- Enforce strict RAN military protocols and workplace safety mandates.

- Act as the primary escalation point for field issues.

- Review technical documentation to optimize future maintenance planning.

- Mentor the team through hands-on, on-the-job training.

- Report operational status, emerging risks, and defects to management.

- Foster a collaborative, professional, and high-performing team culture.

- Execute delegated management tasks, resource allocation, and customer meetings.

- Support inventory logistics and drive LEAN continuous improvement initiatives.

Your Skills:
- An Electronic/Electrical Engineering Diploma or An electrical trade with relevant experience

- Australian citizenship

- NV1 and ITAR clearance

- Supervision/Leadership experience of maintenance activities in local and remote locations.

- 4 + years’ experience in fault diagnosis, repair and maintenance of complex equipment and systems

- A proven track record in quality assurance

We Encourage You to Apply:
After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process.

Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police checks.

As a Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance. To learn more about clearances please visit – http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/

Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

We are looking for a Field Support Engineer with strong expertise in Windows Application Support & Deployment to join our Industrial Personalization Solutions (IPS) team. The role is responsible for delivering on-site and remote technical support for IPS systems, with a strong focus on troubleshooting, deploying, and maintaining Windows-based applications, as well as providing user support and training on system usage and processes.

Industrial Personalization Solutions (IPS) department is in charge of providing infrastructure and business packages to industrialize Thales Banking products in Personalization Bureau.

Responsibilities:
Windows Application Deployment & Support
- Perform acceptance testing and document the procedure before rolling out to production
- Deploy, configure, and maintain Windows-based applications across Windows Server environments (Knowledge of Linux will be an advantage).
- Ensure environment readiness and stability, including configuration validation, patching, and dependency management.
- Perform system health checks and proactive monitoring to prevent application issues.
- Manage and validate application dependencies, including services, permissions, certificates, scheduled tasks, and environment configurations.
- Support application security and encryption components, including certificates, key stores, and secure key integration.
​
Incident & Field Support (Production Support)
- Provide on-site and remote support for production systems, ensuring timely incident resolution.
- Perform real-time troubleshooting of application issues across Windows OS, networking, and system connectivity.
- Analyze logs and monitoring alerts to diagnose and resolve incidents efficiently.
- Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and implement fixes or structured escalation with detailed diagnostics.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve critical production issues.
- Communicate clear incident updates, including impact, risks, and recovery actions

Deployment Automation & DevOps Support
- Support and execute application release and deployment activities, including validation and post-deployment checks.
- Develop, maintain, and execute Ansible playbooks for automated and repeatable deployments.
- Troubleshoot deployment failures and environment inconsistencies.
- Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to improve deployment processes and operational readiness.
- Contribute to automation initiatives to reduce manual effort and increase reliability

AI Tools & Operational Improvement
- Leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance troubleshooting, log analysis, documentation, and knowledge retrieval.
- Contribute to automation and AI-driven initiatives to improve support efficiency and reduce manual operations.

Requirements:
- Degree in IT, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in software development, application support, infrastructure operations, DevOps support, or similar technical roles
- Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server environments, particularly in application deployment and troubleshooting
- Experience in CI/CD, DevOps practices, and release management, with the ability to improve deployment reliability.
- Proven hands-on experience in Ansible, including: creating, maintaining, executing Ansible playbooks & troubleshooting deployment and automation issues
- Strong in Windows: services, Event Viewer, IIS, PowerShell
- Strong troubleshooting skills across:
- Application, OS, and infrastructure layers (CPU, memory, disk, network, services, deployment issues).
- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewall rules, VPN, and connectivity troubleshooting.
- Strong scripting and query skills (e.g. PowerShell, SQL)
- Good knowledge of relational databases, including Oracle, MariaDB, and MySQL
- Experience with tools such as: Datadog, Grafana, VMware, Docker, AWS, Azure

Other Information:
- Working Location: One North

- Working Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm

- Able to travel to regional production sites when required.

- Perform rotating standby support from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM SGT, approximately once every three weeks, inclusive of weekends.

Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

L’activité Systèmes terrestres et aériens basé sur le site de Massy est leader dans les systèmes de commandement et de contrôle des opérations aériennes et les systèmes radars de défense aérienne.

Intégré au secteur "VASSCO" de la Business Line Systèmes Intégrés de protection de l’espace Aérien (IAS) de la GBU LAS, vous prenez en charge le pilotage technique des activités opérationnelles de support et de maintenance sur le projet VASSCO et plus particulièrement sur les systèmes Radio et de Contrôle Local D’Aérodrome (CLA).
En tant que Field Support Manager (FSM), vous êtes garant pour THALES envers les forces Armées de la disponibilité technique des systèmes pour répondre aux engagements de disponibilité opérationnelle sur ces systèmes.
Au sein d’une organisation globale de pilotage du marché VASSCO de support du SCCOA, et pour le compte des domaines de performance associés aux systèmes, vous assurez le pilotage et l’organisation des activités de support des équipes THALES ainsi que celle des partenaires industriels pour chacun des systèmes.

Vos missions :
- De l’organisation et du pilotage des activités techniques de soutien sur les sites ;
- De la mobilisation des équipes techniques pour garantir le niveau de service demandé et le pilotage des activités techniques de soutien des partenaires industriels,
- Du reporting et de la coordination avec le client du suivi des activités de support des sites dont le suivi des incidents techniques et demandes client en interne et de coordonner les actions visant les traiter,
- De maitriser et suivre la performance du RSO (Remise en Service Opérationnel) sur les différents systèmes et les actions correctives relatives à la réduction des écarts pour optimiser le service rendu,
- De fournir des analyses de risques de son domaine au coordinateur HSE du marché VASSCO ;

postings.title: Firewall Support Engineer
postings.description:
Location: SINGAPORE, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Firewall Support Engineer plays a crucial role in safeguarding the company's data and systems. This individual is responsible for day-to-day administration of security infrastructure, monitoring breaches, conducting in-depth incident investigations, and implementing technical solutions to mitigate risks. The role requires a deep understanding of network protocols, security tools, and the ability to work under pressure during security incidents.

Responsibilities:
- Incident Response: Investigate and respond to security incidents and breaches escalated from L1 support, performing root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
- Monitoring & Analysis: Monitor and analyze security alerts and events from various sources, including SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platforms (e.g., QRADAR) and security dashboards.
- Vulnerability Management: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate penetration testing activities to identify weaknesses in systems and networks.
- Security Infrastructure Management: Implement, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain security technologies such as firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortigate, Check Point), intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), EDR/AV, CipherTrust (Tokenization Server), HSM, 2FA, PAM, IBM Guradium and Rapid 7.
- Policy & Documentation: Develop, maintain, and enforce security policies, procedures, and documentation, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
- Threat Hunting: Proactively search for hidden threats, malware, and vulnerabilities in the system to enhance detection capabilities.
- Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with IT, development, and L3 teams to address security issues and implement best practices. May also assist in training and mentoring junior (L1) security staff.
- Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and documentation of security incidents, analyses, and system status for management and compliance purposes.
- On-Call Support: May require participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation to address critical incidents and ensure minimal downtime and be onsite if necessary

Requirements:
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- Experience: 3+ years of proven experience in cybersecurity or information security roles, with a focus on L2 support or similar responsibilities. Minimally 1-2 years of experience in supporting mission critical systems with a stringent SLA of 99.9%
- Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of security protocols, TCP/IP, network security, operating systems (Linux, Windows), and cloud security concepts. Well-versed in IT Service Management (ITSM) standards, processes, guidelines and best practices is an advantage.
- Tool Experience: Hands-on experience with security tools such as SIEM, firewalls, vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), and incident response platforms.
- Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CISSP are highly valued.
- Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication and collaboration skills.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Dans des marchés en rapide évolution, les clients à travers le monde font confiance à Thales. Nos projets de pointe variés utilisent nos expertises en Intelligence Artificielle, Facteurs Humains, Systèmes autonomes collaboratifs, Optimisation, Gestion de la connaissance, Cybersécurité et Design.

Join us to contribute to the development of mission critical solutions. Our various cutting-edge projects use our expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Human Factors, Collaborative Autonomous Systems, Optimization, Knowledge Management, Cybersecurity and Design.

Full Stack Developer – Agentic AI
Ville de Québec, QC (Hybride) Temps plein

Résumé du poste
Notre équipe réalise des travaux de recherche et développement (R&D) pour répondre aux besoins du département de la Défense nationale (DND) et des Forces armées canadiennes (CAF). Les projets portent sur des solutions numériques innovantes combinant développement logiciel, intégration de systèmes, infrastructure moderne et intelligence artificielle générative.
Dans le cadre de l'accélération de nos initiatives en intelligence artificielle, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle génération d'applications basées sur l'Agentic AI. Ces solutions vont au-delà des assistants conversationnels traditionnels en permettant à des agents intelligents d'analyser des données, de raisonner, de prendre des décisions, d'orchestrer des workflows complexes et d'interagir avec plusieurs systèmes d'entreprise de manière autonome et sécurisée.
Nous recherchons une personne Développeur Full Stack spécialisée en IA générative et en Agentic AI pour rejoindre notre équipe à Québec, spécialisée dans la gestion des connaissances. Notre équipe multidisciplinaire se concentre sur la collecte, la transformation et l’enrichissement des données. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. Notre équipe utilise également des concepts d'IA et de machine learning (ML) pour accroître l’efficacité des analyses.

Fonctions essentielles
La personne titulaire du poste Développeur(se) Full Stack spécialisé(e) en IA générative et Agentic AI jouera un rôle clé dans la conception, le développement et la mise en production de plateformes et applications intelligentes intégrant des modèles de langage (LLM), des architectures multi-agents, des moteurs RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), des outils d'orchestration et des services cloud de nouvelle génération. La personne occupant ce poste contribuera à des projets stratégiques permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, le soutien à la décision et l'automatisation de processus complexes dans des environnements où la sécurité, la fiabilité et la traçabilité sont essentielles. Cette personne devra être autonome, curieuse et à l’aise dans un contexte de R&D où les besoins évoluent rapidement. Cette personne travaillera avec les équipes d’architecture, de développement et les spécialistes en intelligence artificielle afin de transformer des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes, démontrables et évolutives.
Cette personne fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et la capacité de travailler en collaboration sont obligatoires. La personne idéale est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui facilitent le transfert du travail effectué à l'ensemble des parties prenantes concernées. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.
Responsabilités du développeur Full Stack en Agentic AI:
• Participer à l’intégration de solutions d’IA générative, de pipelines RAG, d’embeddings vectoriels et de mécanismes de recherche sémantique.
• Développer ou intégrer des MCP tools et MCP servers.
• Contribuer à l’intégration de modèles de langage, d’agents ou de composants IA dans des solutions applicatives.
• Développer des connecteurs permettant aux systèmes IA d’interagir avec des API, des bases de données, des services internes ou des systèmes externes.
• Participer au prototypage, à l’expérimentation et à l’évaluation de solutions basées sur l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques.
• Développer des services backend, des API, des microservices et des composants d’intégration principalement en Python.
• Participer au développement d’interfaces légères, de prototypes web, de démonstrateurs ou d’outils internes.
• Intégrer des composants frontend, backend, des services IA, des bases de données, des API et des systèmes externes.
• Créer, maintenir et optimiser des images Docker.
• Développer, adapter et maintenir des Helm charts pour des environnements Kubernetes.
• Participer à l’automatisation des déploiements, des configurations et des environnements d’exécution.
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes liés aux conteneurs, aux dépendances, aux configurations et aux environnements Kubernetes.
• Collaborer avec les architectes, les développeurs, les spécialistes IA et les autres parties prenantes techniques.
• Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement, de sécurité, de documentation, de tests et de revue de code.
• Participer aux activités Agile de l’équipe.
• Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement, DevOps, CI/CD et d’automatisation.

Exigences minimales
• Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologie de l’information ou dans tout autre domaine connexe et pertinent.
• Minimum de 2 ans d’expérience pertinente en développement logiciel, développement fullstack, backend, infrastructure logicielle ou DevOps.
• Expérience en méthodologie Agile, notamment Scrum ou Kanban.
• Expérience en développement avec Python.
• Expérience avec des outils CI/CD tels que GitLab CI.
• Expérience avec la conteneurisation, notamment Docker.
• Expérience avec les bases de données et leur déploiement.
• Expérience dans le développement et maintenance de flux de données type ETL, transformation, synchronisation, etc.
• Expérience avec l’intelligence artificielle, l’IA générative ou l’apprentissage automatique. Capacité à déployer des modèles AI/ML (FastAPI)
• Expérience avec des frameworks liés à l’IA générative ou aux systèmes agentiques, par exemple LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex ou équivalents.
• Expérience avec les pipelines RAG, les embeddings vectoriels, les bases de données vectorielles ou la recherche sémantique.
• Expérience avec Kubernetes ou des environnements cloud-native, avec la création, la modification ou le déploiement de Helm charts.
• Capacité à développer et intégrer des services backend, des API, des microservices ou des composants d’intégration.
• Capacité à intervenir sur des interfaces web, des prototypes applicatifs, des outils internes ou des démonstrateurs techniques.
• Bonne compréhension des environnements Linux, des scripts, de la configuration applicative et du diagnostic technique.
• Expérience ou intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificielle, l’IA générative ou l’apprentissage automatique.
• Capacité à travailler dans un contexte agile où les besoins peuvent évoluer rapidement.
• Capacité à documenter clairement les composants développés et les procédures techniques associées.
• Maîtrise du français et capacité à travailler en anglais dans un contexte technique.
Ce poste requiert une bonne connaissance de l'anglais pour interagir, soutenir et/ou fournir des services à des clients, employés et/ou partenaires internationaux ainsi qu’à des autorités gouvernementales étrangères qui ne parlent pas français.

Qualifications souhaitables
• Expérience avec le protocole MCP, incluant le développement de MCP tools ou de MCP servers.
• Expérience avec des frameworks frontend modernes tels que React, Angular ou équivalents.
• Connaissance des bonnes pratiques de sécurité applicative, de gestion des secrets et de durcissement des environnements conteneurisés.
• Connaissance du domaine de la défense, du renseignement militaire ou du contexte des Forces armées canadiennes.

postings.title: Full Stack Tech Lead for Defense Business
postings.description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

About the project
Thales’ Defence Business Unit, part of the Romanian Engineering Competence Center, develops cutting-edge solutions and services for electronic combat systems, surveillance and reconnaissance, naval combat, surface warfare, and underwater warfare, integrating sensor and weapon systems with advanced data processing, decision support, and human-machine interfaces.
Together with specialists from our Sophia-Antipolis site, we contribute to the development of sonar systems for submarines and surface vessels, from underwater acoustics to the operator's graphical user interface (GUI).

About the job
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Technical Lead with strong React experience, to join our engineering team and help us develop and evolve the software platform for the Sonar interface.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary and self-managing Agile team located in our premises in Bucharest. Our teams develop and test applications, features and/or components the software platforms used in the Defence domain. The development teams are responsible for the entire development cycle – from requirements analysis, development, testing and validation, to demonstrating the current status of the product. Cybersecurity is an integral part of the whole process.

You will collaborate with colleagues from France. The GUI team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the operational GUIs for sonar operators. These GUIs are the eyes and ears of the submarines and surface ships.

Your tasks include
- Actively contributing to the design of the software architecture of the sonar GUI component by supporting the software architect
- Providing technical guidance to the GUI development team (up to 7 people)
- Conducting preliminary studies to validate technical approaches and chosen architectures
- Being a major contributor to the setup of the CI/CD pipeline for the component
- Providing support to software integrators
- Translate requirements into functional solutions. Writing technical documentation (specifications/design)
- Evaluate and implement new technologies to integrate into and improve our products
- Ensure consistent compliance with best practices and coding standards
- Collaborate with stakeholders to understand and translate technical requirements

About you
Do you have a passion for technology, do you enjoy constantly developing your skills and are you interested in working on Defence systems for the Underwater Domain? Then you are the person we are looking for.

You are an experienced full stack technical lead with strong React experience. You enjoy personal development, both in hard skills and human skills. Your relevant hands-on past experience includes:
- Web development experience (10 years)
- Solid experience in using React (5+ years)
- Solid experience in Java backend development (5 years)
- Demonstrated technical guidance over a 5 people (incl. seniors) team for at least 3 years
- Fluent in software configuration management (GIT/GITLAB/ARTIFACTORY/NEXUS)
- Experience in writing software specification and design documents

You hold a bachelor or master degree in computer science, IT service management or comparable. You have flexibility and the ability to communicate fluently in English to all types of stakeholders (technical, management).

An important requirement to fulfil this role is flexibility and the ability to communicate efficiently in English (French is a plus) to all types (technical, management) of stakeholders. You are willing to work for in France for a period of a couple of weeks up to 3 months for the purpose of knowledge transfer.

Your career at Thales
Joining Thales, you will integrate into a tight-knit team working in an international and friendly environment. Thanks to various teams working on multiple fields and domains, all located in Bucharest, you will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas.

Joining Thales will bring you:
- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
- Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe.
- A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.
- You will have a hybrid work arrangement. Within Thales, we aim for 60/40 a balance, where you work from home at least two days a week, when your role allows this.

Your immediate benefits
- 24 holiday days a year
- Benefit Online
- A good work-life balance which includes flexible working hours
- A comprehensive compensation and benefit package including medical coverage & life insurance
- Hybrid Workplace YOUR WORKING LOCATION IN ROMANIA (hybrid flexible work)

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. You will coach and empower line and placement managers to provide meaningful work and consistent support, ensuring a high-quality experience.
Working closely with leaders, education partners, HR, and the Future Talent team, you’ll align programs with business needs, improve delivery, and support career progression.

You will lead the coordination, oversight and continuous improvement of our Industry apprenticeship programmes, including:
· coaching and supporting line and placement managers to develop their apprentices effectively, ensuring they understand their responsibilities and complete the required training
· working with Industry leaders, heads of function, HR and skills specialists to identify future capability requirements and agree apprentice or graduate recruitment needs

working with managers to create purposeful placements and development plans that build practical competence and meet programme objectives

· supporting timely programme completion and progression into suitable roles, with clear plans for each apprentice’s next career step
· maintaining relationships with former apprentices and graduates to support future recruitment, share experience and understand longer-term career progression.
· Providing pastoral care to graduate programmes across OME UK
What we’re looking for:
We’re looking for someone who combines a commitment to developing people with the organisation, judgement and relationship-building skills needed to deliver effective apprenticeship programmes.

You will be comfortable coaching managers, listening to apprentices and constructively challenging where the quality of development or support needs to improve.
Essential Experience:
- Experienced in supporting apprenticeships and early career development programs.
- Skilled in coaching and mentoring managers and colleagues.
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
- Proficient in program coordination, managing priorities, and follow-up.
- Able to analyze data and feedback to identify issues and improve outcomes.
- Handles sensitive situations with discretion and sound judgment, escalating when necessary.
Desirable Experience:
· experience within manufacturing, engineering, Industry or another operational environment
· knowledge of apprenticeship frameworks, funding requirements or programme governance
· experience working with colleges, training providers or other education partners
· experience supporting learner wellbeing, safeguarding or inclusive learning
· familiarity with HR or learning systems, such as Workday
· relevant coaching, mentoring, learning and development or people management qualifications.
What Success Looks Like:
Success will mean apprentices who feel supported, develop the competence our Industry teams need and progress successfully into meaningful roles within OME UK. Managers will feel confident and equipped to support their development, while programmes remain well governed, inclusive and aligned with business priorities.

You will be able to demonstrate the impact through learner engagement, programme completion, retention and career progression, helping build a sustainable pipeline of skilled Industry talent.

Core Benefits:
On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;
• Performance-related bonus
• Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

• You can read about some of our other benefits here: UK benefits | Thales Group

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions.  This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years.  In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.title: GALILEO Engineering Work Package Manager : Mise en Opérations H/F
postings.description:
Lieu : Toulouse, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

Le programme GALILEO est le système de positionnement par satellites (radionavigation) mis en place par l'Union européenne (UE).
Le segment sol de mission (GMS, Galileo Mission Segment) est chargé de créer le message de navigation diffusé par le satellite (garant des performances des services), de détecter les éventuelles anomalies et d'en prévenir les utilisateurs (dans le message diffusé par les satellites), ainsi que de mesurer les performances du système.
Thales Alenia Space est responsable de l’ingénierie, du développement, de la qualification et du déploiement de ce segment de mission ainsi que du GSF (Galileo Security Facility).
Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un/une Responsable de Migration/Mise en Opérations afin d’encadrer le déploiement des évolutions du GMS et du GSF sur les différentes chaines des sites opérationnels.

Vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes :

Définition de la stratégie de migration et participation aux réponses à appels d’offres :
- Rédaction de la stratégie de migration

Encadrement des activités de migration et gestion des plannings :
- Pilotage des CCR (Configuration Change Request) et des tests usines
- Pilotage des équipes techniques
- Pilotage des ressources (internes, sur site, ...) en adéquation avec les plannings
- Pilotage des livraisons documentaires et SW à destination des clients et fournisseurs
- Reporting au SDM (Service Delivery Manager)/EDM (Engineering Delivery Manager)

Gestion des risques associés aux activités :
- De déploiements/mises à jour (HW/SW)
- Techniques (préparation, répétition des séquences, …)
- Proposition, implémentation et suivi de mitigations

Négociation afin de sécuriser les jalons contractuels :
- Interne (déploiement, fourniture, disponibilité, …)
- Externe avec nos clients (dimension de représentation de Thales Alenia Space auprès de nos clients institutionnels ESA/EUSPA) et notre fournisseur représentant Thales Alenia Space sur les sites opérationnels (équipe IVQ Site)

Votre profil :

- Vous êtes diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur (Aéronautique / Spatial, Informatique, Electronique …) ou d'un parcours universitaire avec un Master 2 (BAC +5) avec une expérience significative et prouvée (5 ans minimum) en IVVQ de systèmes critiques complexes HW/SW.
- Vous savez mener à bien un Work Package de la phase de Bid à la mise en opérations
- Vos compétences en architecture software et infrastructures informatique vous permettent de comprendre le fonctionnement des plateformes hébergeant un système complexe à dominante logicielle
- Vous avez des compétences au niveau système : réseau, virtualisation, linux, infrastructure, administration système
- Vous faites preuve d'un fort leadership et êtes attentif au respect des délais et des coûts pour effectuer les tâches qui vous sont confiées
- Vous savez communiquer de manière efficace avec les parties prenantes dans le cadre d’un programme complexe
- Vous êtes familier avec les problématiques de cybersécurité
- Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais
- Une connaissance du système Galileo est un gros plus

Le poste nécessite une habilitation CUE (Confidentiel Union Européenne)

Des déplacements fréquents en Europe (Allemagne et Italie) sur les sites opérationnels sont nécessaires. Cela représente 15 à 20 missions par an soit 30 à 50% du temps.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Gestion de configuration - F/H
postings.description:
Lieu : Elancourt, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

Votre quotidien

La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.

Le site d’Élancourt rassemble la totalité des moyens de développement, d’intégration et de tests des activités optroniques, électroniques de missiles et lasers intenses de Thales en France. Plus de 2000 collaborateurs fournissent des équipements et systèmes qui apportent des avantages opérationnels décisifs lors des opérations terrestres, navales et aériennes, de jour comme de nuit, sous tous les climats, dans tous les environnements.

Vous serez également rattaché fonctionnellement au responsable de la gestion de configuration du domaine OME-France au sein d'un réseau de plus de 30 acteurs de la gestion de la configuration.

En tant que Responsable en gestion de configuration de produit(s), vous serez amené à :

o Participer aux revues jalons (SFR, PDR, CDR...)
o Piloter la réalisation des audits de configuration FCA et PCA
o Rendre compte au Project Managers (PM) / SysEM

Votre profil

Vous êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement en mutation.
Vous savez expliquer vos besoins ainsi que vos propositions.
Vous êtes reconnu pour votre dynamisme et votre rigueur.
Vous êtes convaincant et persuasif.

La connaissance du PLM PDM Windchill ou du PLM Thales PALMA serait un plus.

postings.title: Google Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Location: Berlin, Germany

We Say HI*

Google Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Ihre Mission als Google Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d):
- Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung hochverfügbarer souveräner GCP-Services mit Fokus auf Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit und Performance

- Überwachung von SLI/SLO-Kennzahlen sowie Analyse und Behebung von Produktionsstörungen im 24x7-Betrieb inklusive Teilnahme an einer Rufbereitschaft

- Zusammenarbeit mit globalen SRE- und GCP-Expertenteams zur schnellen Incident-Analyse, Fehlerbehebung und nachhaltigen Service-Optimierung

- Dokumentation von Betriebswissen, Standardisierung von Prozessen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Automatisierungs- und Operational-Playbooks
