postings.description:
Lieu : Cannes, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique.

Acteur majeur du secteur spatial, Thales Alenia Space place la cybersécurité au cœur de ses activités de navigation, télécommunications, observation et exploration. Elle concerne aussi bien nos systèmes d’information que nos environnements de développement et de production, appelés Business Managed Networks (BMN).
Face à des cybermenaces toujours plus avancées, le poste de GRC Leader – Gouvernance, Risques et Conformité est créé au sein du France Cybersecurity Office.
Dans ce rôle transverse, vous interagissez avec l’ensemble des acteurs de la cybersécurité et de l’ingénierie de Thales Alenia Space : domaines, centres de compétences et fonctions transverses. Vous associez une solide expertise technique, une compréhension approfondie des enjeux de cybersécurité et la capacité à coordonner des équipes qui ne vous sont pas directement rattachées.

VOTRE QUOTIDIEN

Vous êtes responsable de la conformité aux réglementations françaises et européennes applicables, notamment à la directive NIS2. Vous veillez au respect des politiques et des contrôles de cybersécurité destinés à protéger les infrastructures industrielles critiques BMN ainsi que les environnements IS/IT contre les cybermenaces.

À ce titre, vous :
- Définissez et maintenez les cadres de gouvernance cybersécurité, les politiques, les standards et les lignes directrices applicables aux environnements BMN et IS/IT, en cohérence avec la stratégie de l’entreprise et les réglementations ;

- Préparez et organisez les comités réguliers de gouvernance COCYB, centrés sur les risques et la conformité cybersécurité, et contribuez à l’amélioration de la performance ;

- Accompagnez le CISO dans une démarche d’amélioration continue en assurant une veille sur les évolutions réglementaires, sectorielles et technologiques, puis en recommandant les adaptations nécessaires ;

- Pilotez, coordonnez et réalisez les analyses de risques relatives aux systèmes BMN et IS/IT : identification des menaces et vulnérabilités, évaluation des risques et suivi des stratégies et contrôles de réduction des risques ;

- Gérez les risques liés aux tiers, fournisseurs et prestataires, en lien avec les processus de la Direction des Achats ;

- Contrôlez et suivez la conformité aux réglementations et référentiels applicables, notamment NIS2, ISO 27001, GPSSI, PSSIBMN, IGI 1300, II 901 et IM 900, et contribuez aux sujets liés au contrôle des exportations, en soutien des équipes juridiques et selon les exigences des clients ;

- Apportez votre soutien aux audits et aux contrôles des solutions de sécurité afin de garantir leur conformité aux règles de cybersécurité internes, régionales et nationales.

VOTRE PROFIL

Vous êtes diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent Bac+5 et vous disposez d’une solide connaissance des cadres de gouvernance et de gestion des risques cybersécurité, tels que ISO 27001, NIST ou CIS Controls, ainsi que des réglementations françaises et européennes en matière de sécurité ?
Vous maîtrisez les réglementations européennes et internationales, notamment NIS2, RGPD, ITAR et contrôle des exportations ?
Vous avez une bonne compréhension des architectures réseau, des protocoles industriels et des mesures de sécurité associées ?
Vous savez communiquer avec pédagogie sur des sujets techniques de cybersécurité auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques ?
Vous connaissez les outils d’évaluation des vulnérabilités et les techniques de tests d’intrusion ?
Vous savez analyser des rapports de cybersécurité et formuler des recommandations stratégiques ?
Vous êtes capable de coordonner l’utilisation de plateformes GRC telles qu’Agile RM ?

Vous faites preuve de leadership et savez coordonner des équipes transverses ?
Vous disposez d’excellentes qualités relationnelles et appréciez de collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques ?
Votre esprit d’analyse, votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes et votre vision stratégique vous permettent d’identifier les risques, de proposer des solutions concrètes et d’aligner les initiatives de cybersécurité avec les objectifs de l’entreprise ?

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

LE MOT DE L’ÉQUIPE
« Rejoignez nous contribuez, en collaboration avec l’ensemble de nos équipes cybersécurité et ingénierie, à renforcer la gouvernance, la maîtrise des risques et la conformité de nos environnements critiques. »

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. postings.title: H/F - Ingénieur Essais AIT – Constellation Satellites IRIS2
postings.description:
Lieu : Toulouse, France

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Nos engagements, vos avantages

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

VOTRE QUOTIDIEN

Au sein de la Direction CCAIT sur le site de Toulouse, vous rejoignez l'équipe Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) en charge des charges utiles RF dans le cadre du programme de constellation satellitaire IRIS².

- Vous êtes responsable de la préparation des activités d'essais sur les modèles de qualification et de vol. À ce titre, vous assurez la co-ingénierie avec les différents acteurs techniques et industriels impliqués dans le projet. Vous définissez, approvisionnez et préparez l'ensemble des moyens de tests nécessaires à la réalisation des campagnes d'essais et rédigez les spécifications des équipements de tests (EGSE) ainsi que les procédures associées aux domaines électriques et radiofréquences.
- Vous garantissez la disponibilité et la conformité des moyens de tests, des bases de données et des outils de conduite automatique avant chaque phase opérationnelle. Vous êtes notamment responsable des bases de données utilisées par les systèmes de tests automatisés.
- Lors des phases d'AIT au niveau Charge Utile et Satellite, vous pilotez et coordonnez les activités d'essais électriques, numériques et radiofréquences. Vous validez les interventions réalisées sur les équipements, surveillez l'intégrité des charges utiles et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes mécaniques, thermiques et système afin de sécuriser l'ensemble des opérations.
- Vous assurez l'encadrement fonctionnel des Techniciens de Mesures et intervenez sur différents sites industriels européens lorsque nécessaire. Certaines activités peuvent être réalisées en horaires décalés ou dans le cadre d'astreintes.
- Vous analysez les résultats d'essais, réalisez leur validation de premier niveau et approuvez les rapports d'essais en tant que référent métier. Vous contribuez également au traitement des non-conformités en participant aux analyses de causes et à la définition des plans d'actions associés.
- Vous participez activement à l'amélioration continue des activités AIT en capitalisant sur les retours d'expérience, en proposant des actions de compétitivité et en veillant au respect des exigences de qualité, de sécurité et d'environnement (ESD, FOD, ISO 8, habilitations, certifications, 5S, etc.).

Ce poste est proposé dans le cadre d’un CDI de chantier, c’est-à-dire un contrat à durée indéterminée lié à la durée du projet IRIS². Il prendra fin au terme du projet. Ce contrat vous permettra de participer à la réalisation du projet IRIS² tout en étant pleinement salarié de Thales Alenia Space France

VOTRE PROFIL

Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une formation supérieure en électronique, télécommunications, radiofréquences ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une première expérience dans un environnement RF, de préférence dans les secteurs spatial, aéronautique ou des télécommunications.
Vous possédez de solides connaissances en radiofréquence et maîtrisez les principes liés à la propagation des ondes, à la modulation ainsi qu'aux systèmes antennaires.
Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'utilisation des instruments de mesure RF tels que les analyseurs de spectre, générateurs de signaux, wattmètres et bancs de tests automatisés.
Une connaissance des systèmes et équipements constituant une charge utile satellitaire constitue un atout majeur. Une expérience acquise en conception, intégration, fabrication ou essais d'équipements numériques de type Digital Transparent Processor (DTP) serait également appréciée.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à évoluer dans des environnements techniques complexes et pluridisciplinaires. Doté(e) d'un fort esprit d'équipe, vous savez collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés tout en faisant preuve d'autonomie et de rigueur dans vos missions.
Votre sens de l'analyse, votre agilité et votre capacité à proposer des solutions innovantes vous permettent de contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue des activités. Orienté(e) client et résultat, vous aimez relever des défis techniques dans un contexte industriel exigeant.
Vous êtes disposé(e) à travailler en horaires décalés (2x8, 3x8), à assurer des astreintes et à effectuer des déplacements en France et à l'international dans le cadre des activités satellites et des campagnes de lancement.

LE MOT DE L'EQUIPE

"Passionné(e) par le spatial, vous intégrerez une équipe d'une trentaine de spécialistes engagés dans le développement et la qualification des futures constellations de satellites européennes."

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

● Recruter, développer et fidéliser une équipe diversifiée de Customer Engineers.
● Collaborer avec la direction commerciale pour aligner les ressources techniques sur les comptes et segments de marché prioritaires.
● Piloter l'exécution technique des cycles de vente complexes.
● Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des dirigeants (CTO, CIO, CISO) des comptes clients clés
● Servir de passerelle entre le terrain et les équipes d'ingénierie produit. Synthétiser les retours des clients et les tendances du marché pour influencer les feuilles de route et la priorisation des fonctionnalités.
● Optimiser les processus d'ingénierie avant-vente, l'allocation des ressources et les modèles de qualification (“POC”) et de déploiement (“Plays”) de notre Cloud afin d'accélérer la création de valeur pour les clients.

Vous disposez d'une expérience aboutie (> 10 ans) dans le management d’une population d’architectes Cloud, et dans la gestion des relations avec des parties prenantes interfonctionnelles.
Vous avez déjà travaillé avec des grands comptes dans un écosystème associé (partenaires/ISV).

Des certifications GCP constituent un véritable atout dans le cadre de ce recrutement ainsi que des connaissances techniques des infrastructures cloud, de l'analyse de données (Data Analytics), de la modernisation des applications et des frameworks d'IA/ML modernes.
Une bonne maitrise de l’anglais est obligatoire.

We are looking for a Head of Industrial Process Engineering to lead and develop our Industrial Process Engineering capability across the UK Industrial Centre of Competence. In this role, you will provide strategic leadership to a multi-disciplinary team, driving industrial excellence, continuous improvement and manufacturing transformation across a complex engineering and manufacturing environment.

Working closely with senior leaders across Operations, Engineering, Programmes and Supply Chain, you will ensure that industrial processes, tools, people and infrastructure are aligned to support business growth, operational performance and product lifecycle delivery. You will play a critical role in shaping industrial strategy, improving competitiveness and embedding a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes:
- Performance-related bonus up to 12% of your salary
- Car allowance
- Half day every Friday

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts
You can read about some of our other benefits here: United Kingdom benefits | Thales Group

Under Water Systems (UWS)
Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

Main Responsibilities
In this role you will:
- Lead and develop Industrial Process Engineering teams across multiple UK sites, fostering a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture.
- Define and implement industrial strategies, processes and capability development plans that improve operational efficiency, competitiveness and manufacturing readiness.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives, lean manufacturing practices and industrial transformation projects across the business.
- Act as the industrial authority at programme reviews and bid gates, ensuring robust industrialisation, production readiness and cost-effective delivery solutions.
- Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure industrial capabilities, resources and performance support business objectives.

Experience & Skills
We are looking for someone who can bring:
- Significant leadership experience within complex manufacturing, industrial or engineering environments.
- Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and delivering large-scale industrial improvement or transformation programmes.
- Strong knowledge of lean methodologies, continuous improvement techniques and industrial toolsets such as ERP, MRP and MES systems.
- Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across all organisational levels.
- A degree in an engineering, manufacturing or related discipline.

Experience across the full product lifecycle, defence manufacturing environments, or highly regulated industries would be highly advantageous.

Security Clearance Requirement: UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Job Role: Head of Discipline -Mechanical
Responsibilities:
The Mechanical Engineering – Discipline Management Roles are responsible for inspiring and catalysing the improvement of best practices within the Mechanical Engineering discipline, ensuring that they are mastered effectively. They act as a privileged point of contact on complex subjects and take on an educational role so that their team can reach discipline excellence and deliver competitive solutions within a multidisciplinary environment.
They are managers-coaches serving discipline’s engineers and offering a diverse and inclusive environment with Hungry Humble Aware values. They are the guardians of an engineering discipline excellence in a learning environment which contribute to highly competitive realizations (Quality, Attractiveness, Cost, Lead time).
As a Mechanical Engineering - Discipline Management Role within Thales, you will:
- Take in charge the Discipline Practices and Tools tailoring and deployment (incl. digitisation, automation, data management) across Projects and Products
Be responsible for the adoption of new technologies.
- Ensure the capitalisation and sharing of knowledge and assets (building blocks, cost estimating models, best practices, etc.)
- Foster continuous improvement based on root cause analysis, problem solving, new practice deployment, …
- Manage people within your discipline and ensure their development (skills management, coaching, career development, mindset), the adequacy with the expected needs (quality and quantity) at the right time and the allocation to the Bids and Projects
- Oversee mechanical activities and be plunged into a challenging environment, engage and develop team through the use of collaborative work and challenging approaches
- Be Innovative & support continuous Improvement
- You are able to empower and unite employees around clear objectives by acting as a coach and servant leader, which mobilises influencing and “team first” skills and You have substantial knowledge of Mechanical Engineering
- Perform technical reviews associated with their discipline on Bids/Products and Projects
Ensure Operational Subject Matter Experts allocate part of their time to coach engineering people and to train people about the Mechanical Engineering activities

Skill, Qualification & Experience :
- Graduate /master's in mechanical engineering with ~20 years of Industry experience in Mechanical Design & Development.
- Good technical background in mathematics, science, and computer science, with a great knowledge of Mechanical laws, norms and standards.
- Expertise with mechanical technology and associated tools, methods and processes
Mechanical design: DS Catia, DS Solidworks, DS Smarteam, PTC Creo, PTC PDMLink, Siemens NX, Autodesk AutoCAD, CAD Model, Drawings, Bill of Materials, Data Management.
- Mechanical simulation:
Ansys Mechanical, DS Abaqus, DS Dymola, MSC Nastran
Structural analysis (static, modal analysis, shocks, vibrations),
Mechanical tests correlation, Design optimization, Strength analysis
- Mechanical tests: Shocks and vibration tests, Qualification procedure. Demonstrate a strong desire for continuous improvement and a capacity to develop a strategic vision: you are able to integrate and even anticipate the various elements of your environment in order to guide the team through the challenges prompted by competitiveness.

Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages

- Un package de rémunération attractif

Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

À la tête d’une équipe d’environ 30 collaborateurs, composée d’ingénieurs Thales Alenia Space, de sous-traitants, de stagiaires et d’alternants, vous contribuez au développement et à la performance d’une discipline stratégique pour nos activités Télécom.

- Identifiez, développez et valorisez les expertises critiques tout en favorisant les actions de capitalisation et de partage des connaissances ;

- Définissez la stratégie et les objectifs associés à la discipline ainsi que les feuilles de route technologiques et d’innovation ;

- Favorisez les synergies entre projets et disciplines (IVV, numérique, DOS, DNF, TAS-I notamment) afin d’optimiser le coût des solutions techniques et d’assurer leur mise en œuvre.

VOTRE PROFIL

Vous êtes diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent Bac+5 (Électronique, Aéronautique, Spatial, Informatique) ou d’un cursus universitaire de niveau Master 2 ou plus et vous avez une expérience significative en management d’équipes ou en management transverse ?
Vous disposez d’une connaissance globale des différents métiers de l’Ingénierie et d’une vision multi-disciplines ou multi-produits ?
Vous possédez une expertise reconnue en transmission et dimensionnement RF ?
Vous savez développer une vision stratégique et porter les enjeux de votre discipline ?

Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à responsabiliser les équipes et à accompagner leur développement ?
Vous faites preuve de capacités d’influence, de résolution de conflits et êtes force de proposition ?
Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif, le co-engineering et l’animation de communautés d’expertise ?
Vous avez évolué dans des environnements liés à l’ingénierie ou l’architecture Télécom, idéalement dans le domaine des systèmes satellitaires ?
Vous possédez une expérience en ingénierie transmission, traitement du signal ou dimensionnement RF ?
Vous avez occupé des fonctions de management transverse (WPM, EDM, IVVQM) ou déjà exercé des responsabilités de type HoD ?

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

LE MOT DE L’EQUIPE
« Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est contribuer au pilotage d’une discipline clé des systèmes Télécom par satellite et accompagner le développement des compétences, des expertises et des innovations qui feront les solutions de demain. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement multidisciplinaire stimulant, au cœur des enjeux technologiques et stratégiques de la Business Line Telecom. »

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Ottawa, ON, Hybrid (1 day per week in office)

postings.title: HR Business Partner
postings.description:
Location: Amsterdam, Hullenbergweg 81-135 (Office), Netherlands

The Human Resources department is responsible for all employee related activities in the most broad sense. The HR Department plays a vital role to the success of the NL organisation. The Dutch HR department is multi-disciplinary and exists off HR Directors, HR Business Partners, HR Shared Service Centre, together with a number of Centres of Excellence (CoE); Compensations & Benefits, Professional Development, Payroll, HRIS, HR Legal, Talent Acquisition, Talent & Culture and the “Pensioenbureau”. The HR team supports all Dutch offices; Hengelo, Huizen, Eindhoven and Delft.
As HR we want to be good and always strive to get better. In this we act together as one. Do you want to contribute to this? As we are expanding, for our HQ in Hengelo, we are looking for an enthusiastic, inspiring and flexible

About the job
As an HR Business Partner, you have a varied job, managing the process of constant change with an eye for innovation. Thinking out-of-the-box and thinking along about cultural changes within the organization are also aspects that come to light in your role.

Your week as an HR Business Partner starts with the entire HR team, to keep each other informed about the most important projects and share relevant information during the stand-up meeting. During the working week you are regularly in conversation with different parties within the organization. In your role you are constantly switching between the interests and needs of the organization, the employees and managers. Acting like a coach is important in this. You are a sparring partner for department managers, covering various HR-related topics, the (expected) staffing, diversity and inclusion, professional and’s personal development programs, administrative matters, outflow and absenteeism. You also provide support, coach and challenge in the field of Performance Management and Professional Development.

About you
You are able to keep the overview and ‘challenge’ the interests of managers, employees and other stakeholders. You proactively contribute in obtaining the organizational goals by translating HR goals and questions into practical solutions. Besides acting as an interlocutor, it is important that you can easily connect with your colleagues in the HR department.
What you are able to offer:
- A degree HBO-/WO towards HRM/Business Administration;
- Approximately three year experience as HR advisor within a complex international matrix organisation;
- Knowledge of HR instruments;
- A flexible and agile mindset with capability to switch to as needed;
- A valuable interlocutor who can easily switch between different levels and stakeholders;
- Excellent communication skills, honourable, customer oriented, take initiatives, team player;
- Flexibility and drive to achieve desired outcomes in a VUCA environment.
- Is ready for a new challenge within a nice team to achieve results together;
- Good knowledge of the English & Dutch language
What is in it for you
- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovation work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.

- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skill.

- Valuable international collaboration with co-workers from 68 different countries around the globe.

- A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.

- You can usually work where and whenever you want. Within Thales, we aim for a 60/40 balance, where you work from home at least two days a week, when your role allow this.

- A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions; for instance, you can trade PTO for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.

- 40 days off per year (PTO).

Interested?
Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.

To ensure that we are a good match, we can ask you to participate in an assessment.

Diversity Statement
We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.

Security Requirements
In line with Thales' Baseline Security requirements, candidates will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in The Netherlands and employment and/or education history. Some vacancies may require a security clearance which can require further evidence to be provided. For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please refer to the General Intelligence and Security Service.

postings.title: HR Business Partner
HR Business Partner
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Missions and responsibilities :

This position is part of the Human Resources Department. The team apply the methodology as defined in the Thales reference system “Chorus2”. The job holder will be mainly responsible to:
1. HR Business Partnership
- Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, providing counsel on talent, culture, and engagement.
- Partner with leadership teams to translate business strategies into HR priorities.
- Support change management efforts for reorganizations, mergers, or new operating models.
- Provide coaching and guidance to managers on people-related matters.
- Build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
- Work collaboratively with HR Centres of Expertise and regional/global HR teams to deliver appropriate HR solutions.
2. Organisation & Workforce Planning
- Support workforce planning in line with business requirements and future capability needs.
- Partner with business leaders on organisational changes, including changes to workforce structure, roles, capabilities and ways of working.
- Support business transformation and workforce-related initiatives through effective HR planning and implementation.
- Analyse workforce trends and identify people and capability gaps.
- Work with business and Finance stakeholders to ensure workforce plans are aligned with business and cost objectives.
3. Talent & Workforce Management
- Support talent management, talent review and succession planning processes.
- Identify critical roles, talent and capability gaps and work with managers to address development needs.
- Partner with Talent Acquisition and Learning & Development to support current and future workforce requirements.
- Support leadership development, career development and internal mobility initiatives.
4. Data Analytics & Insights
- Leverage HR systems, dashboards, and analytics tools to create actionable workforce insights.
- Track key metrics such as turnover, engagement, diversity, productivity, and cost-to-hire.
- Present findings and recommendations to business leaders with clear narratives.
5. Employee Experience & Culture
- Experience working with union and managing collective agreement (CA).
- Monitor organizational climate through surveys and pulse checks.
- Partner with managers to address engagement issues and improve team performance.
- Champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging initiatives.
- Build effective relationships with all levels of the organization, providing guidance and coaching on employee relations, performance, and developments.
6. Project Management
- Lead or support country, regional and global HR programmes and initiatives.
- Work with HR, business and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver HR projects effectively.
- Support change management and communication activities associated with business and workforce changes.
- Drive continuous improvement of HR processes and employee experience.

Job Requirements

- Good degree, preferably with a Graduate Diploma in Human Resources Management / organizational development.
- 8-10 years of HR business partner or organization development experience, preferably in a complex large organization or MNC, Aerospace industry experience is a preferred.
- Excellent consultation skills, including the ability to work with several layers of management to discern challenges and opportunities and arrive at effective, responsive solutions.
- Ability to execute companywide initiatives with excellence in a fast-paced, global collaborative environment, commitment to innovation and continuous improvement.
- Strong knowledge of HR practices and demonstrated ability to provide HR solutions in a fast-paced and complex environment.
- Experience in workforce analytics, HR reporting, or organization design preferred.
- Professional certification (e.g., OD certification) is an advantage.
- Experience on company restructure; M&A; Carve Out; integration would be preferred.
- Project Management experience.
- Able to work under pressure, multi-task, and handle diverse issues.

Desired Skills and Experience
Coaching, Excellent Communication Skills, Talent Management, Leadership, Talent Acquisition, Change Management, Workforce Planning, HR Business Partnering, Succession Planning, Human Resources, Stakeholder Management, Employee Relations, Performance Management

Key Skills & Competencies
- Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into people solutions.
- Excellent consultation, facilitation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
- Strong coaching and communication skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a matrix and international environment.
- Good analytical ability and ability to translate workforce data into actionable insights.
- Strong judgement and discretion when handling sensitive employee matters.
- Understanding of change management principles and ability to support employees and managers through organizational change, operating module changes.
- Proficiency in HRIS and HR reporting tools, including Workday and Excel.
- Ability to execute HR initiatives effectively while managing multiple priorities.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.description:
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary

The HSE & Quality System Coordinator is responsible for the deployment, maintenance, compliance, and continuous improvement of Cuernavaca’s Health, Safety, Environment, Energy, and Integrated Management Systems, including legal compliance and certification readiness.
This role ensures the effectiveness of the site management systems under ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, Clean Industry, and the applicable automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949, while promoting continuous improvement, risk prevention, and operational discipline. The position provides technical coordination and leadership across cross-functional teams to ensure system integrity, audit readiness, legal conformity, emergency preparedness, and achievement of HSE and Quality System objectives.
The role also acts as a key liaison with internal stakeholders, external auditors, regulatory entities, and management teams, ensuring timely reporting, action plan follow-up, and sustainable compliance with corporate, legal, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Compliance Management
Ensure compliance with applicable HSE, environmental, occupational health, energy, and quality-related legal requirements, including identification of obligations, inspection readiness, follow-up of findings, and closure of action plans.
Legal compliance rate; number of overdue legal actions; inspection findings closure rate; zero major legal non-compliances.
Integrated Audit Management
Plan, coordinate, and follow up internal and external audits for the Integrated Management System, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and timely closure of findings.
100% audit program execution; audit finding closure rate; on-time action plan completion; zero major audit non-conformities.
HSE Site Strategy and Operations
Coordinate HSE programs, operational controls, prevention activities, and improvement initiatives to ensure effective implementation of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 requirements across the site.
LTI-FR vs target; occupational disease rate; HSE objectives achievement; safety action closure rate; environmental incident rate.
Management System Certification and Deployment
Ensure the integrity, implementation, maintenance, and certification readiness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, Clean Industry, and IATF 16949 management systems.
Certification status maintained; zero major non-conformities; successful surveillance/recertification audits; management system compliance rate.
Management Review and Performance Reporting
Consolidate and communicate management system, HSE, and compliance performance to site leadership and relevant stakeholders, ensuring visibility of risks, results, and improvement priorities.
On-time reporting completion; management review effectiveness; KPI visibility; escalation timeliness.
Emergency Preparedness and Brigade Coordination
Coordinate emergency response protocols, site brigade structure, drills, and related preparedness activities to ensure readiness and compliance with site requirements.
Emergency drill compliance; brigade readiness; emergency action closure rate; response protocol effectiveness.
Internal Auditor Team Coordination
Coordinate the internal auditor team, including planning, capability development, assignment of audits, and follow-up of results to strengthen audit effectiveness and system maturity.
Internal auditor qualification compliance; audit assignment completion; audit effectiveness; auditor development progress.
Continuous Improvement of Management Systems
Drive improvement projects and best practices focused on strengthening the effectiveness, maturity, and performance of HSE and Quality Systems.
Improvement projects completed; maturity progression; reduction in recurring findings; system performance improvement.
Customer and Quality System Focus
Ensure that the Integrated Management System maintains customer focus and compliance with applicable customer-specific requirements related to quality systems and automotive expectations.
CSR compliance; customer-related audit results; quality system conformity; zero customer escalations linked to system compliance.
Cross-Functional Compliance and Engagement
Work with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, HR, and support functions to ensure effective deployment of management system requirements and site-wide compliance culture.
Cross-functional action closure rate; stakeholder engagement effectiveness; training deployment compliance; system adherence across areas.

Competencies: Skills, Experience and Education

Formal Education
Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Safety Engineering, Quality Engineering, or related field.
Postgraduate studies or specialization in HSE, Quality Systems, Energy Management, or Integrated Management Systems.
Languages
Fluent English.
Additional international audit or regulatory communication exposure.
IT / Software
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Oracle, Intelex, and applicable systems for compliance, reporting, and management system follow-up.
Power BI, data analytics, or advanced compliance reporting tools.

About the team
You will join the Industry Quality & HSE team. Within this compact team, you will work closely with colleagues across the different departments within Industry. In this role, you are an active partner for department management and, above all, a visible point of contact on the work floor.

About your future job
As an HSE Officer, you are an important link between policy and practice. In a process and production environment, you help keep health, safety and environmental risks under control and drive continuous improvement.

A typical work week may include updating and following up on the Risk Inventory & Evaluation (RI&E) and the related action plan for your departments. You will perform exposure assessments for hazardous substances and support workplace inspections.

Your role is both advisory and hands-on: you will truly become part of the department as an advising and facilitating HSE partner. You discuss risks and improvement opportunities with colleagues, translate HSE-related issues into clear improvement actions, and support the analysis and follow-up of incidents.

What makes this role interesting is that you will work in an environment where safety, health and environment make a real difference every day. You will have plenty of room to work independently, with short communication lines to your HSE colleagues and management.
The main tasks are:
- jointly preparing and monitoring the RI&E, action plan, and mitigating measures;
- performing exposure assessments for hazardous substances (including CMR substances, where relevant);
- carrying out workplace inspections, toolbox talks and TRAs for non-routine tasks;
- monitoring the environmental aspects register and contributing to performance improvement;
- following up on HSE incidents and supporting incident investigations;
- acting as the first point of contact for HSE-related matters.

Why you'd be a good match
We are looking for a new colleague who:
- has at least 3 years of proven experience in the HSE field, preferably in an industrial environment;
- holds IVK or MVK (Integral / Middelbare Veiligheidskunde), or can demonstrate a comparable occupational safety background;
- has proven affinity with chemical/hazardous substances and exposure assessments;
- is practical and visible in day-to-day collaboration with departments, and is used to helping build a strong HSE culture;
- has a good command of Dutch and English for communication with colleagues and alignment within the team and organization;
- is able to work independently within clear frameworks, handle a dynamic environment with flexibility, and communicate transparently.

What's in it for you
- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes freedom for initiative and good ideas.
- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
- Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe.
- A comfortable workspace in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.
- You can usually work where and when you want to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.

The Senior ILS Engineer will form part of the Engineering Support Team and is responsible for provision of Logistic Support Analysis services and deliverables in support of the Scylla Sonar suite deployed on the Collins Class Submarines under the Scylla In-Service Support (ISS) contract. The Senior ILS Engineer collaborates with stakeholders including Management, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply and Training functions as well as the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team.

KEY ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
As a Scylla ILS Engineer, you are accountable for:

- Leading ILS engineering tasks using approved plans, policies, procedures, tools and processes.
- Conducting supportability analysis to identify deficiencies with stock levels.
- Performing spares analysis and modelling to identify requirements for spares and repair parts.
- Managing the Failure Reporting and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) and conducting analysis to identify reliability issues.
- Managing the Allowance Parts List (APL) and Shipboard Allowance List (SAL).
- Submission of new part codification requests.
- Performing Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Testability (RAMT) analysis of Sonar and Towed Array systems.
- Building Reliability Block Diagrams and conducting Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA).
- Providing support for maintenance planning, using Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM), to identify predictive and preventive maintenance tasks.
- Supporting the engineering team with obsolescence studies.
- Identification of ILS products to support the development of ECPs and CCPs.
- Developing logistic support products and reports to meet the requirements of the Contract.
- Ensuring that ILS procedures, processes and work practices are sufficiently comprehensive to enable production of the ILS deliverables to the satisfaction of the Contract.

KEY KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE
To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:
- Tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in a relevant Engineering discipline.
- Formal qualifications in ILS preferred but not essential.
- Planning and executing the identification and development of logistics support and system requirements for military or maritime systems.
- Experience in performing logistic engineering tasks.
- Understanding contracted requirements and the application of technical specifications and standards.
- Aptitude and experience for interpreting technical engineering information (drawings and manuals)
- Experience in managing technical documentation life-cycles.
- Working knowledge of engineering lifecycles and Configuration Management requirements.
- Experience in an In-service Support (ISS) environment performing reliability studies, Maintenance Requirements Determination (MRD) or field service studies.

GOOD TO KNOW
Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and (role dependent) medical checks. A Defence security clearance is required for this role; applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role.

The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role. The U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR) are applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY
After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process. Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

Victoria, B.C., Ottawa, ON., Halifax, N.S., (CAN.), Hybrid

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Supportability and Reliability Analyst (ILS Officer) to conduct, contribute and assist in the preparation and delivery of various Supportability Engineering and Product Support Analyses, plans and reports with the objective of improving the support system of an equipment and / or a system and optimizing the maintainability, availability and the life cycle cost.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Review vendor documentation and identify maintenance and support requirements.
- Collect, organize and expedite the necessary technical data to conduct Product and Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) activities such as Functional Analysis; Failures Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis; Reliability Centered Maintenance Analysis; Level of Repair Analysis; Maintenance Task Analysis and Sparing Analysis.
- Determine required spares and spares quantities to support equipment by reviewing technical publications and usage data as well as interacting with Thales engineering, procurement and service delivery personnel, Technical Authorities or ship staff.
- Review Maintenance Plans, Preventive or Corrective Maintenance Schedules, and Instructions and Performance Test and operational data to propose amendments to eliminate or control equipment failures or to improve maintainability, increase ship availability or reduce life cycle costs.
- Develop Maintenance Plans, Preventive or Corrective Maintenance Schedules, and Instructions and Performance Tests as well as Spare Parts List and accompanying Provisioning Technical Data for any new equipment or modification to existing ship systems.
- Identify the maintenance or spares required to support Short Work Periods or Docking work Periods. Manage the data within Logistics Support Analysis Record (LSAR). Conduct Lifecycle Cost Analysis and report Thru Life Costs. Assist in the preparation and execution of various Supportability plans or B2B processes. Support Engineering personnel with the development of Engineering Change proposals.
- Review elements of the technical data package to ensure that the technical data reflects the latest system/equipment configuration of the ships, is complete, accurate and consistent across the support solution. Prepare Statements of Work to procure supportability services and perform the role of Technical Authority in the delivery of the services.

- An Engineering degree or Technologist diploma in mechanical, electrical, electronic, industrial, reliability or naval engineering.
- Five years or more experience conducting Logistics Support Analysis in maintenance and supply support of complex systems or equipment.

- Experience supporting an operational military asset. Experience developing Integrated Logistics Support Plans, Processes or Procedures.
- Experience identifying and addressing Logistics Support Analysis deficiencies in Technical Publications. Above average Microsoft Windows application experience, communications and interpersonal skills are required for this position.

We Say HI*

Incident Coordination Manager (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

- Verantwortung für das Management kritischer IT-Servicevorfälle über den gesamten Incident-Lifecycle hinweg – von der Erkennung bis zur nachhaltigen Behebung – zur Sicherstellung hoher Serviceverfügbarkeit und SLA-Konformität

YOUR TEAM
Our Underwater Systems team are proud to support the Royal Australian Navy, providing integrated mission-critical solutions to below-surface platforms. With access to some of the world’s most advanced technologies, our people enable naval forces around the world with our state-of-the-art Sonar and undersea combat systems.

YOUR ROLE
As an SSN Industrial Cleaner you will be involved with Virgina Class Submarine maintenance and support activities.This role is responsible for the decontamination, cleaning, preservation and detailing activities associated with hazardous and radiologically access-controlled (reactor) compartments, equipment and materials in support of Virginia Class Submarine maintenance activities. The role supports nuclear safety, regulatory compliance and operational readiness requirements at PHNSY.

WHAT’S ON OFFER
- Permanent full-time employment

- Specialist overseas training secondment in the Pearl Harbour Naval Shipyard, Hawaii

- Comprehensive relocation and international assignment support

GOOD TO KNOW

What you'll be doing
As our Industrialisation Engineer, you'll take ownership of the later stages of the New Product Introduction (NPI) journey, guiding products through Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRL) 5 to 8 and beyond.
You'll:
- Lead the industrialisation process from prototype through to production readiness.

- Develop and implement manufacturing facilities, tooling and processes that enable successful production.

- Drive Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) assessments and ensure key milestones are achieved.

- Host Production Readiness Reviews (PRRs) and coordinate actions across multifunctional teams.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Production, Planning, Health & Safety, Project Management and wider business stakeholders.

- Set up and maintain ERP, MES routes, BOMs and manufacturing routings.

- Support production-released products, resolving post-launch manufacturing challenges.

- Champion continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and InCIght methodologies.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, throughput and manufacturing performance.

- Contribute to the development of best practice within the Industrial Engineering community.

What you'll bring
We're interested in your potential as much as your experience. If you don't meet every requirement but believe you have the skills and passion to succeed, we encourage you to apply.
You'll likely have:
- Experience within New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing, industrial engineering or production engineering environments.

- A strong understanding of manufacturing and production processes.

- Knowledge of Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

- Experience managing projects, work packages or complex deliverables.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- The ability to influence stakeholders and build relationships across multiple teams.

- Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach.

- A proactive mindset with a passion for driving improvements and delivering results.

Why join us?
At Thales, you'll be part of a supportive environment where your ideas are valued, your development is encouraged, and your contribution genuinely matters.
You'll join a team responsible for introducing innovative products from concept through to production, working alongside Industrial Process Engineers, Industrial Architects and Cost Engineers to deliver world-class manufacturing solutions.
We know that diverse teams drive better outcomes, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Whether you're looking for your next challenge, a broader scope of responsibility, or the opportunity to make a lasting impact, this could be the role for you.
Ready to shape the future of manufacturing?

Together, we'll build solutions that make a difference.

postings.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Information Assurance/Technical Security Specialist
Multiple office locations considered (Doncaster, Crawley, Reading, Cheadle, Bristol)

Thales is a global technology leader in the Aerospace, Defence and Digital Security sectors, operating across 68-countries and continuing to expand. We are heavily investing in digital and “deep tech” innovations – Big Data, artificial intelligence, connectivity, cyber security and quantum technology – to build a future we can all trust.

We’re recruiting for a Information Assurance/Technical Security Specialist to provide technical security advice and guidance on the efficient and effective secure through-life management of systems related to the use, processing, storage, and transmission of Thales information or data.

Reporting to the Thales UK Deputy CISO, the Information Assurance/Technical Security is responsibility for the identification of applicable technical security requirements and their associated cost-effective security controls as well as through-life continual security assurance of Thales IS environments throughout their design, implementation, transition into service, and operational lifespans.

We’re looking for an individual who has exposure to complex enterprise IT systems, ideally within a regulated or safety critical environment. Our environment crosses multiple sectors from Aerospace and Defence, through to Cyber, Finance and Air Traffic Management.

What will you deliver?
- Technical Security: Support Thales UK in ensuring all IS/IT technical security measures are implemented, enhanced and developed where necessary, to ensure successful and timely security assurance via on-going through-life continual assurance and compliance programmes.
- Technical Security Point of Contact (PoC): Provide a central PoC for all IS/IT technical security matters and concerns, supporting delivery teams and businesses throughout project lifecycles.
- Change management: Conduct security reviews of internal/ externally connected platform related changes ensuring Security risks, impacts and mitigations are managed appropriately.
- Cloud Security: provide security guidance around the secure deployment and usage of Thales adopted public cloud infrastructure and/or SaaS services (e.g., Azure) in compliance with government security guidelines, Thales’s policy and industry accepted “good practices” for security.
- Compliance & Governance: ensure Thales on-premises and cloud environments comply with government policies, such as Cyber Essentials, DefStan 05-138, UK GDPR, NCSC guidelines and other applicable contractual and regulatory frameworks.
- Evidence Continual Security Assurance: Creation, Maintenance and Review of all IS/IT technical security documentation, policy and procedures associated with Thales’ IS/IT networks, systems and applications, as per Customer (primarily HMG UK MOD) and Thales Group policy and mandatory requirements.
- Incident Response: Be responsible for the reporting, investigation and analysis of security incidents and potential breaches within classified environments, working with the Thales UK Incident management team to ensure identified issues are resolved quickly.
- IS/IT Squad Engagement: Develop security requirements, epics and stories, along with guidance & governance to squads to ensure data protection and data security are included in the scope of new and existing IS/IT Squad activities, initiatives and projects.
- Risk Focused Delivery: Able to work collaboratively with other team members to ensure proposed solutions provide the required level of security assurance in line with data processing requirements, as well as Thales and customer risk appetites.
- Risk Management: Responsibility for developing and coordinating the implementation of formal and regular technical risk and compliance assessments of Thales’ IS environments, recommending remedial action where required.
- Third Party CoCo Assurance: Provide assurance and ensure successful and secure delivery of all Code of Connections (CoCos), associated cryptographic products, key material and required documentation.
- Training & Development: Engage in continuous learning and development both for yourself as well as supporting less experienced Thales UK staff in their development.

Who are we looking for?
- Demonstrable experience of applying security principles within an agile delivery framework.
- Evidential experience as subject matter expert in the evaluation and implementation of technical security products and solutions for Public or Private sector organisations.
- Evidential experience in the identification, assessment and management of technical security risks, developing risk mitigation strategies, and tracking residual risk throughout the risk lifecycle.
- Demonstrable experience of managing assurance and/or compliance activities associated with a defined security standard (ISO 27001, Def-Stan 05-138, NIST SP 800-*, NIST CSF).
- Experience developing security assurance frameworks and governance models.
- Experience in performing formal risk assessments and production of security reporting artefacts within both on-premises and cloud-based environments.
- Evidential experience as subject matter expert in the evaluation and implementation of technical security products for MS Office 365, Azure cloud based Public or Private sector organisations.
- Able to interpret detailed system design documentation, identifying potential security risks and recommend mitigations containing levels of security appropriate to the associated risk levels.
- Able to interpret security standards and derive solution specific security requirements from these and assess solutions against these standards for compliance for both new and changes to existing systems/applications.
- Demonstrable understanding of security across the full stack of information systems, (network, infrastructure and applications) both on-premises and cloud-hosted (MS Azure, Oracle, AWS; PaaS, IaaS and SaaS).
- In-depth experience of technical security issues and remediation activities across a range of system and application platforms, including cloud-based and on-premises.

Desirable:
- Information Security Qualification: MSc (InfoSec)/CISSP/CISM or similar certifications
- Demonstrable understanding of Azure Stack including Security products.
- Current Cloud Security Qualification, e.g. CCSK, CCSP
- Demonstrable understanding of Office 365 Stack including associated Security Risks, Threats and countermeasures.
- Understanding of current and emerging Security technologies.
- Qualifications: AZ-500, CCSP, CISSP, SABSA

Security Clearance statement
This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for Baseline and Security Clearance please refer to the National Security Vetting (NSV) Agency - United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

Your Career at Thales UK
Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your Competencies in different areas:
- Room and attention to personal development
- Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
- Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
- Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

What we can offer
We are committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.

Our packages will include significant bonus, a strong pension contribution, private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities. Further support can be provided towards academic and membership attainments.

Role Overview
This role focuses on delivering and supporting secure, automated, Linux‑based server hosting services for internal and external Thales customers. You will work across the full lifecycle of backend infrastructure — from design and build through to automation, configuration management, and ongoing operational support — within a highly controlled, air‑gapped environment.

- Build and support Linux‑based hosting platforms across virtualised and private cloud environments.
- Deliver infrastructure components to agreed designs, standards, and security requirements.
- Produce and maintain high‑quality design documentation, run books, and operational guides.
- Work independently or within a team to deliver new services, enhancements, and technical changes.
- Diagnose complex issues across Linux, virtualisation, storage, and automation layers.
- Identify opportunities to improve automation, reduce manual effort, and enhance service reliability.
- Share knowledge across the team through documentation, mentoring, technical walkthroughs, and collaborative problem‑solving.
- Support the development of colleagues by coaching team members, contributing to skill‑building activities, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

- Escalate issues appropriately and support resolution of escalated incidents.

Typical Routines:

- Raising and progressing change requests.
- Updating system documentation and configuration repositories.
- Proactively responding to project and operational issues.
- Developing new technical skills and staying current with automation and Linux technologies.

Person Specification:
- Bachelor’s degree or minimum 3 years’ experience in Linux infrastructure, DevOps, or third‑line hosting roles.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and non‑technical teams.
- Ability to improve processes, automation pipelines, and operational tooling.

- Ansible automation

- Red Hat Satellite
- Virtualisation platforms such as VMware vSphere, NSX, and Aria

- Experience working within large, secure, managed estates.

postings.description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

Job summary

The IRIS2 (Infrastructure for Resilience, Interconnectivity and Security by Satellite) constellation is the European Union’s answer to pressing challenges ahead, offering enhanced communication capacities to governmental users, businesses, while ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones. The need for a secure and resilient global connectivity increases with the digitization of the economy and society, and the increasing geopolitical and cybersecurity threats.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will join the IRIS2 team and you will be responsible with the configuration and administration of the project environment, including orchestration of on-prem containers. The project respects the policies of Thales software development, using the Agile methodology and various automation tools implemented in Gitlab pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain and manage dedicated project business networks from the infrastructure perspective

- Negotiate with stakeholders the best technical implementation for the customer requirements

- Advise engineering team on the capabilities and timeline of the future implementations

- Assists as part of the team on the design of components of larger systems.

- Produces detailed architectural documents related to the existing infrastructure

- Puts skills and project experience into practice and provides support to less experienced colleagues.

Required Skills & Experience:
- Solid virtualization skills: VMware, Virt-manager

- Solid knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes orchestration, cluster administration, especially on-prem

- Strong experience with system administration: Linux (mainly RHEL)

- Proven competencies related to networking, in different project contexts

- Previous experience with various scripting tools: shell scripting, Python

- Implementation of security and compliance policies (Security patch updates)

- Ability to follow technical procedures

- Ability to create technical documentation

Nice to have:
- Experience with various DevOps technologies: GitLab, Artifactory, Ansible, Terraform

- CCNA certification

- Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) certification

Behavioral skills:
- Clear communication on technical issues (oral and written)

- Ability to efficiently manage incidents and problems within a multiple teams / multiple cultures environment

- Effective team collaboration

- Teamwork mindset

Mobility:
- Travel to FR – 1-2 / year if necessary

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

- Proven expertise in server management (Linux) and virtualization (KVM, Proxmox).

Votre priorité est de garantir la réussite de projets d'infrastructure critiques dans un environnement international ?
Vous avez l'ambition de fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires et d'accompagner la transformation Agile d'une organisation Infrastructure ?

- Le pilotage de projets ou de produits d'infrastructure IT,

- La gestion des risques, des parties prenantes et des budgets projets.

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

postings.title: Ingeniero/a de procesos (SMD)
postings.description:
Location: Barcelona, Spain

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Thales Cybersecurity & Digital Identity es un líder global en seguridad digital, aportando confianza a un mundo cada vez más conectado. Diseñamos y ofrecemos una amplia gama de productos, software y servicios basados en dos tecnologías principales: la identificación digital y la protección de datos.

Debido a un aumento en la actividad, estamos buscando un Ingeniero/a de Procesos SMD, con sede en Parets del Vallès, Barcelona. Como parte del Equipo de ingeniería de procesos, serás responsable de:

- Analizar, optimizar, desarrollar e implementar mejoras en el desempeño de los procesos de SMD, asegurando el cumplimiento de los KPIs industriales y de los requisitos de calidad asociados a normas IATF, VDA y clientes automoción.
- Ejecutar estudios de métodos, tiempos y eficiencia, identificando pérdidas, cuellos de botella y oportunidades de optimización de procesos, equipos y organización del trabajo.
- Dar soporte técnico continuo a Producción y Mantenimiento, incluyendo la ejecución de ajustes técnicos, mecánicos o de proceso en máquinas, equipos y herramientas, cuando sea necesario y conforme a la cadena de ayuda definida.
- Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con Operadores, Mantenimiento y Calidad para desarrollar, implementar y validar acciones de mejora continua, poka‑yokes y soluciones técnicas, garantizando la estabilidad y robustez del proceso.
- Desarrollar, implementar y mantener herramientas de control estadístico de procesos (SPC / CEP), asegurando el control de la variabilidad y la detección temprana de desviaciones.
- Participar activamente en actividades de APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), asegurando la correcta industrialización de nuevos productos y procesos, incluyendo validaciones, documentación y cumplimiento de requisitos de cliente.
- Definir, implementar y mantener documentación de proceso conforme a estándares IATF/VDA (instrucciones de trabajo, planes de control, PFMEA, etc.), asegurando su correcta aplicación en producción.
- Analizar datos de producción, calidad y desempeño de equipos para identificar desviaciones y definir, ejecutar y dar seguimiento a acciones correctivas y preventivas.
- Apoyar al equipo de Calidad en la investigación de problemas de calidad de producto o proceso, participando activamente en análisis de causa raíz (5 Why, Ishikawa, Pareto, etc.) y en la implementación de acciones de contención y corrección.

- Veille et analyse des évolutions des standards

- Animation du groupe d’auditeurs techniques PCB.

- Procédés de fabrication des PCBs
- Méthodologie de qualification en cas de nouveaux équipements ou de changement matière
- Design for PCB Manufacturing, Contraintes d’industrialisation d’un PCB, en phase NPI, en phase série
- Maîtrise des concepts de capabilité et Répétabilité, résolution de problème (8D, Ishikawa…) et d’amélioration continue (SPC, MSA, DOE…), PFMEA

- Bonne compréhension des contraintes liées à la production, l'intégration et les essais des satellites et instruments spatiaux.

Des connaissances en microvibrations et/ou en opto-mécanique constitueront un atout supplémentaire.
Reconnu pour votre esprit d'équipe, votre sens du service et votre capacité à évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, vous appréciez le travail collaboratif et les défis techniques de haut niveau.
