Position Summary

Thales Canada is seeking a Junior Mechanical Engineer to support the Engineering Change Program for the Royal Canadian Navy's Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ship (AOPS) and Joint Support Ship (JSS) fleets under the AJISS program.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary Engineering Change Team, the successful candidate will support intermediate and senior engineers in the assessment, design, implementation, and documentation of modifications to shipboard mechanical systems. Responsibilities will include engineering work related to propulsion, maneuvering, bilge, ballast, hydraulic, pneumatic, HVAC, and auxiliary systems. Through mentorship and practical experience, the candidate will develop skills in mechanical design, engineering analysis, technical investigations, and engineering change management while contributing to safe, reliable, and maintainable solutions that meet customer, quality, schedule, and cost objectives.

Key Areas of Responsibility

The Junior Mechanical Engineer may assist engineers with some or all of the following:

• Support the implementation and coordination of engineering changes and engineering work packages under the guidance of intermediate and senior engineers;
• Conduct technical investigations into problems associated with marine equipment and/or system malfunction, including failure and root cause analysis, risk assessments, and solution development;
• Assist with the development, traceability, verification, and validation of engineering requirements throughout the engineering change lifecycle;
• Conduct Options Analysis;
• Development and review of Engineering plans, processes and procedures;
• Manage or support the preparation and updating of marine system technical documentation including manufacturing drawings, design and materiel specifications, installation and maintenance instructions, and test and trials documentation;
• Prepare documented work scopes suitable for solicitation of quotations from external resources such as OEM’s, manufacturers, suppliers, repair and testing facilities, or specialist service providers;
• Support the development of technical proposals, schedule estimates, and cost estimates for customer approval;
• Perform engineering calculations and support design reviews for piping, hydraulic, HVAC, pneumatic, structural, and mechanical systems; and

To provide products and customer solutions in consistency with all stakeholders’ needs and entity policies, as well as continuously enhance engineering competitiveness.

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Junior Project Buyer to be responsible for coordinating and executing procurement activities for assigned projects, ensuring all goods and services are sourced to meet project specifications, timelines, and budgetary requirements. This role manages the full purchase cycle, engages in supplier negotiations, fosters supplier relationships, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to support project goals while adhering to company policies and ethical standards.

Key Areas of Responsibility
Request-to-Order Fulfilment (PR to PO):
• Receive, review, and process internal purchase requisitions (PR) for project-specific goods and services in accordance with company policies and requirements.
• Convert PRs into accurate and compliant purchase orders (PO), verifying commodity codes, ship-to locations, supplier information, and required documentation (with guidance as needed).
• Check PO details for completeness and compliance before release (e.g., contractual/quality requirements, lead times, and ordering constraints).
• Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders to clarify PR/PO details and resolve discrepancies.

Sourcing & RFx/RFP Administration:
• Support sourcing activities for project requirements, including assisting with RFx/RFP documentation and coordination.

postings.title: L2 NOC Engineer
postings.location: Austin, Texas, United States of America
postings.description:
Location: Austin, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

This is for a hybrid role in Austin, Texas US.

Position Summary

The L2 NOC Engineer provides advanced operational support for mission-critical customer environments monitored by the Network Operations Center (NOC). This role is responsible for monitoring production systems, analyzing alerts and incidents, performing technical troubleshooting, coordinating escalations, and supporting service restoration activities to maintain service availability and operational performance.

Working within established service level agreements (SLAs), operational procedures, and security requirements, the L2 NOC Engineer assesses service impact, executes approved remediation activities, and collaborates with internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders as needed to resolve incidents efficiently. Responsibilities are performed during scheduled NOC shifts, on-call rotations, planned maintenance activities, major incident events, and operational handoffs.

The NOC supports continuous monitoring, incident management, escalation coordination, and operational stability for critical Identity and Biometrics Solutions environments.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements
Must have U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain the post-hire Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Clearance from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and must be able to obtain post-hire clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investments in the U.S. (CFIUS) and Department of Justice.

Key Areas of Responsibility

- Follow Thales operational processes, NOC procedures, customer support requirements, and applicable security and compliance standards.

- Serves as initial point of contact during assigned NOC shifts, on-call rotations, planned maintenance windows, major incident response, and operational handoffs.

- Monitor production systems, infrastructure, applications, networks, alerts, logs, and service dashboards to identify incidents, outages, and service degradation.

- Perform L2 incident triage, technical troubleshooting, service impact assessment, and approved corrective actions within authorized access and change control boundaries.

- Execute documented runbooks, standard operating procedures, and remediation activities to restore service or minimize customer impact.

- Escalate complex incidents to engineering, infrastructure, application, database, security, vendor, or service delivery teams, providing relevant technical details and impact assessments.

- Participate in major incident response activities, bridge calls, planned maintenance events, change validations, and service restoration efforts.

- Create and maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation, operational reports, shift handover notes, and knowledge base articles.

- Identify recurring issues, monitoring gaps, process improvements, and automation opportunities for review by NOC leadership and engineering teams.

- Communicate incident status, service impacts, and operational updates clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.

- Ensure compliance with customer requirements, data protection standards, access controls, security policies, and applicable regulatory obligations.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in a NOC, SOC, technical support, systems operations, infrastructure operations, or similar production support environment.

- Experience troubleshooting application, server, network, database, cloud, or enterprise platform incidents using monitoring tools, logs, dashboards, and ticketing systems.

- Working knowledge of incident management, escalation management, SLA tracking, change management, and operational handoff practices.

- Ability to follow runbooks, perform structured troubleshooting, document findings, and communicate status in time-sensitive environments.

- Experience using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Remedy, or equivalent platforms.

- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Nagios, SolarWinds, Zabbix, Datadog, Dynatrace, or similar solutions.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident documentation, technical updates, and stakeholder coordination.

- Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment, including shifts, weekends, holidays, maintenance windows, and on-call rotations.

Preferred Qualifications

- Ability to obtain and maintain required background clearances.

- Experience supporting identity management, biometrics, government, public safety, secure credentialing, or other high-availability environments.

- Knowledge of Linux, Windows Server, networking fundamentals, SQL/database administration, scripting, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity monitoring concepts.

- ITIL Foundation, Network+, Security+, Linux+, Microsoft, AWS, Azure, or similar technical certifications preferred.

- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.

- Additional technical or IT service management certifications are preferred but not required unless mandated by customer or regulatory requirements.

Special Position Requirements
Travel:
10% of the time or as needed

As an DevOps Engineer for the Thales CDI/MCS products On-Demand Connectivity (ODC) and eUICC IoT Manager(eIM), you will apply software engineering skills to build, maintain, support and optimize mission-critical, cloud-native systems and applications. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring our ODC &eIM solutions are reliable, scalable, and performant.

- Infrastructure & Automation: Design, develop, and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles. Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.
- Cloud Operations: Install, configure, and manage Kubernetes-based solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- System Reliability: Take ownership of production systems with a "you build it, you run it" mindset. Manage real-time system monitoring, observability, and incident response to meet strict SLA commitments.

- Strong understanding of networking (IPv4, Subnetting, TCP/IP, packet routing).
- Deep knowledge of HTTP(S), SOAP, and REST APIs.
- Strong proficiency in Apache, SSL/TLS/mTLS.
- Databases: Hands-on experience in Cassandra and MySQL.
- Telecom Domain (Preferred): Experience with eSIM technologies (e.g., SGP22/32) and telecommunications infrastructure.
- Development: A background in Java is highly preferred.

Behavior Competencies

- Communication: Strong communicator capable of managing conflicts in a fast-paced environment.
- Adaptability: Quick learner, flexible with hours, and ready to participate onsite in 24/7 team support to ensure system resilience.

postings.description:
Standort: Berlin, Germany

We Say HI*

Lager- und Logistik-Spezialist im Rechenzentrum (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

postings.title: Lead Data & AI Analyst – Zenith Program - F/H
postings.description:
Lieu : Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

Dans le cadre de sa transformation digitale, Thales déploie le programme Zenith pour moderniser ses processus métiers end-to-end, structurer ses données et mettre en place un nouvel ERP avec SAP S/4.
La direction « Data Continuity » accompagne cette transformation en créant et en fiabilisant les données nécessaires à l’entreprise.
Ce poste a pour objectif d’automatiser la découverte, l’analyse et la modélisation des données, de valoriser les schémas de données existants et d’assurer la continuité entre les données et la connaissance métier.

Dans ce cadre vos principales missions seront :

- Piloter l’analyse des sources diverses (ERP, CRM, modèles conceptuels, …) et concevoir des modèles de données partageables.
- Assurer la qualité et la cohérence de modélisation des données en lien avec les processus basé sur des règles de contrôle, des mesures et des plans de remédiation.
- Concevoir des pipelines et des outils pour collecter, transformer, contrôler et exposer les données.
- Traduire les besoins métier en exigences data et accompagner les transformations (indicateurs, vues, migrations ERP).
- Intégrer l’IA et la sémantique pour analyser, structurer et relier les données (knowledge graphs, data products).
- Encadrer les profils juniors, documenter et standardiser, et contribuer à la feuille de route data et aux choix d’architecture.

Votre profil :

Vous disposez d'un Bac +5 ou Doctorat en Data, Informatique, IA ou d’une formation similaire. Vous avez une expérience de 8 à 10 ans en modélisation de données (modèles dimensionnels, modèles logiques, vues métier).

Le leadership, la capacité à collaborer avec des équipes variées et l'esprit d’analyse sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ? Vous avez envie de transmettre et la capacité à encadrer ?
Vous êtes orienté vers des solutions concrètes et réutilisables, avec une forte capacité à prendre du recul tout en maîtrisant les détails techniques.

- Maîtrise de l’analyse de données : Language Python, SQL avancé, exploration, profiling, contrôles de qualité.
- Solide expérience en modélisation de données (modèles dimensionnels, modèles logiques, vues métier).
- Vous vous intéressez à l’automatisation (scripts, APIs, orchestrateurs) appliqué à la donnée, pratique des pipelines / data factory (ETL/ELT, orchestrateurs, CI/CD data).
- Bonne culture des technos data modernes : data platforms, data fabric / mesh, catalogues, APIs, event streaming, etc.
- Expérience ou forte appétence pour : l’IA appliquée à la donnée (modèles de scoring, NLP, LLM pour l’analyse / la structuration),
- Appétence pour les graphes de données / knowledge graphs, sémantique, ontologies (un plus apprécié).
- Vous savez passer du concret (scripts, tables) à l’abstraction (modèles, concepts, ontologies).
- Vous documentez ce que vous faites et avez envie de laisser quelque chose de réutilisable.
- Par ailleurs :
- Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés : métier, business analysts, IT, architecture, data.
- Esprit structuré, capacité prendre de la hauteur (vision, cible) et à descendre en profondeur (détail des tables, des règles, des mappings).

Le mot du manager :

Au cœur de ce programme, la direction « Data Continuity » joue un rôle essentiel en assurant la modélisation, la valorisation et la fiabilité des assets data nécessaires à cette transformation.
Intégrer cette équipe, c’est rejoindre une dynamique collective porteuse d’innovation et contribuer directement à l’évolution des pratiques de gestion et d’exploitation de la donnée chez Thales.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.description:

This is about building the system itself—the connectors, agents, orchestration layer, marketplace infrastructure, and enabling frameworks that will define how engineers interact with agentic AI.

- Help team members navigate complex technical challenges and connect them with right expertise
- Foster a culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement

About you:

Your Experience:

- Proven track record building complex, scalable systems from the ground up
- Deep expertise in: distributed systems (Kubernetes preferred), AI/ML engineering, infrastructure development, or developer tools
- Architecture experience: Made significant architectural decisions and lived with the consequences

Your Technical Expertise:

- Software Excellence: TDD, BDD, clean architecture, DevOps infrastructure, performance optimization

Your Leadership Approach:

postings.title: Lead IVVQ Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Templecombe, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Under Water Systems (UWS)
Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

Primary Purpose of the Role:
The Communications and Acoustic Products (CAP) team support the development and maintenance of RF communications systems and products including antennas, processing and distribution equipment, communications buoys, across multiple projects.

The Lead IVVQ engineer will work with the CAP engineering delivery team to enable early identification of key customer and legislative requirements in response to customer RFQs. These will be used to inform solution orientation capturing the scope of work required, enabling analysis to provide informed, cost, schedule, and resource estimates to deliver the project.

A Lead IVVQ Engineer typically takes the lead in all aspects of system integration and system testing including writing/authorising test specifications, conducting/authorising the testing, reporting and/or investigating defects.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks:
- Converts requirements into conceptual designs and prepares associated documentation by performing operational analyses, simulations and technical trade-off studies evaluating alternative design configurations and functional features.

- Good understanding of the development lifecycle and lifecycle products.

- Interfacing with the client, to gain approval of test specifications and to host acceptance testing activities.

- Writing and/or authorising the execution of Test Specifications.

- Execute test specifications (according to test plan and project schedule).

- Recording and/or approving of results of test execution.

- Raise/investigate/verify defects.

- Maintain agreed quality target/standards.

- Provide status reports to the Principal IVVQ Engineer.

- Identify test method (IADT)

- Infeed / own / drive design reviews (CDR, PDR, TRR, TQR and FQR)

- Able to create and/or authorise outline designs from requirements using a variety of design toolsets

- Similarly creates new concepts or modifies existing concepts to fulfil requirements where necessary

- Prepares system & subsystem requirement specifications, interface requirements and test requirement documents by analysing, decomposing modelling and refining customer requirements.

- Prepares system operational plans and reports that explain how the equipment being developed meets requirements. Operational design limits are evaluated and defined; performance analyses and simulations are developed & performed to support the above.

- Performs technical/engineering tasks to define system design and subsystem requirements details.

- Analysis and simulations are performed as necessary to identify design feasibility & driving requirements.

- Supervises staff, by defining their work, coaching them on how and what to prepare, monitoring their progress and directing them on priorities.

- Proposes work package estimates and descriptions based on knowledge of the work and project requirements, ensuring that compliant solutions at optimum cost are identified.

- Accurately reports work progress and estimates to complete against work packages.

- Investigates problems in the field or with the systems IVVQ documentation.

- Develop, implement and maintain tools relevant to the Systems Engineering function. Lead in the assessment of relevant tools.

- Keep abreast of technical development both within and outside of the company.

- Lead the production of System / IVVQ Engineering estimates at optimum cost.

- Produce quality metrics to measure the soundness of the System / IVVQ Engineering processes under your control.

- Working with project planners to provide detailed input to specific project programs.

- Represent System / IVVQ Engineering at formal Design Reviews, with particular attention to the reduction of design risks.

- Lead System / IVVQ Cost Reviews as part of a Bid team.

Skills:
- Able to use a range of IT tools (e.g. MS Office, MS Visio, etc).

- Has a sound ability to use and/or assess System Engineering tools. (e.g. DOORS, System Architect, JIRA)

- Has knowledge of configuration control.

- Can produce and/or interpret metrics as part of Quality control.

- A working knowledge of project plans.

- Has knowledge of Engineering Safety Management

Experience:
- The Lead Systems / IVVQ Engineers are the IVVQ and technical focal points for the System Engineering process and must aim to resolve all issues, problems, questions and conflicts in the entire system. This requires frequent handling of new and unusual issues; therefore a proven record of working in a Systems / IVVQ Engineering environment is required.

- The post holder should have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate at all levels in the spoken and written word. A good outward appearance, self-motivation and the ability to work under pressure are vital.

- As Lead IVVQ Engineer experience dealing with both functional and non-functional testing is required.

- The success of the Systems Engineering job family relies on the interaction of its engineers at all levels, therefore good evidence of leading a team is required.

Desirable Qualifications and Certification:
- HND/Degree in a relevant subject or equivalent.

- Communication / RF system experience.

- Experience in shock / vibration / EMC / thermal testing.

Essential:
- Have attained, or working towards an appropriate professional status or equivalent

Financial / Budgetary Responsibility:
- The post holder may be expected to deliver designs/projects to an agreed budget.

UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.title: Lead Process Engineer – Design Phase (Methods, Integration, Test & Deployment)
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

OUR BENEFITS
- Family Friendly Workplace Certified company with Competitive Remuneration.

- Be a part of a world-class workshop with all tooling and PPE provided.

- Fitness Passport Discount + Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance).

- Modernised Paid Parental Leave.

- Veterans Leave.

- Personal & professional training, development and internal growth opportunities.

OUR TEAM
As part of our VTS business, our PRV team is primarily focused on the design, manufacture, delivery and support of protected mobility vehicles on a global scale. We are very proud of everything we do in support of both the Bushmaster and Hawkei platforms as we all work together towards our purpose. Most importantly – be a part of a positive team culture that is focused on our people.

YOUR ROLE:
Come join our growing Industry team as a Lead Process Engineer – Design Phase. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and optimising process‑engineering strategies and solutions during the design and early industrialisation phases. Working in close collaboration with the Product Architect and the Process Engineering Manager – Industrialisation, the role ensures that all design‑phase industrial requirements are understood, validated, and translated into robust, scalable processes that support reliable production, testing, integration, and sustainment of Thales products and systems.

This position requires strong leadership behaviours aligned with the Lead@Thales Framework, ensuring innovation, agility, collaboration, and long‑term industrial excellence.

Working at our Bendigo site, on Dja Dja Wurrung Land, your exciting new career opportunity will see you:
- Establishing design‑phase manufacturing, repair, service, testing, and integration strategies, ensuring industrial requirements are embedded early.

- Defining and preparing design‑phase process documentation, including preliminary ranges, tooling concepts, test strategies, and integration plans.

- Validating manufacturability, testability, serviceability, and integration constraints with engineering teams to ensure industrial feasibility.

- Collaborating with R&D engineering to translate design intent into clear industrial requirements and early alignment on documentation, tooling, and process needs.

- Developing early test and control strategies for equipment and subassemblies, ensuring industrial test requirements are captured prior to design freeze.

- Design Readiness Reviews — Lead and contribute to design readiness gates (PDR, CDR, MDR), ensuring industrial requirements are validated before design freeze.

- Providing early technical guidance to APRU and production teams to ensure design decisions support takt time, flow, and industrial constraints.

- Driving continuous improvement and innovation in design‑phase processes to reduce cost, cycle time, and complexity.

- Contributing to early cost modelling and ensuring objective cost estimates are developed and maintained throughout the design phase.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:
- Strong knowledge of design for manufacture, design for repair, and design for test principles.

- Extensive understanding of production and repair processes, with the ability to influence design decisions early.

- Experience in industrial management control, cost modelling, and early phase planning.

- Familiarity with Lean methodologies (flow management, Gemba, PDCA, TPM) applied during design and industrialisation.

- Strong analytical and problem solving capability, particularly in early phase feasibility assessments.

- Knowledge of industrial IT systems, dashboards, and decision support tools.

- Ability to influence engineering teams and ensure industrial constraints are understood and respected.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to mobilise resources, share information transparently, and build long term commitment across teams.

- Demonstrated agility, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

- Understanding of HSE principles, risk management, and safe design practices.

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY:
After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process. Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

As a Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance. To learn more about clearances please visit http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/

- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à La Ciotat, vous intégrez un site idéalement localisé sur le littoral méditerranéen, au sein d'un environnement international regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques.

Description du projet / rôle / missions
Au sein de l’organisation Engineering, vous jouez un rôle central dans la gouvernance et le pilotage de la sécurité à l’échelle de plusieurs équipes de développement. Véritable point d’entrée des sujets de sécurité pour l’organisation, vous assurez la déclinaison opérationnelle des exigences de cybersécurité, de conformité et de gestion des risques au sein des squads.
Dans un environnement international composé de nombreuses équipes de développement et d’architectes, vous garantissez la bonne application des processus de sécurité tout en accompagnant les équipes dans leur mise en œuvre. Votre rôle est fortement orienté exécution, structuration et coordination transverse.
Vos principales missions consistent à :
- Définir, prioriser et piloter les initiatives de sécurité au sein des équipes Engineering en coordination avec les Product Owners et les responsables techniques.

- Traduire les exigences Corporate Security et réglementaires (PCI DSS, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.) en processus, standards, méthodes et plans d’actions applicables par les équipes.

postings.title: Lead SRE Network
postings.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

S3NS est né du partenariat industriel entre Thales, leader mondial de la cyber sécurité, et Google Cloud, leader mondial des solutions cloud. Nous avons pour ambition d’offrir le meilleur des deux mondes à l’ensemble des organisations soucieuses de protéger leurs données sensibles (institutions publiques, OIV, OSE…). C’est-à-dire une solution équivalente à Google Cloud Platform (incluant à la fois les services IaaS et PaaS de GCP) et respectant les exigences du label SecNumCloud.

Une première offre, ‘Contrôles locaux avec S3NS’, est déjà disponible depuis février 2023 pour permettre à nos clients de bénéficier d’un premier niveau de transparence et contrôles additionnels, et d'accélérer la trajectoire vers le cloud de confiance.

Au cœur de S3NS, le Team Lead Network occupe une position stratégique alliant leadership humain et excellence technologique. Vous ne pilotez pas seulement des infrastructures ; vous guidez une équipe de 10 experts dans la construction et l'exploitation du premier Cloud de Confiance français. Vous êtes le garant de la cohésion de l’équipe, de la fluidité des rituels et de la robustesse d’un réseau conçu pour répondre aux exigences les plus strictes de l'ANSSI (SecNumCloud). Au cœur du partenariat stratégique avec Google Cloud. Vous aurez l'opportunité unique d'explorer et de maîtriser l'architecture profonde du réseau de Google

Les missions :

Management, RH & Leadership (50%)
● Animation d'Équipe : Manager et faire progresser une équipe de 10 ingénieurs. Garantir un environnement de travail fondé sur l'entraide et l'excellence technique.
● Rituels & Backlog : Animer les cérémonies Agiles. Arbitrer les priorités entre les projets de construction (Build) et la stabilité opérationnelle (Run).
● Culture SLO (Service Level Objectives) : Définir, suivre et rapporter les indicateurs de performance (SLIs/SLOs/SLAs). Mettre en place des revues périodiques pour garantir que le réseau répond aux engagements de service S3NS.
● Gestion RH & Astreintes : Piloter la stratégie de croissance de l'équipe. Accompagner le développement professionnel de vos collaborateurs (coaching, mentors, plans de formation). Réaliser les entretiens annuels et définir les trajectoires d'évolution pour fidéliser les expertises clés. Structurer et superviser le dispositif d'astreinte pour garantir une réactivité 24/7 sur un environnement de production critique.
● Gestion Budgétaire : Suivre et optimiser les coûts (OPEX/CAPEX) liés aux infrastructures réseau, suivi des appels d’offres et commandes.
● Partenariat stratégique avec Google Cloud : Coordonner les activités avec les équipes réseau de Google. Aligner les besoins de sécurité et opérationnel de S3NS avec le partenaire.

2. Expertise Network & Industrialisation, Automation(30%)
● Maîtrise des fondations GCP : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie de Google pour appréhender et opérer les couches réseau complexes (VPC, Cloud Interconnect, Andromeda, Cloud Armor).
● Infrastructure Core : Garantir la robustesse de la couche physique et du routage : Maîtriser les réseau de Datacenter, VXLAN/EVPN, BGP haute performance et segmentation avancée. Maîtriser IPV6. Avoir une bonne culture WAN (SRV6)
● Maîtrise des Flux : Superviser les architectures de Firewall, Forward et Reverse Proxy (WAF, Load Balancing, inspection SSL) pour assurer un contrôle total des flux entrants et sortants.
● Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : Porter la vision "Everything as Code" pour garantir des déploiements reproductibles et auditables.
● Stack Technologique :
○ Terraform : Pour le provisionnement des infrastructures hybrides (Cloud et On-prem).
○ Ansible : Pour la gestion de configuration et l'orchestration des équipements réseau.
○ Python : Pour le développement d'outillages internes, d'APIs et l'automatisation de workflows complexes.
○ Nix / NixOS : Exploiter Nix pour garantir la reproductibilité des environnements de build et la gestion déclarative des packages, assurant ainsi une conformité SecNumCloud inébranlable..

3. Excellence Opérationnelle, SRE & Résilience (20%)
● Observabilité & Alerting : Concevoir une stratégie de monitoring exhaustive (Prometheus, Grafana…). Mettre en place un alerting intelligent et proactif fondé sur les indicateurs de performance clés.
● Suivi des SLO (Service Level Objectives) : Piloter l'activité par la donnée. Garantir le respect des engagements de service (SLAs) et piloter le "budget d'erreur" pour assurer une fiabilité exemplaire.
● Stratégie DRP/PCA : Concevoir et tester régulièrement les plans de reprise d'activité (Disaster Recovery Plan). Garantir que l'architecture réseau permet une bascule transparente ou une reconstruction rapide en cas de défaillance majeure.
● Chaos Engineering : Initier des tests de résilience pour valider la robustesse des configurations face aux pannes d'équipements ou de liaison

Votre profil :
- Vous êtes expert en networking (VXLAN, BGP, routage dynamique, SRv6, IPv6) et maîtrisez les interconnexions Cloud comme Interconnect ou le Peering?

- Les architectures de Proxy (HAProxy, NGINX) et les services de sécurité périmétrique n'ont plus de secret pour vous?

- Vous maîtrisez les outils de monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana) ainsi que les concepts de Golden Signals (Latence, Trafic, Erreurs, Saturation) , et vous savez piloter une infrastructure par la donnée et les indicateurs de fiabilité (SRE & SLOs)?

- Vous êtes rompu aux déploiements automatisés via Terraform, Ansible, Python, les pipelines CI/CD et l'écosystème NIX?

- Vous possédez de solides compétences en sécurité (Firewalling Next-Gen, ISE) et vous êtes familier avec les contraintes de la conformité SecNumCloud?

- Vous disposez d'un leadership inspirant capable de fédérer une équipe autour d'une vision technologique exigeante , tout en plaçant l'humain au centre en donnant à vos collaborateurs les moyens d'exercer leur travail dans les meilleures conditions possibles?

- Vous savez gérer des situations de crise ou des incidents majeurs sur une production critique?

Le mot de l’équipe :

"L'équipe SRE de S3NS est le moteur de la fiabilité de notre cloud de confiance. Si vous êtes passionné par la construction de systèmes robustes et performants, venez contribuer à notre mission, votre expertise fera la différence. »

postings.title: Leader Supply Chain Industrielle F/H
postings.description:

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

Votre quotidien

A Châtellerault, rejoignez un de nos 2 sites THALES et venez prendre part au futur de l’aéronautique avec nous ! Facilement accessible depuis Paris, Tours et Poitiers, vous vous épanouirez dans une ville riche en culture, verdoyante et sans l’ombre d’un bouchon ! - Supporter la mise en oeuvre du Lean de bout en bout.

- Planifier l’ensemble des besoins incluant les rechanges et les réparations dans le Plan d’Approvisionnement et de Production en s’appuyant sur l’ERP.

- Garantir l'adéquation du niveau des stocks avec les besoins des APRU et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la fonction pour diminuer les encours, le stock, le délai en cohérence avec les exigences clients.

- Garantir le fonctionnement des interfaces de son périmètre (autres sites Thales, clients finaux, achats, activité Administration des Ventes…).

- Garantir le respect du cadre réglementaire des flux entrants et sortants.

- Analyser l'adéquation charge capacité MO interne par poste de travail avec des compétences communes.

- Analyser l'adéquation des moyens de production internes : moyens industriels et infrastructure.

- Analyser l'adéquation de la capacité des Fournisseurs.

- Proposer des investissements à réaliser pour répondre au plan de la demande.

- Manager les aspects Ressources Humaines de son équipe (fixation des objectifs, check-in, développement des compétences, recrutements, ...).

VOTRE PROFIL

De formation Bac+5, vous bénéficiez des compétences suivantes :

- Une expérience d'au moins 15 ans dans le domaine du management de la supply chain dans un univers industriel (petite série) ?
- Une connaissance globale de la Supply Chain (approvisionnement, ordonnancement, planification, logistique, …) ?
- La maitrise des processus de Production et de Réparation ?

Leadership, animation transversale, écoute active, esprit collaboratif, prise de décisions dans un environnement complexe, forte culture de la performance font partie de vos atouts ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

postings.title: Lean Continuous Improvement Leader
postings.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

ARE YOU THE VOICE OF LEAN?
LEAN LEADER — Crawley Manufacturing | Thales UK
We don't want someone who talks about continuous improvement. We want someone who
lives it — on the shop floor, with the teams, every day. Thales UK builds technology that
matters. As our Lean Leader in Crawley, your mission is to make our manufacturing
operations sharper, faster, and better — for good.

THE ROLE
You'll be the go-to expert for Lean Continuous Improvement (LCI) across our Glasgow site. That means embedding robust problem solving (PDCA) and Lean thinking into daily operations, not just running workshops. You'll coach teams, lead transformations, and drive measurable results across Quality (FPTY), Delivery (OTDIF) and Cost (UPC).
This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You'll work directly with Site Production, Engineering, Our Autonomous Production and Repair Unit (APRU) Managers, Head of Industry and the UK Head of Lean Continuous Improvement — and your fingerprints will be on the culture, not just the metrics.

WHAT YOU BRING
• Proven experience in Lean manufacturing and strong knowledge of Lean tools and practises in general - Lean Six Sigma, Green Belt, Back Belt - or equivalent hard-won experience
• Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills
• Real fluency and expertise in Lean tools: VSM, 5S, Flow improvement techniques, Visual Management
• Problem solving frameworks as daily habits, not slide content
• Proven success in low-volume, bespoke manufacturing environments
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence at every level, from production cells to cross-functional teams including stakeholders at all levels.
• A builder's mindset: you leave capability behind, not dependency

Experience with Oracle, iObeya, PowerBI, Minitab or MES systems? Even better.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead and execute transformation activities that elevate efficiency and margins
• Train, coach and develop the Industry team for process optimisation
• Analyse and plan improvements aligned to Group strategy "Thales Towards 2030"
• Facilitate a cultural shift towards Lean agility and operational excellence
• Ensure Lean Continuous Improvement implementation with a structured, measurable approach
• Strategically plan and coordinate all Lean activities across your APRU and site

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
• Delivery (OTDIF), Quality (FPTY) and Cost (UPC) improvements
• Advancement of Lean maturity on-site
• Deployment of the Thales Industry Operating Model (TIOM)
• Lean certification targets achieved within 24 months
• Proactive Lean activity engagement across all functions

What we can offer you
• 28 days holiday plus bank holidays
• Pension scheme and life cover
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• 24 hours p.a. paid volunteering
• Gym membership discounts and employee discount schemes

SECURITY CLEARANCE
This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for Baseline and Security Clearance please refer to the National Security Vetting (NSV) Agency - United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

READY TO LEAD THE CHARGE?
Apply now and help shape the future of manufacturing at Thales UK.

Thales is an equal opportunities employer. Diversity and inclusion are integral to our success.
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

With multiple payment methods for both digital and physical transactions, Payment Services (PAY) Business Line helps financial institutions, retailers, transport operators and other players meeting the challenge of rapid evolution of financial services driven by regulatory changes, digital transformation and the arrival of new Fintech players. - Recommend contractual structures that enhance competitiveness while respecting applicable regulations and internal governance

- Draft, revise, and negotiate contractual documents with customers, partners, and subcontractors

- Ability to identify opportunities to protect or improve the project's financial performance

- Prepare and present contractual sections of internal approval documentation, including clear recommendations to management

- Establish, manage, and continuously update the contractual baseline from contract signature to project closure

- Coordinate with the Litigation Department when disputes arise, including fact‑finding, documentation, evidence management, and support to legal strategy

- Handle contractual aspects of key subcontractors and suppliers or coordinate with dedicated contract management teams where applicable

3. Governance, Leadership & Coordination
- Act as the reference point for all contractual matters within the project

- Provide strategic and operational contractual advice to internal stakeholders

- Participate in departmental initiatives such as improving templates, tools, and best practices, contributing expertise linked to complex project execution

4. Compliance Activities
- Support relevant compliance processes for the tenders and projects (e.g. third‑party screenings) in coordination with the Compliance Officer (Antitrust, Anticorruption, Personal Data Protection (incl. GDPR), Trade compliance & Duty of vigilance), in particular:

- Escalate any potential non‑compliance issues where required.

5. Transversal Activities

- Interface with external counsels for analysis and management of specific legal issues in the framework of complex contractual and/or legal arrangements or claim/litigation procedures in the Region on a need-basis,

- Contribute to the development and delivery of training to operational teams (compliance, contract management, …

· You are keen to work in diverse teams and have inter-cultural awareness and interest,
· You have full mastery of IT tools, all types of data exchange platforms, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint,
· You can travel on regular basis over the Region (once a month) and from time-to-time to Europe (once a year).

WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGEHTHER?
The position particularly covers both the InFlyt Experience (IFE) and Aviation Global Services (AGS) Business Lines activities in the Region. The Job Holder will lead the contract management function for the assigned portfolios and will provide day-to-day and strategic oversight of the Contract Manager currently supporting these activities. The role includes managing performance, ensuring contractual compliance, setting standards and processes, and ensuring timely and effective execution across the contract lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own contract lifecycle delivery for the perimeter
- Lead negotiation strategy and provide commercial/legal recommendations
- Manage contract risks and ensure governance processes are followed
- Maintain auditable contract documentation and reporting
1. Contractual Support for Tender, Offers, Variations & Extensions
· Recommend contractual structures that enhance competitiveness while respecting applicable regulations and internal governance
· Draft, revise, and negotiate contractual documents with customers, partners, and subcontractors
· Contribute to internal risk reviews, financial exposure assessments, and mitigation plans
· Ability to identify opportunities to protect or improve projects’ financial performance
· Support the capture and preparation of variations, extensions, new phases or related offers connected to existing program
· Prepare and present contractual sections of internal approval documentation, including clear recommendations to management
· Participate in the risk analysis process and the construction of mitigation plans with the help of operations (possibly estimating financial provisions for risks such as delay, if necessary),

2. Contract Management Throughout Project Execution
· Establish, manage, and continuously update the contractual baseline from contract signature to project closure
· Ensure full contractual awareness across the project team, enabling correct application of obligations, rights, deadlines, and deliverables
· Anticipate deviations and manage them proactively through contractual notices, waivers, amendments, claims, clarification requests, and other contractual instruments
· Anticipate and drive projects’ risk and opportunity strategy, in close collaboration with project leadership, including claim preparation, defensive measures, and value‑protection initiatives, proposing defensible, practical solutions
· Oversee all incoming and outgoing contractual communications with the customer, ensuring consistency, traceability, and strategic alignment
· Coordinate with the Litigation Department when disputes arise, including fact‑finding, documentation, evidence management, and support to legal strategy
· Handle contractual aspects of key subcontractors and suppliers or coordinate with dedicated contract management teams where applicable

3. Claims, Disputes, Risk Management and Commercial Strategy
· Lead the preparation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of claims from or against customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and other contracting parties.
· Interface with executive management and customer representatives regarding significant contractual disputes, escalations, and claim resolution efforts.
· Provide contractual risk analyses, mitigation recommendations, and commercial strategies for new business opportunities, ongoing programs, and complex contractual situations.
· Advise executive and senior management regarding the contractual rights and obligations of Thales and its contracting parties, including associated liabilities, remedies, and commercial positioning.
· Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of Thales’ and the relevant contracting party’s positions and develop practical, defensible recommendations that support business objectives.
· Coordinate with the Litigation Department and external counsel when disputes arise, including fact-finding, documentation, evidence management, and support for legal strategy.

4. Compliance, Governance, Leadership & Coordination
· Act as the reference point for all contractual matters within the perimeter
· Provide strategic and operational legal and contractual advice to internal stakeholders in particular by providing country legal intelligence and knowledge to the relevant global, regional, or corporate stakeholders
· Support relevant compliance processes for the tenders and projects (e.g., third‑party screenings) in coordination with the Compliance Officer (Antitrust, Anticorruption, Personal Data Protection (incl. GDPR), Trade compliance & Duty of vigilance), in particular:
o Escalate any potential non‑compliance issues where required
· Interface with external counsels for analysis and management of specific legal issues in the framework of complex contractual and/or legal arrangements or claim/litigation procedures in the Region on a need-basis
· Participate in departmental initiatives such as
o improving templates, tools, and best practices, contributing to expertise linked to complex project execution
o cross-functional working group for Legal, Contract and Compliance Department (contract management, IP, standard contracts, insurance…)
o Contribute to the development and delivery of training to operational teams (compliance, contract management, …)

5. People Management
· The position includes 1 direct report: Lead and manage the Contract Manager’s day-to-day activities, including prioritization of workload, assignment of contract tasks, and escalation of risks.
o Set clear objectives and performance expectations for the Contract Manager; conduct regular 1:1 meetings and agreed check-ins.
o Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and structured feedback on contract drafting/review quality.
o Ensure the Contract Manager adheres to company contract governance processes (e.g., approval workflows, recordkeeping, version control).
o Drive consistent contract interpretation and commercial decision-making aligned with company policy and risk appetite.

WHAT WE OFFER
· High impact, visibility, and autonomy within the organization
· Exposure to senior internal stakeholders and cross‑functional teams
· A collaborative and international working environment

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

This role is Hybrid Halifax or Hybrid Victoria
Life Cycle and Materiel Manager (LCMM) – Combat Systems Specialist
Position Summary
Thales Canada is looking for a Life Cycle and Materiel Manager (LCMM) – Combat Systems Specialist to support its non-Combatant In-Service Support Programs for the Royal Canadian Navy.
The LCMM – Combat Systems Specialist is responsible for engineering support and technical oversight of various systems including but not limited to Navigation Systems, Communications Systems, Command and Control systems, Data processing systems, Above water and underwater sensor systems and Ship’s weapons systems, on board the various platforms of the Royal Canadian Navy. Accountable to the Operational Support Manager and working directly with various internal and external stakeholders, this role manages various activities to establish and maintain the configuration and design intent of the marine auxiliary and other mechanical systems on the ships and manage any changes through their end-of-life and divestment.
The successful candidate will leverage their existing knowledge and expertise in marine mechanical systems and equipment to become a subject matter expert and main point of contact for all technical matters associated with the systems assigned thereto. The principal objective is to maximize effectiveness and efficiency, while minimizing the Life Cycle Cost (LCC) associated with the support of their systems.
Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Key Areas of Responsibility
The key functions and areas of responsibility for the LCMM – Combat Systems Specialist include but is not limited to:
- Performing Life Cycle and Materiel Management functions including but not limited to equipment obsolescence, material compatibility issues, alternate part investigations, maintenance management, and disposal management;
- Supporting and managing activities associated with the design and configuration control of the vessels including conducting functional and physical configuration audits, as well as deviations and waivers documentation;
- Providing technical advice to enable auxiliary and mechanical equipment and/or systems to be correctly operated or maintained;
- Monitoring systems and equipment performance through various reports such as but not limited to Unsatisfactory Condition Reports (UCRs), Pre-installation failures (PIFs) and technical investigations (TIs) conducted by the customer;
- Ensuring proper level of spares are maintained throughout the life of the systems and equipment; support the cataloguing process;
- Conducting technical investigations into problems associated with combat systems, equipment and/or software issues, including failure analysis and solution recommendation;
- Developing and reviewing technical documentation including equipment specifications, installation and maintenance instructions, test and trials agendas, and engineering change documentation and drawings;
- Analyzing requirements associated with baseline changes to the ships configuration, equipment and software;
- Liaise with OEMs, Service Providers and ship staff to support the investigation and resolution of defects;
- Preparing documented work scopes, suitable for the solicitation of quotations from external resources such as OEMs, manufacturers, suppliers, testing facilities or specialist service providers; and
- Preparing and managing Work Packages and cost estimates for customer approval.

Minimum Requirements
- 3-year technical program diploma (for Technologists) or 2-year technical program diploma (for Technicians) in a marine technical field offered by a recognized technical institute; or
- Certified a technologist or technician by a recognized provincial, state, or federal (national) licensing body in a relevant field or certified body; or
- Certified as one of the following technical trades of the Canadian Armed Forces:- QL6B Naval Electronics Technician
- RQPO1 WEng Tech

- Possess a minimum 8 years of demonstrated professional work experience in the naval, marine, or offshore industry within the last 15 years;
- Extensive knowledge of combat systems and equipment
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite;
- Familiar with safety standards;
- Strong communication skills (oral and written);
- Language: English (Essential).

Preferred Qualifications
- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Technical Specialist with marine with marine communications, navigation or naval combat systems;
- Previous experience with the Royal Canadian Navy or Canadian Coast Guard;
- Previous experience as a Life Cycle Materiel Manager in the communications, navigation or naval combat systems field;
- Demonstrated project management experience;
- Familiar with the Department of National Defense (DND) maintenance management and implementation system “DRMIS”;
- Experience in delivering marine in-service support of operational assets; and
- Familiar with certification requirements including but not limited to Classification Society, SOLAS/IMO, IEEE, CSA, Naval Ship Code, and DND regulations.

Physical Demands
- Predominantly office work but will be required to occasionally travel to and work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships
- May be required to undertake inspections on Naval ships which may involve involving bending and twisting, and working aloft

Special Position Requirements
- Schedule: 40 hours per week
- Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required in support of the ships

postings.title: Line Maintenance Technician
postings.location: Jamaica, New York, United States of America
postings.description:
Location: JFK_Airport, United States of America

Thales people architect solutions that enable two-thirds of planes to take off and land safely. We create in-flight entertainment systems that engross 50 million fliers every year and we develop the avionics that control the world’s largest commercial aircrafts. Our simulators train the next generation of pilots for fighter jets, transporters and search and rescue helicopters. And, together, each and every member of our aerospace team makes a difference.

When you rely on airlines to connect you in flight, you rely on Thales. In an increasingly fast paced world, we make the unpredictable, predictable by connecting and entertain passengers to make your life better. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to passengers and airlines. Whatever it takes.

Line Maintenance Technician

Queens, New York (JFK Airport) – Fully Onsite

Position Summary

Thales is looking for a Line Maintenance Technician, who will be responsible for performing line maintenance, installation, repair station, and ground equipment maintenance work on Thales In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems in accordance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations, airline customer maintenance manuals, and internal operating procedures.

In this position, you will ensure all maintenance activities are executed with a strong focus on safety, compliance, reliability, and operational efficiency while supporting airline customers in a fast-paced, deadline-driven airport environment, requiring a detail-oriented and technically skilled professional who can troubleshoot, install, and repair complex electronic systems and who demonstrates a strong understanding of regulatory requirements, adherence to procedures, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, and system modifications on all Thales In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems.
- Diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently to ensure minimal aircraft downtime and operational impact.
- Ensure all airline logbook discrepancies related to Thales systems are accurately documented and cleared in a timely manner.
- Document all maintenance activities daily using established procedures and submit detailed reports to the Supervisor of Maintenance.
- Support airline customers by ensuring adherence to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements during all maintenance activities.
- Maintain compliance with FAA regulations, safety standards, and internal quality procedures while working in a fast-paced airport environment.

Minimum Qualifications
- High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) required, along with a valid Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) Certificate and the ability to meet recent experience requirements in accordance with 14 CFR 65.83.
- Ability to obtain and maintain airport security requirements, including a Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) badge, Customs Clearance (as required), successful completion of a 7-year background check with fingerprinting, and a pre-employment drug test.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment, possess and maintain a valid Driver License that meets company insurance standards, and be able to operate ground support equipment such as tugs, trucks, lift trucks, and boom lifts after training.
- Strong avionics and electronics knowledge, including the ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical instructions, as well as perform proper crimping and soldering methods in accordance with aviation industry standards.
- Ability to analyze data, troubleshoot issues of moderate scope, and effectively communicate technical information to Supervisors and Customers while working under pressure in a fast-paced team environment.
- Demonstrate professionalism and reliability, including regular attendance and punctuality, fluency in speaking, reading, and writing English, a positive attitude, and alignment with Thales values of Compliance, Respect, Innovation, Responsibility, and Teamwork.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications
- Two (2) years of aircraft maintenance technician school and/or equivalent technical training.
- Two (2) years of line maintenance experience, preferably in a commercial aviation environment.
- Federal Communications Commission (FCC) license is preferred.
- Ability to work in physically demanding environments, including crawling, bending, kneeling, climbing, and stooping in confined spaces.
- Ability to lift and handle equipment up to 50–80 pounds occasionally and up to 20 pounds frequently, while safely using a variety of hand tools and testing equipment.
- Ability to adapt to changing conditions and directions while maintaining situational awareness around moving vehicles and aircraft in an active airport environment.

Special Position Requirements
- Flexible work schedule required, including days, evenings, midnights, weekends, and holidays, based on seniority and operational needs.

postings.description:
Location: Fort Lauderdale, United States of America

Thales people architect solutions that enable two-thirds of planes to take off and land safely. We create in-flight entertainment systems that engross 50 million fliers every year and we develop the avionics that control the world’s largest commercial aircrafts. Our simulators train the next generation of pilots for fighter jets, transporters and search and rescue helicopters. And, together, each and every member of our aerospace team makes a difference.

When you rely on airlines to connect you in flight, you rely on Thales. In an increasingly fast paced world, we make the unpredictable, predictable by connecting and entertain passengers to make your life better. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to passengers and airlines. Whatever it takes.

Line Maintenance Technician

Fort Lauderdale, FL (Fully onsite)

Position Summary

Thales is looking for a Line Maintenance Technician, whose role involves performing line maintenance, installation, repair station, and ground equipment maintenance activities on Thales In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems and other systems for which the technician is authorized and trained.

In this position, you will support the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of IFE equipment and systems while helping ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable technical and quality requirements.
Referral Bonus Eligibility: Tier 1 - $2,500

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Perform scheduled maintenance activities on all authorized Thales systems in accordance with established procedures.
- Perform unscheduled maintenance and system modifications on all authorized Thales systems.
- Ensure airline logbook discrepancies pertaining to Thales systems are addressed and cleared in a timely manner.
- Document all maintenance activities performed on a daily basis utilizing established procedures.
- Prepare and submit required daily maintenance reports to the Supervisor of Maintenance.
- Provide customers with ongoing support while carrying out and upholding Company policies and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications
- High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) Diploma required; valid Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Airframe and Powerplant Certificate required, with recent experience requirements met in accordance with 14 CFR 65.83.
- Strong knowledge of avionics/electronics with the ability to read and interpret blueprints and wiring diagrams, follow written procedures and instructions, and terminate electrical connectors using proper crimping and soldering methods acceptable within the aviation industry.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced team environment while maintaining accuracy and efficiency, analyze problems and situations of moderate scope, and effectively summarize and present information to Supervisors and Customers.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a local airport Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) Badge and Customs Clearance as required and successfully complete a seven-year background check, including fingerprinting, pre-employment drug testing, and Criminal History Records Check (CHRC).
- Must speak, read, and write English fluently; be legally authorized to work in the country where the position is located; maintain regular attendance and punctuality; demonstrate a positive attitude; and exhibit Thales values of Compliance, Respect, Innovation, Responsibility, and Teamwork.
- Must possess and maintain a valid Driver License and driving record that meets Company insurance standards, with the ability to operate tugs, trucks, lift trucks, snorkel lifts, boom lifts, and tractors upon completion of required training.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

Special Position Requirements
- Two (2) years of aircraft maintenance technician school and two (2) years of line maintenance experience preferred; Federal Communications Commission (FCC) license preferred.
- Ability to adapt to changing conditions and directions, remain alert to moving vehicles and aircraft, and frequently crawl, bend, kneel, climb, and stoop while working in confined spaces.
- Ability to occasionally handle objects weighing 50–80 pounds, frequently handle objects weighing up to 20 pounds, and frequently use a variety of hand tools to test equipment.
- Flexibility to work varying schedules based on seniority and operational requirements, including day, swing, or midnight shifts, weekends, and holidays, and ability to work outside on the aircraft ramp and/or in hangar environments where loud noise may be experienced.
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and/or internationally up to 10% of the time, including supporting customer locations or site visits as required.
- Ability to obtain and maintain required airport and customer security credentials, including successfully completing the applicable 10-year background check and other security requirements.

postings.title: Logisticien Atelier (H/F)
postings.description:
Lieu : La Ferté-Saint-Aubin, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Au sein de l’activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques, le site de La Ferté Saint Aubin est spécialisé dans la production de systèmes d’armements terrestres et aéroportés (mortiers, munitions, roquettes…), de systèmes de protection des forces et de contrôle de zone.
Fort de ses 450 salariés, ingénieurs, techniciens et ouvriers spécialisés, le site de la Ferté Saint Aubin assure la recherche et développement, la production, les essais ainsi que toutes les fonctions « supports » nécessaires à la conception de systèmes performants essentiels à la réussite des missions opérationnelles.
Thales a constitué, avec le groupe allemand de défense DIEHL, une Joint-Venture « JUNGHANS T2M » qui compte 165 salariés permettant aux deux entreprises d’associer leurs compétences d’électronique et de mécanique de précision et de devenir ainsi un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des fusées de munitions. Cette Joint-Venture est présente également sur le site de La Ferté saint Aubin.

Au sein d’une Unité Autonome de Production et Réparation en croissance, vous êtes l’interface entre le service de planification industrielle et les ateliers.

Vous veillez sur l’alimentation des composants vers les ateliers. En flux physiques et informatiques.

- Vous êtes en charge de suivre les Ordres de Fabrication des ateliers qui vous sont confiés.
- Vous interfacez les flux physiques entre les magasins et les ateliers.
- Vous garantissez les inventaires en atelier.
- Vous veillez sur les transactions informatiques de l’ERP (SAP) pour le suivi de traçabilité.

Votre Profil

- Vous savez organiser les activités.
- Vous maitrisez l’usage d’un ERP, idéalement SAP.
- Vous comprenez les flux industriels et identifier les goulots à prioriser.
- Vous avez des connaissances dans la logistique et les flux industriels.

On vous reconnait pour votre rigueur.

Vous êtes structuré.

MOT DE L’ÉQUIPE / DU MANAGER

Notre industrie est en forte croissance. Le poste à pourvoir est dans une APRU dynamique.
Il s’agit d’une duplication de poste. Le logisticien en place sera amené à tutorer la prise de poste.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !
