Votre quotidien

Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.

Votre quotidien
Les métiers de l'Ingénierie, de l'Industrie, de la Logistique et du Customer Service sont en train d'opérer une transformation importante pour répondre aux enjeux du business avec une croissante très forte sur les performances attendues (réduction des délais, réduction des coûts, augmentation de la productivité) ; Cela nécessite un système d'information efficace (ERP, PLM, MES, ...) avec des données maîtrisées et fiabilisées, dans un contexte France mais avec de très fortes interactions avec l'International. Au sein des Opérations, une équipe MOA est en place pour répondre à ces enjeux, accompagner les Métiers sur l'implémentation de leurs pratiques dans les outils. Cette équipe anime une communauté d'acteurs sur les différents Métiers répartis dans les BL et les différents sites de LAS France.

Un des enjeux majeurs des 3 prochaines années est le programme ZENITH intégrant la migration de SAP ECC6 vers SAP 4/HANA et la transformation des processus outillés de l'ingénierie jusqu'à la production et le maintien en condition opérationnelle des produits définis et vendus par Thales.
Dans ce cadre, vos missions sont les suivantes :
- Prendre la responsabilité MOA sur les sujets industrie de la phase d'industrialisation via PALMA et MPE jusqu'à l'exécution de la fabrication via SAP et le MES :
- Apporter du support aux Key-Users des sites
- Piloter les demandes d'évolution (recenser, qualifier, spécifier, recetter) et contribuer à la gestion des anomalies
- Maintenir un référentiel documentaire de bon niveau, (déroulés, modes opératoires)
- S'assurer de l'intégration des processus outillés dans le schéma global IS/IT (PALMA, MPE, SAP, MES)
- Maintenir/Animer un réseau actif d'acteurs au sein de LAS (communauté MOA) au service des End User
- Présenter l'avancement des projets auprès du management LAS (DOP, référents métiers)

postings.title: Modelling and Simulation System Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Tubize, Belgium

In Tubize, you will join more than 300 colleagues recognized by domestic and international partners for expertise on products such as Radio Frequency (RF) Products, C4ISR, Crypto Global Solution, MACS (Aeronautical Intercom), Crypto and many others.
Today the Group employs more than 1,000 people across nine sites in Belgium. Discover all Thales activities in Belgium here.
We are looking for a skilled Modelling & Simulation Systems Engineer to join our team. In this dynamic role, you will work alongside top-tier design professionals and contribute to innovative, mission-critical
projects.

Your mission:
As an experienced engineering professional, your responsibilities will include:
• Lead technical planning, system integration, and verification and validation (V&V) activities for
simulated land military vehicle platforms and mission systems.
• Conduct system and technical analyses to support the design, development, integration, and sustainment of vehicle models, digital twins, and simulated subsystems (e.g., communications,
sensors, EW, and weapon systems).
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues within simulation environments, including network configurations, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups, and model integration challenges, while maintaining configuration-managed baselines.
• Develop and execute validation plans to ensure simulation fidelity, accuracy, and correlation with real-world vehicle performance.
• Create and implement preventive maintenance and update plans for simulation frameworks, databases, models, and supporting lab infrastructure to ensure continuous operational readiness.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a related field, along with at least 5 years of
relevant professional experience; or a Master’s degree in a related discipline with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience.
• Experience supporting projection, display, and visualization systems, as well as vehicle crew station hardware, electronic interfaces, and associated mechanical assemblies within simulation environments.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience working with Linux and Microsoft operating systems,
including Microsoft-based tools and products.
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience installing, configuring, modifying, and integrating simulation system software and hardware.
• At least 3 years of experience in distributed modeling and simulation (DM&S) environments and complex IT/AV system infrastructures.
• Ability to obtain a Security Clearance.

Desired Skills:
• Experience supporting high-fidelity simulation systems operating across multiple security classification levels.
• Background in system design and development to support experimentation, test events, and capability assessments.
• Strong understanding of network architecture, implementation, and troubleshooting, including
familiarity with simulation-specific communication protocols.
• Experience performing technical analyses to support the design, installation, integration,
sustainment, and operational use of devices, systems, and subsystems.
• Demonstrated ability to identify and implement effective solutions to complex technical issues,
including system, network, and infrastructure reconfiguration.
• Proven ability to coordinate and lead projects or initiatives across multiple functional disciplines and diverse stakeholder groups.

YOUR CAREER AT THALES

Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your Competencies in different areas:

Room for and attention to personal development
Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or move to a more complex Solution
Choose between a technical expert or a leadership path
Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

Lieu : Bordeaux, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Sur un Campus Bordelais à la pointe de la technologie, entre océan et vignes, nous concevons et développons des systèmes, des équipements et services pour garantir le succès des missions aéroportées de nos clients.

Depuis 2017, Le Groupe Thales dispose d’un Service autonome et agréé de Santé au travail piloté par un Médecin coordinateur et constitué d’un réseau d’une vingtaine de Médecin répartis par zone géographique sur l’ensemble de la France. Pour la région de Bordeaux qui regroupe des activités pour les systèmes de défense, l’avionique et les fonctions de service, Thales recherche un deuxième médecin du travail pour intégrer son service autonome de santé au travail.

Localisé sur le site de Bordeaux, Campus de 2800 salariés, vous assurez avec l’aide d’un second médecin et de 4 infirmiers spécialisés en Santé au Travail, les visites médicales périodiques d’aptitudes et de surveillance particulières des salariés.

Rattaché à la Direction des Ressources Humaines du site, vous bénéficiez également de la présence d’une conseillère sociale.
Vous assurez en toute indépendance l’ensemble des responsabilités du Médecin du Travail : visites médicales, études de postes et de risques (chimie et CMR, électromagnétique, manutention, accident du travail, bruit, déplacements et chantiers à l’étranger, travail en hauteur…), recommandations et conseils en matière d’organisation des secours et formation des secouristes, prévention et gestion des risques psychosociaux, alerte et plans d’actions individuels et/ou collectifs le cas échéant.
Vous conseillez la direction en matière de prévention sanitaire, études de postes et proposition d’amélioration.
Vous participez à la politique du Groupe mobilisé sur la prévention et sur l’amélioration de la qualité et le bien-être au travail, notamment au travers des accords tels que celui sur la qualité de vie au travail.
Vous êtes également amené, en équipe, à organiser des campagnes d’information/sensibilisation sur des thèmes liés à votre périmètre de compétences.
Vous participez à des projets en lien avec la politique du Groupe en matière de santé au travail, de qualité de vie au travail, d’emploi des personnes handicapées.
Vous assurez l’interface avec la Direction de l’Etablissement et les équipes HSE et vous participez également à certaines instances paritaires notamment la CSSCT et la commission Handicap.

Votre profil
Vous êtes diplômé en Médecine du Travail.
Fort d’une première expérience dans le domaine de la Santé au Travail, vous démontrez une forte capacité d’écoute et de solides qualités relationnelles.
Vous êtes force de proposition, rigoureux et organisé.
Vous avez un goût réel pour le travail en équipe.
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une nouvelle équipe pluridisciplinaire et contribuer à la politique de Santé au travail.
Alors rejoignez-nous !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Remote- North Carolina

This position will work closely with key contacts to help Optiv build a vision and execute a strategy that derives maximum business benefit from offering our portfolio of solutions to their customers across Thales Data Security and Imperva. The National CAM will manage all aspects of the business as well as be the liaison between the internal and partner sales and marketing teams. The CAM will implement a ROI approach to partnering efforts with an emphasis on revenue generation, channel generated opportunities, and a focus on product offerings that differentiate Thales and Imperva in the marketplace. The Channel Account Manager will need to understand how to drive channel growth, create channel opportunities and manage partner relationships.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Educate and Enable Optiv to drive Thales and Imperva sales

- Manage, develop, and maintain strong and successful relationships with Optiv, Thales and Imperva sales and leadership teams, as well as key end-user customers for continued business growth

- Plan and develop go-to-market strategies and execute on marketing initiatives to deliver on the strategy

- Understand key goals and objectives of Optiv and come to agreement on mutual goals that align the partner with ours

- Understand and be conversant on the partner business metrics of taking on our solutions and building a profitable business selling, implementing, and supporting them. The CAM will facilitate and ensure all program requirements have been met by Optiv.

- Key point of contact that manages the occasional handling of difficult conversations and bringing about successful resolutions with the partner

- Enable the Optiv community to sell Thales solutions

- Build and expand the executive level Thales/Optiv value proposition

- Keep management current on status and performance through regular communication, forecasts, reviews, and reports

- 5+ years minimum experience in channel sales and channel development, in a security, appdev, networking, cloud based or Infrastructure Company preferably within a two-tier distribution environment

- Ability to forecast annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue streams accurately.

- Capable of developing and presenting interesting solution strategies, meeting/exceeding customer requirements and expectation

- Strong written, verbal and organizational communication skills and can clearly and effectively articulate Thales value as well as the ability to engage with all levels of a distribution Partner organization

- Ability to perform job functions independently with limited supervision

- Using business-planning skills to achieve a high level of customer and partner satisfaction

- Ability to execute and deliver a defined plan to exceed revenue goals

- Results oriented and effective in customer situations comprising senior level management

- Must have the ability to work independently in a dynamic sales environment

- Ability to work in a fast-moving environment, to prioritize effectively to think big picture, and to use good judgment in resolving difficult issues

- Passion, Commitment and drive for success working in a motivated Team environment

- Strong cross-functional leadership and excellent communications skills to drive consensus across groups both internally and within the Channel/Partner organizations

Position Summary

Thales Canada Defence & Security (TCDS) is looking for a Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager to provide resource management to the Naval Architecture team.

The Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager provides Naval Architecture leadership and support for Thales Canada’s ongoing projects throughout their respective life cycles; from requirements analysis and design, through development, integration, test and acceptance.

- Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level.

Position Summary
We have a current vacancy for a Naval Engineering Maintenance (NEM) Liaison.

Embedded within the Fleet Engineering Readiness (FER) section of the Royal Canadian Navy, the Naval Engineering Maintenance (NEM) Liaison serves as the primary Point of Contact (POC) between relevant coastal organizations for the iterative development of Arctic and Offshore Patrol Vessel (AOPV) and Joint Support Ship (JSS) Fleet Service Schedules. The NEM Liaison prioritizes deficiencies and manages their rectification schedule for all AOPV and JSS In-Service Support (AJISS) coastal platforms. As a representative of Thales on the AJISS Assignment Team (AAT), the NEM Liaison is responsible for coordinating among all AJISS stakeholders for the allocation, prioritization, disposition, and reporting of deficiencies from notification to closeout. Reporting to the Coastal Operations Manager, the NEM Liaison tracks and reports on Key Performance Indicator (KPI) metrics related to Service Delivery.

Key Areas of Responsibility
The NEM liaison is responsible for:
- Acting as the main Point of Contact (POC) for FER, ensuring all deficiencies reported by ship staff are valid and assigned appropriate repair priorities.

- Coordinating FER priorities and managing workflow between FER and Thales related activities.

- Being available on a rotational, 24/7 on-call basis (unless formally delegated), to respond to urgent requests from FER, MEPM(NC), and FMF.

- Resolving day-to-day issues arising from FER on all ships.

- Coordinating High Priority Requests (HPRs) and TRANREQs, facilitating communication to and from the ship.

- Reporting the status of Operational Deficiencies (OPDEF) as received from FER.

- Managing, tracking, and reporting on OPDEF rectification plans.

- Coordinating Material State Disclosure Conferences (MSDCs) Caveat A/B status for Thales-responsible items.

- Arranging and facilitating progress meetings with FER as required.

- Representing Thales in the development of Formation and Fleet Operational schedules (AOPVs and JSSs), ensuring balanced repair and maintenance efforts across the fleet.

- Scheduling and attending regular meetings with AJISS stakeholders to review ship schedules, including Short Work Periods and Docking Work Periods.

- Communicating all operational requirements and schedule changes from FER to appropriate Thales stakeholders.

- Tracking and reporting metrics used to inform KPIs related to Service Delivery.

- Participating in the refinement of KPI definitions as needed.

- Representing Thales as a member of the AJISS Assignment Team (AAT).

- Attending regular AAT meetings to confirm work assigned to Thales.

- Liaising with other AAT members outside of scheduled meetings to facilitate timely decision-making for urgent defects.

- Preparing slides and attending the weekly NEM brief on the coast, representing Thales.

- Attending project meetings and providing ship status updates as required.

- Participating in recurring Financial Review Meetings internally and with customers.

- Coordinating with other coastal NEM Liaisons to manage the Fleet Scheduling B2B process for AJISS.

- Promoting a culture of teamwork and collaboration across all levels within the customer organization, leveraging the Relational Contracting (RC) model and the RC AJISS Enterprise Charter.

- Identifying and addressing areas of concern within projects and Thales, and driving improvements through liaison with internal and external stakeholders.

- Updating documentation, procedures, and templates for AJISS as requested.

- Fostering a spirit of teamwork and unity within the department, supporting effective collaboration, cohesion, and success.

- Performing other project duties as assigned and preparing regular reports as required.

- Health, Safety & Environment
- Comply with all relevant health, safety, and environmental (HS&E) legislative requirements, policies, procedures, and frameworks to prevent or minimize accidental exposure to self, colleagues, contractors, visitors, and/or the environment.

- Participate in the development and implementation of the Waterfront Safety Plan as required.

- Promote Thales’s health, safety, and environmental programs by demonstrating HS&E leadership in a professional and supportive manner.

Minimum Qualifications
- Possess a minimum 3-year technical program diploma in a marine technical field offered by a recognized technical institute or certified as a technologist by a recognized provincial, state, or federal (national) licensing body in a relevant field or certified to the QL-6B level of military technical training; and

- Possess a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated technical professional work experience in the marine sector within the last 10 years;

- Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated experience interfacing between various internal/external stakeholders;

- Strong organizational skills and ability to balance multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications
- A thorough knowledge of the RCN deficiency reporting methodologies and experience with the evaluation and prioritization of defect repairs is preferred

- 2 years demonstrated experience within the last 5 years, liaising with Coastal Authorities (Fleet Engineering Readiness (FER)) and Coastal Fleet Maintenance Facilities (FMF’s) for the scheduling and execution of work and trials during DWP’s and/or SWP’s is preferred.

- Experience with the Defense Resource Management Information System (DRMIS) is advantageous

- Experience working within a defense environment with active defense force personnel.

- Strong computer literacy, with proven experience with Microsoft products especially Word, Excel and PowerPoint;

- Strong understanding of Federal and Provincial safety regulations;

Physical Environment: Office or onboard Naval ships alongside in harbor, or at sea, therefore must meet all federal government requirements to access Canadian government facilities, including naval dockyards.

Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel will be required, which will include access to government facilities and assets, including naval vessels

postings.title: Network SRE — Bucharest Sovereign Cloud Hub
postings.description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

The mission

A trusted, sovereign Google Cloud region operated end-to-end from within Europe by the joint venture between Thales and Google Cloud. Same Google Cloud power (GKE, compute, data, Vertex AI), European jurisdiction, European operators, Thales-grade cybersecurity.
In the last 6 months alone: world-first regulatory qualification (IaaS + CaaS + PaaS in a single decision, SecNumCloud 3.2, December 2025), named 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year for Sovereign Cloud, 3 data centres, 10,000+ devices, NVIDIA H100 GPU clusters in production, workloads across energy, banking, healthcare, defense.
We are standing up the SRE function for this platform from scratch. Bucharest is the primary hub, Q3 / Q4 2026 hiring window. You are joining a greenfield team, not inheriting one.

Why this role matters:

You will design and operate the network fabric of a sovereign cloud region: SDN control plane, Kubernetes CNI plugins, overlay networks (VXLAN, Geneve), network policies, cloud load balancing, and service mesh integration. You own network reliability, traffic engineering, and segmentation from packet to pod.

What you will do:
- Operate the platform SDN control and data planes
- Own the K8s CNI plugin choice, deployment, and operational patterns
- Design overlay network topologies (VXLAN, Geneve) for tenant isolation
- Implement L3/L4 and L7 network policies for workload segmentation
- Integrate service mesh (Istio or equivalent) with the network fabric
- Drive network reliability engineering: capacity, latency, throughput, packet loss
- Own network incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement
- Follow-the-sun on-call rotation with Google Cloud SRE teams

What we are looking for:

You have some or all of the following. We hire for depth in at least one area of the stack, breadth in the adjacent ones, and willingness to grow into the rest.
- Minimum 3 years in SRE, Network Engineering, or Platform Engineering with strong networking depth
- Hands-on Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, network policies, service mesh)
- Solid SDN concepts (control/data plane separation, programmable fabric)
- Understanding of overlay networking (VXLAN, Geneve, encapsulation)
- Automation via Terraform or equivalent (network as code)
- Excellent English (international team, follow-the-sun on-call)

Nice to have:
- OpenFlow, P4, or programmable data plane experience
- Service mesh in production (Istio, Linkerd, Consul)
- Cloud load balancing at scale (GCLB, ALB, or equivalent)
- Experience with regulated environments (banking, healthcare, defense)
- BGP, MPLS, or traditional network engineering background

Why join:
- Greenfield SRE function, Bucharest hub. You catch the org before it exists. First hires shape the standard everyone else inherits.
- Accelerated Google training program on Google's internal technical stack (Borg, Colossus, Spanner) is planned as part of onboarding.
- Direct technical collaboration with Google Cloud SRE teams. Follow-the-sun on-call model with global coverage.
- Sovereign cloud, first-of-its-kind, SecNumCloud 3.2 qualified. Regulated workloads in banking, healthcare, energy, defense.
- Hyperscaler-level scale of operations from a single location. No relocation required.
- Competitive package, private medical, meal vouchers, sport benefit, and the rest of the Thales standard package.

Sound like you?

Apply via the link in the first comment. We review Senior and Mid profiles within the same pipeline and route based on experience during first-stage screening.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: New Product Engineer Intern
postings.description:
Localizacion : Madrid, Spain

Thales people architect solutions at the heart of the defence-security continuum. Interoperable and secure information and telecommunications systems for defence, security, and civil operators, are based upon innovative use of radiocommunications, networks, and cybersecurity. We are ground breaking new digital technologies such as 4G mobile communications, cryptography, cloud computing and big data for use in physical protection systems, and critical information systems.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

El Grupo Thales es una de las principales compañías tecnológicas del mundo y un actor relevante en los mercados de aeronáutica, defensa, ciberseguridad, seguridad digital y espacio.

Thales está formada por más de 80.000 personas y está presente en 68 países. En España, cuenta con un equipo de 700 empleados, a las que se suman las regiones de Portugal y Turquía.

Thales en España es líder en soluciones tecnológicas de sistemas de información y comunicaciones seguras, vigilancia inteligente, además de contar con el centro de competencia de sistemas de identidad y biometría en Madrid.

¿En qué consiste el Young Talent Programme?

En Thales, creemos que las nuevas generaciones son las impulsoras del cambio y, por ello, hemos desarrollado un programa de prácticas de un año a jornada completa que complementaremos con una formación en Máster en Gestión Adaptativa e Innovación impartida por la Fundación Universidad-Empresa (a distancia).

Como parte del equipo de Investigación y Desarrollo (I+D), participarás en el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones para proyectos europeos en las áreas de C2 (Mando y Control), Gestión de la Energía y otras, aplicando nuevas tecnologías como la Inteligencia Artificial. En particular, podrás trabajar en entornos donde los Agentes de Inteligencia Artificial se aplican principalmente a sistemas de comunicación (como comunicaciones tácticas o submarinas o redes eléctricas) en el ámbito de la Defensa. Colaborarás estrechamente en la definición de modelos de IA adaptados a estos contextos, tanto desde su concepción como en su implementación y entrenamiento.

Como Ingeniero/a en Prácticas de Nuevos Productos, colaborarás en la especificación, definición e implementación de modelos de IA aplicados a sistemas, realizando las siguientes tareas:
- Definición de modelos

- Desarrollo e implementación de software del modelo

- Entrenamiento de modelos

- Pruebas (testing) de software

- Simulación y modelado de canales de comunicación en entornos complejos

- Procesamiento y análisis de señales para sistemas de transmisión

Buscamos un perfil versátil con un gran interés en aprender sobre diferentes entornos y nuevas tecnologías para su aplicación en la generación de nuevos productos para las Fuerzas Armadas.

¿Qué Buscamos?
En primer lugar y más importante… ¡Jóvenes como tú! Que tienen ganas de aprender, que cuentan con energía y entusiasmo, y que además se sienten motivad@s por los nuevos retos y el trabajo en equipo.

Además, nos gustaría que cumplieses con los siguientes requisitos:

Competencias técnicas y funcionales:
- Titulación: Grado en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería del Software o similar.

- Protocolos de red: Comprensión de los procesos de comunicación bajo el paradigma OSI y su aplicación.

- Desarrollo de software: Dominio del desarrollo en entornos Python o C#, demostrando capacidad para diseñar, implementar y mantener algoritmos para aplicaciones de software.

- Nivel de inglés: Competencia fluida que permita una comunicación, documentación y colaboración efectivas en equipos internacionales y multiculturales.

Otros aspectos valorables (méritos):
- Entornos de desarrollo Linux: Uso y aprovechamiento de herramientas y utilidades avanzadas para dar soporte a un código y despliegue eficientes.

- Marcos de trabajo (frameworks) de Deep Learning: Dominio de los principales entornos como Keras/TensorFlow o PyTorch.

- Librerías clave: Conocimiento de bibliotecas esenciales de Visión por Computador y Machine Learning, incluyendo OpenCV, NumPy, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Pandas, etc.

- Control de versiones: Experiencia práctica con Git para la gestión del código fuente y flujos de trabajo colaborativos.

- Comunicaciones: Familiaridad con el procesamiento digital de señales, sistemas de transmisión o modelado de canales.

Habilidades conductuales y blandas:
- Comunicación efectiva: Expresión clara de ideas, escucha activa y adaptación del mensaje según el interlocutor.

- Trabajo en equipo: Capacidad de trabajo y colaboración en equipos multinacionales.

- Adaptabilidad: Flexibilidad frente al cambio, nuevas tareas o situaciones imprevistas.

- Visión sistémica: Enfoque orientado a la perspectiva global del sistema, aplicando soluciones a toda la arquitectura y no solo a elementos puntuales.

- Gestión del tiempo y organización: Priorización de tareas, cumplimiento de plazos y trabajo eficiente.

- Asertividad: Expresión de ideas y necesidades con respeto, seguridad y sin agresividad.

- Pensamiento crítico: Análisis lógico y objetivo de situaciones y problemas.

- Actitud positiva: Afrontamiento de retos y relaciones interpersonales con entusiasmo y optimismo.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
- 21 días de vacaciones.

- 1.150€ brutos al mes.

- Horario flexible.

- Jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.

- Entorno multidisciplinar e internacional, que te enriquecerá como profesional.

- Ubicación: Leganés

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

In this role, the individual will support the team in ensuring the long-term reliability and availability of our customer’s assets by assisting with the identification, analysis, and mitigation of obsolescence risks.

- Hands-on experience in reliability and obsolescence management within a leading technology company.

Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique.

En tant que Manager de Sûreté du site de Cannes et Officier de Sûreté Thales Alenia Space France (TASF), vous êtes responsable d'assurer la protection des intérêts de TASF à travers la sauvegarde des opérations, des collaborateurs, des actifs matériels et de l’information du Groupe en toutes circonstances et dans tous les lieux où TAS France est présente et/ou amenée à opérer.

Vous participez à la définition, au déploiement et au pilotage de la stratégie Groupe de la Sûreté sur le périmètre de TASF et vous êtes garant de la mise en œuvre de la politique définie.

A ce titre, vous garantissez la protection des collaborateurs, des sites et du patrimoine industriel, scientifique et technique de la société ainsi que la protection du secret défense sur votre périmètre.

Vous pilotez et animez la cellule de crise ainsi que les relations avec les autorités étatiques en charge des questions de sûreté et autres professionnels de la Sûreté.

Au sein de votre périmètre de responsabilités et d'action, vous avez pour missions principales :
- Participer à la définition des politiques et des processus.

- Participer à la conception et veiller à la mise en application des instructions générales et particulières relatives à la protection de personnes, des biens et de l'information.

- Veiller et anticiper les menaces pouvant porter atteinte aux intérêts du Groupe.

- Proposer et gérer le budget.

- Animer et coordonner la fonction Sûreté à travers la définition des priorités, l'élaboration et l'analyse d'indicateurs spécifiques et la mise en place et optimisation des actions correctives.

- Assurer le maintien de la cohérence globale entre la mission de la fonction sûreté et les moyens consacrés.

- Garantir l’application et le respect des réglementations nationales et internationales applicables.

- Intervenir en support aux business et opérations sur les questions de sûreté et apporter un conseil sur les enjeux de défense si nécessaire.

- Manager et conseiller votre équipe en coordonnant et développant le métier de Sûreté Globale.

- Manager les aspects Ressources Humaines de votre équipe (fixation des objectifs, check-in, développement des compétences, recrutements, ...).

Votre profil

Vous avez des connaissances en management des risques et gestion de crises ?

Vous possédez de bonnes capacités de communication et de synthèse pour travailler efficacement en coordination avec des interlocuteurs variés, internes comme externes, y compris des autorités étatiques ou internationales?

Diplômé d’un Bac + 5 dans le domaine de la sûreté et de la sécurité, vous justifiez de l’ expérience et des compétences suivantes :
- Expérience d'au moins 10 ans sur un poste similaire dans un autre groupe industriel ou dans un service de l’Etat traitant directement des sujets de sûreté (armées, police, gendarmerie, douane, magistrature, intelligence économique).

- Maîtrise du processus d’analyse du contexte, des menaces et des vulnérabilités.

- Maitrise de l'Anglais (oral et écrit).
​

Rigueur, sens de l'analyse, capacité rédactionnelle et esprit d'équipe sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: OpenSky DevSecOps Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Whom We Are Looking For
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps engineer specializing in Kubernetes to join our team, to design, implement and manage our container orchestration (aka OpenSky) platforms for the next generation of Air Traffic Management Systems. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in Kubernetes internals, automation and observability, and is passionate about enabling development teams to deliver applications reliably and securely at scale.
The candidate would be working in an agile squad, in software delivery, led by the OpenSky Architect.
Responsibilities:
- Cluster Management and Operations- Deploy, upgrade and manage Kubernetes clusters across an Azure based cloud and on-prem environments.
- Ensure high-availability and disaster recovery of Kubernetes workloads
- Manage cluster lifecycle using tools like Cluster API, kubeadm or managed services.

- Workload Deployment & Automation- Define and manage Helm charts, kustomize overlays, or GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, FluxCD).
- Automate application deployments, scaling and rollbacks with Kubernetes native patterns.
- Design CI/CD pipelines that integrate seamlessly with Kubernetes

- Networking & Security- Configure Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins like Cillium, Calico, Multus).
- Implement Ingress, Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateway solutions.
- Apply security best practices including RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, and secrets management (e.g., Vault, Sealed Secrets)

- Observability and Reliability- Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry)
- Conduct Performance tuning and capacity planning for clusters and workloads
- Establish SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets in collaboration with development teams, Release Train Engineers, Product Owners

- Infrastructure as Code & Automation- Provision Kubernetes clusters and underlying infrastructure using Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi
- Manage configuration drift with GitOps practices
- Automate cluster upgrades, patching and compliance enforcement

- Collaboration & Culture- Partner with developers to design cloud-native applications aligned with Kubernetes bet practices
- Support Agile Release Trains and DevSecOps culture by promoting self-service platforms.
- Provide guidance and mentorship on Kubernetes to engineers across the organization.

Requirements:

Education
- Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology
- Recognized Engineering degree

Essential Skills/Experience
- Proven hands-on experience with Kubernetes (2+ years in production)
- Strong knowledge of containerization (Docker, OCI images) and registries.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) or hybrid Kubernetes environments
- Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD).
- Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking and security.

Desirable Skills/Experience
If you have the following desirable skills and relevant experiences, it would be an added advantage!

- Relevant certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKSS), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).
- Experience with Service Meshes (Istio, Linkerd, Consul).
- Familiarity with multi-cluster, multi-tenant or edge Kubernetes deployments.
- Knowledge of FinOps and cost optimization for Kubernetes workloads.

Essential / Desirable Traits
- Possess learning agility, flexibility and pro-activity
- Comfortable with agile teamwork and user engagement

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.description:
Location: Barcelona, Spain

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Thales Cybersecurity & Digital Identity es un líder global en seguridad digital, aportando confianza a un mundo cada vez más conectado. Diseñamos y ofrecemos una amplia gama de productos, software y servicios basados en dos tecnologías principales: la identificación digital y la protección de datos.
Debido a un aumento en la actividad, estamos buscando un/a Técnico/a de Calidad Visual, con sede en Parets del Vallès, Barcelona. Como parte del Equipo de Calidad, serás responsable de:

- Realizar auditorías visuales y funcionales de productos SIM y SMD, asegurando el cumplimiento de especificaciones, procedimientos y requisitos del cliente o la clienta.
- Actuar como garante de la calidad en la fuente, identificando desviaciones antes de que los productos avancen al siguiente proceso o al cliente o la clienta.
- Auditar procesos, máquinas, parámetros operativos y condiciones de producción conforme a los estándares de calidad definidos.
- Verificar el cumplimiento de instrucciones de trabajo, planes de control, CSR y criterios de aceptación/rechazo.
- Ejecutar controles de calidad en producto en proceso, producto terminado y puntos críticos definidos.
- Registrar no conformidades, desviaciones y hallazgos de auditoría en los sistemas correspondientes.
- Dar soporte directo al personal operativo, aclarando dudas sobre criterios de calidad, procedimientos, controles visuales y pruebas aplicables.
- Apoyar la correcta ejecución de testes, inspecciones visuales y controles definidos para SIM y SMD.
- Escalar oportunamente desviaciones recurrentes o críticas a Calidad, Producción e Ingeniería.
- Participar en la investigación de defectos, análisis de causa raíz y seguimiento de acciones correctivas y preventivas.
- Colaborar en auditorías internas, de cliente y corporativas, garantizando trazabilidad y evidencia objetiva.
- Asegurar el cumplimiento de los requisitos de seguridad, trazabilidad y protección de producto (GSMA, IATF, VDA, información y producto clasificado).
- Promover la disciplina operativa, el cumplimiento de estándares y la mejora continua dentro del área productiva.

Experiencia, Conocimientos y Skills

- Educación mínima: Bachillerato, Formación Técnica o equivalente.
- Experiencia previa en control de calidad, auditoría visual o inspección en entornos industriales.
- Conocimiento práctico de procesos productivos, preferentemente en SIM, SMD o electrónica.
-  Conocimientos básicos en el uso de instrumentos de medición y control de calidad, tales como Reloj comparador, Micrómetro, etc.
- Capacidad para interpretar instrucciones de trabajo, planes de control y criterios de aceptación.
- Conocimiento básico de sistemas de registro de calidad y trazabilidad.
- Atención al detalle, rigor, disciplina y objetividad.
- Capacidad de comunicación clara con operadores y equipos de soporte.
- Perfil independiente, responsable y orientado a la prevención de errores.

Valorable:

- Experiencia específica en procesos de fabricación de SIM Cards y SMD.
- Conocimiento de estándares de calidad, ISO9001, CSR, GSMA y/o IATF a nivel operativo.
- Experiencia en auditorías internas de proceso y producto.
- Conocimiento de herramientas básicas de calidad (checklists, NCR, defect mapping, Pareto).
- Experiencia trabajando en entornos de alta exigencia en calidad y trazabilidad.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

- Retribución flexible

- Trabajo por turnos

- Seguro de vida

- Seguro de salud parcialmente subvencionado

- Servicios para la conciliación

- Incorporación a una compañía líder global en ciberseguridad e identidad digital.

- Entorno industrial dinámico, con fuerte cultura de seguridad y sostenibilidad.

- Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de Thales.

Thales es una empresa que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades. Todas las candidaturas cualificadas serán tenidas en cuenta para el puesto, independientemente de su raza, color, religión, sexo, nacionalidad, ascendencia, embarazo, edad, orientación sexual, identidad de género, estado civil, condición de veterano protegido, afección médica o discapacidad, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

She or he acts as a TAS-E GENEX ISIT Segment Referent fully responsible to Lead all tasks related to General Procurement Categories as part of TAS Segment A&F team working with TAS JV GENEX ISIT Director, JV Team Leader and JV Category Managers in order to properly apply TAS/Thales Strategy.

• Contribute to the formulation of and responsible for the execution of TAS procurement strategy in TAS-E by managing her/his team and by coaching and influencing all supply chain actors and TAS-E stakeholders
• Implement Change Management by ensuring full interaction with TAS JV OP Organization in the frame of a new JV OP Model implementation
• Ensure succecssful new ERP (SAP for Space) implementation in TAS-E (transition phase to full deployment) without impacts on the operational proc service level
• Define and put in place initiatives and innovative solutions either to optimize resources and headcount in the Country and improve the operational efficiency
• Drive the professionalization of the OP team in her/his Country and develop team's tools, methods, capabilities and skills by ensuring synergy with JV OP teams
• Set objectives to the OP Teams in his/her Country taking into account TAS/Thales inputs
• Monitor and forecast his team WL and upcoming levels of demand
• Apply and enforce the TAS/Thales Code of Ethics throughout his/her OP Team
Operational local tasks:
• Review, approve and sign all the purchase orders placed by the team under his or her responsibility, including "excess/obsolete". Manage purchase order cancellations
• Ensure that her/his team's purchase orders are acknowledged and that Export Control documents are filled out by suppliers & attached to purchase orders
• Ensure that Tactical Buyer team keeps information systems up to date with latest information and optimal parameters, including support just-in-time or pulled flows deliveries when required

• Ensure that her/his team resolves invoicing issues and strictly respects Cash Golden Rules
• Defend claims raised by her/his team with TAS-E management and suppliers
• Ensure his or her team's overall Order Book, Order Book reviews, Stock and Forecast management review processes function properly
• Ensure his/her OP team by using the LEAN Approach,ensure his/her team's overall performance meets expected service levels & key performance indicators

• Actively attend the meetings to keep updated internal customer and the other functions in Procurement

=> CAPEX PROC management
=> LVPOs efficiency
=> internal stakeholder change management

Votre quotidien

Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

Au cœur des activités d’intégration et de tests des satellites, vous intervenez sur les équipements de radiofréquence et contribuez à leur gestion, leur contrôle et leur surveillance.
Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Métier RF, vous participez aux différentes phases d’intégration, de tests, de qualification et d’exploitation des systèmes satellitaires.

En tant qu’Opérateur AIT Radio Fréquence (RF), vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

- Mettre en place, paramétrer et contrôler les équipements RF nécessaires aux tests et aux opérations satellite ;
- Effectuer les mesures et analyses des signaux RF : puissance, fréquence, modulation et qualité de transmission ;
- Contrôler la conformité des systèmes RF aux spécifications techniques et aux normes en vigueur ;
- Participer aux campagnes d’essais RF lors des phases de développement et de qualification des satellites ;
- Surveiller les performances des tests RF, identifier les anomalies et contribuer à leur diagnostic ;
- Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie pour résoudre les problématiques techniques liées aux équipements RF ;
- Rédiger les comptes rendus d’essais et garantir la traçabilité des opérations ;
- Respecter les exigences de sécurité et de qualité applicables dans les laboratoires et salles d’essais.

Le poste nécessite une habilitation électrique et implique une exposition aux risques électriques et RF.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation Bac+2 ou Bac+3 de type BTS ou BUT, dans le domaine de l’électronique, des télécommunications ou équivalent.
Vous disposez d’une première expérience dans un environnement RF, idéalement dans le secteur spatial, aéronautique ou des télécommunications.
Vous connaissez les principes de la radiofréquence, notamment les ondes, la modulation et les antennes, et maîtrisez les principaux équipements de mesure RF tels que les analyseurs de spectre, générateurs de signaux et wattmètres. Une bonne compréhension des systèmes de communication satellitaires est également attendue.
Rigoureux et attentif à la qualité des mesures, vous savez lire et interpréter des plans, schémas et spécifications techniques. Votre autonomie, votre esprit d’initiative, votre sens de l’observation et votre réactivité vous permettent d'évoluer efficacement au sein d’une équipe opérationnelle.

Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés (2x8 ou 3x8) et pour participer à des missions à l’étranger dans le cadre des campagnes de lancement satellite.

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

LE MOT DE L’ÉQUIPE
« Passionné par le spatial ? Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et vivez au plus près les phases d’essais et de qualification de nos satellites, jusqu’aux campagnes de lancement ! »

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Au sein de l’activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques, le site de La Ferté Saint Aubin est spécialisé dans la production de systèmes d’armements terrestres et aéroportés (mortiers, munitions, roquettes…), de systèmes de protection des forces et de contrôle de zone.
Fort de ses 450 salariés, ingénieurs, techniciens et ouvriers spécialisés, le site de la Ferté Saint Aubin assure la recherche et développement, la production, les essais ainsi que toutes les fonctions « supports » nécessaires à la conception de systèmes performants essentiels à la réussite des missions opérationnelles.

- Prendre connaissance et appliquer les règles et consignes d’Hygiène Sécurité Environnement ;

- Réaliser la série en conformité avec les temps gamme ;

- Appliquer les contrôles prévus et renseigner les fiches suiveuses ;

Titulaire d'une formation dans le secteur de l’industrie (CAP/BEP/Bac PRO ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience solide en production, idéalement dans le domaine de la pyrotechnie ?
Vous avez une fibre naturelle pour le travail en équipe et êtes capable de vous adapter à un environnement pluridisciplinaire composé de différents niveaux hiérarchiques ?
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit de synthèse et d’une bonne gestion de l’urgence ?

• Bonnes connaissances des outils informatiques (word, excel)

postings.title: Partners Ecosystem Manager (w/m/d)
postings.description:
Location: Berlin, Germany

We Say HI*

Partners Ecosystem Manager (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Ihre Mission als Partners Ecosystem Manager:
- Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Partner- und Alliance-Strategie zur Etablierung und zum Ausbau des indirekten Vertriebskanals im deutschen Markt

- Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung eines strategischen Partnernetzwerks sowie Verantwortung für die Umsatzentwicklung des zugeordneten Partnerportfolios.

- Planung und Umsetzung gemeinsamer Vertriebsaktivitäten (Co-Selling und Reselling), Verhandlung von Partnerschaften sowie Identifikation neuer Geschäftspotenziale

- Enge bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Produktmanagement, Operations sowie den Bereichen Finance, Legal und Customer Success, um Partnerinteressen erfolgreich zu vertreten und gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb oder Partnermanagement in Verbindung mit relevantem Netzwerk und Branchenkenntnissen

- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sicherer Umgang mit datenbasierten Vertriebs- und Reporting-Tools zur Steuerung von Performance und Geschäftserfolg

- Strategische Denkweise, ausgeprägte Leadership-Kompetenz und die Fähigkeit, Strategien flexibel an Markt- und Unternehmensanforderungen anzupassen

- Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau langfristiger Partnerbeziehungen und in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams und C-Level-Stakeholdern

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Platform Engineer
Locations – Crawley, Doncaster (Hybrid Working)
Full-time or Part-time

Who are we and what do we do?

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales is continuing to develop its digital platform capabilities, and this role will play an important part in supporting and evolving a dedicated AI platform capability within the UK Digital Competence Centre (Best-In-Class).
As an Infrastructure Systems Engineer, you will join an agile platform team responsible for supporting secure, resilient and high-performing on-premise infrastructure services that underpin a business-critical hosted AI solution. You will help maintain and improve the core infrastructure environment, ensuring services remain available, supportable and secure for internal users and engineering teams.

This is a varied role with a strong operational focus, covering infrastructure support, systems administration, troubleshooting, lifecycle management and service improvement across a mixed technology estate. You will work closely with platform engineers, developers, security specialists and other stakeholders to support reliable service delivery and continuous improvement.
Your career could develop within the DCC as it continues to grow or take you into the wider business as our digital and technical agenda evolves.
Thales is a great place to work where diversity, integrity and a passion for what we do are very important to us. Whether you have worked with platform infrastructure for many years, or have gained relevant experience more recently and are looking to build on it, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities
- Support and maintain the infrastructure underpinning an on-premise hosted AI platform, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and available.
- Monitor platform health and performance, investigating and resolving issues as part of day-to-day service support.
- Carry out routine maintenance and lifecycle activities, including patching, upgrades and scale-out activities.
- Work with engineering, security and service teams to support a resilient, supportable and well-governed platform.
- Contribute to technical documentation, operational standards and continuous improvement activities.

Infrastructure and platform support
- Support the day-to-day operation of the hosted platform across physical server, the virtualisation layer and operating system environments.
- Help maintain service availability, performance and capacity through monitoring, troubleshooting and proactive maintenance.
- Support containerised services and the underlying infrastructure they rely on.

Maintenance and lifecycle management
- Carry out routine maintenance activities including patching, upgrades and health checks.
- Support the ongoing management of hardware and software lifecycles to keep services secure and supportable.
- Maintain clear technical documentation and operational records.

Incident resolution and service improvement
- Investigate and resolve infrastructure and platform issues in line with agreed support processes.
- Work with internal teams and, where necessary, suppliers to restore service and address recurring problems.
- Identify opportunities to improve reliability, supportability and efficiency across the platform.

Experience Required

We recruit for roles at many levels so we would be very interested to hear from you regardless of your length of experience.
- Experience working with Windows Server operating systems
- Experience with Unix-based operating systems, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
- Experience with VMware ESXi and/or other hypervisors
- Experience supporting containerised environments, particularly Kubernetes
- Incident and problem management, troubleshooting and working within change management procedures
- Good understanding of core networking principles
- Ability to demonstrate a good understanding of application and operating system lifecycle management
- Experience supporting infrastructure in an enterprise or operational environment
- Good understanding of platform and infrastructure support principles

Desirable Skills

- Experience with build and CI/CD tools and pipeline (BitBucket/ Github)
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible
- Active ability and interest in scripting languages
- HP Enterprise hardware
- Agile working methodologies
- Active Directory
- PowerBI
- Solid understanding of APIs and their function

Connect with Fiona Tal, Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-FT1 who is eager to explore together with you this exciting opportunity.

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions.  This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years.  In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.location: Austin, Texas, United States of America
postings.description:
Location: Austin, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary

Austin, Hybrid
We are seeking a PMO Specialist to join Thales in Austin, TX.

As a Project Management Office (PMO) Specialist for the Identity and Biometrics Solutions team in the USA, you will serve as a key member of the Projects and Portfolio Management organization, providing advanced analytical, governance, reporting, and project management support across the NORAM portfolio.

The PMO Specialist is responsible for analyzing complex project and portfolio data, establishing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), identifying trends and risks, and translating data into meaningful insights and recommendations for project teams and leadership. The role will independently develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, templates, governance practices, and portfolio-level processes that improve visibility, consistency, compliance, and decision-making.

This position partners closely with Project Managers, functional teams, Finance, and business leadership to support project scheduling, financial analysis, portfolio reporting, project governance, internal audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. The PMO Specialist will also contribute to executive-level project and portfolio reviews by ensuring information is accurate, consistent, and presented in a manner that supports effective business decisions.

The Identity and Biometrics Solutions team designs and develops innovative products and solutions ranging from desktop applications integrating biometric devices to high-performance server applications, secure identity-document issuance solutions utilizing PKI, encryption, and cryptography, and emerging digital identity technologies such as Digital Driver’s Licenses.

The Projects and Portfolio Management team is responsible for leading the definition, execution, acceptance, and handoff of projects across the business line within the region.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements
Must have U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain the post-hire Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Clearance from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and must be able to obtain post-hire clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investments in the U.S. (CFIUS) and Department of Justice.

Key Areas of Responsibility

• Independently analyze and interpret complex Projects and Services data to identify trends, patterns, risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, visualizations, and analytical tools that provide meaningful insight into project, portfolio, and business performance.
• Analyze large and diverse datasets, validate findings, draw informed conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations for Project Managers and leadership.
• Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Projects and Portfolio KPIs, including defining measurement methodologies, monitoring performance, identifying variances, and recommending corrective or improvement actions.
• Prepare and communicate analytical findings, portfolio trends, risks, and recommendations to management and senior leadership.
• Partner cross-functionally with Project Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, and other stakeholders to interpret project and portfolio performance and resolve reporting or data inconsistencies.

postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

We’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries - from the bottom of the oceans to the depths of space and cyberspace - and from manufacturing to engineering, we work together to build a future we can all trust.

Imperva, a Thales company, is a globally recognized cybersecurity leader, dedicated to securing data and applications across diverse environments. Our cutting-edge solutions empower organizations to safeguard their most critical assets, ensuring robust protection against emerging threats.
Principal Business Intelligence & Product Operation
About the role

We are looking for a commercially sharp Strategy & GTM Lead to join our Data Security Product Management team. This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, marketing and finance — owning pricing and packaging across our data security portfolio (DSPM, DSF, FAM, CipherTrust), running our competitive and win-loss programs, and serving as the commercial bridge between what we build and how we sell it.​

What You'll Own

- Pricing & Packaging: Own pricing and packaging strategy across the portfolio — list price, tier and edition design, metering and consumption models, discount architecture, and cross-product bundling.
- Competitive Analysis: Own the competitive program — battlecards, positioning, objection handling, and displacement plays that Sales actually uses. Track competitor pricing, packaging, releases, and GTM motion, and translate movement into a recommendation.
- Win-Loss Analysis: Build and run a repeatable win-loss program end to end — interview design, execution, and synthesis. Separate the reported loss reason from the real one: product gap, price, packaging, competitive displacement, or sales execution. Close the loop into the roadmap and into enablement.
- Pipeline Analysis: Analyze pipeline health by product, segment, and route to market. Find where deals stall, name why, and drive the fix with the accountable owner.
- Back Office & Commercial Operations: Serve as Product's interface to the back office.
- Field Enablement and GTM: Equip Sales and Sales Engineering to sell on value — pricing guidance, competitive training, and value articulation.

What We're Looking For

Must have:
- 10+ years in outbound product management, product marketing, pricing strategy, or GTM strategy for enterprise B2B software — with at least 5 years personally owning pricing, competitive, or win-loss outcomes
- 5+ years in security business
- Hands-on ownership of a real pricing or packaging change: what you changed, why, what it did to ASP or win rate, and what you got wrong
- Hands on experience with analyzing pipelines and performing win-loss analysis
- Experience with leading GTM activities
- Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Operations without authority over any of them
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Team player who brings evidence, states plainly when the data is thin, and makes the call anyway

Advantages:

- Strong advantage - DSPM market experience — data security posture management, data discovery and classification.
- Data Security experience more broadly — DAM, encryption and key management, DLP, data governance
- Enterprise security in an adjacent segment — endpoint, network, cloud, identity, or SIEM/SOC
- Portfolio spanning both on-premises/hybrid and SaaS, including the pricing tension between them
- Consumption or usage-based pricing experience; channel, MSSP, or hyperscaler marketplace motion
- Familiarity with the compliance drivers behind data security spend (GDPR, PCI DSS, DORA, NIS2, data residency and sovereignty)
- SQL or BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI)

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Organisation Context
The Airspace Mobility Solutions (AMS) business, part of the Global Business Unit Land and Air Systems, provides leading-edge Air Traffic Management (ATM), Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM), Security, and Digital Aviation solutions for the Commercial and Defence sectors.

The AMS manages 11% of the world's airspace and, with revenues of over 500 million Euros worldwide, is the global market leader in airspace management solutions. In Singapore, the business focuses on the delivery and support of ATM solutions in the Asia Pacific region.

Role Description
The Principal Integration Engineer is responsible for the integration of software and hardware components within a complex software-centric ATM system. The role involves coordinating and executing integration activities, troubleshooting system issues, and ensuring that various components work seamlessly together while satisfying functional and performance requirements.
Working within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) or Agile Squad, the role may also involve Verification and Validation activities.

- Identify risks, and propose effective solutions; execute mitigation actions and report on outcomes / cost savings and residual risks

- Assist bid activities with integration estimation

- Authoring and/or reviewing documentation and documentation updates

- Contribute to the development of Integration Policies, Processes and Procedures to ensure best practice.

- Promote knowledge sharing ensuring that work is captured sufficiently for re-use across projects

- Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Qualifications
- Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or relevant experience

Essential Experience
- 7+ years of experience in similar positions integrating complex software-centric real-time systems

- ATM Domain Experience

- Ability to understand the structure of and troubleshoot Virtualisation Platforms/Operating Systems (Clients/Servers): 3+ years
- Linux/Unix Operating Systems, SNMP Services, RSYSLOG

- Windows Operating Systems

- VMware

- Scripting: Python, Shell, XML – 3+ years

- DevOps and Automation Tools: Ansible, Jenkins

- Configuration Management: GIT (Bitbucket), JIRA

- Cybersecurity: LDAP, AD, PKI

- Network Protocols and Technologies: SNMP, UDP, TCP, IP

- Debugging tools (e.g., Wireshark)

- Infrastructure monitoring tools

- Adept at troubleshooting issues quickly and efficiently

- Aptitude to work effectively in a multi-disciplinary integrated team environment with colleagues based in remote sites or other countries

- Positive attitude combined with excellent interpersonal and motivational skills

- Ability to effectively communicate complex engineering issues and concepts, both verbally and in writing, tailored appropriately for stakeholders

Desirable
- Programming Languages: Java, C++

- Site integration and deployment experience

- Knowledge of networks and network configuration / exposure to distributed systems

- Experience with System Engineering Tools (e.g., DOORS, Polarion, Jira, MBSE)

- Experience in ATM Domain and related standards (e.g., ICAO, Eurocontrol) or safety-critical systems

- Experience working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)

General Requirements

- Advocate for diversity and inclusion, actively involved in implementing change initiatives to achieve diversity goals

- Advocate for a culture of continuous improvement

- Advocate for accountability, transparency, and curiosity

- Comply with all relevant company Occupational Health, Safety and Environmental policies and work practices to prevent or minimise accidental exposures to self, colleagues, visitors, and/or the environment

- Comply with all relevant company policies and procedures

Special Requirements

- Implementation of continuous improvement and management tools (Lean: flow management, conducting Experience in implementation of continuous improvement and management tools (Lean: flow management, conducting Gemba Walks, Compass Room, Plan Do Check Act (PDCA), TPM, etc).

Le domaine de la défense connait aujourd’hui une transformation en profondeur de ses systèmes d’information, aussi bien dans le domaine du commandement, du renseignement, ou que des opérations tactiques, basée sur l’adoption de technologies déployées dans les domaines :

Conteneurisation, ...),

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

- La conception logicielle ou le support technique de systèmes embarqués (JavaCard, OS sécurisés, firmware)

- Les technologies carte à puce, cryptographie ou électronique embarquée

- La gestion de projets industriels multi-acteurs (R&D, production, qualité…)
