postings.title: Product Manager- Application Security
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

We’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries - from the bottom of the oceans to the depths of space and cyberspace - and from manufacturing to engineering, we work together to build a future we can all trust.

Imperva, a Thales company, is a globally recognized cybersecurity leader, dedicated to securing data and applications across diverse environments. Our cutting-edge solutions empower organizations to safeguard their most critical assets, ensuring robust protection against emerging threats.

Product Manager, Application Security

Imperva is a leading cybersecurity provider delivering best-in-class solutions to protect data and applications across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Our customers, from innovative startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, trust us to secure their digital experiences at scale.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Israel’s Top 50 High-Tech Companies to Work For in 2025 (Dun & Bradstreet) and offer a flexible hybrid work model from our Tel Aviv Rehovot office.

The Role

We are seeking a Platform Product Manager to drive the strategy, vision, and execution for the next-generation core engine powering our Cloud and Application Security platform.
In this strategic, high-leverage role leading dedicated core engineering teams, you will design the foundation that powers our security engine and build the seamless integration framework that allows other Imperva products and services to connect into our core ecosystem.
If you are energized by high-scale platform architecture, ecosystem integration, and creating leverage that accelerates an entire R&D organization, this role offers an incredible opportunity to shape the core technology behind our enterprise security portfolio.

Your Impact

As the Product Manager you will drive foundational initiatives that directly amplify the power, speed, and capability of our cloud security suite:
- Shape the platform of the future, ensuring it can meet next-generation security demands.
- Enable seamless cross-product integration across the platform.
- Bridge strategy & core infrastructure to maximize R&D output.

Responsibilities
- Lead product strategy, prioritization, and backlog management for core engineering teams, aligning technical delivery with enterprise outcomes.
- Establish platform standards, interfaces, and capabilities to streamline internal products interoperability.
- Partner closely with R&D leaders, and cross-functional product managers to ensure the core engine supports future product innovations.
- Define and track key platform metrics.
- Drive alignment across executive and technical stakeholders, translating complex platform capabilities into business value.

Requirements
- 3+ years of Product Management experience, leading platform products, cloud infrastructure, core developer tools, or backend enterprise solutions.
- Strong strategic & technical aptitude: proven track record of defining a clear strategy and translating complex systems needs into actionable product roadmaps.
- Knowledge of core networking concepts, proxy architectures, or web security fundamentals.
- Cross-functional leadership: ability to align multiple engineering teams, influence technical leaders, and drive consensus across organizational boundaries.
- Strategic problem solver: skilled at balancing foundational platform evolution with immediate cross-product delivery needs.

Preferred Qualifications (Advantage)
- Previous experience in engineering, system architecture, or other technical lead role.
- Platform & API integration experience: deep understanding of modern cloud architecture, APIs, microservices patterns, and platform ecosystem design.
- Experience working in modern agile environments (e.g., SAFe, Scrum).
- Experience building software platforms designed for internal cross-team enablement or developer ecosystem growth.

Thales, champions inclusion and we believe diversity strengthens the fabric of our culture. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

postings.title: Product Owner
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Thales established its presence in Singapore in 1973 to support the expansion of aerospace-related activities in the Asia-Pacific region. Throughout the last four decades, the company grew from strength to strength and is today involved in the primary businesses of Aerospace (including Air Traffic Management), Defence & Security, Ground Transportation and Digital Identity & Security. Thales today employs over 2,100 people in Singapore across all its business areas.

Thales established its presence in Singapore in 1973 to support the expansion of aerospace-related activities in the Asia-Pacific region. Throughout the last four decades, the company grew from strength to strength and is today involved in the primary businesses of Aerospace (including Air Traffic Management), Defense & Security and Digital Identity & Security. Thales today employs over 2,100 people in Singapore across all its business areas.

About AMS
The Airspace Mobility Solutions (AMS) business, part of the Global Business Unit Land and Air Systems, is providing leading edge Air Traffic Management (ATM), Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM), Security and Digital Aviation solutions for the Commercial and Defence sectors.

The AMS business manages 11% of the world’s airspace and with revenues of over 500 million Euros worldwide, is the global market leader in airspace management solutions. In Singapore, the business focus is the delivery and support of two key ATM solutions including TopSKY-ATC(HE) and LORADS-III.

This role will initially support the TopSKY-ATC (HE) product.

Role Description Summary
The Product Owner (PO) will lead and provide technical direction for a multidisciplinary squad working within a SAFe framework. The PO is responsible for the allocation and prioritisation of ATM functions to epics to maximise the value delivered by the team and ensure that the team backlog is aligned to business objectives as defined by the Initiative Owner (IO).
The PO will engage with key stakeholders, including; solution architects, speciality engineers (Safety, Security, HF) and ATM subject matter experts to prepare and deliver requirement and design changes with reference to a defined system functional baseline to satisfy customer needs and project/bid cost targets.

As a Product Owner / Senior Systems Engineer, you are accountable for:
- Set a clear vision outlining the squad’s purpose and develop a strategy tailored to the squad’s capabilities
- Organise the co-engineering of the Feature Team working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
- Define the work (Epics/Features/Stories) and create the team backlog into thoroughly defined and deliverable items without compromising quality standards
- Prioritise the team backlog to streamline the execution of program priorities and ensure alignment with business objectives defined by the Initiative Owner
- Define and verify the Definition of Ready (DoR) - a unit of work is ready to be tackled
- Define and verify the Definition of Done (DoD) - a unit of work is complete
- Synthesise information from multiple sources
- Proactively identify, along with the Scrum Master, any necessary upskilling required within the squad.
- Design and maintain the systems engineering artefacts for the ATM function, including; requirements, capability description, functional behaviour and data exchanges (internal and external interfaces)
- Ensure the transversal constraints related to the function are considered (Safety, Human Factor, Performance, Security)
- Contribute and participate to the technical reviews (SOR, SFR, FIRR, SwRR)
- Contribute to the definition of the validation strategy
- Provides technical oversight to other teams within the project/bid, ensuring that the designed solution is implemented as per the design and in accordance to the project/bid schedule and cost and quality constraints.
- Support the Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM) by providing timely inputs to maintain the master schedule

Requirements :
- Degree in Engineering, IT or related discipline
- Postgraduate studies in Systems Engineering (Desirable)
- Air Traffic Management in one or more of the following functional areas:- Coordination
- Surveillance
- Adaptation/Configuration
- Interpartition/SWIM
- Profile
- HMI
- Tower
- Simulation and Training
- Safety Nets/Conflict Detection
- AMAN/DMAN

- Proven experience in Systems Engineering (7+ years) including; Requirements, Design, Integration and Verification and Validation
- Experience with Systems Engineering Standards eg. ISO/IEC15288
- Proven experience in the ATM Domain and related standards eg. ICAO, Eurocontrol
- Proven experience in the development of products and projects in a variety of methodologies, with a particular focus on iterative/agile development
- Proven experience as Product Owner in an Agile framework

In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

Thales, a global technology giant, stands out in the Defense & Security, Aeronautics & Space, and Cybersecurity & Digital Identity sectors. With an annual investment of nearly 4 billion euros in Research & Development, Thales positions itself at the forefront of innovation in key areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), quantum technology, and cybersecurity. The group employs 81,000 people across 68 countries and generated revenues of 18.4 billion euros in 2023.

The Organisation

The Engineering & Digital department defines, develops, and deploys processes, tools, and infrastructures to address the challenges faced by systems, software, and hardware engineers at Thales Group. You will join our Engineering Competence Center Romania department, more specifically the team associated with CortAIx activity. CortAIx is the group’s new entity dedicated to innovation in defense AI. It is composed of three pillars: CortAIx Labs focuses its efforts on research, CortAIx Sensors aims at integrating AI into sensors, and finally CortAIx Factory seeks to industrialize advanced AI solutions within the systems of armed forces, aircraft manufacturers, and airports. This initiative reflects Thales’s ambition to significantly enhance data analysis and decision-making in critical contexts, meeting high requirements for cybersecurity, embeddability, and efficiency. CortAIx relies on the expertise of over 600 AI specialists and annually engages around one hundred doctoral candidates, demonstrating the importance placed on research and innovation. With an extensive network of industrial partners, start-ups, and academic institutions, Thales establishes itself as a leader in AI for critical systems, leading in patent filings in this field in Europe. This approach is part of Thales’s long-term vision for transparent, explainable, and ethical AI, affirming its role as a pioneer in developing embeddable and secure solutions that address the sovereignty and security challenges of its clients.

Who are you?

- You hold a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.
- You have at least 5 years of experience supporting agile teams in a software environment
- You are pragmatic in your approach and focus on the "why" and on measuring the objectives to be achieved.
- You know how to review technical deliverables from engineering teams (customer needs, OCDs, requirements, architecture choices, etc.).
- You can lead and manage technical engineering projects, meeting requirements with a clear vision of risks and opportunities.
- You can engage and influence a diverse range of stakeholders around clear and achievable goals.
- You can make decisions even in uncertain contexts.
- You excel in maintaining a well-refined backlog, ensuring stories are clear, actionable, and aligned with business goals

Skills

- Jira (how to use and administrate project/board/workflow), Miro
- Organization of quarterly planning / PI planning
- Roadmap follow-up tools
- Ability to communicate the right elements to the right people
- Expert in value driven Product Management
- Knowledge of techniques for (vertical) functional slicing of requirements into Epics/User Stories
- Knowledge of prioritization techniques (MOSCOW, RICE, ...)
- Proficiency in writing Epics, User Stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios (knowledge of BDD a plus)
- You have a basic understanding of software development processes, architectures, and technologies to facilitate effective communication with the team
- You can balance competing priorities and negotiate trade-offs
- Knowledge of DDD (Event storming, ...) or Service Blue print workshop a plus
- Pragmatism
- Pro-activity

What we can accomplish together:

By joining the CortAIx / ECC-Romania team, you will play a crucial role in revolutionizing AI technologies within the industry, addressing real-world challenges to support the armed forces, civil aviation, and aerospace sectors. These challenges include real-time detection and identification of mobile units, data fusion and situation simulation, detection of hazards, intrusions, and threats, decision support for operators, as well as monitoring and control of triggered actions. As a Product Owner for cortAIx Annotation Tools, your missions will notably include:

Collaborate with stakeholders, the development team and CortAIx Factory Head of Assets

- Collaborate with the stakeholders and team to ensure alignment between business objectives, product vision and technical delivery
- Manage stakeholder expectations regarding releases, timelines and priorities
- Translate business goals and user needs into actionable product requirements
- Collaborate with CortAIx Head of Assets on the product vision and strategy
- Give regular updates to stakeholders (client and CortAIx management)
- Make progress and risks visible to all
- Collaborate with the team to plan and coordinate iteration deliverables, focusing on the right priorities and ensuring appropriate quality and documentation
- Work closely with the development team to ensure that objectives and backlog elements are clear to the team

Define release objectives and manage the product roadmap
- Define and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned with business strategy, user needs and team capacity, balancing short-term delivery with long-term innovation
- Update the roadmap based on business milestones, value metrics and emerging priorities
- Define and communicate clear release objectives, ensuring they align with the overall product vision and business strategy
- Define and monitor regularly the impact and performance of the product through metrics
- Manage the tradeoffs of scope change inside the allocated budget
- Manage risks and mitigations
- Follow up on action plans (make sure actions are defined, with an owner and due date, manage action follow up)

Manage & prioritize the product backlog driven by objectives
- Create and maintain the product backlog (Jira)
- Breaking down product needs into backlog elements providing customer/user value at different granularities (epics, user stories)
- Define epics and user stories at the right level with: description (for who, why, what), business rules, acceptance criterias, test scenarios
- Refine backlog items (user stories, features, bugs) with the team to ensure clarity and readiness for development
- Work with the development team to ensure backlog items are feasible, well-defined, and aligned with sprint goals
- Keep the prioritization of the backlog elements up to date
- Validate User Stories continuously during the sprint

Product Leadership
- Champion the vision for Annotation Solutions, leveraging all the possible mechanisms to accelerate time to annotate while making annotation a task people want to do
- Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve the product capabilities
- Adopt user-centric design and data-driven decision-making approaches to ensure stakeholders satisfaction

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Leadership, vision stratégique, capacité à fédérer, sens de l’organisation, excellent relationnel et communication en anglais sont des qualités que l’on vous reconnaît ?

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Mérignac, à proximité de Bordeaux, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.

Contexte :
Dans le cadre d’un développement ambitieux et face à de nombreux enjeux liés aux offres, projets et produits de nos clients, le succès des projets s’appuie sur un atelier d’ingénierie innovant, performant et maîtrisé par les équipes impliquées.

L’atelier Orchestra, actuellement utilisé par l’ensemble des projets, se compose de plusieurs capacités, dont la gestion des exigences avec DOORS (IBM) et la gestion des tests avec VIVALDI (Thales).
Depuis 2023, un vaste projet de rénovation de l’atelier d’ingénierie système (Distributed System basé sur POLARION) a été lancé, et un projet de déploiement dédié est actuellement en cours d’exécution (LEWIS).
Afin de garantir l’utilisation optimale de ces environnements d’ingénierie, le département Engineering Support apporte un accompagnement sur la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie, à destination de l’ensemble des ingénieurs travaillant sur ces projets.

Missions principales :

Réalisation de la migration des projets d’Orchestra vers Distributed System selon la roadmap 2026
- Analyser les données d’ingénierie de type exigence (DOORS) et test (VIVALDI) et identifier les écarts entre l’existant et la cible conformément aux exigences des outils de migration.

- Remédier les écarts, en accord avec le projet, pour préparer les données à la migration vers l’atelier Distributed System

- Préparer l’environnement cible

- Valider les migrations à blanc et la migration opérationnelle

Répondre aux demandes de support concernant l’atelier Distributed System (POLARION) émises par les projets :
- Apporter le support à l’utilisation ou réaliser les actions liées aux demandes de support des ingénieurs sur l'utilisation de l'ensemble de l'atelier. Cela concerne l'utilisation des outils, le support à la remontée des incidents, l'analyse des demandes d'évolution.

- Capitaliser les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation de l’atelier, en particulier en rédigeant des fiches de pratiques outillées (FPO)

Déployer l’environnement d’ingénierie Distributed System pour les nouveaux projets
- Capter les besoins des projets et proposer le processus outillé le plus adapté en s’appuyant sur le standard DMS ; Rédaction du Dossier de Description Atelier (DDA)

- Suivi du déploiement et configuration de l’environnement

postings.description:
Location: Quebec City, Canada

Dans des marchés en rapide évolution, les clients à travers le monde font confiance à Thales. Thales est une entreprise où les personnes les plus brillantes du monde entier se regroupent pour mettre en commun leurs idées et ainsi s'inspirer mutuellement. Dans tous les secteurs où œuvre Thales, notamment l’aérospatiale, le transport, la défense, la sécurité et l'espace, nos équipes d’architectes conçoivent des solutions innovantes qui rendent demain possible dès aujourd’hui.

Au sein du groupe, Thales Digital Solutions (TDS) est un pôle d’innovation technologique supportant tous les secteurs d’activités autant sur le marché local canadien qu’à l'international. Rejoignez-nous afin de contribuer au développement de solutions pour nos missions critiques. Nos projets de pointe variés utilisent nos expertises en Intelligence Artificielle, Facteurs Humains, Systèmes autonomes collaboratifs, Optimisation, Gestion de la connaissance, Cybersécurité et Design.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Within the group, Thales Digital Solutions (TDS) is a technological innovation hub supporting all sectors of activity, both in the local Canadian market and internationally. Join us to contribute to the development of mission critical solutions. Our various cutting-edge projects use our expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Human Factors, Collaborative Autonomous Systems, Optimization, Knowledge Management, Cybersecurity and Design.

Product Owner – Agentic AI
Ville de Québec, QC (Hybride) Temps plein

Résumé du poste
Notre équipe réalise des travaux de recherche et développement (R&D) pour répondre aux besoins du département de la Défense nationale (DND) et des Forces armées canadiennes (CAF). Les projets portent sur des solutions numériques innovantes combinant développement logiciel, intégration de systèmes, infrastructure moderne et intelligence artificielle générative.
Dans le cadre de l'accélération de nos initiatives en intelligence artificielle, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle génération d'applications basées sur l'Agentic AI. Ces solutions vont au-delà des assistants conversationnels traditionnels en permettant à des agents intelligents d'analyser des données, de raisonner, de prendre des décisions, d'orchestrer des workflows complexes et d'interagir avec plusieurs systèmes d'entreprise de manière autonome et sécurisée.
Nous recherchons un(e) Product Owner spécialisé(e) en IA générative et Agentic AI une personne spécialisée en gestion de produit (Product Owner) dans le domaine de l'IA générative et de l'Agentic AI pour rejoindre notre équipe à Québec, spécialisée dans la gestion des connaissances. Notre équipe multidisciplinaire se concentre sur la collecte, la transformation et l’enrichissement des données. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. Notre équipe utilise également des concepts d'IA et de machine learning (ML) pour accroître l’efficacité des analyses.

Fonctions essentielles
La personne titulaire du poste de Product Owner spécialisé(e) en IA pour la défense jouera un rôle clé dans la compréhension des besoins utilisateurs et opérationnels pour des sujets appliqués au domaine de la défense. La personne devra être capable d’établir une vision produit ou service adressant ces besoins afin de nourrir des équipes de développement produits axé sur des solutions en Intelligence Artificielle (IA). La personne occupant ce poste contribuera à des projets stratégiques permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, le soutien à la décision et l'automatisation de processus complexes dans des environnements où la sécurité, la fiabilité et la traçabilité sont essentielles. Cette personne devra être autonome, curieuse et à l’aise à la fois dans le domaine de la défense, du logiciel, de l’IA et de la R&D. Elle travaillera avec des clients, experts du domaine de la défense, architectes et ingénieurs logiciels, de données et IA.
Le candidat La personne occupant ce poste aura une expérience dans le milieu de la défense, soit du coté de l’industrie et/ou en uniforme.
Cette personne fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et des capacités de travail d'équipe sont obligatoires.
La personne titulaire du poste idéal est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui faciliteraient facilitent le transfert du travail effectué à tous les intervenants impliqués. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.
Responsabilités du développeur Product Owner en Agentic AI:
• Agir comme Product Owner technique entre les utilisateurs métier, les experts du domaine de la défense et les équipes de développement IA.
• Analyser les besoins opérationnels, les cas d'usage et les objectifs d'affaires afin d'identifier les opportunités de création de valeur à l'aide des technologies GenAI, Agentic AI et ML.
• Définir et maintenir la vision produit, la feuille de route (roadmap) ainsi que les priorités en fonction des objectifs stratégiques et des besoins des personnes utilisateurs.
• Travailler de façon étroite avec des ingénieurs en données et IA afin de mieux cerner un cas d’usage, un besoin et un potentiel d’application de l’IA en croisant le besoin opérationnel, la donnée et l’IA.
• Traduire les exigences métier, techniques et contractuelles en epics et user stories, puis gérer et prioriser le product backlog.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, architectes, experts IA et parties prenantes afin d'assurer la faisabilité, la cohérence et la compréhension commune des solutions.
• Contribuer à la conception et à l'évolution des solutions d'IA en participant aux décisions fonctionnelles et technologiques.
• Définir les critères d'acceptation, superviser la qualité des livrables et participer à la validation fonctionnelle des solutions.
• Assurer le suivi de la livraison, des risques, des performances du produit et communiquer l'avancement, les décisions et les orientations aux parties prenantes.

Exigences minimales
• Baccalauréat en informatique, génie, systèmes d'information ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Owner, Scrum Master technique, Team Lead, Business Analyst senior ou dans un rôle équivalent au sein d'environnements technologiques complexes.
• Expérience dans le milieu de la défense : terre, air, naval; renseignement, logistique
• Expérience démontrée dans la collecte, l'analyse et la traduction des besoins d'affaires et des exigences utilisateurs en solutions technologiques.
• Expérience dans la définition et la gestion de produits numériques, incluant la rédaction d'epics, user stories, critères d'acceptation et la priorisation d'un backlog.
• Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires incluant développeurs, architectes, experts métier et parties prenantes.
• Bonne compréhension des technologies de données, d'intelligence artificielle, d'intelligence artificielle générative (GenAI) et d'apprentissage automatique (ML).
• Capacité à analyser des processus opérationnels, définir des cas d'usage et traduire des concepts techniques complexes en valeur d'affaires.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies Agile (Scrum, Kanban ou SAFe) ainsi que des outils de gestion de produit tels que Jira.
• Excellentes aptitudes en communication, leadership d'influence et vulgarisation technique.
• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
Ce poste requiert une bonne connaissance de l'anglais pour interagir, soutenir et/ou fournir des services à des clients, employés et/ou partenaires internationaux ainsi qu’à des autorités gouvernementales étrangères qui ne parlent pas français.

Qualifications souhaitables
• Expérience pratique en développement d’applications, services ou autre solution logiciel
• Expérience avec des C2IS (système d’information de commandement et contrôle) et tout service/fonction touchant au renseignement, traitement de la donnée (ISR), planification, conscience de la situation (SA).
• Expérience dans le domaine naval (civil ou défense) au niveau maintenance et maintient en service.
• Expérience et Connaissance des technologies d’IA/ML, GenAI et Agentic AI
• Expérience dans l’analyse de données
• Expérience dans des environnements de défense, maritime, naval, industriel ou mission critique constitue un atout important.
• Curiosité intellectuelle et capacité à piloter des projets complexes dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

Exigences physiques
Ce poste peut nécessiter de l’employé(e) de mettre en place de l’équipement et de conduire des expériences sur le terrain en environnement extérieur.

Ce poste exige un accès direct ou indirect à du matériel, des logiciels, ou à des informations techniques contrôlés en vertu de la Liste canadienne des marchandises et technologies d’exportation contrôlée, du Programme canadien des marchandises contrôlées, du Programme canadien de la sécurité industrielle, de la réglementation américaine lnternational Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) ou de la réglementation américaine Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Tous les candidats doivent être éligibles ou en mesure d'obtenir une autorisation pour un tel accès, y compris l'éligibilité au Programme canadien des marchandises contrôlées et être en mesure d'obtenir une habilitation de sécurité canadienne de niveau Secret OTAN.

Thales propose un vaste programme d'avantages sociaux à tous les employés à temps plein travaillant 24 heures ou plus par semaine et à leurs personnes à charge éligibles, notamment :

• Des soins de santé complémentaires payés par l’entreprise, des soins dentaires, un compte de dépenses de santé, un programme d’assurance-vie, de Décès et mutilation accidentels, une assurance invalidité de courte durée, une assurance voyage, un régime d'aide aux employés et un programme de bien-être.
• Des régimes d'épargne-retraite (REER, RRCD, CELI) avec contribution de l'entreprise et abondement à un RRCD, sans période d'acquisition.
• Des congés payés par l'entreprise, des jours de vacances et congés de maladie payés.
• Des rabais sur les assurances habitation et automobile.

Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 24 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:

• Company paid Extended Health, Dental, HSA, Life, AD&D, Short-term Disability, travel insurance, Employee Assistance Plan and Well-Being program.
• Retirement Savings Plans (RRSP, DCPP, TFSA) with a company contribution and a match to a DCPP, with no vesting period.

Thales est un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances qui valorise la diversité et l’inclusion sur le lieu de travail. Thales s’engage à mettre en place des mesures d’adaptation tout au long du processus de recrutement. Les candidats sélectionnés pour une entrevue et ayant besoin de mesures d’adaptation sont priés de le faire savoir lors de l’invitation à l’entrevue; notre équipe travaillera volontiers avec chaque candidat pour répondre à ses besoins particuliers. Tous les renseignements relatifs aux mesures d’adaptation seront traités d’une manière confidentielle et utilisés uniquement dans le but d’offrir une expérience candidat adaptée.

Thales is an equal opportunity employer which values diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. Thales is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the interview process. Applicants selected for an interview who require accommodation are asked to advise accordingly upon the invitation for an interview. We will work with you to meet your needs. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

postings.title: Product Safety Engineer
postings.additional_locations: Crawley, West Sussex, United Kingdom; Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom
postings.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Product Safety Engineer
Bristol, Crawley or Reading - Hybrid.
Thales develop and engineer cutting edge products and technologies such as autonomous platforms (air and maritime), high performance sonar arrays, Air Traffic Management systems, electronic warfare & counter measure systems, to name a few.

We’re expanding our central safety team, which operate across highly critical development programmes and serve as a Thales UK Subject Matter Expert function. The position of Product Safety Engineer is a senior level position and will work closely alongside Safety Managers.

You'll have opportunity to work on several high value, high visibility programmes, directly supporting the UK MOD and allied Naval projects. You'll be supported by a vast network of specialist safety professionals and have access to enhanced learning, training and academic support programmes to elevate your career through our various partnerships and internal development programmes.

As a Product Safety Engineer at Thales, your day to day responsibilities will include but not be limited to:
- Developing safety plans & ensuring the implementation at project level
- Applying and leveraging your knowledge of Systems Safety Engineering to complex systems and supporting/mentoring junior Product Safety / Systems Safety Engineers
- Undertaking systems safety activities and assessments
- Ensuring that Thales products are supported by robust safety cases and evidence
- Working in multidisciplinary project/product teams to identify and manage hazards and risks
- Undertaking Systems Safety activities and assessment
- Working in multidisciplinary project/product teams to identify and manage hazards and risks
- Working across a range of activities at various stages of the systems engineering lifecycle.

What we are looking for:
- Experience of Systems Safety, Product Safety or Safety Engineering activities in defence would preferred, but we are equally open to considering experience from safety critical industries i.e. aerospace, medical, oil & gas, rail or automotive.
- Experience of preparing Safety Cases and familiar with ALARP principles and arguments
- Demonstrable experience of undertaking Systems Safety activities including System Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Event Tree Analysis (ETA), Common Cause Failure Analysis, Functional Failure Analysis (FFA), Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Interface Hazard Analysis (IHA), System Hazard Logs, System Hazard Analysis Reports
- Ability to work collaboratively in an engineering development environment, ensuring Systems Safety compliance is achieved throughout the project life cycle

Security Clearance statement
This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.
For further details of the evidence required to apply for Baseline and Security Clearance please refer to the National Security Vetting (NSV) Agency - United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

What we can offer
We’re committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.

Our packages will include bonus, a strong pension contribute plan matched up to 7%, Private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities.

#LI-CL1
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

Au sein de Customer Worldwide Services (CWS), vous intégrez une équipe dédiée à la pérennité et à la performance des produits en service. En tant que Product Support Manager, vous serez responsable de deux produits stratégiques :

- Le radar Master, système clé de surveillance et de défense aérienne.
- Un système de lutte anti-drone, solution innovante pour la protection des espaces sensibles.

Votre rôle sera à la fois opérationnel et stratégique, avec pour mission de garantir la disponibilité, la fiabilité et l’évolution de ces produits tout au long de leur cycle de vie.

Vos principales responsabilités seront de :

Piloter la performance et la pérennité des produits :
- Définir et mettre en œuvre des plans d’actions pour maintenir et améliorer la performance (traitement des raies de panne, améliorations fonctionnelles, évolutions du concept de soutien, mise à jour des documentations techniques…).
- Analyser les retours terrain (pannes, anomalies, demandes d’amélioration) pour identifier les axes de progression.

Piloter le projet soutien du produit
- Animer les Core Teams et suivre le planning des livrables pour garantir le respect des engagements.
- Établir la note de cadrage des produits en service et définir leur roadmap, en alignement avec la stratégie CWS et les besoins clients.

Traiter les questions techniques complexes :
- Piloter la résolution des problèmes techniques (hors concept de soutien), en collaboration avec l’ingénierie produit et les experts métiers.
- Capitaliser les connaissances et les retours d’expérience (RETEX) dans les bases de référence pour une maîtrise optimale des produits sur leur cycle de vie.

​Anticiper et sécuriser la pérennité des produits :
- Contribuer à la stratégie de traitement des obsolescences
- Définir et constituer un stock stratégique pour sécuriser les objectifs de disponibilité à long terme.

Votre profil

Titulaire d'un BAC+5, vous avez de l'expérience/des compétences dans:
- La gestion de produits techniques (idéalement dans les domaines radar, systèmes militaires, ou équipements critiques).
- Les enjeux de pérennité (obsolescence, gestion de stocks, contractualisation)
- Le pilotage de projets transverses (animation d’équipes, gestion de budgets, reporting).

Votre rigueur et esprit d'analyse sont des qualités que l'on vous reconnait.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Product Support Specialist
postings.description:
Location: Vancouver - Burrard St, Canada

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary
As a member of a Global Support Success team, the Product Support Specialist will be instrumental in replicating complex customer problems, diagnosing possible causations, recommending remediation techniques, and managing level 2 to 3 customer interactions.
The primary focus of this position is to assist with defining methodologies and processes that will improve the overall management of customer reported problems to the greatest degree possible.

The Product Support Specialist must be able to work under minimal supervision. This position will work closely with the global support teams, team lead, and core engineering teams to assure effective cross communication between the teams for customer issue and will attend team calls to free up the team lead to focus more on the daily management of the support staff. The Product Support Specialist will also work closely with product and program managers, customers, and third-party vendors as necessary, providing support throughout the customer issue lifecycle.

Essential Functions
- Answer customers’ questions and troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with complex technical products over the telephone or via electronic communications in the areas of system configurations/setup, product functionality and bugs/enhancements/upgrades.
- Advice customers, work to diagnose customer issues with Thales Crypto products, and interpret logs and error messages as well as interrogate and understand the customer environment where the products are being used.
- Recommend solutions and workarounds to known problems and provide advice to customers on how to apply the solution or workaround.
- Provide guidance and support on how to use Thales products with 3rd party solutions and supported integrations.
- Reproduce previously unknown issues (if need be) and interface with the Product Champion providing the customer setup and steps to reproduce the issues.
- Identify and document issues consistently and clearly using group tools.
- Support implementation of hotfixes and patches to minimize risk of unexpected issues and ensure that the fix resolves the customer problem

Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor’s or associate’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant field of study, or equivalent hands-on experience.
- Strong understanding of Linux / RHEL.
- Experience with Active Directory and LDAP-based directories.
- Ability to analyze packet captures/sniffer traces and troubleshoot routing, firewall, and connectivity issues.
- Strong networking knowledge including TCP/IP, routing protocols such as OSPF and RIP, DNS, VPNs, and firewall concepts.
- Experience with virtual environments such as VMware or equivalent technologies.
- Hands-on experience with databases including MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle, MSSQL, or PostgreSQL, with strong SQL knowledge.
- Experience supporting data security, database activity monitoring, and audit/compliance solutions.
- Knowledge of Microsoft technologies such as Exchange, SharePoint, Active Directory, and Windows Server is an advantage.
- Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Shell, or similar tools.
- Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, database, network, and infrastructure layers.
- Strong customer-facing communication skills with the ability to provide creative solutions and help customers and partners succeed. Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.
- 2 or more years of experience in a technical support, product support, or technical account management role supporting security, database, or enterprise software products.
- Prior experience supporting database security or similar monitoring and compliance platforms is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science and or another relevant field of study.
- Database skills MongoDB and PostgreSQL
- Knowledge of Public cloud platforms. Familiarity with AWS, VMware vCloud Air, Microsoft Azure, etc. is an advantage

postings.title: Product Technical Lead: Exercise and Training
postings.description:
Location: Remote UK, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Location: Ebbw Vale, Reading, Crawley, Bristol, Templecombe, and Cheadle (any Thales office)

Step into a role where your cyber expertise shapes national‑level resilience and the future of secure critical systems!

What the role has to offer
- Enterprise-wide technical influence – …

- Own the Exercise and Training technical strategy, defining the product and services SCT offer to UK customers.

- Lead architecture design of OT Range capabilities, including identity, segmentation, continuous verification, and policy-driven access.

- Define and evolve Exercise and Training products, including the classification, tagging, encryption, and attribute-based access control strategies.

- Drive inclusion of Thales wider solutions into Exercise and Training capabilities, including Thales security products and solutions.

- Develop defensible design patterns, for OT Exercising and assurance capabilities within the Ebbw Vale facility.

- Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, guiding implementation, testing, and assurance of Exercise and Training offers.

- Engage with senior stakeholders, translating complex exercise and training concepts into clear, actionable decisions.

- Shape internal standards, patterns, and governance, ensuring consistency across programmes.

- Represent the organisation externally, contributing to working groups, standards bodies, and partner ecosystems.

- Innovation leadership – driving next‑generation of exercise and training capabilities, defining and using new technologies and architecture patterns such as leveraging AI opportunities, and shaping Thales’ long‑term OT cyber, Exercise and Training strategy.

Our Opportunity
You will lead the technical direction for our Exercise and Training capability, shaping how we design, assure, deliver, and deploy Exercises for cyber resilience to Thales’ customers and OT Training capabilities operated out of the Thales UK Ebbw Vale facility. The role shall include the definition of the technologies Thales UK will implement into a Cyber Exercise product offer. In addition, the role will work closely with the technical leads in Ebbw Vale to define the product needs and architectures for OT Training as a product offering out of the Ebbw Vale office in support of our MOD customers.
This is a role for someone who can operate at architecture engineering, and governance levels simultaneously – an individual who can define the blueprint, assure the implementation, and influence the organisation.

About You
At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Essential Skills:
- Degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or a related technical field

- Proven experience acting as a Technical Authority, Design Authority, or equivalent senior engineering role

- Deep expertise in modern security engineering practices

OT & Industrial Skills:
- Strong understanding of:
- ICS/SCADA environments

- Industrial operations and processes

- PLC/DCS/SIS environments

- Industrial networking

- Remote access in OT

- OT incident response

- Industrial safety considerations

- Knowledge of:
- Purdue model

- OT resilience principles

- High-availability operations

- Critical infrastructure environments

Cyber Security Skills:
- OT threat landscape awareness.

- Knowledge of:
- MITRE ATT&CK for ICS

- Adversary behaviours

- Industrial ransomware threats

- OT detection and monitoring concepts

- Incident response coordination.

- Risk communication and cyber awareness delivery.

- OT security governance and assurance understanding.

Training & Facilitation Skills:
- Exercise facilitation and scenario management.

- Adult learning and instructional design principles.

- Development of technical training material.

- Executive briefing and communication skills.

- Workshop and stakeholder facilitation.

- Ability to simplify complex technical topics for varied audiences.

Leadership & Business Skills:
- Programme leadership.

- Cross-functional stakeholder engagement.

- Organisational change management.

- Strategic planning and roadmap development.

- Strong written and verbal communication.

- Ability to influence operational and executive stakeholders.

- Ability to design and review high-assurance architectures for regulated, mission-critical environments.

- Proven ability to lead complex technical decisions, challenge suppliers, and provide defensible recommendations.

- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and maintain a strong external network.

- A strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Desirable:
- Postgraduate degree (MSc/MEng) in Cyber Security, Systems Engineering, Industrial Automation, or a related field

- Experience in regulated environments such as defence, healthcare, policing, utilities, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure

- Professional certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, or CISM

- Motivated by contributing to a safer, more secure world through Cybersecurity & Trust

If you’re ready to lead, influence, and engineer the next generation of OT cyber security, we’d love to receive your application.

Benefits:
- Performance-related bonus

- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- 24 hours volunteering paid for

- Private healthcare

- Pension scheme

- Life cover

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

- Gym membership discounts

This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

postings.description:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Key Responsibilities
- Process Design & Optimization — Develop, validate, and optimize production processes for electronic equipment, satellite subsystems, and structural assemblies.

- Industrial Documentation — Create and maintain work instructions, manufacturing flowcharts, assembly sequences, and process sheets aligned with ECSS and TAS internal standards.

- Production Support — Provide daily technical support to operators, resolving process deviations, non-conformities, and bottlenecks.

- Continuous Improvement — Lead Lean and Six Sigma initiatives to reduce lead time, improve throughput, and enhance process stability.

- Industrial Validation — Perform capability studies, and industrial readiness reviews (IRR, MRR).

- Digitalization & Tools — Deploy digital manufacturing tools and contribute to industrial digital transformation.

- Cross-functional Collaboration — Work closely with Industrial Architect, design engineering, quality assurance, supply chain, and project teams to ensure manufacturability and industrial robustness.

- Non-Conformity Management — Analyze NCRs, lead root-cause investigations, and implement corrective/preventive actions (8D, DMAIC).

- Technology & Materials — Evaluate new materials, processes, and equipment to support innovation and competitiveness.

Required Skills & Competencies

- Manufacturing Engineering Expertise — Strong knowledge of assembly, integration, testing, and manufacturing processes for high-reliability products.

- Lean & Six Sigma — Ability to apply structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.

- ECSS Standards — Familiarity with ECSS-Q-ST-70 series (soldering, adhesives, materials, cleanliness, etc.).

- Technical Documentation — Ability to write clear, precise, and compliant industrial documentation.

- Data Analysis — Competence in statistical analysis, capability studies, and process monitoring.

- Digital Tools — Experience with MES, ERP, PLM (Windchill), and digital manufacturing platforms.

- Teamwork & Communication — Strong ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced industrial environment.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials & Processes, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) is highly valued.

postings.description:
Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) Program Manager / Directeur(trice) de Programme afin de piloter la transformation et le delivery d'un Centre de Services Agile Industrialisé pour l'un de nos grands comptes du secteur public.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable du Secteur Social, vous êtes responsable de la stratégie de delivery, de la gouvernance du programme et de l'atteinte des engagements contractuels.

Vous accompagnez la transition d'un modèle capacitaire vers un modèle industrialisé piloté par les engagements, tout en garantissant la satisfaction client, la performance économique et la montée en maturité des équipes.

Vos principales missions s'articuleront autour de 5 axes :

Direction et gouvernance
- Définir et piloter la stratégie globale du programme
- Structurer l'organisation et la gouvernance du Centre de Services
- Animer les instances de pilotage et accompagner les décisions stratégiques
- Garantir l'alignement entre les enjeux métier, IT et contractuels

Pilotage du Delivery
- Garantir la tenue des engagements de livraison
- Piloter la capacité, la qualité, la prédictibilité et la performance du dispositif
- Superviser les responsables de projets et managers opérationnels
- Sécuriser les jalons et les mises en production

Transformation et amélioration continue
- Accompagner la transformation vers un modèle industrialisé
- Déployer les standards de delivery et les bonnes pratiques SAFe
- Mettre en place les indicateurs de pilotage et les tableaux de bord exécutifs
- Piloter les plans d'amélioration continue

Pilotage économique et contractuel
- Garantir l'équilibre économique du portefeuille
- Piloter les engagements contractuels et financiers
- Identifier les risques, opportunités et leviers de performance
- Gérer les évolutions contractuelles et les avenants

Développement et relation client
- Développer une relation de confiance avec les directions clientes
- Identifier les opportunités de croissance et de transformation
- Contribuer aux réponses techniques et commerciales
- Participer au développement du secteur en lien avec les équipes commerciales

Votre profil :

Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une formation universitaire Bac+5, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en Direction de Programme, Pilotage de Centres de Services ou Management de grands projets IT dans un environnement ESN.

Vous avez piloté des dispositifs complexes en engagement forfaitaire ou en Centre de Services Agile et possédez une solide expérience dans la transformation organisationnelle/contractuelle et l'industrialisation du Delivery.

Vous maîtrisez les environnements AGILE / SAFe ainsi que les modèles de delivery basés sur la valeur métier, la prédictibilité des engagements et la gouvernance de portefeuille.

Vous disposez d'une forte culture technique vous permettant d'interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (Architecture, Développement, Business Analysis, Tests, DevOps, Scrum Masters, Product Owners).

Reconnu(e) pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer et votre vision stratégique, vous êtes capable de piloter simultanément plusieurs enjeux :

- Transformation organisationnelle et contractuelle,
- Gouvernance client,
- Pilotage financier,
- Développement commercial,
- Amélioration continue des performances.

Vous êtes orienté(e) résultats, pragmatique, doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel et aimez évoluer dans des environnements complexes à forts enjeux.

Le mot du manager :

Ce qui fera la différence, c'est votre capacité à combiner vision stratégique, excellence opérationnelle, leadership et développement business pour construire un Centre de Services Agile Industrialisé performant, prévisible et durablement orienté vers la création de valeur pour nos clients.

Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors vous avez toutes les qualités pour accompagner la transformation de nos grands programmes stratégiques.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Vous portez la responsabilité globale et êtes entouré d’une équipe multi compétences pour atteindre les objectifs de delivery.

Leadership et management : Animation d’équipes pluridisciplinaires, gestion fonctionnelle des ressources, suivi des performances et gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

Gestion de projets : Suivi rigoureux des aspects contractuels, budgétaires, de planification et de delivery (« on time delivery »).

Connaissance du marché : Expérience dans les entreprises de services numériques (ESN) et compréhension des enjeux stratégiques liés aux transformations digitales.

Culture internationale : Expérience en gestion de programmes alliant périmètres applicatifs et infrastructures, avec une production en near-shore/off-shore, et maîtrise de l’anglais.

Piloter des projets et programmes complexes, en assurant le respect des délais et des budgets.

Développer les axes stratégiques et assurer une relation client de qualité et durable.

Coordonner et piloter les équipes, garantir l’efficacité des ressources et la bonne exécution des tâches.

Assurer le suivi financier des projets, le reporting et la gestion de la performance.

VOTRE QUOTIDIEN

Au sein de l'équipe Contrôle Mécanique, vous garantissez la conformité dimensionnelle des pièces et sous-ensembles en vous appuyant sur des moyens de contrôle conventionnels et tridimensionnels.

À partir des plans et des spécifications techniques, vous définissez les méthodes de contrôle et développez les programmes de mesure adaptés aux besoins de production et de qualification. Vous réalisez la programmation et l'exploitation des machines à mesurer tridimensionnelles (MMT), notamment sur les logiciels Quindos et COSMOS.

Vous effectuez les opérations de contrôle 3D sur MMT ainsi que les contrôles dimensionnels à l'aide des moyens conventionnels de métrologie (pied à coulisse, micromètre, comparateur, jauges, colonne de mesure). Vous vérifiez la cohérence et la validité des résultats obtenus, analysez les mesures réalisées et prononcez la conformité des pièces au regard des exigences techniques.

En cas d'écart, vous identifiez les non-conformités, alertez les acteurs concernés et rédigez les fiches associées dans les outils de gestion qualité. Vous assurez également la rédaction des procès-verbaux de contrôle et leur mise à disposition dans le système de gestion documentaire.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement exigeant nécessitant le respect rigoureux des procédures qualité, des règles de métrologie et des bonnes pratiques associées au travail en zone propre et à la manipulation de composants optiques. Vous participez enfin à l'amélioration continue des méthodes et processus de contrôle afin de garantir le plus haut niveau de qualité des produits.

Titulaire d'un BTS, DUT ou d'une Licence Professionnelle en mécanique, métrologie, mesures physiques ou équivalent, vous disposez d'une expérience en contrôle dimensionnel, métrologie ou programmation de machines à mesurer tridimensionnelles,

Vous maîtrisez les principes fondamentaux de la métrologie, notamment les notions de précision, d'incertitude, de tolérances, de critères d'acceptation, de déclaration de conformité et d'échantillonnage?

Vous possédez de solides compétences en lecture de plans complexes ainsi qu'en interprétation des cotations fonctionnelles et géométriques?

Vous avez une bonne connaissance des machines à mesurer tridimensionnelles et de leur programmation ?

Des connaissances en optique géométrique ainsi qu'un bon niveau en mathématiques appliquées constituent de réels atouts pour réussir dans cette fonction.

Rigoureux(se), consciencieux(se) et méticuleux(se), vous êtes capable de suivre des processus méthodologiques stricts et de détecter toute dérive susceptible d'impacter la qualité des mesures ,

Votre sens du détail, votre habileté gestuelle et votre dextérité vous permettent d'intervenir sur des opérations de contrôle de haute précision ?

Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents services de production, méthodes et qualité?
Votre capacité à maintenir un niveau élevé de concentration et d'exigence dans un environnement technique complexe sera essentielle à votre réussite?

La maîtrise de l'anglais technique écrit est nécessaire pour comprendre et exploiter la documentation technique.

Une sensibilisation au travail en zone propre, à la manipulation de composants optiques ainsi qu'à l'utilisation de moyens de levage pour la manutention de pièces volumineuses sera appréciée.

postings.description:

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Project Buyer who is responsible for the transactional procurement process of RFX, Purchase Requisition and Purchase Order (PR/PO) lifecycle. They are required to expedite and follow-up on purchase orders to ensure delivery to support internal priorities and quality requirements are in accordance with terms and conditions issued. Drive continuous improvement of supplier performance and commodity cost. Collaborate internally with project management and senior leaders to achieve desired business outcomes. Own all aspects of part management as it relates to sourcing. Requires developed and strong foundation of function skills and knowledge of relevant purchasing and sourcing concepts. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the effective and timely execution of purchasing activities. This function shall strive to provide an uninterrupted flow of goods and/or services required by the organization.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and /or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility
Request-to-Order Fulfilment (PR to PO)
- Receive, review, and process internal purchase requisitions (PR) for project-specific goods and services in accordance with company policies and requirements.
- Transform PRs into accurate and compliant purchase orders (PO), verifying commodity codes, ship-to locations, supplier information, and relevant documentation/notes (with guidance as needed).
- Ensure PO accuracy and completeness before release (e.g., contractual/quality requirements, lead times, ordering constraints).
- Act as a point of contact for internal stakeholders to clarify PR/PO details, resolve discrepancies, and support order priorities.
- Engage weekly with internal project teams to review priorities and provide status updates on open orders.
- Lead weekly fulfilment execution activities with the broader team.
- Collect, challenge, and master PR priorities in coordination with project planning and industry requirement.

Sourcing & RFx/RFP Administration
- Support sourcing activities for project requirements, including assistance with RFx/RFP documentation and coordination.
- Administer RFx/RFP activities (e.g., issuing documents, collecting responses, and maintaininging support records).
- Support local negotiations within the delegated threshold, ensuring outcomes are reflected in PO terms and documentation.

PO Management, Expediting & Delivery Tracking
- Execute and own the fulfilment process from order creation to invoice, including end-to-end PO administration (PO creation, records maintenance, and PO acknowledgment follow-up).
- Engage with suppliers to ensure they acknowledge PO receipt and provide delivery commitment(s).
- Follow up and expedite purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery and adherence to contractual terms and quality standards.
- Monitor order/delivery progress, identify risks (e.g., delays, backorders, incomplete confirmations), and escalate as required.
- Maintain ongoing updates to internal stakeholders regarding order status, delivery commitments, and expected changes.

Supplier Coordination & Issue Resolution
- Maintain close relationships with suppliers and buyers.
- Liaise with suppliers to secure PO acknowledgment and delivery commitments, and support resolution of order discrepancies.
- Manage disputes and solve medium & high-level procurement problems; escalate significant matters to the Supply Chain Manager / Category Buyers / Category Managers or Procurement Project Managers as appropriate.
- Coordinate changes, cancellations, or amendments to POs when required.
- Report medium & high-level procurement issues to the Supply Chain Manager / Category Buyers/Managers (CB/CM).
- Maintain ethical approach to supplier and internal relationships in accordance with relevant Thales policies.

Invoice Resolution & Supplier Support (with AP/Finance)
- Support invoice resolution by following up on supplier queries, missing information, and discrepancies affecting PO/invoice matching.
- Liaise with suppliers to obtain accurate and timely invoice details as needed and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues.
- Support accounts payable follow-ups on outstanding or missing invoices, maintaining clear communication records.

Reporting, Cost/Status Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
- Prepare reports on purchases, including cost analysis to leverage and support strategic offers (with guidance as needed).
- Support KPI tracking for the role in coordination with the Supply Chain Manager.
- Monitor performance according to industry best practices and contribute to improving function performance.
- Report and track purchasing activity (e.g., open order status and basic cost/status tracking where applicable).
- Work proactively with the tactical team to enhance function performance and purchasing efficiency.

Compliance, Documentation & System Support (ERP/SAP)
- Ensure day-to-day compliance with company purchasing policies/procedures; recommend policy/procedure changes to enhance effectiveness and efficiency.
- Support activities to ensure compliance with ISO series quality accreditation and Defense regulatory requirements.
- Maintain accurate documentation and records to support audit readiness and compliance.
- Support SAP/ERP functionality improvements to improve purchasing efficiencies (e.g., implementation of improved SAP functionality and related activities).
- Maintain ethical standards in all procurement tasks and ensure alignment with Thales policies.
-Provide support in the implementation of improved SAP functionality to improve purchasing efficiencies.
- Support all aspects of the department as required, including other supply chain activities as needed.

Minimum Qualifications
- The candidate must meet one of the following criteria sets (a&b)
a) possess a university degree in any field and possess a minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 5 years; or possess a diploma from a recognized college program in procurement, finance, economics, commerce, accounting or materiel management and possess a minimum of 18 months of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 6 years; and
b) possess a minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity in the federal government, either as a civilian or military Crown employee or as a contractor personnel through extensive experience dealing with the federal government.
- Proven experience in supply chain operations, financial/accounting, order management.
- Proficiency in supply chain management or financial/accounting software experience (SAP) and MS Office Suite.

All applicants must be able to obtain a Canadian NATO Secret clearance and meet the eligibility requirements outlined in the Canadian Controlled Goods Registration Program and ITAR.

Preferred Qualifications

- Purchasing or Financial Certification and/or 5 years of applicable experience; and
- Previous experience in the Defense Industry;

Special Position Requirements

- Role will require working from both home and office (hybrid).
- Schedule: 40 working hours per week Monday- Friday. Flexible time, however, accommodating core hours of 9am-3 pm, project needs and global/international time zones.

Pay Transparency

The anticipated Total Target Compensation (TTC), inclusive of annual salary and bonus eligibility, for this role is $55,000 to 75,000 CAD Annual​. The Company reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, provincial, and federal laws.
