postings.title: Project Design Authority
postings.description:
Location: Cheadle, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Under Water Systems (UWS)
Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

Primary Purpose of the Role:
The Project Design Authority will be responsible for Solution Compliance for a Bid or Project. The PDA acts as the primary technical leader of the bid or project team and as the lead technical interface with the Customer.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks:
- Analyses Customer needs/requirements and assesses Solution architecture and technical choices.
- Ensures Solution compliance with Customer needs, Product Policy, MTB Strategy & applicable legislation, rules & regulations.
- Reviews the technical risks and opportunities and the related mitigation plans throughout the bid or project.
- Ensures best trade-off between Customer requirements & Product Policy consistent with schedule, costs, MTB strategy & risks/ opportunities.
- Checks the production and the maintenance/service aspects of the Solution with the Production Process/Technology Manager (PPTM) and the Service Engineering Manager.
- Approves the technical specification and source selection of subsystems/products to be outsourced, by taking into account Make-Team-Buy policy, export restrictions and offset requirements.
- Checks that the Engineering Environment (E2) for the Solution is consistent with Country/Company E2 Instruction, and overall Solution cost, technical risks & schedule.
- Responsible for ensuring, with the support of Specialty Engineering experts & Safety/HSE stakeholders, that the Solution design takes into account contract requirements and applicable legislation, rules & regulations, including product safety & security and Environmental/HSE requirements & standards, and that related certification activities are performed adequately and correctly.
- Approves the Design & Justification File (D&JF) prepared by the Solution Architect (ARC).
- Approves the completion of integration, verification, validation and qualification results.
- Performs the Complexity Profiler analysis with the Solution Architect (ARC) & SEM. Take into account the resulting actions during the bid or project.
- Alerts first the DA & then upward within CBU/Domain, Country, BL or GBU Technical Directorate.
- Leads the main bid/project Engineering Reviews and approves the main Engineering deliverables at each project decision milestone.
- Organises when appropriate technical meetings and peer reviews together with the SEM (System Engineering Manager) and other technical stakeholders and experts, in order to perform the Solution technical assessment and validation.
- Sound understanding of the development lifecycle and lifecycle products.
- Interfacing with the client (internal/external), to define the solution.
- Keep abreast of technical development both within and outside of the company.

Skills
- Good technical writing skills and good interpersonal communication skills.
- Leadership skills – with natural ability to build and sustain good working relationships at all levels.
- First class presentation skills.
- Ability to effectively manage relationships across the business and achieve outcomes beneficial to both own team and the broader business.
- On-budget, on-time delivery, whilst maximising margin and delighting the customer.
- Effective personal organisation and an ability to remain composed and focused under pressure.

Experience:
- Technical prowess in one or more of the technological disciplines relevant to the company, e.g. Sonar Systems, Processing, Outboard Hardware etc, and/or in one or more of understanding of business case generation, resource planning, and budgetary control.
- Experience in the developmental lifecycle disciplines, e.g. Requirements Capture, Modelling & Analysis, System Design, Product Development, and IV&V.
- Experienced and knowledgeable of whole systems engineering lifecycles for complex systems.
- Proven technical/project experience in critical control systems engineering

Values & Behaviours:
- Innovate – Be motivated to search for novel and unique design solutions.
- Team working – Maximise the use of the wider Thales community to produce winning solutions.
- Develop people – Be prepared to share your ideas and experience with the wider Thales engineering community.
- Focus on customers – Be driven to deliver quality solutions to clients.
- Safety – Totally embrace the Thales safety culture to provide a safe and healthy working environment for all.
- Ethics - Thales employees must be exemplary in their ethical conduct and social responsibility.
- Job holders will be expected to perform in line with the Thales Code of Practice, Policies and Procedures.

Desirable Qualifications and Certification:
- HND/Degree in a relevant subject or equivalent.

UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Location: Templecombe or Cheadle (Hybrid options available)
Travel: 25% (UK-wide)

The Mission:
In this pivotal role, you sit at the heart of the "Golden Triangle"—partnering with the Solution Architect and the Engineering Delivery Manager to turn customer needs into reality.

Key Objectives:
- Technical Governance: Act as the "technical conscience" for the project, providing final approval on the Design & Justification File (D&JF).

- Customer Leadership: Serve as the lead technical voice in front of the Customer, translating complex requirements into actionable engineering strategies.

- Total Compliance: Ensure our solutions meet rigorous contract requirements, export restrictions, and safety/environmental legislation.

- Risk & Strategy: Navigate "Make vs. Buy" decisions and mitigate technical risks throughout the bid and project lifecycle.

- Verification: Sign off on the final integration, verification, and validation (IV&V) of complex systems.

About You:
You are an experienced engineer who has moved beyond "doing" and into the realm of authorizing and influencing. You thrive in high-stakes environments where your decisions have a direct impact on national security.

Your DNA:
- Technical Depth: Significant expertise in Sonar Systems, Signal Processing, or Hardware, with a deep understanding of the full systems engineering lifecycle.

- Natural Authority: A proven track record as a PDA or Lead Engineer on large-scale, complex defense projects.

- Strategic Thinker: You don’t just solve the problem; you consider the business case, the supportability, and the long-term footprint.

- Communicator: You can command a room of experts or simplify complex technical hurdles for stakeholders with ease.

Why Join Thales?
At Thales, we design the systems that the world relies on to stay safe. You will be joining a close-knit, friendly team that values hard work and professional growth. We offer:
- Autonomy: The power to lead and define technical solutions.

- Impact: See your work deployed in the most challenging environments on Earth—the deep ocean.

- Flexibility: A culture that respects work-life balance while delivering on critical national milestones.

Benefits:
- Performance-related bonus

- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- 24 hours volunteering paid for

- Private healthcare

- Pension scheme

- Life cover

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

postings.title: Project Manager
postings.description:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Project Manager to lead complex space programs from proposal and contract award through to project delivery and customer acceptance.
In this role, you will manage projects across our space portfolio, including RF equipment for telecommunications satellites, satellite communication and control units, digital onboard processing solutions, ground segment systems, spacecraft control platforms, and associated test equipment.
As a key contributor to business success, you will drive project execution while balancing customer expectations, technical requirements, cost, quality, schedule, and risk. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and senior leadership in an international environment.
This position requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex technical challenges in a highly specialized and fast-evolving space industry.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end project execution, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
- Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, resource allocation, and performance indicators.
- Monitor project progress and proactively adapt plans to address emerging challenges and changing priorities.
- Manage customer relationships and act as the primary interface for project-related communications.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, and support functions.
- Identify, assess, and manage project risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
- Define and implement mitigation and contingency plans to minimize project exposure.
- Ensure effective governance through regular reporting, project reviews, and executive presentations.
- Oversee contractual commitments and ensure compliance with customer requirements.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project execution methodologies and operational efficiency.
- Promote collaboration, accountability, and high team engagement within the project organization.
- Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation, tender reviews, cost estimations, and bid management support.
- Utilize project management best practices, tools, and digital solutions to improve visibility and decision-making.
-
Required Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience managing complex technical or engineering projects.
- Previous experience in the space, aerospace, defense, telecommunications, or other high-technology sectors is highly valued.
- Proven experience managing cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
- Solid understanding of project management methodologies
- Experience managing customer-facing projects and contractual commitments.
-
Preferred Certifications
- PMP (Project Management Professional)
- IPMA Certification

Key Competencies
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
- Strategic mindset with strong business acumen.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- Risk management and problem-solving skills.
- Negotiation and conflict resolution abilities.
- Financial awareness, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
- Decision-making based on data and project performance metrics.
- Resilience and adaptability under pressure.
- Attention to detail while maintaining a broad project perspective.

Languages
- Fluent English (mandatory).
- Additional European languages are considered an asset.
-
What We Offer

Your role

Core duties will include:
- Acting as the primary interface between internal stakeholders, customers and procurement teams for the Regional Maintenance Program East (RMPE). To build strong, on-the-ground relationships with the business to facilitate problem-solving and to ensure timely procurement actions

- Supporting in the management of the suppliers relevant to RMPE, coordinating regular reviews, driving continuous improvement initiatives and addressing any supplier performance issues in a proactive manner

Key Responsibilities:
- Ensure that the services and products delivered to the customers meet the requirements,
- Ensure space standards, applicable rules and internal Quality requirements, for SW/HW Projects, and act as a point of contact for the quality authority designated by the customer.
- Analyze the customer’s Quality requirements, define and set up the Quality plans in the project phase, and ensure the plan contains all the measures necessary to fulfill the standards and reference system.
- Follow TAS Quality Management System (QMS) rules Chorus 2 for all processes as well as tools and methodologies within TAS in Spain.
- Comply with Quality Plan, schedule, budgets and specifications for all appointed projects and tasks.
- Manage and contribute to project reviews (KO, EQSR, PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR, TRB, DRB), ensuring that they are carried out according to a consistent and coherent documentation.

- Coordinate and supervise the activities of Non Conformance Review Boards (NRB) in case of deviations or non-compliance with any product specification.

postings.title: Proposal Technical Manager
Propulsion Industrialisation Expert
postings.description:
Location: Oxford, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Due to the growth of our Propulsion Centre of Excellence at our Harwell site, we’re making new hires into our propulsion systems team. This is an excellent time to join if you have propulsion industrial experience and want to play a key role in ensuring industrial readiness for flight production, with a particular focus on building robust test and production means from the earliest stages of design development.

Governments and private industry rely on us to create satellite‑based systems that provide trusted, anytime‑anywhere connectivity and positioning—helping care for our planet, manage its resources thoughtfully, and explore our Solar System with curiosity and purpose. We view space as a new horizon for collective progress, shaping a more sustainable life on Earth. As a joint venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space partners with Telespazio through the Space Alliance to deliver a full suite of integrated solutions and services.

The role:
Reporting to the Head of Discipline - Propulsion Systems, the Propulsion Industrialisation Expert will be responsible for a wide range of propulsion subsystem and equipment activities across EP and/or CP technologies during Phases A to E for recurring TAS satellite product line application programmes and developments .This role will play a key part in ensuring industrial readiness for flight production, with a strong focus on early industrial preparation, build and test means, and manufacturing readiness.

Key Responsibilities:
- Interpret mission-specific, customer-specific, and generic system-level requirements, and establish the baseline Technical Requirements Document (TRD) for the propulsion subsystem.

- Act as the primary technical point of contact for the propulsion subsystem, covering both MAIT and architecture aspects, including procured propulsion equipment.

- Interface with customer technical teams, PMO, AIT, procurement, and other subsystem experts such as Mechanical, Thermal, and AOCS.

- Lead propulsion subsystem industrialisation activities, ensuring build and test requirements are considered from the earliest stages of design development.

- Work with suppliers of new equipment developments to ensure recurring delivery in line with programme needs.

- Collaborate with the propulsion AIT facility in Belfast, as well as AIT teams and suppliers, to ensure capability and capacity are in place to meet the required production rate.

- Ensure industrial means are planned, developed, and de-risked ahead of need, including MRR/TRR activities and GSE.

- Act as the bridge between TAS Industrialisation Teams and propulsion project teams, supporting production, test requirements, and DfM topics.

- Provide technical oversight of production process development and verification, including anomaly investigations.

- Oversee production control, planning, and materials management activities.

- Manage supplier development teams, including engineering support to procurement and industrial audit assessments.

- Drive resolution of supplier issues and ensure robust corrective actions are implemented.

- Maintain strong knowledge of equipment across both CP and EP technologies.

Required Experience:
- Strong MAIT experience.

- Strong understanding of industrialisation and IVVQ principles.

- Proven experience in propulsion or related technical industrialisation roles.

- Demonstrated ability to manage suppliers and support procurement activities.

- Strong background in resolving technical and delivery issues with suppliers.

- Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Benefits:
- Performance-related bonus

- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- 24 hours volunteering paid for

- Private healthcare

- Pension scheme

- Life cover

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

- Gym membership discounts

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.description:
Location: DITZINGEN SRA OME, Germany

We Say HI*

Prüfmittelentwickler / EoL- Test Bench Engineer (w/m/d) Am Standort Ditzingen #LI-HYBRID (Ref. Nr. R0313731)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

In Ditzingen erwarten Sie Sicherheitslösungen zur Überwachung und Absicherung von Grenzen sowie für Grenzkontrollen, für den Schutz ziviler und militärischer Einrichtungen sowie für die taktische Kommunikation. Hier sind Sie richtig, wenn Sie gemeinsam mit uns an praxisbewährten, hochmobilen Radaren zur Boden- und Küstenüberwachung oder an Nachtsichtbrillen und multi-funktionalen Wärmebildgeräten arbeiten wollen. Werden Sie Teil des Thales-Expertenteams für Radare, optronische Sichtsysteme für gepanzerte, militärische Fahrzeuge oder für die Absicherung von Feldlagern der Bundeswehr. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

Ihre Mission:
- Entwicklung von und Soft- und Hardware für Prüfsysteme (digitale, analoge und HF-Schaltungstechnik)

- Sie erarbeiten Prüfkonzepte für die Serienprüfung von Produkten und Systemen

- Sie erstellen und aktualisieren Prüfdokumentationen

- Sie klären technische Probleme an End-of-Line-Serienprüfplätzen

- Vorbereitung von Entscheidungen zur Beschaffung von Soft- und Hardware für die Prüfung von Produkten

- Unterstützung der Fertigung bei der Lösung technischer Probleme

- Sie unterstützen bei der Implementierung von Industrie 4.0 und Lean Management Initiativen

Darauf freuen wir uns:
- Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Sie verfügen über mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld

- Sie bringen Erfahrung mit NI LabView oder Python mit

- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Hochfrequenz und Radartechnik von Vorteil

- Strong in analytical and critical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, interpret data and turn insights into meaningful recommendations.

- Proactive and forward-thinking, anticipating challenges and opportunities whilst developing practical solutions to prevent issues before they arise and therefore a culture of continuous improvement.

- An engaging communicator who can influence, inspire and build trusted partnerships across a variety of stakeholders.

- Curious, adaptable and open-minded, with a willingness to learn, embrace change and continuously develop.

- Confident facilitating discussions and bringing people together to achieve shared goals.

- Adaptable, resilient and flexible, able to navigate changing priorities whilst maintaining momentum and focus.

- A collaborative team player with high levels of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

- Well-organised, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.

- A creative problem-solver who can make well-informed decisions and approach challenges with confidence.

- Able to balance day-to-day requirements with a broader strategic perspective.

- Committed to acting with integrity and upholding the Thales Ethics Policy.

Why Join Thales?

Quality Assurance Managers at Thales play a critical role in supporting programme delivery, representing the voice of the customer and driving a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
You'll work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers and business leaders, helping to ensure that quality remains at the heart of decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

What the Role Has to Offer
- Highly visible role with exposure across all areas of the business.

- Opportunity to act as the voice of the customer within bids and projects.

- Varied and rewarding work where no two days are the same.

- Hybrid working, with 3 days per week on-site.

- Funded CQI membership.

- Support for professional development and formal quality training, including Lead Auditor certification where appropriate.

What Will Your Day Look Like?

Reporting to the Quality Manager, you'll be responsible for:
- Acting as the customer's representative within project and bid teams to maximise customer satisfaction.

- Monitoring, analysing and reporting quality performance to support successful project delivery.

- Encouraging and developing best practice across programmes and functions.

- Identifying risks, opportunities and areas for continuous improvement.

- Planning and conducting project audits and surveillance activities in line with Project Quality Plans and audit strategies.

- Promoting a positive quality culture throughout the business.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

We're interested in individuals who can demonstrate the behaviours above and who also bring some of the following experience:

Essential
- Experience working within a quality assurance, regulated, or continuous improvement environment.

- Sound knowledge of current quality standards, practices, and methodologies.

- Understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and certification requirements.

Desirable
- Quality assurance experience within project, design, engineering, or manufacturing environments.

- Proven experience collaborating across multi-functional teams to drive quality improvements.

- Qualified auditor status or equivalent auditing experience.

Security Clearance

This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

postings.legal_entity: THALES DIS TECHNOLOGY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
postings.description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Job Summary
As a Quality Engineer Technical Lead, you will be expected to lead the quality engineering strategy for the team with strong ownership of automation, performance validation, test reliability, and production-quality observability. You will drive and maintain the Automation Suite framework used across the team, define scalable automation practices, strengthen regression and integration coverage, and ensure that quality gates are embedded effectively across delivery pipelines. The role requires strong hands-on exposure to performance testing, troubleshooting distributed applications in Kubernetes environments, and using observability tools such as Datadog and logging frameworks to diagnose issues, improve system reliability, and support faster root-cause analysis. Along with individual contribution, you will mentor engineers, guide test design, improve engineering productivity, support customer escalations, and continuously enhance the overall quality posture of the product.
Job Requirement and Responsibilities
- The Quality Engineer Technical Lead will be responsible for leading the quality engineering charter for the team, including automation strategy, test framework ownership, performance validation, release quality, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
- Own, maintain, and evolve the Automation Suite framework used by the whole team, ensuring that it is scalable, reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to extend across functional, regression, integration, and API test scenarios.
- Define automation best practices, coding standards, reusable utilities, test data strategies, reporting mechanisms, and execution patterns that improve team productivity and reduce manual validation effort.
- Build and strengthen a robust suite of performance tests covering key product workflows, scalability scenarios, load profiles, reliability checks, and performance regression detection.
- Work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to embed quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and ensure that automation, regression, and performance feedback is available early in the delivery lifecycle.
- Provide strong troubleshooting support for issues observed in Kubernetes-based deployments, including pod failures, service connectivity, resource constraints, configuration issues, and environment-related problems.
- Use observability platforms such as Datadog, application logs, metrics, dashboards, traces, and logging frameworks to perform root-cause analysis and support faster resolution of production and pre-production issues.
- Mentor quality engineers and developers on automation design, testability, performance analysis, defect investigation, and engineering practices that improve overall product quality.
- Support customer escalations by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and telemetry, validating fixes, and ensuring relevant automated coverage is added to prevent recurrence.
- Drive continuous improvements in automation reliability, execution speed, test coverage, performance benchmarking, observability, and quality engineering processes.

Job Knowledge, Skill and Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 7+ years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, performance testing, and technical leadership.
- Strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, maintaining, and scaling automation frameworks for API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end test coverage.
- Proven ability to lead an Automation Suite framework for a team or program, including framework architecture, reusable components, test orchestration, reporting, maintainability, and adoption by multiple engineers.
- Good programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language used for automation development, test utilities, scripting, and framework enhancements.
- Strong experience with performance testing tools and practices, including load testing, scalability testing, baseline creation, bottleneck identification, trend analysis, and performance regression validation.
- Good troubleshooting exposure in Kubernetes-based environments, including deployments, pods, services, ingress, configuration, resource utilization, logs, and common runtime issues.
- Hands-on exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, with the ability to analyze dashboards, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health indicators.
- Strong understanding of logging frameworks and log analysis practices to support debugging, defect triaging, root-cause analysis, and production issue investigation.
- Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensuring automated quality gates are reliable, actionable, and aligned with release expectations.
- Exposure to cloud-native applications, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed system behavior will be an important factor.
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect automation failures, performance trends, logs, metrics, and deployment behavior to identify issues quickly and accurately.
- Ability to mentor team members, review automation code, improve test design, promote quality ownership, and collaborate effectively with engineering, DevOps, and product stakeholders.

Location: Reading, Crawley, Bristol, Templecombe and Belfast (any Thales office)

Lead the capture of next-generation radar solutions and play a key role in shaping the future of UK air defence.

What the role has to offer

- Shape the Future of UK Radar Capability - influence and secure major Radar programmes that support national defence, security and critical infrastructure. Drive the adoption of next-generation technologies and help define future capability roadmaps

- High-Impact, High-Visibility Role - work at the heart of strategic customer engagement, leading complex capture activities and partnering with senior decision-makers across UK Government, the MoD and industry

- Cutting-Edge Radar Innovation - join a global technology leader and collaborate with world-class engineering teams delivering advanced Radar solutions across land, naval and integrated air defence domains

Our Opportunity

Reporting to the Sales Director (AOW), you will be responsible for driving order intake growth, maximising GMOI and strengthening customer satisfaction across the UK market. You will identify, qualify and mature strategic opportunities, undertake detailed customer mapping using the Blue Sheet methodology (or equivalent), and develop winning capture plans that engage key stakeholders within complex customer organisations.

As Capture Leader, you will define and execute long-term capture strategies, align cross-functional teams and lead opportunities from early shaping activity through to contract award. Your primary focus will be on air defence and air surveillance radar solutions across both land and naval domains, supporting some of the UK's most critical defence programmes.

To succeed in this role, you will bring a strong track record of leading multinational capture or campaign teams and securing complex technology opportunities within UK Government, the MoD, policing or critical national infrastructure sectors. You will combine radar domain expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement, negotiation and proposal development skills, and be comfortable operating within challenging, high-profile environments. A proactive mindset, collaborative approach and ability to obtain and maintain security clearance are essential.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Focus on customers and Innovation are two key values at Thales, and they are at the heart of our Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams globally. Digital technologies that play a crucial role in our future, such as AI, Quantum, 6G, Cybersecurity and Neuroscience, account for nearly half of our innovations. Joining Thales means being part of a community driven by passion and the determination to go the extra mile for our customers, to make the world a better place.

IAS sits at the centre of armed forces operational priorities and is a major growth area for Thales. Its mission is to ensure national airspace sovereignty and to support the Armed Forces in protecting populations and critical infrastructure from all forms of aerial threat. The portfolio is built around three core product lines: national-level airspace security solutions using advanced radars and command-and-control systems; medium-range weapon systems that protect regional airspace against diverse threats; and short-range weapon systems that deliver close-in, tactical-level air defence over a few kilometres.

What We Offer You

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing and professional growth, which includes:

- Performance-related bonus

- Car cash allowance

- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- 24 hours volunteering paid for

- Private healthcare

- Pension scheme

- Life cover

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

- Gym membership discounts

Main Responsibilities

- Lead the UK Radar growth strategy, identifying, qualifying and securing new business opportunities across defence, security and critical national infrastructure markets while building a sustainable opportunity pipeline

- Own strategic capture and bid activities from opportunity shaping through to contract award, leading customer engagements, tender responses, solution demonstrations, negotiations and winning proposals

- Develop and maintain influential customer relationships with key stakeholders across Government, the MoD, industry partners and wider defence ecosystems to strengthen Thales' market position

- Drive market intelligence and future capability development, leveraging customer insight, competitor analysis and emerging threat trends to influence strategy, product development and technology roadmaps

- Champion cross-functional collaboration and governance, working closely with engineering, commercial, bid, marketing and programme teams to deliver customer-focused solutions while ensuring full regulatory, export control and cybersecurity compliance

About You

At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world's most critical challenges.

Essential Experience & Skills

- Proven success in sales, business development or capture leadership within the defence, security or advanced technology sectors, including the delivery of complex solutions to UK Government, MoD, policing or critical national infrastructure customers

- Strong understanding of Radar systems and air defence capabilities, with the ability to translate technical solutions into compelling customer value propositions across land and naval domains

- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with a track record of building trusted relationships, leading negotiations and creating winning proposals

- Demonstrated leadership and resilience in complex environments, including experience leading multinational capture teams, managing high-value campaigns and engaging senior decision-makers

- Self-driven and collaborative approach, with the ability to operate effectively in matrix organisations, embody Lead@Thales behaviours (Think Big, Make it Happen, Together) and obtain and maintain the required security clearance

If you're ready to influence the future of UK air defence and take on a high-profile role with real strategic impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Security Clearance Statement

This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for Baseline and Security Clearance please refer to the National Security Vetting (NSV) Agency - United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

postings.title: RAMS Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Within the RAMS service of the Quality Engineering, the activities are carried out under the primary responsibility of the head of service and consist to:
- Provide Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety (RAMS) engineering expertise and analysis in the development and implementation of Space products.
- Develop, maintain and implement a Dependability (RAM) & Safety programme plan for all project phases addressing the RAMS requirements applicable to the project.
- Perform RAMS design, analysis, modeling and simulation to specify and verify that the Space products developed at Thales Alenia Space to meet the customer requirements during the whole operational lifetime.
- Represent RAMS in technical meetings involving RAMS-related issues. Participate in, influence and approve design decisions impacting or potentially impacting RAMS.
- Attend the Program Design reviews for their respective Product and/or Project areas and provide evaluations & recommendations (RIDs).
- Review the RAMS Analyses performed by subcontractors.
- Identify with adequate anticipation risks and opportunities and propose mitigation actions.
- Prepare subsystem & equipment RAMS requirements for relative specifications, interface requirements and test requirements by analysing and decomposing customer requirements.
- Perform trade off evaluations in conjunction with other attributes such as mass, size, cost and performance to identify the product RAMS engineering design choices with associated advantages and disadvantages.
- Evaluate the compliance of designs with RAMS engineering requirements by review of technical specifications, designs & designs changes for both HW and SW, and suggests design alternatives where appropriate to enhance reliability based on a knowledge of design feasibility & the RAMS requirements.
- Support the rationale for the selection of the design solution and the demonstration that the design meets the RAMS requirements by performing:
- Failure Modes Effects Analysis (FMEA) with identification of Single Point Failure
- Fault Tree Analysis (FTA),
- Hardware Software Interaction Analysis
- Failure Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) analysis
- Availability/Outage Analysis
- Maintainability Activities
- Hazard Analysis
- Ensure that RAMS can be verified. Review of test documentation.
- Report directly to the RAMS Manager RAMS and work closely with other team members, both inside the RAMS team and from other functional teams, to meet the project objectives.

Business Context:
- To assure the RAMS of products is maintained.
- To provide “RAM designs” which meet specifications and budgets.
- To ensure that Product Design meets the customer requirements.
- To develop new and creative methods for analyzing equipment designs and problem-solving in order to identify effective design solutions to meet operational and dependability objectives.
- To work with others as a team member and to enhance the image of RAMS Engineering within the company and with our customers.
- To maintain high personal productivity while working interactively with many other suppliers and user groups.
- To keep up to date on new analysis techniques.
- To respect project deadlines.

Competences:
- Experience on projects in the context of Safety & RAM assurance.
- Knowledge of design engineering in particular electronic design,
- Competence on RAMS Analysis methods.

A five-years experience in RAMS engineering is preferred

What do we offer?

- Flexible schedule, from 8 to 9.30 and 16.30 until 18h.
- Thales Concilia: a set of advantages and free services and others at reduced prices.
- Free and healthy canteen.
- Enjoy discounts and special promotions on products and services thanks to Club Ahorro.
- 22 working days of vacation, 6 days of free disposal and closing days that do not consume vacations at Christmas and Easter.
- Thales Flex: Personalized flexible compensation plan in which you can choose how to distribute your salary (health insurance, childcare vouchers, transportation and training).
- Annual bonus.
- Fixed profit bonus of 739,76€.
- Sharing Thales program: become a Thales shareholder.
- Hybrid work plan.
- Pension Plan with monthly contributions on your behalf to your Pension Plan.
- Wellness Plan: thematic webinars and access to our company clubs.
- Medical and physiotherapy service at the workplace.
- We continuously create an inclusive, respectful and cooperative environment.

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now!

postings.description:

- la pratique d'un outil déclaratif douanier (CONEX, EASYLOG) Avec une expérience d'au moins 5 ans, vous avez envie de découvrir ce métier dans un environnement complexe, stimulant et passionnant ?

La curiosité et l'envie d'apprendre sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

When you rely on airlines to connect you in flight, you rely on Thales. In an increasingly fast paced world, we make the unpredictable, predictable by connecting and entertain passengers to make your life better. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to passengers and airlines. Whatever it takes.

Regional Category Manager - Real Estate and Building Services
Orlando- Hybrid

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

Position Summary
The Regional Category Manager will primarily support the Americas Real Estate and Building Services Category. The position will represent the Procurement Organization both globally and for the Americas Region and shall be responsible for the effective creation and implementation of all the category’s strategic direction and management of the category within the scope of their responsibility (primarily supporting the Real Estate category strategy in managing Thales architectural, general contractors, engineers, building services and office furniture purchases for CAPEX projects, and supplier relationship management). This role will be responsible for developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, as well as identifying and mitigating supply chain risk.

Key Areas of Responsibility
As Category Manager, and in full alignment with the Segment Director, the individual in this role will be responsible for managing their category, bringing procurement acumen, support and influence strategies that drive product and service innovation.

They are responsible for providing the best procurement solutions (quality, price and timing), meeting customer needs and aligning with the relevant Procurement Strategies as lead by the Segment Director and the Global Category Managers , ensuring full compliance with all Thales policies and procedures in a hands on, fast paced environment.

- Ensure the relevant players have a good knowledge of Thales need and support the category strategy so that the business secures targeted projects and customer competitive advantage.

- Ensure that Category, Procurement and Stakeholder Team members adhere to the Thales Group Purchasing policies

- Ensure that clear and measurable savings targets are identified and delivered by category and endorsed by business / project.

- Monitor category markets on an on-going basis to identify and understand key players, newcomers, economic evolutions, market or regulation constraints, innovations and technology in order to support the development of the most up to date category strategies for the businesses.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, procurement or comparable field of study with at least 8 years of relevant work experience in procurement or Master’s degree in procurement or business administration or comparable field of study with at least 6 years of relevant work experience in procurement

- Prior experience developing strategy for a complex procurement organization

- Understanding Construction and / or real estate pricing structure as well as supplier risk assessments and mitigating planning

- Prior experience with construction contracts (AIA, CCDC, etc.) or related, complex contracts

- Ability to create and deploy category strategy to secure short and long term vision of a commodity/ies applying procurement expertise to aid in meeting the same

- Prior advanced level experience in Microsoft Office Products (PowerPoint presentations to executives, Excel Macros and VLOOKUP etc.)

The ideal candidate, if possible, would already have direct experience supporting the Real Estate category strategy in managing architectural, general contractors, engineers, building services for CAPEX projects, and supplier relationship management

postings.title: Regional Cyber Security Presales and Solution Architect
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

JOB OBJECTIVE
Thales DIS delivers cutting edge cybersecurity solutions to regional clients, with a strong focus on protecting critical infrastructure and mission critical environments. As part of our strategic growth to expand regional operations and leverage global expertise, we are seeking a Cybersecurity Sales Manager to drive business development, solution positioning, and revenue growth across the IT and OT cybersecurity portfolio.

The successful candidate will be a commercially driven cybersecurity professional with a strong understanding of complex security technologies and the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling value propositions. They will lead customer engagement across key sectors, develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and work closely with engineering, delivery, and partner teams to shape end to end cybersecurity solutions aligned with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and international standards.

This role is expected to support the full sales lifecycle, from opportunity identification and solution shaping through technical sales leadership and contract closure. It offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the protection of critical infrastructure, support the modernisation of legacy environments, and enable the delivery of resilient, high assurance cybersecurity solutions in some of the most demanding operational contexts across the region.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
- Lead regional business development activities for cybersecurity services across IT and OT environments, with a particular focus on critical infrastructure, government, and regulated industries.

- Support the full sales lifecycle, including pipeline development, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiations and contract closure.

- Lead and manage technology partner management, solution architecture, solution security design, interoperability between system of systems.

- Support sales managers in maintaining a healthy sales pipeline at minimum 3x coverage of quarterly revenue targets, continuously prospecting and developing opportunities to ensure sustainable revenue growth.

- Engage local and regional internal stakeholders from adjacent business units and business lines to generate opportunities.

- Engage senior customer stakeholders (C-suite, CIO, CISO, CTO, and operational leadership) to understand business drivers, risk profiles, and regulatory obligations, positioning Thales DIS cybersecurity offerings as trusted, high assurance solutions.

- Translate complex cybersecurity technologies and architectures into clear, value-driven propositions that address customer risk, resilience, and compliance requirements.

- Work closely with consulting, engineering, solution architects, and delivery teams to develop technically sound, compliant, and commercially viable proposals aligned with customer needs and international standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, IEC 62443).

- Support and coordinate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and tenders, ensuring high-quality technical, commercial, and governance inputs that meet customer and regulatory expectations.

- Support the development and maintenance on strategic account plans for key customers, identifying upsell, cross-sell, and long-term partnership opportunities.

- Establish and manage relationships with technology partners, system integrators, and internal stakeholders to strengthen go-to-market execution and solution differentiation.

- Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and evolving cyber threats to inform sales strategy, product positioning, and customer engagement approaches.

- Support contract handover and transition to delivery teams, ensuring clear scope definition, risk management, and alignment between commercial commitments and delivery outcomes.

- Contribute to regional growth strategy, forecasting, and reporting, providing accurate pipeline visibility, revenue projections, and forecast updates to senior management with disciplined CRM hygiene and opportunity tracking.

- Ensure all sales activities comply with internal governance, export control, security, and ethical requirements applicable to high assurance and critical infrastructure environments.

WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
- Minimum of 10–15 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, or technology solutions, with at least 5 years in a sales, business development, or pre sales leadership role.

- Demonstrated track record of successfully selling complex cybersecurity solutions (products, systems integration, and/or managed services) into enterprise, government, defence, or critical infrastructure sectors.

- Proven experience managing the full enterprise sales lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, bid/tender management, commercial negotiation, and contract closure.

- Hands on experience responding to RFPs, RFIs, and formal tenders, particularly within highly regulated procurement environments.

- Strong exposure to IT and OT cybersecurity domains, including network security, identity and access management, endpoint security, encryption, security monitoring, and industrial control system (ICS/SCADA) security.

- Experience engaging with senior customer stakeholders (“C” level and executive leadership) and influencing decision making at both technical and business levels.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with engineering, solution architecture, and delivery teams to develop compliant, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions.

- Experience working with international standards and regulatory frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, IEC 62443, and sector specific regulations applicable to critical infrastructure.

- Proven experience managing strategic accounts, building long term customer relationships, and driving account expansion through upsell and cross sell initiatives.

- Experience operating in matrixed, multinational organisations, with exposure to regional or global sales structures and collaboration across multiple geographies.

- Prior experience with technology partners, system integrators, or alliance led sales models is strongly preferred.

- Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.

QUALIFICATION, CERTIFICATION & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS

Required
Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Professional Knowledge & Skills
- Strong foundational understanding of cybersecurity concepts, architectures, and risk management principles across enterprise IT environments.

- Working knowledge of international cybersecurity standards and frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and related best practices.

- Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non technical and executive stakeholders.

Governance & Compliance
- Awareness of local and international regulatory, compliance, governance requirements and industrial best practices applicable to critical infrastructure and regulated industries.

- Ability to operate within high assurance, security sensitive environments, adhering to internal governance, ethics, and compliance obligations.

Preferred
Advanced Education
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering Management, or Business Administration (MBA).

Cybersecurity Certifications
- Industry recognised cybersecurity certifications, including:
- CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

- CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

- CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)

- GIAC certifications (e.g. GSEC, GICSP)

OT & Critical Infrastructure Security
- Certifications or formal training in industrial and OT security, such as:
- IEC 62443 cybersecurity certifications

- GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional)

Sales & Commercial Certifications
- Certification or formal training in enterprise or complex sales methodologies, such as:
- Miller Heiman / Strategic Selling

- SPIN Selling

Vendor & Technology Exposure
- Vendor neutral or vendor aligned certifications in network security, IAM, encryption, SOC, or OT security platforms.

- Experience or eligibility to obtain security clearance, where required.

- Demonstrated commitment to continuous professional development in cybersecurity and enterprise sales disciplines.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Research and Development Engineer – CEMA
Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.
We are looking for a Research and Development Engineer – CEMA join our highly experienced research team within Thales Research & Technology (TRT). This is an exciting opportunity to develop rapid proof-of-concept demonstrators, explore emerging technologies and contribute to innovative research projects that support future defence and security capabilities. Working within a collaborative team of experienced researchers, you'll have the freedom to be creative, experiment with new ideas and help shape technologies from concept through to prototype.

About Thales Research & Technology
The Thales Research & Technology (TRT) function sits at the heart of Thales UK's innovation capability, supporting growth across our key market sectors and exploring future technologies and opportunities. Our teams undertake cutting-edge research and development activities, helping shape the next generation of solutions across defence, aerospace, security and digital technologies.
Working across a variety of cutting-edge projects, you'll combine hands-on software development with research, rapid prototyping and technology exploration. No two projects are the same, offering exposure to a diverse range of technical challenges and emerging technologies. If you're motivated by solving complex engineering problems, learning from experienced research engineers, and seeing your ideas shape future defence and security solutions, this role offers an exceptional environment to develop your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

Main Responsibilities
- Invent and explore new concepts and technologies, and demonstrate their applicability to Thales and future defence and security capabilities.
- Identify opportunities to build on and expand existing capabilities to address new and emerging technical challenges.
- Develop proof-of-concept demonstrators to explore, evaluate and communicate innovative concepts and technologies.
- Carry out feasibility studies through analysis, rapid prototyping, experimentation and trials to assess the potential of new approaches.
- Work effectively within a team, while being self-motivated to take ownership of individual research activities, and remain flexible and adaptable to new research areas, technical challenges and ways of working.

Ideal Experience & Skills
- Experience with RF applications, such as electromagnetic spectrum sensing, Electronic Countermeasures (ECM), Electronic Warfare (EW) and Software Defined Radio (SDR).
- Ability to generate, develop and clearly describe innovative approaches to user and technical challenges, with a creative and problem-solving mindset and the ability to translate ideas into practical solutions.
- Versatile software development skills, ideally with experience across multiple programming languages. Python and C are essential, with experience in C#, C++ or Rust desirable.
- Experience configuring and/or developing software for embedded platforms or single-board computers, either industrial or consumer electronics. Experience with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, STM32, RTOS, device drivers and peripherals would be desirable.
- Practical experience with rapid hands-on prototyping, including skills such as soldering, 3D printing, debugging and fault-finding.
- A creative, innovative and adaptable approach to research and engineering, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a small, multidisciplinary team.

Benefits
• Performance-related bonus (grade dependent)
• Car cash allowance (grade dependent)
• Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
• 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
• 24 hours paid volunteering leave
• Private healthcare (grade dependent)
• Pension scheme
• Life cover
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme and access to a mental wellbeing app
• Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
• Gym membership discounts

Security Clearance Requirement (UK Eyes Only)
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held; however, if not currently held, the successful applicant must undergo, achieve and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years' residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels

- la gestion de projet

Votre quotidien

Au sein de l’activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques, le site de La Ferté Saint Aubin est spécialisé dans la production de systèmes d’armements terrestres et aéroportés (mortiers, munitions, roquettes…), de systèmes de protection des forces et de contrôle de zone.
Fort de ses 450 salariés, ingénieurs, techniciens et ouvriers spécialisés, le site de la Ferté Saint Aubin assure la recherche et développement, la production, les essais ainsi que toutes les fonctions « supports » nécessaires à la conception de systèmes performants essentiels à la réussite des missions opérationnelles.
Thales a constitué, avec le groupe allemand de défense DIEHL, une Joint-Venture « JUNGHANS T2M » qui compte 165 salariés permettant aux deux entreprises d’associer leurs compétences d’électronique et de mécanique de précision et de devenir ainsi un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des fusées de munitions. Cette Joint-Venture est présente également sur le site de La Ferté saint Aubin.

Vos missions

- Garantir la performance de son équipe en termes de Coûts, Qualité, Délais et dans le respect de la bonne application des standards métiers et des normes Sécurité et HSE.
- Assurer le management fonctionnel de l'ensemble de l'écosystème de son périmètre.
- Animer ses équipes et développer leurs compétences pour accroître leur autonomie,
- Animer sur son périmètre les fonctions supports allouées au rythme de la production (Supply Chain, Process Engineering, Lean Performances).
- Assurer la tenue des coûts standards, proposer des axes améliorations et participer aux améliorations assurées par les fonctions supports.

- Garantir la tenue du plan de production et des attendus journaliers du client (Réparations), en anticipant les risques industriels, dans le respect de la Qualité des produits livrés.
- Améliorer les en cours de Production / Réparation et d’Investigation en mettant en œuvre les actions visant à améliorer la productivité et à réduire le rework.
- Participer à l’adéquation charges/capacités et les ressources humaines de son périmètre dans un souci d’efficacité globale, au travers d’un management quotidien et d'une communication adaptée.
- Appliquer la démarche de transformation LEAN (Gemba, VSM, Andon KAIZEN).
- Veiller à l’application des standards et être force de proposition pour l’amélioration continue.
- Manager la performance au travers d’un processus de management (AIC) standardisé, intégré dans le processus de management du site.
- Fixer les priorités et prendre les décisions requises permettant la correction des écarts.
- Animer les DOJOs.Manager les aspects Ressources Humaines de son équipe (fixation des objectifs, check-in, développement des compétences, recrutements, ...).

Votre profil

Vos précédentes équipes vous reconnaissent comme un manager rigoureux, respectueux des consignes et dans la recherche de simplicité et d'efficacité ?

Vous avez l'ambition de garantir la réalisation du plan de production de votre ligne, en conformité avec la qualité et les coûts indiqués dans les devis tout en veillant au développement et à l'optimisation des ressources (matérielles et humaines) liées à votre périmètre ?

Vous avez de l'expérience et des connaissances approfondies sur
- Les Process industriels
- La gestion des flux de production
- La pyrotechnie ou le domaine des munitions
- Le Lean Manufacturing et la résolution de problèmes

L'adaptabilité, l'aisance relationnelle et la capacité à gérer le stress sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

- L’analyse systématique des causes d’écarts, le pilotage des actions correctives et l’élaboration des éventuels plans de rattrapage.

- Être force de proposition dans l’amélioration continue des process.

- Animer et analyser les indicateurs de mesure de la performance opérationnelle et les plans d’actions associés dans le respect des standards sécurité et qualité.

- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de coordination logistique ainsi qu’à la standardisation des pratiques. Utilisation des pratiques du lean.

Vous avez une véritable aptitude à gérer le relationnel avec différents interlocuteurs internes et externes ?

postings.title: S3NS - Cloud and Security Engineer  F/H
postings.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

S3NS est né du partenariat industriel entre Thales, leader mondial de la cyber sécurité, et Google Cloud, leader mondial des solutions cloud. Nous avons pour ambition d’offrir le meilleur des deux mondes à l’ensemble des organisations soucieuses de protéger leurs données sensibles (institutions publiques, OIV, OSE…). C’est-à-dire une solution équivalente à Google Cloud Platform (incluant à la fois les services IaaS et PaaS de GCP) et respectant les exigences du label SecNumCloud.

Une première offre, ‘Contrôles locaux avec S3NS’, est déjà disponible depuis février 2023 pour permettre à nos clients de bénéficier d’un premier niveau de transparence et contrôles additionnels, et d'accélérer la trajectoire vers le cloud de confiance.

QUI ETES-VOUS ?

Vous êtes passionné par l’innovation technologique, le Cloud et les déploiements de services et d’infrastructure “as code” ? Vous aimez opérer des systèmes critiques de grande envergure ?

Diplômé (e) d’école d’ingénieur vous justifiez d'une expérience reconnue sur des marchés régulés (secteur bancaire/médical…) avec une exposition internationale.
Vous justifiez de 3 ans d'expérience minimum dans le software engineering, l’automatisation, et le développement (Sécurité et conformité, Automatisation, Résolution de problèmes).
Vous première expérience de migration d’infrastructure privée ou hybride vers le cloud est un atout.

Vos compétences :
- Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs des langages de programmation suivants : C, C++, Java, Python, Go

- Bonnes connaissances des technologies de containerisation (ex. Docker, Kata Containers) et d’orchestration (ex. Kubernetes, Swarm)

- Pratique a minima des services d’un cloud public (ex. GCP)

- Bonnes connaissances des technologies d‘hébergement Open Source (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Openstack)

- Solides connaissances en OS Linux / Unix et langages de scripting shell

- Pratique du SRE (Infra-As-Code, Git, Continuous Deployment, Terraform, Ansible)

- Capacité à débugger, à optimiser le code et à automatiser les tâches de routine

- Bonne connaissance des services d’Identité et de Sécurité du cloud sur les aspects :
- Fonctionnels :
- Gestion des services d’identité ex. Contrôle d’accès, Identité, Authentification

- Gestion des services de sécurité ex. gestion des clés, gestion des secrets, sécurisation des accès/Zéro Trust, Audit Logs

- Techniques :
- IAM, OpenID connect, OAuth2

- KMS, HSM

- Bastion Zero Trust ex. BeyondCorp, Boundary

- Outils collaboratifs ex. Jitsi, Guacamole

- Opérationnels :
- Maintien en Conditions Opérationnelles, de Sécurité et de Modernité de la solution

- Intégrité, confidentialité, haute disponibilité, élasticité, utilisabilité

CE QUE NOUS POUVONS ACCOMPLIR ENSEMBLE

En intégrant l’équipe, vous serez dans un premier temps contributeur de la construction de services d’identité et de sécurité du Cloud de Confiance (ex. gestion des accès, des clés, des identités, des sessions d’administration) : design, définition SLO/SLI, mise en œuvre des services, tests, etc. Vous bénéficierez d’une latitude importante quant aux choix effectués dans ces phases de design et d'implémentation.
Vous bénéficiez également d’un parcours de formation accéléré et intense sur les services GCP, y compris chez Google et dans leurs équipes afin d’être parfaitement formé à la stack technique de Google.
A terme, vous ferez partie d’une des équipes SREs qui aura la responsabilité d’opérer à la fois certains services internes mais aussi les services techniques permettant de délivrer les services GCP dans un Cloud de Confiance.

Au sein de cette organisation SRE, vous aurez l'occasion de relever les défis complexes liés à l'échelle qui sont propres à une plateforme cloud, tout en mettant à profit votre expertise en matière de codage, d'algorithmes, d'analyse de la complexité et de conception de systèmes à grande échelle.
La culture de diversité, de curiosité intellectuelle, de résolution de problèmes et d'ouverture de SRE est la clé de son succès. Notre organisation rassemble des personnes aux parcours, expériences et perspectives très variés. Nous les encourageons à collaborer, à voir grand et à prendre des risques dans un environnement sans reproche.
Nous favorisons l'autodétermination pour travailler sur des projets significatifs, tout en nous efforçant de créer un environnement qui offre le soutien et le mentorat nécessaires à l'apprentissage et à la croissance.

En qualité de SRE, vous missions seront les suivantes :
- Participer à la conception des principaux composants logiciels, systèmes et fonctionnalités en collaboration étroite avec les architectes de S3NS afin d'améliorer la disponibilité, l'évolutivité, la latence et l'efficacité des services du Cloud de Confiance de S3NS

- Mettre en œuvre en respectant l'état de l’art de la cyber sécurité toutes les solutions et/ou outils afin d’améliorer l'offre Plateforme Cloud de Confiance : depuis l’architecture, le développement, le déploiement, jusqu’aux opérations d’infrastructure

- Contribuer au design, au développement et à l’intégration des solutions d’automatisation et de suivi des infrastructures afin de nous permettre une mise à l’échelle de nos opérations sensibles et processus critiques
