postings.title: Safety Component engineer (F/H)
postings.description:
Lieu : Bordeaux, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Sur un Campus Bordelais à la pointe de la technologie, entre océan et vignes, nous concevons et développons des systèmes, des équipements et services pour garantir le succès des missions aéroportées de nos clients.

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Composants Électroniques - Spécialiste SEE (Single Event Effects) (F/H) en CDI à Bordeaux.

Au sein du groupe Thales, l'entité Flight Avionics (AVS/FLX) conçoit, développe et fournit des systèmes et calculateurs embarqués et solutions avioniques pour les marchés civils et militaires, tandis que l’équipe Hardware (HTA) est en charge de la conception et de la justification des équipements électroniques critiques.

Dans ce contexte, le poste de Safety Component Engineer – SEE s’inscrit au cœur des activités de développement et de justification des matériels avioniques, avec un focus particulier sur le comportement des composants électroniques soumis aux environnements sévères (notamment radiatifs) et sur la sûreté de fonctionnement des systèmes.

Au sein d'AVS/FLX/HTA, vous contribuez à :
- L’analyse et le choix des composants électroniques en tenant compte des contraintes de safety, de fiabilité et d’environnement (SEE)
- Au support safety et produit de la mise en œuvre des stratégies de mitigation (architectures, derating, protections, redondances…) pour maîtriser les risques de défaillance liés aux composants
- La rédaction et la mise à jour des dossiers et justifications techniques composants en support des projets (dossiers de certification, safety cases, revues de conception).
- En interaction avec les équipes hardware, système, safety, fiabilité, achats et industrialisation, vous contribuez à garantir que les choix composants sont cohérents avec les exigences de sûreté, de performance et de disponibilité des équipements avioniques développés par Thales AVS/FLX.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

1) Analyser les risques SEE et Sûreté des Composants :
→ Identifier et évaluer les risques liés aux Single Event Effects (SEU, SET, SEFI, SEL) au niveau des composants électroniques, les modes de défaillance induits par les radiations et leurs impacts, alimenter les analyses système (ex. : DFMEA)

2) Définir les Exigences SEE et Qualification des Composants :
→ Spécifier les niveaux de performance radiative attendus, sélectionner les composants adaptés (COTS, rad-tol, rad-hard) et participer à leur qualification selon l’environnement de mission.

3) Gérer les activités liées aux composants de sécurité :
→ Analyse de la documentation, essais de radiation (y compris la sous-traitance), inspection des puces (microscopie, spectroscopie, métallographie, micrographie en coupe, etc.), tests de contraintes électriques, compatibilité électromagnétique (CEM), contraintes mécaniques et thermiques, etc.

4) Définir et recommander les stratégies de mitigation SEE (HW/SW, archi, durcissement) :
→ Proposer et comparer des contre-mesures (redondance, ECC, scrubbing, protections logicielles et matérielles) en cohérence avec les contraintes de performance, coût et sûreté.

5) Assurer le support technique SEE aux projets et l’interface avec clients et fournisseurs :
→ Apporter une expertise SEE tout au long du cycle projet, présenter les analyses en revue, challenger les données fournisseurs et répondre aux demandes techniques des clients.

6)Réaliser une veille technique/normative et contribuer aux référentiels internes et à la formation :
→ Suivre l’évolution des technologies, normes et pratiques SEE, mettre à jour les règles internes et participer à la sensibilisation/formation des équipes d’ingénierie.

7) Participer a la définition des plans d’essais SEE, analyser les résultats et capitaliser le REX :
→ Définir ou ajuster les plans d’irradiation, exploiter les résultats d’essais (seuils, cross-section, modes de défaillance) et enrichir les bases de données internes et guides de conception.

8) Assurer le support de la réalisation des études de sûreté/fiabilité et les dossiers de justification associés :
→ Contribue aux analyses type FMEA/FMECA, calculs de taux de défaillance, bilans de fiabilité et peut être amené à rédiger les notes techniques et justifications pour les revues internes et clients.

Votre profil :
Vous disposez d'un Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou équivalent) spécialisé en Electronique/Microélectronique/Physique des composants et avez :
- de solides bases en électronique des composants : une connaissance des effets des radiations sur l’électronique et/ou une expérience en environnement radiatif (spatial, avionique, défense, nucléaire)

- une maîtrise des phénomènes de fiabilité et de défaillance,

- une connaissance en SEE et essais d'irradiation : des normes et méthodes d'essais radiatifs, capacité à définir des plans d'essais SEE,

- Connaissance des méthodes d'analyse de risques (FMEA/FMECA, arbres de défaillance, calculs de fiabilité),

- Connaissance des normes de sûreté (ex. : ECSS, CEI 61508, EN 50129, ISO26262),

- Anglais technique opérationnel (oral et écrit) et une capacité à travailler et interagir avec des équipes internationales.

Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d'équipe, bon relationnel, capacité d'analyse & synthèse, rigueur documentaire et rédaction technique, capacité à travailler dans un environnement multi-métiers sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

postings.description:
Location: Virginia Remote, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Remote- Virginia, Maryland or District of Columbia

Thales is hiring an experience Sales Account Manager for our Identity & Biometrics Solutions (IBS) business is responsible for selling Thales solutions, protecting and growing the company’s strategic relationship with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and expanding its presence across federal law enforcement, border security, public safety, and digital identity markets.

The position manages assigned federal sales opportunities through the full sales lifecycle—from qualification and solution positioning through financial and commercial offer development, negotiation, order completion, and contract award. The Federal Account Executive serves as a primary sales interface for assigned accounts and is accountable for pipeline development, forecast accuracy, order intake, account growth, and customer satisfaction.

The role also identifies and shapes opportunities across DHS components and adjacent agencies responsible for national security, secure identity, border management, and public safety. Working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, advanced biometrics, and digital identity, the Federal Account Executive connects customer mission requirements with Thales solutions that support secure travel, fraud prevention, border security, identity assurance, and public safety.

In partnership with Solution Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, Capture, Finance, Contracts, Legal, and Bid Management, the position develops customer-specific value propositions, financial and commercial offers, and competitive pursuit strategies that convert qualified opportunities into orders and support sustainable business growth.

Key Area of Responsibility

Sales Execution and Account Growth
- Own assigned federal sales opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle—from qualification and customer engagement through solution positioning, commercial offer development, negotiation, order completion, and contract award.
- Serve as a primary sales interface for assigned DHS and federal accounts, building trusted relationships and maintaining a strong understanding of customer missions, priorities, purchasing requirements, and decision-making processes.
- Promote and sell Thales’ portfolio of biometric, digital identity, identity proofing, credentialing, AI-enabled, border security, and public safety solutions, translating customer needs into differentiated operational, technical, and commercial value propositions.
- Develop and execute sales and account plans that support order intake, revenue growth, margin objectives, account expansion, competitive displacement, and new customer acquisition.
- Build and present financial and commercial offers in collaboration with Finance, Solution Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, Legal, and other stakeholders, including pricing and commercial terms that appropriately consider customer requirements, competition, delivery, risk, profitability, and delegated authority.
- Lead or support customer negotiations involving pricing, scope, schedules, commercial terms, and change requests; address customer questions and objections; adapt offers as appropriate; and secure the internal approvals needed to advance opportunities toward closure.
- Coordinate the commercial and administrative activities required to convert accepted offers into orders, contracts, contract modifications, or other recognized bookings, while maintaining accountability for opportunity status, customer commitments, internal actions, and closing plans.
- Maintain customer satisfaction throughout the sales process; ensure accurate CRM, pipeline, and forecast information; and track performance against applicable sales indicators, including order intake, pipeline growth, forecast accuracy, revenue, and margin.

Opportunity Development, Capture, and Market Engagement
- Protect and grow Thales’ strategic DHS portfolio by building relationships with executive decision-makers, acquisition officials, program leaders, CIO and CTO organizations, federal systems integrators, and strategic industry partners.
- Identify, qualify, and shape adjacent opportunities across federal law enforcement, border security, public safety, digital identity, and other mission-critical government markets.
- Apply customer intelligence, market analysis, and federal-industry knowledge to anticipate mission needs, influence requirements and acquisition strategies, and position Thales before solicitations are released.
- Develop opportunity and capture plans addressing customer requirements, competitive positioning, win themes, solution gaps, teaming, pricing considerations, decision criteria, and overall pursuit strategy.
- Lead complex, multi-million-dollar federal pursuits by coordinating cross-functional contributors, internal bid gates, opportunity reviews, and responses to RFIs, RFPs, and other federal procurement activities.
- Prepare and coordinate required pursuit deliverables, including opportunity summaries, bid-gate materials, commercial strategies, executive summaries, compliant proposals, and closing plans.
- Monitor and communicate relevant customer requirements, federal policy, funding priorities, acquisition strategies, technology trends, competitive activity, risks, and market opportunities to inform product roadmaps, innovation priorities, go-to-market plans, account strategies, and teaming approaches.

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- At least 8 years of successful enterprise sales, account management, business development, or capture experience supporting U.S. Federal Government customers, including meaningful responsibility for progressing opportunities toward orders or contract awards.
- Demonstrated success selling mission-critical technology solutions, such as biometrics, digital identity, AI-enabled software, cybersecurity, border security, law enforcement, public safety, or identity management technologies.
- Experience managing strategic federal accounts and delivering measurable sales growth through account expansion, opportunity conversion, competitive displacement, and new customer acquisition.
- Demonstrated experience developing financial and commercial offers, positioning customer value, supporting pricing decisions, negotiating commercial terms, and completing the activities required to close sales.
- Established relationships within DHS, federal law enforcement agencies, federal systems integrators, and/or relevant strategic industry partners.
- Proven ability to identify, qualify, shape, manage, and win complex, multi-million-dollar federal opportunities.
- Strong understanding of federal procurement processes, acquisition strategies, contract vehicles, competitive capture planning, and the federal acquisition lifecycle.
- Experience leading or coordinating responses to RFIs, RFPs, and other federal procurement activities.
- Ability to analyze customer requirements, competitive information, financial considerations, and sales data to support opportunity and commercial decisions.
- Strong customer communication, presentation, value-positioning, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts—including AI, biometrics, digital identity, cloud platforms, and enterprise software—to technical, acquisition, and executive audiences.
- Experience using CRM platforms to manage opportunity progression, customer activity, pipeline development, sales forecasting, and closing plans.
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and lead sales and pursuit activities through cross-functional influence rather than direct managerial authority.
- Travel 20%

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

Thales people architect solutions at the heart of the defence-security continuum. Thales – Descripción del puesto | Departamento Comercial | Programa Young Talent 2026

En Defensa y Seguridad, las fuerzas armadas, los gobiernos y las organizaciones globales confían en Thales para ayudarles a lograr y mantener la seguridad, la superioridad táctica y la independencia estratégica frente a cualquier tipo de amenaza. En un mundo cada vez más impredecible, los gobiernos confían en nuestra experiencia para proteger a sus ciudadanos y hacer del mundo un lugar más seguro, desde el diseño de sensores inteligentes y la conexión de soldados en el campo de batalla digital hasta la entrega de soluciones que protegen estados, ciudades e infraestructuras críticas.
En España, Thales Sistemas está especializada en sistemas de Mando y Control, Comunicaciones Tácticas y Modelado y Simulación, ofreciendo soluciones en el ámbito de la Defensa y la Seguridad. Thales es el líder español en CIS (Sistemas de Información y Comunicaciones) tácticos terrestres, cubriendo todo el ciclo de vida del producto (diseño, desarrollo, producción y soporte logístico integrado). Con sede en Leganés, Thales Sistemas cuenta con una plantilla altamente especializada de más de 100 personas, en su mayoría ingenieros que participan en las siguientes actividades:
- Sistemas de Información y Comunicaciones (CIS) para dar soporte a la función de Mando y a la Toma de Decisiones.

- Comunicaciones tácticas.

Como parte del equipo de Ventas, en calidad de Becario/a de Ventas de Defensa, te encargarás de:

- Apoyar en las actividades de análisis de mercado, incluyendo la identificación de las necesidades de los clientes, próximos programas, competidores y tendencias del mercado.

- Asistir en la preparación de ofertas comerciales, presentaciones, reuniones con clientes y revisiones internas de negocio.

- Contribuir a la preparación y mantenimiento de las previsiones de ventas, el mapa de oportunidades (pipeline), los datos del CRM y los informes comerciales.

- Apoyar en la coordinación de las actividades comerciales con las líneas de productos y unidades de negocio de Thales tanto en España como a nivel internacional.

- Asistir en la organización y preparación de visitas de clientes, ferias, conferencias y otros eventos comerciales.

- Dar soporte al equipo en la recopilación y estructuración de información relacionada con clientes y programas clave de Defensa.

Competencias

- Gran interés en el desarrollo de negocio, las ventas y el sector de la Defensa y la Seguridad.

- Formación técnica o de ingeniería combinada con interés en actividades comerciales y de negocio.

¿En qué consiste el Programa de Talento? En Thales creemos que las nuevas generaciones son los motores del cambio y, por este motivo, hemos desarrollado un programa de prácticas a jornada completa de un año de duración que complementaremos con un Máster en Productividad, Gestión Adaptativa e Innovación a través de la Universidad Nebrija (a distancia).

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

En tant que Sales Enablement Manager, votre rôle sera de concevoir et déployer le Sales Enablement B2B à l’échelle mondiale pour les services financiers, en collaboration avec les régions commerciales, afin d’intégrer la réflexion stratégique dans les activités commerciales quotidiennes — depuis la définition d’objectifs clairs jusqu’à leur transformation en actions concrètes et KPIs mesurables.
En équipant les équipes avec les bons outils, méthodes de planification comptes et pays, ainsi que des routines claires de revue et suivi, ce poste aide les forces de vente à gérer des comptes complexes, améliorer leur efficience et transformer les ambitions de croissance en une exécution constante et mesurable.

Missions :
Définir et déployer une méthodologie stratégique de planification des comptes et des pays, en coordination avec la direction commerciale.
Mettre en œuvre des processus de revue de pipeline et de demande, en s’appuyant sur l’analyse des données de performance commerciale pour piloter des actions d’amélioration.
Mesurer et optimiser l’efficacité commerciale via le suivi des taux de réussite, de la rentabilité et du chiffre d’affaires, et proposer des plans d’amélioration adaptés.
Standardiser et diffuser les meilleures pratiques ainsi que les méthodologies de vente inbound et outbound à l’international.
Soutenir l’adoption d’une approche « AI-first » pour les contenus et outils de vente, et garantir leur qualité en partenariat avec les équipes Produit, Marketing et Expérience Client.
Concevoir et gérer l’écosystème de formations commerciales (académie, intégration, événements).
Surveiller, analyser et ajuster les plans d’incitation commerciale afin de les aligner sur les priorités business et contribuer à la performance collective. Assurer la continuité et la pertinence des programmes déployés par rapport aux benchmarks du marché.

Votre profil
Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau master ou équivalent (Bac+5), vous justifiez de plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire (Commercial et/ou Sales Enablement) ou un poste équivalent lié aux méthodologies de formation ou aux opérations commerciales.
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les outils CRM (tels que Salesforce ou Microsoft Dynamics) ainsi que les plateformes de support commercial (LMS/CMS).
Vous disposez d’une connaissance approfondie de l’environnement technologique commercial (par exemple : sales engagement, ABM, social selling, données d’intention).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec le développement de tableaux de bord et d’analyses (par exemple : Power BI/Tableau) tels que le suivi de la santé du pipeline, les taux de conversion, la durée des cycles et l’analyse de la vélocité.
Vous pouvez piloter la définition d’indicateurs clairs d’adoption, mettre en place des boucles de feedback et animer des rythmes d’amélioration continue.
Vous possédez de solides compétences dans la conception et l’animation d’événements (Sales Kick-offs, bootcamps, office hours).

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre capacité à concevoir, déployer, gérer et améliorer en continu des programmes commerciaux globaux ;
Votre aptitude à influencer sans autorité ; vos fortes compétences d’animation et d’accompagnement ;
Votre communication claire et votre capacité à simplifier des sujets complexes ;
Votre esprit analytique, structuré et orienté résultats ;
Votre sens aigu des responsabilités, votre réactivité et votre soin du détail ;
Votre posture collaborative et empathique, avec une crédibilité auprès des cadres commerciaux seniors.
Formation d’ingénieur, commerce, management, marketing ou domaine connexe, complétée par une expérience avérée en B2B et services SaaS.
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l’anglais et le français.

English version

As a Sales Enablement Manager, your role will be to collaborate with the sales regions to integrate strategic thinking into daily commercial activities—from setting clear objectives to turning them into concrete actions.

By equipping teams with the right tools, account and country planning methods, and clear review and follow-up routines, this position helps sales forces manage complex accounts, improve efficiency, and turn growth ambitions into consistent and measurable execution.

In this capacity, your main responsibilities will include:
1. Defining and deploying a strategic account and country planning methodology, in coordination with sales management.
2. Implementing pipeline and demand review processes, leveraging commercial performance data analysis to drive improvement actions.
3. Measuring and optimizing commercial effectiveness through monitoring win rates, profitability, and revenue, and proposing tailored improvement plans.

Your profile

With a master's degree or equivalent (Bac+5 level), you have more than 10 years of experience in a similar role (Commercial and/or Sales Enablement) or an equivalent position related to training methodologies or sales operations.

You have excellent command of CRM tools (such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics) as well as commercial support platforms (LMS/CMS).

You possess in-depth knowledge of the commercial technology environment (e.g., sales engagement, ABM, social selling, intent data).
You are comfortable developing dashboards and analyses (e.g., Power BI/Tableau): pipeline health tracking, conversion rates, cycle duration, and velocity analysis.

You can lead the definition of clear adoption indicators, set up feedback loops, and drive continuous improvement rhythms.
You have strong skills in designing and facilitating events (Sales Kick-offs, bootcamps, office hours).

You are recognized for:
- your ability to exert influence without authority; your strong facilitation and support skills;
- your clear communication and your ability to simplify complex topics;
- your analytical, structured, and results-oriented mindset;
- your strong sense of responsibility, responsiveness, and attention to detail;
- your collaborative and empathetic approach, with credibility among senior sales executives.

postings.title: Sales Manager (Hybrid)
postings.description:
Location: Madrid, Spain

Thales people architect solutions at the heart of the defence-security continuum. Interoperable and secure information and telecommunications systems for defence, security, and civil operators, are based upon innovative use of radiocommunications, networks, and cybersecurity. We are ground breaking new digital technologies such as 4G mobile communications, cryptography, cloud computing and big data for use in physical protection systems, and critical information systems.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

In Defence and security, armed forces, governments and global organisations entrust Thales with helping them achieve and maintain security, tactical superiority and strategic independence in the face of any type of threat. In an increasingly unpredictable world, governments rely on our expertise to protect their citizens and make the world safer, from designing smart sensors and connecting soldiers on the digital battlefield to delivering solutions that protect states, cities and critical infrastructures.

In Spain, Thales Sistemas is specialized in Command and Control systems, Tactical Communications and Modeling and Simulation addressing solutions in the domain of Defense and Security. Thales is the Spanish leader in tactical Land CIS (Communication and Information Systems) covering all the product life cycle (design, development, production, ILS). Based in Leganés, Thales Sistemas employs a highly specialized workforce of more than 100 people, most of them engineers that participate in the following activities:
- Communications and Information Systems (CIS) to support Command function and Decision Making:
- Embedded electronics for military aircraft
- Tactical Communications
- Radio Navigation Aids for air traffic

The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and executing Thales Spain’s commercial strategy for the Defence sector, with a primary focus on the Spanish Ministry of Defence, the Spanish Armed Forces, and key national defence stakeholders.
The role will drive business growth by identifying and capturing new opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, building long-term institutional relationships, and positioning Thales’ advanced defence solutions in support of Spain’s defence modernization programmes.

Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales Strategy
- Develop and implement a commercial roadmap aligned with Thales’ global defence priorities and Spain’s national defence plans.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities with the Spanish Ministry of Defence, the Armed Forces, and relevant public agencies.
- Build and manage capture plans for strategic opportunities, ensuring alignment between customer needs, Thales capabilities, and competitive positioning.
- Develop strategic partnerships with Spanish defence industry players.
- Conduct market intelligence to anticipate future defence requirements, budget priorities, procurement plans, and competitor activity.
Institutional & Stakeholder Relations
- Act as a key commercial interface with the Spanish Ministry of Defence, the Armed Forces — Army, Navy, Air Force — and relevant agencies, including DGAM.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers, influencers, technical stakeholders, procurement authorities, and industrial partners.
- Represent Thales Spain in defence exhibitions, industry forums, customer meetings, and institutional events such as FEINDEF and EUROSATORY.
- Promote Thales’ defence portfolio and value proposition in line with customer priorities and national industrial objectives.

Complex Sales Cycle Management
- Lead end-to-end sales and tender processes, from opportunity identification and capture strategy to proposal submission, negotiation, and contract signature.
- Coordinate internal teams, including engineering, bid management, legal, finance, operations, contracts, and programme management and develop compliant technical and commercial proposals.
- Lead negotiations with customers and partners, ensuring alignment with Thales’ governance and risk processes.

Internal & External Collaboration
- Work with Thales Spain teams and international network to deliver competitive solutions.
- Coordinate with business lines to adapt offerings to customer needs and support key presentations and approvals.

Experience, Knowledge & Skills
- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or a related field. A technical background in Aerospace, Telecommunications, Electronics, Naval Systems, Defence Systems, or similar areas will be highly valued.
- A Master’s degree in Defence, International Business, Public Administration, or an MBA would be a plus.
- Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in B2G sales, business development, account management, or capture management, preferably in the defence, aerospace, security, or high-technology sectors.
- Proven experience working with the Spanish Ministry of Defence, Spanish Armed Forces, public-sector procurement processes, or major defence industry stakeholders.
- Previous service as a member of the Spanish Armed Forces, would be highly valued.
- Strong understanding of Spanish defence procurement, public tenders, industrial partnerships, and the national defence ecosystem.
- Willingness to travel within Spain and internationally.
- Eligibility to obtain Spanish and NATO Secret security clearance for handling classified information.
- High standards of integrity, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
- You must have fluent English level (B2+) and high or native level of Spanish.

Valuable
- French would be a plus.

The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial experience, knowledge of the Spanish defence market, the ability to build trusted institutional relationships, and sufficient technical understanding to position Thales’ defence solutions effectively.
The candidate should be proactive, customer-oriented, results-driven, and capable of operating successfully in a complex international organization.

What do we offer?
- Flexible working hours.
- Intensive working days on Fridays and during summer.
- Remote-friendly – 2 days a week working from home.
- Restaurant allowance and social benefits (health insurance, kindergarden).

Thales is a company that promotes equal opportunities. All qualified candidates will be considered for the position regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, nationality, ancestry, pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, status as a protected veteran, medical condition or disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

Sales Manager (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

- Planung und Durchführung von Marketing- und Promotionsmaßnahmen sowie Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Messen und Konferenzen.

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien, Mitwirkung bei Jahresplanungen und enge länderübergreifende Abstimmung im Sales-Team.

Darauf freuen wir uns:
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb und/oder Key Account Management, einschließlich fundierter methodischer Kenntnisse.

- Abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches oder technisches Studium mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit technischem Verständnis.

- Idealerweise abgeschlossene Offizierslaufbahn in der Marine und sehr gute Kenntnisse des relevanten Marktes.

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Leitung komplexer Projekte.

- Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit Matrix-Organisationen und vertraut mit Unternehmensprozessen.

Location: The preferred location is Reading, although Remote UK with regular visit to Reading site could be taken into consideration for the ideal candidate. This role offers a hybrid approach to office and remote working. Travel in the UK and around Nordics / BeNeLux is an essential part of the role

Thales Software Monetization
The position is based in the Thales Software Monetization division. Thales has more than 30 years of experience in software protection, software delivery and license management with many thousands of customers worldwide. Software companies and smart device manufacturers can use these solutions to reliably license, deliver and protect their software, enabling steady business growth. The Sentinel product portfolio helps customers get the most value from their software whether it is on-premise, in the cloud or on an embedded device. Sentinel is the brand name in the software industry for secure, flexible and future-proof software monetization solutions.

Core Activities
In your area of responsibility, you are the first point of contact for all interested parties from the initial contact to the conclusion of the contract for the Thales Software Monetization portfolio in the region UK/Ireland, the BeNeLux and the Nordics. As Sales Manager you are an active part of the sales team and inspire potential new customers about the Sentinel solutions in the field.

The range of tasks includes:
- Direct sales of our products, solutions and services in the key account environment and in the upper midmarket in UK/Ireland, the BeNeLux and the Nordics.

- Active acquisition of new customers in selected industry segments (e.g. mechanical engineering, medical technology and software companies) and development of an opportunity pipeline

- Acquisition of new contacts (new customers in B2B business) in the field, by phone and online

- First point of contact for interested parties from initial contact to contract conclusion

- Market analysis and definition of interesting key customers within your segment incl. participation in marketing activities, trade conferences and fairs

- Close cooperation and orchestration of internal departments in customer projects (pre-sales, product management, professional services)

- Development of project benefits and added value arguments with and for customers and prospects

- Forecasting and creation of measurable concepts for target achievement

- Traceable documentation in the CRM system Salesforce

Education
- Successful university degree (business administration, business informatics or similar) or comparable education / professional experience

Skills
- 5-10 years of experience in direct sales of complex software / IT solutions with proven successes

- Strategic thinking and goal-oriented action within the scope of quota responsibility

- Understanding of complex business processes and business models in medium-sized and large companies

- Experience with sales methodologies such as Value-based Selling or Diagnostic Selling

- Extensive willingness to travel

Social Competencies
- Strong communication skills and agility

- Independent, team-oriented and structured way of working

- Curiosity and customer centricity

postings.description:
Location: Glasgow, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME) Sales Manager - Sea Sector

Location: Glasgow (preferred) or Reading. While this is a hybrid role, successful candidates will spend regular time on-site to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders. We will also consider candidates based elsewhere in the UK who can commit to regular travel and maintaining a strong presence within the team. UK and international travel (approximately 50-60%) is required.

Shape the Future of Naval Defence
We're looking for a driven and commercially minded Sales Manager to help grow our Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME) business within the Sea Sector.
This is an exciting opportunity for a defence sales, business development, commercial or programme professional who thrives on building relationships, identifying opportunities and turning them into long-term business success.
You'll join an experienced and ambitious team, working with cutting-edge technologies and a globally recognised portfolio of naval defence solutions. Our heritage includes delivering every sighting solution (Periscope and Optronics Mast) to the Royal Navy, alongside supporting customers around the world with advanced maritime capabilities.

The Opportunity
As Sales Manager, you'll be responsible for developing and converting a strong pipeline of opportunities across our Sea Sector portfolio. You'll work closely with customers, industry partners, major prime contractors and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape winning strategies and secure profitable growth.

A key focus of the role will be building and strengthening industry relationships, expanding our market presence and helping position the business for future success in both UK and international markets.
We're looking for someone who can quickly establish credibility, build networks and bring energy, drive and commercial focus to a growing business.
What You'll Be Doing
- Developing and delivering a robust pipeline of new business opportunities.
- Building relationships with customers, major prime contractors and key stakeholders across the defence community.
- Identifying, qualifying and pursuing opportunities that support strategic growth objectives.
- Developing compelling capture and win strategies to secure new business.
- Leading and influencing cross-functional teams throughout the sales and bid process.
- Working closely with Product Line, Strategy, Marketing and Operational teams to develop customer-focused solutions.
- Managing key customer accounts and supporting long-term relationship growth.
- Representing the business at customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions and conferences.
- Contributing to strategic planning, market analysis and future growth initiatives.

About You
You'll be a motivated, relationship-focused professional with a strong commercial mindset and a track record of delivering results.
You enjoy working at pace, building networks, influencing stakeholders and creating opportunities. You're equally comfortable developing strategy, engaging senior customers and rolling up your sleeves to support the wider team when needed.
We're particularly interested in candidates who have:
- Experience in sales, business development, capture management or commercial leadership within the defence sector.
- A proven track record of winning business and delivering sustainable growth.
- Strong relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to quickly establish credibility and identify opportunities.
- Knowledge of, or experience working with, major defence prime contractors and defence supply chains.
- Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to balance customer needs and business objectives.
- The ability to lead, motivate and influence cross-functional teams.
- Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive, resilient and positive attitude, with a willingness to take ownership and make things happen.
- The drive to continuously learn, develop and stay connected to market trends.
It would be beneficial if you also have:
- Knowledge of UK MOD procurement and commercial processes.
- Experience of complex defence sales, capture management or bid leadership.
- Understanding of export or international defence programmes.
- Experience of structured bid methodologies such as Shipley.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to join a growing business at the forefront of defence technology, where you'll have the autonomy to build relationships, shape opportunities and directly influence future growth. You'll work alongside highly experienced colleagues, engage with leading defence organisations and play a key role in delivering capabilities that matter.

UKEO (UK Eyes Only)
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a Non-ITAR country may be considered. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link -
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels

#LI-BG2
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

postings.description:
Lieu : Massy, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

L’activité Systèmes terrestres et aériens basé sur le site de Massy est leader dans les systèmes de commandement et de contrôle des opérations aériennes et les systèmes radars de défense aérienne.

Au sein de la Direction Commerciale Defense Air Systems de Thales LAS France, vous contribuez à la croissance des activités Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) et Surface Radars (SRA). Dans un environnement international en plein évolution stratégique et technologique, vous identifiez les besoins des grandes nations européennes de l’OTAN souhaitant moderniser leur défense aérienne et anti-missile et définissez les solutions Thales à promouvoir. Vous avez pour objectif de développer les ventes de radars, de systèmes d’armes et de système de Commande et de Contrôle.
Au sein de la Direction Commerciale, vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes :
- Identifier et caractériser les opportunités en matière de défense et de surveillance aérienne (capteurs, effecteurs et Control& Command)

- Construire et piloter les plans de compte en considérant l’ambition stratégique de chaque état, l’environnement concurrentiel et industriel local, ceci en coopération avec les entités Thales implantées localement.

- Animer les relations avec les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes, participer aux salons internationaux, gérer les demandes de licences d’exportation et contribuer activement au développement du business à l’export.

A noter : Vous intégrerez l’établissement de Massy avant de rejoindre notre site Thales situé à Vélizy-Villacoublay après le déménagement des activités auxquelles vous êtes rattaché.

Votre profil :

Vous disposez d’une formation supérieure d’ingénieur ou commerciale et justifiez d’à minima 8 ans en Business Development et/ou Commerce, idéalement dans des environnements complexes et internationaux.
Vous avez de l’expérience sur :
- Le développement commercial et la stratégie de capture, notamment auprès de clients institutionnels internationaux ;

- Les techniques de vente et de négociation en Business-to-Government (BtoG) et Business-to-Business (BtoB) ;

- La connaissance des marchés de Défense, avec idéalement une expérience dans le domaine de la défense aérienne ou naval ;

- Le pilotage d’offres complexes, la coordination d’équipes Bid et la conduite de revues décisionnelles ;

- La négociation commerciale et contractuelle, ainsi que la gestion de relations avec des clients, partenaires et acteurs institutionnels ;

- L’environnement technologique de haute complexité, avec une capacité à comprendre et valoriser des solutions techniques à forte valeur ajoutée.

La maîtrise de l'Anglais est indispensable pour ce poste
Une expérience professionnelle à l’étranger constitue un atout supplémentaire. Une connaissance des radars, des systèmes d’armes ou du domaine naval serait également appréciée.
Le leadership, la ténacité, le sens de la négociation, l'excellent relationnel, l'esprit d’équipe, l'autonomie, la capacité d’adaptation et orientation résultats sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ?

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: SAP Integration Manager
postings.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

About the Role:

We are seeking an Integration Manager (SAP) to provide end-to-end leadership and ownership of SAP integration capabilities across our enterprise systems. This role is accountable for integration architecture, standards, governance, delivery oversight, and operational excellence.
You will partner with enterprise architecture, SAP functional owners, infrastructure/security teams, and external vendors/partners to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable. You will not only manage delivery, but also drive continuous improvement across interface quality, monitoring, incident handling, and long-term integration strategy.

Required Skills & Experience:
- Higher education qualification: minimum bachelor's degree; a master's degree is preferred.
- At least 15 years of experience in SAP environments, including a minimum of 5 years of experience in SAP project or delivery management.
- Strong analytical skills, rigor, and autonomy Good interpersonal skills and ability to work as part of a team Proficiency in French would be a plus.
- Proven experience supporting SAP integrations in a production run/support capacity. Experience in SAP integration or migration projects
- Strong knowledge of project planning, risk management, issue management, scope management, and change control Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, ServiceNow, or equivalent Demonstrated ability to operate integrations using: monitoring tools, logs/trace inspection, and structured troubleshooting
- Strong incident/problem management skills, including RCA and CAPA execution. Understanding of integration reliability patterns: error handling, retries, reconciliation, idempotency, failure workflows
- Experience coordinating across multiple technical and functional teams (SAP basis, security, infra, SAP functional, vendors, partners, TMA). Excellent communication skills during incidents and for operational governance. Experience implementing/maintaining integration monitoring and operational KPIs. Familiarity with ITSM processes (incident/problem/change management).

Key Responsibilities:

Own daily operations of SAP integration services/interfaces (production support), including interface health, performance, and stability. Define and maintain monitoring and observability standards:- dashboards/alerts, thresholding, operational metrics (throughput, failures, latency, backlog)
- log/traceability practices for end-to-end message tracking
Lead incident management for integration outages and degraded service:- triage, prioritization, escalation, coordination across teams
- root cause analysis (RCA) and effective recovery actions
Drive problem management:- corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)
- eliminate repeat incidents and reduce operational risk
Ensure integrations follow operationally sound practices Manage the run documentation set (as applicable):- runbooks, support playbooks, interface ownership matrix, troubleshooting guides
Oversee SLA/OLAs and ensure operational KPIs are met (as defined by the business). Coordinate integration-related changes impacting run:- participate in release readiness, supportability checks, and post-release validation
- ensure knowledge transfer and readiness for support handover
Partner with SAP functional owners and technical teams to maintain interface requirements consistency. Work with vendors/partners when applicable to ensure effective support coverage and timely resolutions.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Scientifique-chercheur en IA Appliquée /Applied AI Research Scientist
postings.legal_entity: Thales Digital Solutions Inc., Research & Technology
postings.description:
Location: Montreal, Canada

Dans des marchés en rapide évolution, les clients à travers le monde font confiance à Thales. Thales est une entreprise où les personnes les plus brillantes du monde entier se regroupent pour mettre en commun leurs idées et ainsi s'inspirer mutuellement. Dans tous les secteurs où œuvre Thales, notamment l’aérospatiale, le transport, la défense, la sécurité et l'espace, nos équipes d’architectes conçoivent des solutions innovantes qui rendent demain possible dès aujourd’hui.

Carrefour mondial de l’intelligence artificielle, Montréal est le foyer du nouveau centre de recherche et de technologie spécialisé en intelligence artificielle (cortAIx) collaborant avec les principaux groupes canadiens de recherche en intelligence artificielle à Montréal et à Toronto. S’appuyant sur ses compétences dans les principaux marchés industriels, Thales donne vie à l'intelligence artificielle au profit de ses clients tout en créant de passionnants emplois pour les chercheurs et les développeurs experts en intelligence artificielle en vue de trouver des solutions qui transformeront notre monde, du fond des océans aux confins de l'univers et du cyberespace. Ayant très tôt opté pour le modèle d’innovation ouverte et collaborative, Thales procède actuellement à la création de la structure du centre de recherche et de technologie spécialisé en intelligence artificielle (cortAIx). Piloté par Thales, le centre cortAIx, l'Institut de valorisation des données (IVADO) et l’Institut Vector de Toronto, est situé dans le célèbre quartier Petite-Italie, au cœur de la communauté de l’innovation à Montréal.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Montreal – a world leading AI hub, is home to new Centre of Research & Technology in Artificial Intelligence eXpertise (cortAIx) collaborating with leading Canadian AI research groups in Montreal and Toronto. With competencies in major industrial markets Thales is bringing artificial intelligence to life for our customers creating exciting jobs for AI researchers and developers who will create solutions that will transform our world from the bottom of oceans to the depths of space and cyberspace. As an early adopter of open, creative and collaborative innovation model, Thales is building the Centre of Research and Technology in Artificial Intelligence eXpertise (cortAIx). Led by Thales, cortAIx, the IVADO (Institute of Data Valorization) and the Vector Institute of Toronto, is located in Montreal’s famous Little Italy, in the heart of Montreal’s innovation community.

Scientifique-chercheur en IA Appliquée /Applied AI Research Scientist
Montréal, QC (Hybride/Hybrid) Temps plein/Full-time

Résumé du poste/Position Summary
Un scientifique en recherche et technologie (R&T) spécialisé dans l'IA de frontière et la vision par ordinateur est chargé de découvrir, de développer et d'intégrer des méthodologies innovantes pour relever des défis complexes dans ces domaines et de traduire les concepts connexes en solutions Thales. Il/elle prouve leur viabilité à travers la mise en œuvre de preuves de concepts et guide leur croissance en maturité à travers des prototypes et des démonstrateurs qui illustreront et permettront à leur tour leur plein potentiel commercial.
Pour réussir dans ce rôle, la curiosité pour ce qui est nouveau, la volonté de défier le statu quo, l'ouverture d'esprit et la pensée originale sont essentielles. L'individu doit rapidement apprendre et évaluer les nouvelles techniques et technologies afin de décider de les adopter, de les adapter ou de les abandonner. Il doit également être capable de proposer de nouvelles idées, de les présenter, de les questionner et de les améliorer en permanence. La personne doit posséder des compétences techniques approfondies et pratiques et être familière avec les outils et méthodes associés à la recherche dans les domaines vision par ordinateur et IA pour la vision par ordinateur. Le candidat doit démontrer une solide compréhension de la méthode scientifique et sa capacité à fournir un contenu de qualité à toutes les étapes du processus de recherche : de la capacité à résumer le contexte théorique d'un nouveau domaine jusqu’à la diffusion des résultats de la recherche par le biais de publications revues par les pairs, de brevets ou autres moyens.
Le scientifique fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et des capacités de travail d'équipe sont obligatoires. Le candidat idéal est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui faciliteraient le transfert du travail effectué à tous les intervenants impliqués. Il / elle contribuera en tant qu'expert technique aux projets de recherche et technologie de Thales et de ses unités commerciales. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.

A Research and Technology (R&T) scientist specializing in frontier AI and computer vision is responsible for discovering, developing and integrating innovative methodologies to address complex challenges in these fields and to translate related concepts into Thales solutions. He/she proves their viability through the implementation of Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and guides their maturity growth through prototypes and demonstrators that will in turn illustrate and enable their full business potential.
To be successful in this role, curiosity for what is new, willingness to challenge the status quo, open-mindedness and out-of-the-box thinking are crucial. The individual should quickly learn and assess new techniques and technologies in order to decide whether to adopt, adapt or discard them. He/she also needs to be able to come up with new ideas, present them, challenge them and improve them continuously. The individual must possess deep, hands-on technical skills and be familiar with computer vision and AI for computer vision research methods and tools. The candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of the scientific method and his/her ability to deliver quality content at all steps of the research process, from the capability to summarize the theoretical background of a novel domain to the dissemination of research outputs through peer-reviewed publications, patents or other means.
The scientist is part of a multi-disciplinary team. Strong team spirit and teamwork capabilities are mandatory. The ideal candidate therefore is able to demonstrate transverse skills that would facilitate the transfer of the work carried out to all stakeholders involved. She/he will contribute as a technical subject matter expert to Research and Technology projects across Thales and its business units. Therefore, good communication skills are required.

Fonctions essentielles/Essential Functions
Responsabilisés clés du Scientifique en Recherche en IA/Vision par Ordinateur:
- Effectuer des recherches en vision par ordinateur, avec un focus sur les modèles de fondation vision-langage (VLMs, Ve-LLMs et modèles de fondation visuels), le traitement d’images et de vidéos, les algorithmes d’apprentissage efficaces et sans entraînement, ainsi que les modèles de vision par ordinateur optimisés pour le déploiement en périphérie.
- Concevoir, adapter et évaluer des modèles de fondation, des modèles vision-langage et des modèles de perception multimodale pour des cas d’usage réels.
- Développer des méthodes pour la détection d’objets, la segmentation, le raisonnement visuel, le suivi d’objets et la compréhension de scènes.
- Mener des travaux de recherche de pointe sur les méthodes d’apprentissage frugales afin d’adapter des modèles à grande échelle au moyen du fine-tuning, de l’apprentissage few-shot, de l’apprentissage zero-shot, du prompt tuning, de LoRA ou d’autres techniques efficaces en paramètres.
- Établir des protocoles d’évaluation rigoureux pour mesurer la précision, la robustesse, l’incertitude, les biais, l’explicabilité et la généralisation.
- Transformer les avancées de l’état de l’art en prototypes, démonstrateurs et composants IA déployables.
- Collaborer avec des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires afin de convertir les percées de recherche en prototypes déployables et en systèmes prêts pour la production.
- Travailler sur des problématiques de portée variée afin de soutenir le déploiement de modèles d’IA fiables, de confiance et certifiables dans des systèmes critiques.
- Publier les résultats de recherche dans des conférences et revues pertinentes ou de premier plan en IA et en vision par ordinateur, et contribuer au dépôt de brevets d’innovation.
- Faire preuve d’excellentes compétences en communication auprès de parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
- Démontrer un bon jugement dans la sélection des méthodes et techniques permettant d’obtenir de meilleures solutions.
- Développer d’excellentes compétences de collaboration avec des organisations académiques ou de recherche, par exemple le CRSNG, MITACS, etc., ainsi qu’avec des partenaires industriels.
- Proposer, recueillir et synthétiser les exigences système auprès des parties prenantes, et contribuer à l’élaboration de feuilles de route efficaces en recherche et innovation.

AI/Computer Vision Research Scientist Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct research in computer vision, focusing on vision-language foundation models (VLMs, Ve-LLMs, and vision foundation models), image/video processing, efficient and training-free learning algorithms, and edge-optimized CV models.
- Design, adapt, and evaluate foundation models, vision-language models, and multimodal perception models for real-world use cases.
- Develop methods for object detection, segmentation, visual reasoning, tracking, and scene understanding.
- Conduct pioneering research in frugal learning methods to adapt large-scale models using fine-tuning, few-shot learning, zero-shot learning, prompt tuning, LoRA, or other parameter-efficient techniques.
- Establish rigorous evaluation protocols for accuracy, robustness, uncertainty, bias, explainability, and generalization.
- Translate state-of-the-art research into prototypes, demonstrators, and deployable AI components.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to translate research breakthroughs into deployable prototypes and production-ready systems.
- Work on problems of diverse scope to support the deployment of trustworthy and certifiable AI models in critical systems.
- Publish research findings in relevant/top-tier conferences and journals, in AI and computer vision, and contribute to publishing innovation patents.
- Demonstrate excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrate good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining better solutions.
- Develop excellent collaboration skills with academic or research organizations (e.g., NSERC, MITACS, etc.), and with industrial partners.
- Suggest, collect, and synthesize system requirements from stakeholders and contribute to shaping effective research and innovation roadmaps.

Exigences minimales/Minimum Requirements
- Doctorat ou maîtrise recherche en informatique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe, avec un accent sur la vision par ordinateur, l'apprentissage automatique/approfondi et les modèles d’IA avances.
- Solides connaissances théoriques et compréhension des principes fondamentaux de l'apprentissage automatique, de l'apprentissage supervisé/non supervisé, de l'apprentissage auto-supervisé, de l'apprentissage frugale.
- Démontrer une expérience dans le développement et le déploiement d'algorithmes de vision par ordinateur dans des environnements universitaires ou industriels.
- Solide compréhension des diverses modalités de détection d'images, notamment l'imagerie RVB, RADAR, infrarouge, LIDAR, hyperspectrale, multispectrale, RVB-D, thermique, ultrasonique, sonar et à lumière structurée.
- Solide connaissance des architectures d'apprentissage profond pour la vision par ordinateur, telles que les CNN, les transformateurs, les modèles de fondation récents et les techniques connexes utilisées dans la détection, la segmentation et la reconnaissance d'objets.
- Solide expérience dans la conception et l'exécution d'expériences, l'affinement des modèles, l'optimisation et l'analyse des données.
- Maîtrise des langages de programmation tels que Python et C++, et de l'utilisation de frameworks de ML tels que PyTorch, Tensorflow, Scikit-learn et la bibliothèque OpenCV.
- Un historique de publications de recherche dans des conférences et journaux pertinents sur l’IA et la vision par ordinateur, tels que NeurIPs, ICCV, ECCV, CVPR, AAAI, PAMI.
- Esprit critique et capacité à communiquer des travaux scientifiques de manière claire et efficace.
- Excellentes compétences en matière de résolution de problèmes et capacité à penser de manière créative et stratégique.
- Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au travail en équipe.
- Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale pour une collaboration et une diffusion efficace de la recherche.
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (parlé et écrit).

- Ph.D. or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field with focus on computer vision, machine/deep learning and advanced AI models.
- Solid theoretical knowledge and understanding of machine learning fundamentals, supervised/unsupervised learning, self-supervised learning, efficient and few-shot learning.
- Demonstrate experience in developing and deploying computer vision algorithms in either academic or industrial settings.
- Strong understanding of various image sensing modalities, including RGB, RADAR, Infrared, LIDAR, hyperspectral, multispectral, RGB-D, thermal, ultrasonic, sonar, and structured light imaging.
- Strong knowledge of deep learning architectures for computer vision such as CNNs, Transformers, recent foundation models and related techniques used in object detection, segmentation and recognition.
- Solid experience in designing and executing experiments, refining models, optimization and data analysis.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and C++, and in using ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Tensorflow, and Scikit-learn, and OpenCV library.
- A track record of research publications in relevant AI and computer vision conferences and journals, such as NeurIPs, ICCV, ECCV, CVPR, AAAI, and PAMI.
- Critical thinker with ability to communicating scientific work in a clear and effective manner.
- Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to think creatively and strategically.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration and dissemination of research.
- Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).

Ce poste requiert une bonne connaissance de l'anglais pour la rédaction de documents techniques, pour interagir, soutenir et/ou fournir des services à des clients, employés et/ou partenaires internationaux ainsi qu’à des autorités gouvernementales étrangères qui ne parlent pas français.

Qualifications souhaitables/Preferred Qualifications
- 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans la recherche en robotique, en systèmes autonomes, ou dans des domaines similaires.
- Connaissance pratique des MLOps, du packaging logiciel, du développement de SDK/librairies, des processus de validation en ingénierie et du déploiement de solutions IA prêtes pour la production.

postings.title: Security AI Operations Engineer
postings.description:
Location: BELFAST ARNOTT HOUSE, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Role Title: Security AI Operations Engineer
Organization: Value Added Services / Security Operations
Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland (Hybrid)

Role Overview
The Security AI Operations Specialist bridges automated AI systems and human security operations. This role is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, quality control, and execution of AI-assisted security workflows.
Working alongside the Security Automation & AI Engineering team, the Specialist manages "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) triage queues, maintains and updates knowledge bases feeding generative models, audits AI outputs for accuracy, and ensures prioritized investigation tasks are routed seamlessly to front-line security analysts and consultants.

Key Responsibilities
1. AI Workflow Supervision & Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Routing
- Review and validate low-confidence alert enrichments, threat summaries, and triage recommendations generated by AI agents.
- Assign, dispatch, and track complex security investigations, policy changes, and incident response playbooks to appropriate Tier 2/3 analysts and consultants.
- Serve as the operational escalation point when automated pipelines encounter exceptions, edge cases, or platform integration errors.
2. Knowledge Base & Prompt Lifecycle Management
- Curate, clean, and organize internal runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), threat intelligence, and product documentation stored in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Amazon OpenSearch Service.
- Audit AI retrieval quality and document gaps in knowledge coverage that lead to model hallucinations or poor responses.
- Perform routine prompt adjustments and template maintenance, submitting structured enhancement tickets to engineering when underlying code changes are required.
3. Quality Assurance & Performance Auditing
- Regularly audit AI-generated outputs (incident summaries, triage context, customer reports) against human analyst benchmarks to ensure high fidelity and operational safety.
- Identify recurring false positives or hallucination patterns, collaborating directly with automation engineers to refine model guardrails and prompt evaluation datasets.
- Track and report on operational KPIs, including Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), task assignment velocity, and analyst AI adoption.
4. Team Enablement & Operational Feedback
- Train security analysts and services teams on prompt best practices, effective use of internal AI copilots, and feedback submission workflows.
- Gather front-line feedback and feature requests from security practitioners to help shape the automation engineering roadmap.
5. Sales
- Partner with the Sales Engineering team to develop and deliver Value-Added Services (VAS) proof-of-values (POVs), clearly demonstrating the business value and impact of these services.
- Collaborate with Account teams to accelerate time-to-value for Thales solutions among non-VAS customers, strengthening customer adoption, retention, and renewal outcomes.

Required Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s degree, in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus!
- Experience: 3–5+ years in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services (MSSP), IT Service Management (ITSM), or technical workflow coordination role, including 2+ years working with AI/Gen AI-enabled tools or workflows.
- Cybersecurity Foundation: Working knowledge of security operations, threat lifecycle, alert triage, WAF, API security, and common security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, NIST).
- AI & Workflow Tooling: Practical experience interacting with generative AI tools, prompt workflows, and enterprise ticketing/orchestration platforms (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, or SOAR platforms).
- Cloud & Search Interface Familiarity: Working comfort navigating the AWS Management Console (specifically Amazon Bedrock, Amazon OpenSearch Dashboards, and CloudWatch metrics).
- Communication & Documentation: Strong technical writing skills with experience authoring security runbooks, SOPs, and structured process documentation.

Preferred Qualifications
- Data & Query Skills: Basic scripting ability in Python or experience writing search queries (OpenSearch / Elasticsearch queries, SQL, or Lucene).
- Workflow Automation: Experience configuring no-code/low-code workflow tools, webhook triggers, or ticketing automation rules.
- Industry Certifications:- AWS Certified Security – Specialty or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional
- AWS Certified AI Practitioner or Machine Learning – Specialty
- CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
- GIAC Certifications: GCIH (Incident Handler), GCIA (Intrusion Analyst), GCDA (Detection Analyst), or GASAE (AI Security Automation Engineer)

Success Metrics (KPIs)
Queue & Dispatch SLA - 95%+ of HITL exceptions and high-priority AI-flagged alerts assigned within defined SLAs.
Knowledge Base Freshness - 100% of operational runbooks reviewed and indexed on a recurring monthly/quarterly schedule.
Output Quality & Accuracy - Maintain >95% accuracy on AI-assisted triage outputs through continuous auditing and feedback loops.
Team Adoption & Satisfaction - High analyst satisfaction and engagement scores with AI-enabled workflows and copilots.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the UK at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

As a first line of defense, you are expected to bring deep expertise across security operations, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat detection, and incident response, with strong hands-on experience in securing modern cloud-native environments. In addition, you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide security guidance, support, and training to strengthen our organization’s overall security posture.

This position requires participation in a shift rotation to support 24/7 security monitoring and incident response operations.

Responsibilities
- Monitor, investigate, and triage security events to support and enhance threat modeling efforts

- Proactively monitor cloud, network, endpoint to identify suspicious activity and emerging threats

- Document, analyze, and escalate security incidents as needed

- Collaborate with other business units to assess system configurations and ensure secure integration

- Partner with internal stakeholders to define, develop, and implement security standards and best practices

- Conduct quarterly security gap analyses and risk assessments

- Conduct third-party security assessments for new and renewing vendors

Qualifications
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with major cloud service providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

- 5+ years of hands-on experience with endpoint security and detection technologies such as Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, or equivalent platforms.

- 5+ years of experience working with SIEM solutions, including log correlation, alert development, and dashboard creation

- 5+ years of experience in security alert monitoring and incident investigation

- 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including security integration within CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), container security, and automated security testing

- Strong understanding of cloud-native security tools and configurations, including identity and access management, logging/monitoring, and workload protection

- Experience developing automation using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to improve security operations and incident response workflows

- Practical experience with threat hunting techniques and methodologies

- Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to detection engineering and incident analysis

- Strong ability to interpret and analyze security logs, network traffic, and system behaviors to detect attack patterns and anomalies

- In-depth knowledge of network, endpoint, and cloud security technologies and principles

- Demonstrated experience collaborating across global teams and working in cross-functional environments

- Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work independently

- Up-to-date knowledge of recent vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and remediation strategies

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills to support collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders

We have a unique opportunity for a Security Supply Chain & Risk Analyst.

You will also support Procurement and Thales UK suppliers with Defstan 05-138 V4 requirements, as well as Thales UK and Group security requirements for suppliers. - Analyse supplier related security incidents and support Security Incident Team as well manage relevant stakeholders.

- Support business lines and functions assess their risks and advise them on mitigation strategies
- Promote the security risk management policy and process to help improve security culture across the organisation

- Support the business in achieving and/or maintaining security accreditations such as ISO 27001, CE+, IPSA, industry related standards, FSC, NIST, etc.

- Create, review and update relevant documentation related to security risk management and Supply Chain such as policy, process, ToRs, training, etc.

Skills and Experience

- Manage the Regional Strategic Partner Engineering community and help address technical needs.

- Identifier et étudier très en Amont les techniques et technologies à déployer sur nos futurs produits.
