- Définir l'architecture des plateformes matérielles en collaboration étroite avec les Equipes SW (estimation des performances, définition et/ou réutilisation de Building Blocks HW/SW, ...),

- Élaborer des propositions techniques & budgétaires conformément au Processus Offres en vigueur,
- Introduire des nouvelles technologies, après avoir engagé les travaux de levée de risques,
- Justifier les choix techniques et être force de proposition dans l'élaboration des stratégies & roadmaps Produits,
- Assurer un support technique auprès de nos différents clients,
- Participer à la maintenance corrective des produits (recherche de défauts, résolution de problèmes, …)

Vous êtes diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un parcours universitaire avec un Master 2 (BAC +5) en électronique numérique.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance des systèmes électroniques.
Vous maitrisez la définition d'architectures matérielles orientées Numérique et/ou Radio.
Vous avez une expérience en management et en coordination technique.
Vous êtes familier avec le fonctionnement d'une chaine de traitement Radio pour des plateformes SDR embarquées (Air -Terre - Mer) exploitant des composants SoC complexes.
Vous avez développé des systèmes "Safety-Critical"' (application de la norme D0-254 DAL A/B/C).
Vous connaissez les règles d'assemblage des composants pour des produits soumis a des environnements contraints (température, vibrations, chocs).
Vous avez des connaissances générales sur le software et FPGA (méthodologie de développement, outils de développement, vérification et simulation, protocoles de communication bas-niveau, observabilité, cybersécurité).
On vous reconnait pour votre curiosité technique et votre capacité à proposer et à porter des sujets innovants.
Vous avez un véritable esprit d'équipe.

Mot du manager
" Le service Architecture Plateforme Hardware (APH) est composée d’une petite Equipe de spécialistes et experts en charge de définir les futures plateformes matérielles à développer sur des applications majoritairement embarquées (Air, Terre, Mer) nécessitant une maitrise du SWaP (Size Weight and Power)."

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Au sud de Paris, notre site est facilement accessible en transport en commun.

Rattaché au Directeur des Offres, vous êtes en charge d’élaborer des offres à forts enjeux et des propositions techniques complexes (multi domaines Thales) de la phase acquisition dans le domaine des opérations aériennes et des systèmes de défense sol-air. Vous serez aussi amené à élaborer des offres en partenariat avec un ou plusieurs industriels majeurs du secteur.
A ce titre, vous avez pour mission de :
- Produire des réponses à appels d’offre compétitives, innovantes et gagnantes ;

- Porter la stratégie de réponse avec les équipes commerciales, piloter les ressources internes à l’offre, maitriser le planning, questionner les solutions, réaliser les chiffrages et participer à l’établissement de l’offre financière ;

- Préparer et présenter les dossiers de soutenance en interne et auprès des clients,

- Développer et promouvoir nos offres, assurer le support avant-vente auprès de nos clients et accompagner la Direction Commerciale.

- Analyser les besoins de nos clients en phase amont, afin de garantir une bonne qualification des opportunités et d’amener des éléments d’aide à la décision lors des revues de bid / no bid,

- Piloter les acteurs impliqués dans la réponse : financiers, techniques, juridiques, achats, partenaires, sous-traitants,

- Appliquer et respecter l’ensemble des processus et meilleures pratiques du bid management,

- Présenter et valider en interne la proposition technique et financière lors des revues ad hoc,

- Soutenir l’offre auprès de nos clients jusqu’à la signature du contrat,

- Accompagner le dossier lors de la phase de démarrage (transfert de connaissance du contexte client, contrôle du respect des engagements de THALES lors du démarrage),

- Contribuer à l’effort collectif de l’équipe en capitalisant nos propositions commerciales.

postings.title: Senior Category Buyer II
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Category Buyer (CB) may support one or several procurement categories. He/She is accountable for end to end performance of the acquisition process, via the management of the RFI &/or RFP's until the Pvet 4 stage (up to PVet 5 based on some Regions).
The Category Buyer is expected to lead supplier selection exercises to support business needs. He/She ensures the deployment, implementation and monitoring of agreed category strategies.
Furthermore, the CB is:
Responsible for supplier relationship management and continuous improvement of suppliers within his/her category (with the support of Supplier Performance Management Team if needed) and the management of suppliers performance including, but not limited to, quality, cost, delivery, contractual performance and innovation.
An essential element of his/her role is to ensure that the suppliers provide the competitiveness required to support the business and to introduce optimal supply base changes to support business winning capability.
Job Responsibilities:
The Category Buyer (CB) supports one or several procurement categories, working closely with the relevant Global Category Managers (GCM), the Categories Team leader (CTL), the Category Manager (CM) and the Tactical Buyer (TB).
All actions have to be in line with the strategy defined by the Global Category Manager and the CM. The CB's prime role is the management of the RFI or/and RFP's until PVet 4 stage (up to PVet 5 based on some Regions) in order to provide the competitiveness to the business.
In addition to this, the main tasks are:
Operational Support:
- Ensure the BA's (Business Admin/Users) receive all required information to raise the Procurement Orders.
Procurement Competitiveness Capture:
- Monitor the markets for defined categories including key players, newcomers, economic evolutions, market or regulation constraints, innovations and technology in order to support the development of the most up to date category strategies to the businesses.
- Based on the above provide insights as to how products / projects could be more competitive via the adoption of different suppliers / methodologies / technology etc.
- Governance, Leadership and Performance Management
- Ensure appropriate governance is applied using KPI's and root cause corrective actions
Supplier / Acquisition Management:
- Performance management of the supply base in line with the standards set out by the Global Category Manager.
- Ensure that supplier competitions follow the governance process and are balanced and fair in order to improve business and customer performance.
- Ensure that global contracts / framework agreements are adopted and utilized.
- Ensure that Thales e-Acquisition and all THALES procurement tools are fully used.
- Based on the performance management of the supply base, identify the suppliers who require focused development actions and ensure that the Supplier Development Team have the required support / leverage in order for these actions to be successful.
Qualifications:
- Recognized professional qualification (CIPS, EIPM, ISM, MAI...) are desirable.
- Bachelor's degree in business, Procurement, Supply Chain or Engineering.
- 5 to 10 years of relevant experience.
- Experience working in project/program, design/product development with cross functional teams.
- IS/IT Category experience includes IS/IT hardware, software, network equipment, telco services and its equivalent.
- Demonstrates experience in project negotiations and/or categories is desirable.
- Ability to implement operational supply chain strategy.
- Contractual knowledge especially of framework agreements, liability & insurance.
- Ability to lead negotiation including import / export considerations.
- Understanding of the market for the categories under his/her control but also ability to understand the customer’s needs and program issues.
- Good knowledge of a best practice acquisition process.
- Capability to work within cross functional and international multi organizational teams (teamwork).
- Open minded (listen, share ideas etc.) and able to bring added value and new ideas.
- Ability to take initiatives with a good capacity of analysis and of synthesis.
- Ability to prioritize tasks.
- Ability to represent Thales and to demonstrate Thales values.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Senior CloudOps Developer
postings.description:
Location: Vancouver - Pender St, Canada

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

This is a Hybrid position located in Vancouver, BC

Position Summary

A Senior CloudOps Developer bridges development and operations to design, automate, and operate the cloud platform that powers our CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service. This role combines strong software engineering and operational skills to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable systems are delivered and maintained in production.

Essential Functions
- Support the full application and infrastructure stack to ensure the CipherTrust Data Security Platform Service remains highly available, secure, performant, and reliable.
- Design, implement, and maintain observability, monitoring, and synthetic testing to detect issues early and validate service behavior end-to-end.
- Participate in on-call rotation and provide timely incident response through PagerDuty and related operational processes.
- Lead or support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.
- Define, track, and continuously improve SLOs/SLIs to align platform reliability with business expectations.
- Produce clear and actionable monthly operations reports summarizing service health, trends, incidents, and improvement opportunities.
- Leverage Datadog to analyze logs, create and maintain monitoring metrics, and configure dashboards and alerts that support CloudOps activities and platform reliability.
- Analyze operational data and platform metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for automation or optimization.
- Design, build, and maintain automation and internal tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the CloudOps environment.
- Deploy, configure, and maintain application and platform layers of the service, ensuring changes are implemented safely and in accordance with standards.
- Collaborate with architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders to review designs, provide feedback, and help shape scalable and resilient solutions.
- Review peer code and infrastructure changes to ensure quality, maintainability, and compliance with team standards and best practices.
- Develop, test, and document automation and platform components, including runbooks and operational procedures, to support long-term maintainability and operational readiness.

Minimum Requirements
- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or CloudOps, with 3+ years of building and operating cloud-native platforms- Development Application side Experience in deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
- Ability to think in a Cloud Services manner.
- Experience with orchestration toolsets.

- Operations- Understanding of operational concepts like change management, on call rotations, escalations, uptime, etc...
- Experience in managing production systems on a very large scale.
- Experience working with virtualization: VMWare, Hyper-V, etc...
- Experience working with DB’s: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra, etc...

- Software Development Experience with cloud and server architecture- Experience with REST APIs, microservices development and deployment.
- Experience with security-relevant protocols

- OS- Deep understanding of one of the major OS families (Linux or Windows)

- Security- Conscious of security concerns
- Adhere to security best practices from design to implementation and operations

- Automation- Experience with automation technologies (Terraform, Cloud formation, Ansible)
- Experience with CaaS or PaaS technologies (K8s, OpenShift, etc...)
- Experience with IaaS technologies (OpenStack, Azure Stack, etc...)

- Public and Private Cloud- Experience with Public cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
- Experience with Private hosting (Private data centers, Rackspace, etc...)

- Interaction & Communication- Good social interaction with the immediate team as well as other teams
- Ability to work in an extremely geographically distributed company
- Excellent communication skills across multiple mediums.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science

We are seeking an experienced Senior Contracts Manager to provide expert commercial and contractual leadership across bids and contract delivery within IAS UK. This role is critical to enabling the business to win new work, negotiate robust contracts and manage contractual risk throughout the delivery lifecycle. You will work closely with bid, project and operational teams, acting as a trusted advisor on commercial strategy while ensuring obligations are met and opportunities maximised.

Core Benefits:
On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;
- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00

- 24 hours volunteering paid for

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts
- You can read about some of our other benefits here: UK benefits | Thales Group

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS)
Our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.
Paragraph selected from BL list below

Main Responsibilities:
- Lead contractual input across bids and projects, supporting negotiation strategy and contract formation.
- Provide expert commercial advice on terms and conditions, risks, liabilities and opportunities.
- Manage change control, claims and disputes, working with legal and senior stakeholders to protect business interests.
- Oversee financial instruments such as Letters of Credit, bank guarantees and other trade finance arrangements.
- Drive compliance with contract governance, processes and delegation of authority requirements.

Ideal Experience & Skills:
- Strong background in contract and commercial management, ideally within complex or regulated environments.

- Solid understanding of contractual risk, change management, claims and dispute resolution.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, including exposure to international contracting and trade finance.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence at all levels.

Security Clearance Requirement:
UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

- Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Knowledge of customer success planning, health scoring, and outcome-based success frameworks

CPS Asia provides a range of cybersecurity services and solutions to our regional clients with a strong focus for national critical infrastructure. We are seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Consultant to join our team and work with our clients in the region.

The ideal candidate should have good experience in IT systems and architecture. The candidate must be able to identify and mitigate potential cyber risks and threats. The candidate should also have relevant experience on emerging technology trends such as Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and Frontier AI related topics.

The role will require someone who is a problem solver, determined and responsible. He/she brings experience of working with a wide variety of cybersecurity products and solutions within large complex system development. He/she should have the ability to apply cybersecurity concepts and principles to organisational requirements and be able to identify and remediate critical infrastructure systems that were designed without system security considerations. He/she should also possess an open mind and a keen interest to learn about emerging technologies such as PQC and Frontier AI related topics.

The successful candidate will enjoy a rewarding role full of new challenges and be part of a company that provides highly complex solutions in the most critical operational environments where robust safety and resilience standards are applied.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct cybersecurity assessments of clients' IT environment to identify vulnerabilities and risks, particularly on emerging technology trends such as PQC and Frontier AI related topics.

- Independently conduct requirement gathering sessions

- Independently conduct threat and risk assessments and its corresponding threat models

- Develop and implement strategies to protect systems from cyber threats, including malware, ransomware, and unauthorised access.

- Work with clients to implement security controls and measures to reduce the risk of cyber-attacks.

- Provide technical guidance and support to clients' IT teams on cybersecurity best practices.

- Work with the clients' IT teams to integrate systems with enterprise-level cybersecurity measures and solutions.

- Keep up to date with emerging cyber threats and trends in the cybersecurity industry.

- Provide recommendations on cybersecurity policies and procedures for clients.

REQUIREMENTS
- At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on consulting and auditing activities, particularly on emerging technology trends such as PQC and Frontier AI related topics

- Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks, such as IM(ICT&SS), CCoP and NIST CSF.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Willingness to travel to client sites as required.

- Preferred experience working in the Aviation, Transportation, Defense, Public Security and/or Government sectors.

QUALIFICATION, CERTIFICATION & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

- Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)

- Certified Information Security Auditor (CISA)

The below certifications will be advantageous
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP)

postings.title: Senior Data Science & AI Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

In Singapore, TRT strengthens Thales' presence within the scientific and engineering communities by fostering innovation, collaboration, and knowledge sharing while attracting world-class research talent to advance our technological expertise.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Science & AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of intelligent systems that transform operational data into actionable insights, enabling end users to make trusted, data-driven decisions through AI and advanced analytics. The role is based at Thales' Avionics industry and manufacturing facility, working within the Avionics Industry Centre of Excellence (CoE) and collaborating with multiple flight avionics sites.

Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered software, data, and automation solutions following cyber security frameworks and compliance to improve manufacturing operations, engineering processes, and business efficiency within an Agile/Scrum environment.Collaborate with project managers, business users, and engineering teams to gather requirements, develop proof-of-concepts (POCs), and deliver scalable production-ready solutions aligned with business objectives.
- Own the full software development lifecycle, including solution architecture, UI/X design, coding, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, deployment, maintenance, and technical documentation.
- Design, build, and maintain scalable DataOps and MLOps pipelines, ensuring reliable data integration, processing, model deployment, monitoring, and governance.
- Develop AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and workflow automation to enhance engineering productivity and operational decision-making.
- Integrate data from enterprise and manufacturing systems, including MES, ERP, IoT devices, sensors, manufacturing databases, and engineering applications, while ensuring data quality, security, and compliance.
- Design and implement intelligent automation, alerting, and notification systems that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency.
- Collaborate closely with IT infrastructure teams and operational stakeholders (such as providing user training and gather user requirement and feedback) to deploy secure, scalable, and reliable AI solutions while continuously monitoring and optimizing solution performance and measurable business impact and efficiency gain.Produce and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, user guides, and reusable knowledge assets to support long-term maintenance and knowledge transfer.
- Contribute to a culture of innovation by continuously exploring emerging AI technologies, sharing knowledge, and driving the adoption of best practices across the team.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years of relevant industry experience in software engineering, AI application development, or manufacturing digitalization.
- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in Java, C#, or JavaScript considered an advantage, and hands-on experience building RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
- Practical experience developing AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, Mistral, Ollama, or similar technologies. Experience with Dataiku and GCP data engineering services is an advantage.
- Solid understanding of data engineering, DataOps, MLOps, SQL databases, enterprise system integration, containerization (Docker), Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI solutions.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership, and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Senior Digital Hardware Engineer
postings.description:
Localizacion : Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

Thales Alenia Space people architect and deliver satellite-based systems that help position, connect and observe our planet, and push the boundaries of our understanding of planet's resources. Our systems are in orbit at 400 km, 20000 km, 36000 km and beyond to the edges of the solar system.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Join one of Europe's leading space engineering teams and design the next generation of telecommunications satellites. Design advanced FPGA-based hardware and work with state-of-the-art digital technologies, high-speed interfaces and space-qualified electronics in an international engineering environment where your designs will fly in orbit for more than 15 years.

As part of our Digital Hardware team, you will contribute to the development of cutting-edge telecommunications satellites, working alongside experts in FPGA design, signal integrity, embedded processing and space-qualified electronics.

What you will do:
- Define digital architectures for next-generation telecommunication satellites.
- Design complex boards based on FPGAs, microprocessors and high-speed digital interfaces.
- Develop solutions involving DDR memories, SpaceWire, high-speed serial links and advanced processing architectures.
- You will work with technologies including Xilinx Kintex UltraScale, Microchip PolarFire and RTG4 FPGAs, DDR4 memories, SpaceWire interfaces and multi-gigabit serial links.
- Perform signal integrity and power integrity analyses.
- Lead technical decisions throughout the complete product lifecycle, from concept to qualification.
- Collaborate with international multidisciplinary teams across Europe.
- You will have significant technical ownership of the hardware architecture and will influence key design decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

Required
- 5+ years in digital electronic design.
- FPGA and/or processor-based designs.
- High-speed digital electronics (Such as 1GB+ Ethernet, PCIe, SpaceFibre, Aurora, WizardLink, etc.).
- Board development lifecycle.

Nice to have
- Space industry experience.
- ECSS standards.
- Radiation-tolerant FPGAs.
- Hyperlynx or equivalent SI tools.
- RISC-V architectures.
- VITA Standard
- Knowledge of design tools: LTspice, Simplis/Simetrix, OrCAD, …

We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet every preferred qualification. We value potential, motivation and the ability to learn as prior experience.

Languages:
- Good written and verbal Spanish and English as a minimum. French knowledge will be valued.

What do we offer?
- Work on real satellite hardware operating in orbit.
- Long-term participation in flagship European space programs.
- Hybrid working model (40% remote work, 60% work at the Tres Cantos facility).
- Flexible schedule and excellent work-life balance.
- Individual career development plan and technical growth path.
- Continuous training on advanced digital electronics and FPGA technologies.
- Free meals at the office.
- Pension plan.
- 28 business days of vacation plus Christmas and Easter weeks.

Join us and help design the electronics that will power the next generation of telecommunications satellites. Your work will contribute to systems operating hundreds of kilometers above Earth and serving customers worldwide.
We will consider being in possession of a certificate of disability.
Thales is a company committed to equal opportunities between women and men, and for this reason, we work to raise awareness and disseminate information on the subject both internally and externally.

postings.title: Senior Electronics Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Reading, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Senior Electronics Engineer
Reading - Hybrid Working

Thales OME designs a range of state-of-the-art solutions for some of the most technically advanced defence and security platforms in the world, and we’re seeking talented engineers who can apply their knowledge and skills in an electronics role.
We have over 100 years’ experience in design and manufacture of state-of-the-art Periscopes and Optronics and have led Optronics innovation on a global scale, by combining world-leading expertise from across the Thales group.

Overview

This role covers all aspects of the product lifecycle, from requirements through specification, concept studies, design and development, integration, validation and qualification. This is a great opportunity for an experienced electronics engineer to build technical skills, widen their systems understanding and develop their career.

Key responsibilities of the role
- Undertake design of complex electronic circuit assemblies or architectures, from concept through to system integration & qualification
- Lead discussions with a multi-disciplinary team (systems, mechanical, software, safety, etc) to develop an optimum solution
- Work collaboratively with the project team to ensure products meet all their requirements and comply with regulatory safety and environmental standards
- Contribute to the development of the wider electronics team, including mentoring junior members of staff, overseeing the implementation of improvements and reviewing the work of peers
- Generate electronics specifications, architectures, and development or verification plan
- Support the bid process through generation of estimates and consultancy on electronic solution
- Present robust engineering solutions at design reviews
- Monitor progress of work against cost, schedule and performance

Experience and skill required

We are looking for a forward thinking individual with the following skills and experience:
- Experience of electronic design throughout the design lifecycle
- Previous use of schematic capture packages (Cadence, Mentor Graphics or similar)
- Development of electronic products in a formal environment
- Experience testing at circuit board and system level (eg. board bring-up and debug, EMC testing)
- Preparation of sub-system requirements/procurement specs
- General understanding of engineering process and design lifecycles

What we can offer

We’re committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.
Our packages will include bonus, a strong pension contribute plan matched up to 7%, Private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities.

Flexibility

Your health and well-being matters to us and that’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, home working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times. Where possible, we support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions.

Connect with Fiona Tal, Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-FT1 who is eager to explore together with you this exciting opportunity.

UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

Engineer & SR Engineer –Avionics SW

Thales India Engineering Competency Center is seeking a Engineer/Sr Engineer to be part of its Avionics Flight Display Systems. The Engineer/Sr Engineer is in charge of the software development activities (Requirement Capturing, Design, Code and V&V), in order to deliver software that meet requirements coming from a Business Lines (B/L), with the adequate quality and maturity level, within schedule and budget.

Location: Thales India Private Limited, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025.

As a Engineer/Sr Engineer, you will be a major actor in the software development phase using approach with C /Embedded C. In more details:
- Development of Application Software with a good understanding of architectures, multi thread program development, requirements, algorithms, interfaces and designs for avionics systems (Flight Display System) as per DO178B/C standards

- To perform Development free hands testing & regression on existing features.
- Ensure quality deliveries before hand-off to Quality Assurance teams for further testing and verification.

Minimum Skills/Experience:

- EXPERT in Memory usage & execution time allocation.
- Good understanding of Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA)
- Candidate should be Strong in RTRT
- Knowledge in Data Structures.
- Good experience on Cockpit Display and Graphics, Primary Flight Display, Multi-Functional Display, Flight Management System functionality

Senior Engineer - System Engineering
Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Solution Engineer for MCO equipment, to be part of MCO engineering team.
In this role you will be in charge of Engineering activities to demonstrate the compliance and functionalities of equipment in front of Design Changes with same form-fit-functionalities. You establish the Change Impact Analysis, and perform the Simulation, analysis and verification activities.

Context of Design in MCO activities for FLX Cockipit and Computers,
After the first certification of our Equipments, during serial production and support phases, our equipment are regularly submitted to Design Changes. These Design Change involving partial redesign, are mainly due to obsolescence treatment, necessary correction to solve critical PR (Problem Report).; or enhancement improvement of equipment capabilities. These design changes vary from minor changes (component change with limited impact) to more significant change where all the safety, qualification, and certification information have to be re-assessed regarding airworthiness regulation, all the Design Changes must be submitted to customer approval before release.

Our Equipments are Computers (as Flight Control, Flight Management, Display, Interactivity Control Panel, Head up Display)
Our team is focused on Hardware Changes (electronics, packaging .. )

Qualifications: Equipment engineering or equivalent with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in aeronautic. Higher qualifications of Post-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in civil Avionics design is desirable.

Responsibilities:
- Establish Impact Analysis of electronics Design Changes
- Understand the applicable documentation basis (from specification to IVVQ and safety BOM data package).

- Propose the validation plan

- Build the Simulation/analysis, and establish the entire necessary demonstration to obtain our PDA (followed by Customer) approval,

- Prepare all the customer satisfactory certification documentation (expected example) and reviews

- Perform the complementary testing and IVV at equipment level.

- Coordinate with stakeholders and specialists in a collaborative manner for

- Electronics Engineers when boards or FPGA are modified

- Packaging :Environmental testing when Qualification test are repeated

- Test Bench and Means : industrialization & Production Support , Acceptances Tests in manufacturing

- Configuration Management team

- Project Managers

Skills & experience:
- Must have strong knowledge in Electronics (analog and digital) design and development.
- Should be able to analyze electronics circuits individually.

- Should be able to select alternate electronics components (Active, Passive and Connector) individually

- Should be able to read schematic, Bill of materials and Layout file.

- Must have high awareness of Airworthiness, Aeronautic Safety requirements and standards. ( as per ARP4761 or ARP4754 )

- Must have strong experience with aeronautic standard (DO-160 environment , DO-254, ARP4754, ARP4761; APQP)

- Must have strong experience to troubleshoot on electronics and embedded hardware systems to find the root cause and to fix with a suitable solution

- Must have experience in interfacing with external test facilities for environmental and EMI/EMC and other electrical tests as per MIL-STD and DO-160 standards

- Should be familiar in developing Qualification Test procedures (QTPs), Qualification Test Reports (QTR), Qualification by similarity reports (QBSR) and other documents required by airborne certification authorities

- Must be fluent with on Configuration Management data package (Build of Materials, Definition File, Identification, Design Change Rules)

Must be fluent with tools and data repositories: as BDDP and PLM/TOL/GED
- Experience in establishing Design Documentation (Requirement, IVVQ procedure, reports)

- Should be familiar with mechanical drawings, wiring diagram reading and understanding.

- Should be familiar in Industrialization, Production process, Testing, (Acceptance test, Screening testing ) ideally experience on APQP

- Should be familiar in the IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation and Qualification) including requirements management

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Senior Engineer- HW PCBA ECAD
Primary Purpose of the Role
He / She contributes to the hardware PCBA ECAD development and IVVQ (integration, verification, validation & qualification) activities required to develop a test bench solution and/or HW building blocks associated with it. Performs hardware PCBA ECAD development activities and generates associated manufacturing definition files… generating Schematic and PCBA Gerber file to meet the test bench requirements as well as governing regulatory standards (CE, UL, IPC-610 etc.). Identifies the key BOM and compliance to ROHS, WEEE & REACH standard. Contributes to co-engineering activities with the hardware, mechanical, IVVQ and Systems Engineering team. Performs development activity as per the CHORUS 2.0 process.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks
- Develop ECAD activity in line with project requirements.
- Review of PCBA design input requirements / data and ensure timely collaboration with cross-functional teams for resolution as required to progress the ECAD design per schedule.
- Define PCB Stack-up, Layer set-up and PCB Layout execution.
- Execute the Digital, analog and RF based design boards as per Thales Design specification.
- Implement DFM, DFA, DFT principles and design for thermal, mechanical, EMC constraints.
- Perform ECAD deliverables review with necessary stakeholders and ensure on time review closure.
- Perform Layout updates in line with electrical design updates and or requirements.
- Provide industrialization support for the board design: Implementation of supplier feedback as required.
- Adhere to the quality management practices deployed for the project.
- Ensuring error-free release of Gerber, BOM and Fabrication/Assembly drawings as per Thales Guidelines.
- Participates in the integration activities and verification phases of PCBA solution in test benches/ building blocks.

Skills Required
Essential
- Understanding of PCB / CCA design input requirements
- Mixed signal / analog / digital and Radio Frequency board design.
- PCB Layout generation.
- Hands on experience in the following tools
- Cadence Allegro. (Concept HDL Entry and Allegro PCB layout)
- OrCAD Capture CIS
- DFx concepts and its implementation.
- IPC and industry standards associated with printed circuit board (PCB) and circuit card assembly (CCA) design.
- Design for thermal, mechanical, EMC constraints of PCB / CCA
- Design for manufacturing, assembly and testing (DFM , DFA , DFT) of PCB / CCA
- Signal Integrity concepts and its implementation.
- Materials, technologies and processes for PCB & CCA manufacturing.
- PCB / CCA Design Data Package for fabrication and assembly (Data files, Bill of Material or Item List, Item, Documents, components, COTS, Find Number, Material & Processes Item, etc.)
- Working with multi-disciplinary team (Electronics design, Mechanical design and System engineering teams).
- Experienced in DESIGN to PRODUCTION project lifecycle and associated PCB / CCA processes.
- ECAD activity estimation and schedule generation.

COTS Test & Measurement equipment
Knowledge and ability to select instruments to meet test needs

HW IVVQ Testing
- Hands-on usage of instruments and test set-ups
- Aware of test standards associated with CE marking, DO 160

Desirable
RF Domain knowledge
RF HW design tools (Keysight ADS or equivalent)

Manufacturing
Manufacturing control process IPC – 610

Years of experience
5 to 10 years of Industry experience

Educational Qualification: Graduate/ master's degree in engineering in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation or equivalent

Certifications
Signals and Systems, Electrical Safety, CAD Knowledge

Technologies and Programming Languages
Electronics - Electronics Design. Test and Measurements

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Senior Engineering Delivery Manager (F/H)
postings.description:
Lieu : Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

Description du projet / rôle / missions
Au sein de la Business Line Identity, Biometrics & Security (IBS), l’activité Border & Travel développe des solutions critiques permettant aux gouvernements et autorités aux frontières de gérer les flux de voyageurs, de renforcer la sécurité et d’améliorer l’expérience passager. En tant qu’Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM), vous pilotez la delivery des activités d’ingénierie de bout en bout, en veillant au respect des besoins clients, des engagements contractuels, de la baseline technique et des jalons projet. En étroite collaboration avec le Project Design Authority, garant de la solution et du « quoi », vous êtes responsable du « comment » de son exécution.
Vos principales missions seront de :
- Organiser et coordonner les équipes d’ingénierie et Work Package Managers couvrant les systèmes, logiciels, hardware, IVVQ, intégration et expertises spécialisées ;
- Piloter la delivery en garantissant le respect de l’architecture, des exigences, des contraintes de sûreté/sécurité et des pratiques d’ingénierie Thales ;
- Construire et suivre le plan de delivery engineering, en pilotant coûts, délais, qualité, risques, problématiques et KPI, et assurer le reporting auprès des équipes projet et engineering ;
- Travailler avec le Project Design Authority afin de garantir la cohérence technique de la solution, d’arbitrer les choix et de maîtriser les évolutions de la baseline ;
- Fédérer les différents interlocuteurs, notamment équipes projet, Product Management, clients et partenaires, et contribuer à l’analyse des exigences, au contrôle du périmètre et aux négociations techniques ;
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques d’ingénierie, à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience ainsi qu’aux offres, estimations et études d’impact liées aux évolutions de la solution.

Votre profil
Vous avez envie de piloter la réalisation de systèmes complexes et critiques, au cœur d’enjeux de sécurité et de mobilité internationale ?
Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international, à l’interface entre ingénierie, projet, clients et partenaires ?
Vous aimez donner un cap aux équipes, structurer la delivery et arbitrer des sujets complexes en conciliant contraintes techniques, coûts, délais et qualité ?
De formation ingénieur, Bac+5 en informatique, systèmes, IT ou domaine équivalent, vous disposez de 10 ans ou plus d’expérience en management de projets techniques ou en engineering delivery sur des programmes complexes.
Vous disposez notamment d’une solide expérience sur :
- Le cycle de vie des systèmes, le System Engineering et les processus de management de projet ;
- L’IVVQ, l’intégration et la validation de systèmes complexes, idéalement dans des environnements software-intensive ou critiques ;
- Le pilotage d’équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales, de Work Packages, budgets, plannings, risques et indicateurs de performance ;
- L’arbitrage entre enjeux techniques, coûts, délais, qualité et performance opérationnelle ;
- Des outils collaboratifs tels que Jira, Confluence et les outils de planification/reporting.

Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité d’influence et votre excellente communication, notamment avec des interlocuteurs techniques, clients et de niveau senior.
Une expérience dans les domaines du contrôle aux frontières, de la biométrie, de l’identité numérique, de la sécurité ou des systèmes opérationnels à grande échelle constitue un plus.

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Senior Engineering Manager
postings.description:
Location: Glasgow, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME)

We help forces to find the right information at the right time to make the right decision. For over 130 years we’ve proudly led the development of Optronics for military, scientific and commercial use. We cover three sectors: Air, Land and Sea.

Senior Engineering Manager

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Engineering Manager within Thales Optronics and Missile Electronics (OME). The successful candidate will initially undertake the role of a Senior Engineering Manager in the Sea business.

This role will be on one of the largest development and production projects within OME. This role will be part of the leadership team for a large multi-entity delivery team focussed on specific development within the Sea business.

As a Senior Engineering Manager you will work in collaboration with the overall Programme Director, the Senior Programme Managers, the Sea Portfolio Engineering Manager and the Head of Engineering Delivery to lead the design and development through to qualification and acceptance for development and production projects within OME and the Sea business.

In this role you will be responsible for:
- forming and leading high performing, large multi-discipline and multi-entity engineering teams to generate engineering solutions that meet the Customer needs
- producing the strategy that will ensure delivery of all engineering aspects of the programme whilst meeting the governance required within the business
- working with the Programme Manager and Programme Director to define the organisation and work breakdown required to deliver to the Customer needs
- defining the project specific processes, practices and tools to be used to ensure delivery
- defining and being in charge of meeting cost, schedule and quality of the whole engineering delivery for the programme
- defining the engineering team’s work packages in terms of resources required, budgets assigned to each task, risks and assumptions on these and the timescales to deliver within
- the planning and prioritisation of activities required to deliver the solution to the contract schedule, costs and quality
- the day to day management of the engineering team’s activities ensuring proactive management of issues, opportunities and risks
- managing and reporting the engineering efficiency for the project
- the identification of re-use opportunities across the project
- the alignment of the project defined solution to the Product Roadmap
- acting as the People Manager for the engineering team on the project and provide feedback into the people manager reviews with the functional discipline leads

The successful candidate will have an extensive background in engineering and engineering management on large complex development programmes with demonstrable experience in successfully defining and leading the delivery of multi-disciplinary engineering projects.

They will be highly customer focused with excellent communication skills and have the ability to work in a fast moving environment with multiple parallel objectives. Knowledge and experience of naval products and projects would be beneficial to this role.

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following, aligned to the Thales Leadership Behavioural Model:
- acting with agility to ensure that the business objectives remain in focus
- dealing with multiple strands of complexity to achieve business objectives
- engaging with stakeholders to achieve a common goal
- creating a competitive advantage by managing risk, identifying opportunities and fostering continuous improvement
- supporting the development of others to ensure we continuously improve for our customers

Benefits:
- Performance-related bonus (grade dependent)
- Car cash allowance (grade dependent)
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare (grade dependent)
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

This role will work closely with the Programme Manager and the Project Design Authority (PDA) for the specific project. This role will report to the Sea Portfolio Engineering Manager.

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

#LI-MC2
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

postings.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Platform
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

We’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries - from the bottom of the oceans to the depths of space and cyberspace - and from manufacturing to engineering, we work together to build a future we can all trust.

Imperva, a Thales company, is a globally recognized cybersecurity leader, dedicated to securing data and applications across diverse environments. Our cutting-edge solutions empower organizations to safeguard their most critical assets, ensuring robust protection against emerging threats.
Imperva, a Thales company, protects the world's largest organizations from cyberattacks. Our Platform Engineering group builds the foundation and developer experience powering Imperva's application security products.
We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Data Platform group — owning the pipelines, storage, and streaming infrastructure, deployed on AWS, that power data-driven capabilities across the company, including an emerging AI agent for forensic data investigation.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end delivery for the group — roadmap, execution, and Agile/SAFe process.

- Hire, mentor, and grow a team of engineers.

- Guide architecture and technical direction for scalable data pipelines (real-time and batch), streaming (Kafka), and processing frameworks (Spark/Flink).

- Oversee the platform's AWS infrastructure and cloud architecture decisions.

- Ensure sound data storage design across relational, NoSQL, and search systems.

- Drive improvements in reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

- Guide the team's development of an AI agent for forensic use cases, including MCP tool design for safe, effective data access.

- Represent the group across a matrixed org and partner with product teams.

Requirements :

- 10+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams, ideally in a matrixed organization.

- Strong background in Data Platform or Big Data engineering within a cloud-native, high-scale environment, with experience designing and operating large-scale, data-intensive systems.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems and data platform concepts, including scalability, partitioning, consistency, fault tolerance, performance, and reliability.

- Sufficient hands-on technical and coding depth to guide architecture, review designs and code, and troubleshoot complex production issues.

- Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot, Kafka or similar streaming technologies, and Kubernetes.

- Solid experience with AWS/Azure/GCP and etc.

- Strong experience with PostgreSQL/RDS, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, and NoSQL databases, including the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs.

- Working knowledge of AI agent architectures and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar standards.

- Strong communication skills and sound judgment under pressure

Advantages:

- Observability tooling; MLOps exposure.

- Hands-on experience building AI agents or MCP servers.

Thales, champions inclusion and we believe diversity strengthens the fabric of our culture. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

postings.title: Senior Front-End Developer (UI Components & Design Tokens) – Quantum
postings.description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

Role: Senior Front-End Developer (UI Components & Design Tokens) – Quantum

If you enjoy bridging design and development and turning Figma logic into robust, accessible component libraries, this role is for you! 🫵
Help us mature Quantum: components, patterns, tokens, theming, and premium UI at scale.

About the Design System and the Team:

Quantum, the Thales digital Design System, is a strategic pillar adopted by more than 300 designers and 2,000 developers across the Group. It enhances our brand image and enables the creation of premium user experiences, while supporting the company’s overall performance.
By joining the product team responsible for Quantum, you will participate in the design, evolution, and maintenance of the Design System. As the true common foundation for all our digital products, our Design System ensures brand and design coherence and the operational efficiency of Thales interfaces at scale.

Quantum Design System Overview:

Design: design libraries (on Figma and other design tools), covering color palettes, typographies, layout structures, elevation levels, icon systems, components, patterns, templates, and guidelines. Each component has been meticulously designed in various states, resulting in hundreds of variants.
Dev: The system includes comprehensive implementation packages and documentation, based on a single source of truth via design tokens. It supports all major web technologies, as well as extensions for desktop applications.
Quantum is built on a hybrid contribution model: a central team (2 designers, 2 front-end developers) operates in Agile-Kanban and collaborates with a guild of 30 contributors across Thales entities.

Our Target:

We are looking for an experienced developer, passionate about design, capable of bridging design and development, and contributing to a robust, scalable, and inspiring system for teams.

Who are you?

- A senior developer with at least 8 years’ experience, including 2–3 years in a Design System team
- You have a strong UI culture and attention to detail, ensuring visual consistency and quality
- You collaborate effectively with designers thanks to your understanding of design logic
- You like to structure, rationalize, and document to make development reusable and scalable
- You inspire confidence and leadership, and can bring others along in a collective approach
- Your Mindset?
- Curious and proactive: you enjoy exploring, proposing, and thinking beyond the obvious
- Rigorous and passionate, with a systemic approach
- Autonomous and humble: you can self-train and know that nuance is a strength
- Impact- and learning-oriented: you’re here to build as much as to learn, in a changing environment
- Inspiring and collaborative: you share your energy and good practices to help the team and community grow
- Comfortable with uncertainty: you can navigate non-fixed contexts and provide well-considered solutions

Your Skills and Experience:

- Strong expertise in modern UI development, with a sharp eye for detail and a solid understanding of UI principles: accessibility, code quality, and design rigor.
- Advanced knowledge of web development fundamentals: HTML, CSS (pre/post processors a plus), JavaScript/TypeScript, and experience building and maintaining component libraries in a collaborative IDE environment.
- Proficient in translating design assets from Figma to code (experience with Penpot is a plus).
- Demonstrated experience integrating and developing accessible components and interfaces to meet at least AA accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).
- Experience implementing and consuming design tokens, supporting theming and scalable design patterns, with a strong interest in advancing this area.
- Awareness of UX design methodologies (user research, usability testing, etc.) and comfort participating in, or facilitating, workshops with designers and stakeholders.
- Capacity to thrive in a hybrid and agile environment, favoring collaboration and contribution
- Strong communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams
- Strong, stimulating, and flexible leadership
- Excellent command of English (C1 level minimum) and professional proficiency in French is desirable but not mandatory

🚀 Does this sound like you? Let’s talk missions!

Your Mission:

Under the operational responsibility of the Tech Lead of the Design System, you will play a key role in advancing Quantum, our Design System, to a new level of maturity. Quantum is currently undergoing an ambitious transformation: implementation of an advanced Design Token system, creation of a brand-new visual language, while consolidating the development libraries. As such, you will be at the heart of strategic developments, take part in scaling to the next version, and support the smooth adoption of these innovations within the organization. By joining the Thales Quantum Design System team, you will play a key role in evolving our Design System.

Your missions will include:

- Designing and developing design system components using a code-first approach and best development practices, ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability.
- Collaborating closely with the Design Lead and Tech Lead to tackle large-scale design system challenges, and contribute to technical decisions and architectural choices.
- Gathering and understanding user needs and behaviors in collaboration with UX specialists, and participating in UX activities such as interviews, workshops, and user testing to inform component development.
- Contributing to and implementing a complete visual review of the design system, ensuring developed components elevate the brand and align with premium design standards.
- Structuring, implementing, and maintaining design tokens, including the modeling, management, and automation required for scalability and multi-theme support.
- Translating design specifications and prototypes into robust, reusable code.
- Contributing to comprehensive documentation, formalization, and support of the design system, explaining usage to the internal developer and designer community and supporting adoption.
- Acting as a UI and frontend reference within the team and broader community: participating in code/design reviews and sharing best coding and UI practices.
- Staying informed about advancements and best practices in design systems, frontend development, and related technologies.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Senior Industrial Engineer (m/w/d) Industrialisierung & Produktion
postings.description:
Standort: Ulm, Germany

We say HI*

Senior Industrial Engineer (m/w/d) Industrialisierung & Produktion
in Voll- oder Teilzeit - zunächst befristet auf 2 Jahre
Am Standort Ulm #LI-ONSITE
(Ref. Nr. R0316294)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

In Ulm erwarten Sie Kommunikationslösungen für Raumfahrtmissionen und elektrische Satelliten-Triebwerke. Hier sind Sie richtig, wenn Sie gemeinsam mit uns Wanderfeldröhren-Verstärker entwickeln wollen, die an Bord der meisten Satelliten im Einsatz sind und dort für die Signalübertragung zur Erde sorgen. Oder schlägt ihr Herz für umweltfreundliche, elektrische Triebwerke? Dann werden Sie Teil des Thales-Expertenteams für Raumfahrtkomponenten, die nachhaltiges Leben auf der Erde möglich machen. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

Ihre Mission

Sie entwickeln zukunftsfähige Produktionsstrukturen, begleiten die Industrialisierung neuer Produkte und sorgen gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams für effiziente, stabile und wettbewerbsfähige Produktionsprozesse. Dabei verbinden Sie technische, wirtschaftliche und strategische Anforderungen und setzen gezielt LEAN-Methoden und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse ein.

Dies beinhaltet außerdem folgende Aufgaben

- Entwicklung und Optimierung von Produktionslayouts, Wertströmen und Materialflüssen

- Planung und Weiterentwicklung effizienter industrieller Produktionsstrukturen

- Begleitung der Industrialisierung von der Angebotsphase bis zu Serienreife

- Steuerung von Produkt- Produktionstransfers sowie Ramp-Ups/Kapazitätserweiterungen

- Anwendung von LEAN-Methoden, KVP und Wertstromoptimierungen zur nachhaltigen Effizienzsteigerung

- Analyse von Prozessreife, Risiken und Chancen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen

- Bewertung von Kosten, Investitionen und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Unterstützung bei strategischen Entscheidungen

- Fachliche Koordination interdisziplinärer Projektteams und Zusammenarbeit mit internen sowie externen Partnern

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Ingenieurwissenschaften, Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Industrial Engineering oder vergleichbar

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Produktionsplanung oder Industrialisierung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Produktionsplanung, Fertigungstechnologie und industriellen Prozessen sowie im technischen Projektmanagement und in der Steuerung komplexer Industrieprojekte

- Mehrjährige nachweisbare Erfahrung in den Bereichen Werks-/Linienplanung, Layout- und Materialflusskonzeption, LEAN-Methoden, KVP sowie Wertstromoptimierung

- Kenntnisse in Kostenanalyse, Investitionsplanung und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtung

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französischkenntnisse sind vorteilhaft

- Ausgeprägte analytische, kommunikative und durchsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2024 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 20,6 Milliarden Euro.
Für mehr als 83.000 Mitarbeitende in 68 Ländern eröffnen wir zukunftsweisende Perspektiven, verwirklichen individuelle Karrierewege und ermöglichen kreative Freiräume. Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.
