From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

WHO ARE WE?
The Job Holder will be part of the Legal, Contract and Compliance (LC&C) Department of Thales international division (DGDI) for Southeast Asia. The LC&C Department support all Thales’ businesses in Southeast Asia (“the Region”).
Within DGDI, you report hierarchically to the Legal, Contract and Compliance Director for Southeast Asia.
Thales has been present and has grown from strength to strength in the Asian region for over 50 years, providing state-of-the-art solutions for customers in the avionics, secure communications and information systems, defense mission systems and strategy, research and technology, and digital security domains. The position particularly covers Defense & Security, Air Management Systems, Research & Development activities in Singapore and in the Region.

WHO ARE YOU?
· You hold an advanced academic background in Law, Contract Management, Business, or related field, equivalent to a Master’s degree‑level qualification (EU/UK/SG/US or other comparable higher‑education systems) including a Specialization in Law,
· You have 10 to 15 years of demonstrated experience as a legal counsel or contract manager working in an international context and as part of the legal department of a multinational company,
· Endowed with analytical and synthesis skills, you assess situations accurately and can easily propose pragmatic solutions,
· You understand the stakes associated with a major international Group’s compliance program,
· You master the techniques related to third-party review (third-party screening) and are able to conduct compliance analyses,
· During your experience, you have developed strong proactivity towards stakeholders and good ability to manage priorities,
· You have appetite in leadership and coaching, fostering your others growth
· You enjoy sharing your experiences and best practices, with a collective and collaborative mindset,
· You also have good listening and communication skills,
· You are keen to work in diverse teams and have inter-cultural awareness and interest,
· You have full mastery of IT tools, all types of data exchange platforms, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint,
· You can travel on regular basis over the Region (up to once a month) and from time-to-time to Europe (up to once a year).

WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGETHER?
The Job Holder will lead the contract management function for the assigned portfolios and will provide day-to-day and strategic oversight of the Contract Manager currently supporting these activities. The role includes managing performance, ensuring contractual compliance, setting standards and processes, and ensuring timely and effective execution across the contract lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities:
- Own contract lifecycle delivery for the perimeter
- Lead negotiation strategy and provide commercial/legal recommendations
- Manage contract risks and ensure governance processes are followed
- Manage the Contract Manager: set priorities, run regular check-ins, coach, review outputs, ensure quality, and escalate risks
- Maintain auditable contract documentation and reporting
1. Contractual Support for Tender, Offers, Variations & Extensions
· Recommend contractual structures that enhance competitiveness while respecting applicable regulations and internal governance
· Draft, revise, and negotiate contractual documents with customers, partners, and subcontractors
· Contribute to internal risk reviews, financial exposure assessments, and mitigation plans
· Ability to identify opportunities to protect or improve the project's financial performance
· Support the capture and preparation of variations, extensions, new phases or related offers connected to existing program
· Prepare and present contractual sections of internal approval documentation, including clear recommendations to management
2. Contract Management Throughout Project Execution
· Establish, manage, and continuously update the contractual baseline from contract signature to project closure
· Ensure full contractual awareness across the project team, enabling correct application of obligations, rights, deadlines, and deliverables
· Anticipate deviations and manage them proactively through contractual notices, waivers, amendments, claims, clarification requests, and other contractual instruments
· Anticipate and drive the project’s risk and opportunity strategy, in close collaboration with project leadership, including claim preparation, defensive measures, and value‑protection initiatives, proposing defensible, practical solutions
· Oversee all incoming and outgoing contractual communications with the customer, ensuring consistency, traceability, and strategic alignment
· Coordinate with the Litigation Department when disputes arise, including fact‑finding, documentation, evidence management, and support to legal strategy
· Handle contractual aspects of key subcontractors and suppliers or coordinate with dedicated contract management teams where applicable
3. People Management, Governance, Leadership & Coordination
· The position includes 1 direct report: Lead and manage the Contract Manager’s day-to-day activities, including prioritization of workload, assignment of contract tasks, and escalation of risks.
o Set clear objectives and performance expectations for the Contract Manager; conduct regular 1:1 meetings and agreed check-ins.
o Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and structured feedback on contract drafting/review quality.
o Ensure the Contract Manager adheres to company contract governance processes (e.g., approval workflows, recordkeeping, version control).
o Drive consistent contract interpretation and commercial decision-making aligned with company policy and risk appetite.
· Act as the reference point for all contractual matters within the perimeter
· Provide strategic and operational contractual advice to internal stakeholders
· Participate in departmental initiatives such as improving templates, tools, and best practices, contributing expertise linked to complex project execution
4. Compliance Activities
Although the role is primarily focused on contract management, you will:
· Support relevant compliance processes for the tenders and projects (e.g., third‑party screenings) in coordination with the Compliance Officer (Antitrust, Anticorruption, Personal Data Protection (incl. GDPR), Trade compliance & Duty of vigilance), in particular:
· Escalate any potential non‑compliance issues where required.
5. Transversal Activities
· Provide country legal intelligence and knowledge to the relevant global, regional, or corporate stakeholders
· Interface with external counsels for analysis and management of specific legal issues in the framework of complex contractual and/or legal arrangements or claim/litigation procedures in the Region on a need-basis,
· Participate in a cross-functional working group for Legal, Contract and Compliance Department (contract management, IP, standard contracts, insurance…),
· Contribute to the development and delivery of training to operational teams (compliance, contract management,…)

WHAT WE OFFER
· A unique opportunity to manage the contractual dimension of a flagship, technically complex program in Singapore.
· High impact, visibility, and autonomy within the organization.
· Exposure to senior internal stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.
· A collaborative and international working environment.

- 5–7 years of IT infrastructure experience.

Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Senior Missile Architect (IAS)
Known internally as Missile Architect
Location: based in Belfast, 4.5 days/ week in office (onsite), with
Other: permanent, full-time, for eligible candidates, relocation support can be provided

This is an opportunity for a senior technical leader to drive the architectural vision for future missile systems while influencing strategy, investment, and technology direction across the business.

What the role has to offer

- Shape the Future of Missile Capability - take a leading role in defining next-generation missile architectures, influencing technology choices, product strategies, and future capability roadmaps that will underpin tomorrow's defence solutions
- End-to-End Product Lifecycle Exposure - shape missile capability across the full product lifecycle, from concept and innovation through to delivery and support. With exposure to diverse technologies, programmes, and stakeholders, you'll develop broad architectural expertise while making a tangible impact at every stage
- Strategic Technical Leadership - operate at the intersection of engineering, innovation, and business strategy, providing technical leadership across concept development, bids, investment planning, and technology maturation activities

Our Opportunity

As a Senior Missile Architect, you will be at the forefront of shaping the next generation of missile and effector capability. Leading the assessment, selection, and integration of advanced technologies, you'll define future architectures that deliver operational advantage and underpin long-term product strategy.

You'll provide technical leadership across multiple technology domains, driving architectural decisions from early concept through to strategic capability planning. Drawing on broad experience across missile technologies, potentially including missile effectiveness and operational analysis, you'll influence both current and future solutions.

This is a high-impact role with significant visibility across the business. You'll lead concept studies, support major bids, shape technology investment priorities, and influence future capability roadmaps. Working closely with customers, partners, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams, you'll play a key role in defining the technologies and architectures that will deliver tomorrow's defence capabilities.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) - our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

What we offer you

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing and professional growth, which includes:

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

Main Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership, governance, and guidance for missile and effector concept development activities and bids
- Lead the development, maintenance, and application of architectural models and trade studies to support key technology and design decisions
- Develop future missile concept architectures and specifications aligned to strategic capability objectives
- Contribute to the development and communication of the effector strategy, technology roadmaps, and investment priorities
- Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and industry partners to influence future capability development and technology direction
- Lead and support capability growth across the organisation through mentoring, SQEP development, and leadership of technical specialist groups

About You

At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Ideal Experience & Skills

Essential

- Degree-qualified in Engineering or a numerate discipline, with the ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Clearance (SC)
- Significant experience within the defence sector, with strong knowledge of missile, weapon, or effector systems and associated technologies
- Proven experience in missile or system architecture development, including concept generation and architectural trade studies
- Strong understanding of the product lifecycle, from early concept and design through development, production, and in-service support
- Experience applying modelling, analysis, and engineering judgement to support complex technical decision making
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences at all levels
- Demonstrated leadership capability, including leading multidisciplinary teams, technical communities, or strategic engineering activities

Desirable

- Experience developing and delivering missile or effector products within a Defence organisation
- Knowledge of missile subsystem technologies, architecture policies, technology road mapping, and product line strategy development

If you're passionate about shaping the future of missile capability and want to influence the technologies and architectures that will define tomorrow's defence solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Security Clearance Requirement:

It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

postings.title: Senior Network Architect
postings.additional_locations: Cheadle, Cheshire, United Kingdom; Templecombe, Somerset, United Kingdom
postings.description:
Location: Templecombe, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Under Water Systems (UWS)
Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

The Senior Network Communications Architect is responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining secure, resilient network communication solutions across Thales projects and products.

This role ensures end-to-end ownership of the network communications lifecycle, from requirements gathering to formal testing, while driving innovation, cost efficiency, and alignment with Thales’ strategic goals.

Key focus areas include:
- Technical Leadership: Serving as the recognised "go-to" expert in network communications and security, both internally and externally.
- Bid and Project Support: Developing detailed, costed, and achievable estimates for bids, ensuring solutions meet budgetary and technical constraints.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Acting as the direct customer and supplier interface, presenting designs at review gates, and resolving critical network issues that threaten project delivery.
- Knowledge Sharing: Driving best practices, common approaches, and continuous improvement within the UWS UK Network team, including recruitment, training, and tooling specifications.

Key Responsibilities:

Network Solution Delivery:
- Design and implement secure and resilient network communication systems using IP/Ethernet, RF radio/satellite, and underwater acoustic bearers.
- Develop high-level and low-level designs, ensuring compliance with project requirements and security standards.
- Conduct formal testing to validate network performance, security, and resilience.

Bid and Estimation Support:
- Produce detailed documented estimates for bids, ensuring they are technically feasible, cost-effective, and aligned with budget constraints.
- Collaborate with engineering teams, procurement, and suppliers to create innovative bid solutions, even when requirements or materials are incomplete.

Customer and Supplier Interface:
- Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, presenting designs at review gates and agreeing on interface boundaries.
- Work with network and communication equipment suppliers to select appropriate hardware, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolutions.
- Provide integration and testing support to ensure seamless project execution.

Critical Problem Solving:
- Take ownership of critical network/communication problems that threaten project timelines or budgets.
- Drive root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

Technical Leadership (UWS UK Network Capabilities):
- Ensure common approaches, knowledge sharing, and best practices are adopted across the networking team.
- Conduct recruitment, selection, and interviews for networking roles.
- Specify tooling and workplace facility needs to support team productivity.
- Identify and support individual training and development to close skill gaps.

Security and Compliance:
- Secure networks against internal and external attacks, ensuring they pass PEN test evaluations.
- Author Security Operating Procedures (SyOps) tailored to the required security level.
- Ensure compliance with CE/UKCA marking, EMC, and other regulatory standards.

Cloud and Infrastructure Design:
- Design and deliver private cloud systems with demanding CPU/GPU processing, network, power, racking, and storage requirements.

Key Skills / Experience

Network Design & Security
- IP/Ethernet, RF/satellite, underwater acoustic communication bearers.
- Network security (PEN testing, SyOps authoring).
- VPN and military crypto device configuration.

Cloud and Virtualization
- VMware vSphere/ESXi network and security management.
- Private cloud architecture (CPU/GPU, storage, power).

Protocols and Tools
- IP multicast, Wireshark, tcpdump.
- Linux networking stack, network monitoring systems.
- Bash, TCL, PowerShell scripting.
- Software development (C/C++/Rust/Java/Ada).

UK Eyes Only:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Senior NPI Engineer (EMS)
Primary Purpose of the Role
Thales is expanding its presence in India through the development of a Group Engineering Competence Centre (ECC), reinforcing its position as a leader in all its markets. Launching in early 2019 in Bengaluru, the ECC will expand Thales’ footprint in its core business areas and cement its long-standing relationship with India. Strong of more than 500 engineers as of today, ECC will grow to >1200 by 2029. This role is part of the Industrial Process Engineering function within the AVS-FLX team. The position is Senior NPI Engineer – PCB,PCBA, responsible for managing the introduction of new products and overseeing industrial transfer activities.
AVS-FLX has an objective to expand industrial process engineering function in India ensuring remote engineering support to FLX Industry and preparing industrial footprint expansion in the region. Achieving a high level of maturity for our products in production is one of the major challenges of the AVS/FLX industry, both during the industrialization phase and throughout the product's life cycle. Supplier Industrialization in India is the core area in Industrial Footprint expansion. You will join the Supplier Industrialization team responsible to develop & production of Thales Parts/Products at Supplier End.

JOB Description:
Key Responsibilities and Tasks
- NPI - You work Closely with Design Team from India/France to understand the design requirement & then work with Suppliers(India/Asia) to manufacture the PCB/PCBA complaint with Thales requirements

- Industrial Transfer - You are responsible to reindustrialize the production of PCB/PCBA Boards from Global Location to India/Asia Suppliers.

Detailed Responsibilities below:
Project Planning and Execution
- Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of PCB and PCBA projects from concept through production and final shipment.

- Develop detailed project schedules, milestones, and timelines ensuring all deliverables meet quality, cost, and deadline targets.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams including design, procurement, manufacturing, and quality assurance.

- Monitor project progress and adjust plans as necessary to address risks, delays, or technical issues.

Technical Management
- Oversee PCB design reviews and ensure designs meet manufacturing and assembly requirements (DFM/DFA).

- Manage PCB and PCBA prototyping, pilot runs, and transition to volume production.

- Ensure all processes comply with industry standards such as IPC, ISO, RoHS, and other regulatory requirements.

- Collaborate with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure product quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.

- Review and approve technical documentation including BOM (Bill of Materials), process flows, and work instructions.

Quality Assurance & Risk Management
- Implement quality control processes and oversee product testing (AOI, ICT, functional testing).

- Lead root cause analysis and drive corrective actions for manufacturing or assembly issues.

- Manage risk assessments and mitigation strategies throughout the project lifecycle.

- Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.

Communication and Reporting
- Serve as the primary point of contact for internal teams, suppliers, and clients regarding project status and issues.

- Provide regular project updates and reports to senior management.

- Facilitate meetings, review sessions, and project documentation audits.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify cost reduction opportunities to improve PCB/PCBA design, manufacturing, and assembly processes.

- Implement best practices and lessons learned to enhance project efficiency and product quality.

- Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and standards.

The position is based in Bangalore, with frequent travel to supplier sites across Bangalore and other locations within India.
Major Challenges
- Ensure Supplier Schedule meets global industrial expansion plan & Timeline.

- Work with Design team of France in a different Time Zone & ECC Bangalore

- Work with multiple Suppliers/multiple projects in tandem for Process Qualification

- Continuously Develop the required technical skills (skilling-up) and capability by effective learning

- Promote collaboration within the team for Technology Specialist, Component Engineers

- Work with Multi Stakeholders(Design/Purchase/Supply chain/Production Engineers)

Opportunities
- The chance to work in an organization that is driving towards building a structured engineering footprint in line with Thales’ growth and competitiveness ambition

- The chance to be in contact with people having different cultural background from all across the world

- A young and enthusiastic team looking to take new interesting projects on board

- A working environment that facilitates professional development through continuous learning, close collaboration within teams and a solution-oriented attitude

- An opportunity to work in Bengaluru, the innovation and technological hub of India

Organization
Skills & Knowledge Required
Project Management Skills:
- Must have experience in technologies qualification plan definition and execution in order to increase technology maturity from TRL3-4 to TRL 5-6

- Must have experience in electronic manufacturing readiness definition and execution in order to increase process maturity from MRL2-4 to MRL7-8

- Must have experience to ensure the realization of your batch in the objective of the targeted RC series, the mastery of NRC industrialization and the provision of production lines of all means of production and testing

- Proven experience managing end-to-end PCB and PCBA projects from concept through production and delivery.

- Strong ability to coordinate cross-functional teams including design engineers, production, quality, and procurement.

- Expertise in project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk management.

- Ability to manage budgets, timelines, and supplier/vendor relationships effectively.

Technical Knowledge:
- Strong understanding of PCB design and manufacturing processes, including multilayer boards, flex and rigid-flex PCBs.

- In-depth knowledge of PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) processes: SMT, through-hole, wave soldering, reflow soldering, and inspection techniques.

- Familiarity with DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and DFA (Design for Assembly) principles.

- Knowledge of industry standards and certifications (IPC standards like IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, ISO, RoHS, REACH).

- Understanding of testing methodologies for PCBs and PCBA: AOI (Automated Optical Inspection), ICT (In-Circuit Test), functional testing.

- Knowledge of materials, components, and supply chain relevant to PCB & PCBA.

Quality Tools:

- Knowledge of APQP methodology

- Practice of analysis and problem-solving techniques (PDCA, 8D, .) related to electronic board assembly technologies

Design For Manufacturing:
- Knowledge of DFx approach (Design For Manufacturing, Test, Repair, ...).

- Knowledge of EN9100 standard requirements

- Knowledge of APQP requirements, particularly aerospace standard EN9145

- Ensure full collaboration and interaction within ECC and country stakeholders

SOFT SKILLS
- Proactive mindset with the ability to deliver results despite challenges or adversities.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders

- Dynamic and flexible, able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and environments.

- Ability to work with deadlines and without supervision

- Analytical and problem-solving skills, Logical thinking

- Adaptability and learning skills

- Negotiation and networking skills

- Cost conscious and frugal thinking

- Multi- Disciplinary team working

- Strong willingness to interact with different stakeholders

-

Years of experience
- Minimum 6 years of experience managing projects related to PCB and PCB assembly boards.

- Experience in automotive or aerospace sectors preferred.

Educational Qualification
- Bachelor in Electronics Engineering or related field

This will enable a new level of safety and efficiency, while also reducing delays for the travelling public and providing opportunities to improve environmental outcomes. OneSKY will transform Australia’s sky, and we are proud to be partners in its delivery.

The Role
Working from our Melbourne Office in the World Trade Centre on Wurundjeri land, we have an opportunity for an experienced Senior Planner / Senior Scheduler to join our team on the OneSky program, one of Australia’s most critical defence projects. The successful candidate will manage and lead planning and scheduling activities to maintain control of program timelines, costs, and deliverables.

You will collaborate with Planners, Bid Managers, Project Managers, and Control Account Managers to develop and maintain schedules aligned with the Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB). Your role is key in identifying schedule risks, analysing variances, and supporting earned value management to help the program deliver on time and budget.
- Use Primavera to develop, maintain, and update the program schedule, ensuring it reflects the latest progress, dependencies, and milestones.

- Utilise Deltek Cobra to monitor cost performance, earned value, and budget adherence.

- Apply principles of project controls to track cost, schedule, and performance, providing actionable insights to leadership.

- Identify, assess, and mitigate scheduling risks, ensuring proactive resolution of potential delays or cost overruns.

- Work with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and entities to trace progress, manage dependencies, and report on cost/schedule adherence.

- Balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ensuring the program remains on track.

Your Experience
- Proven experience in complex program/project environments with integrated master schedules of large scale preferably in defence, IT solutions, or complex programs.

- Expertise in Primavera (scheduling) and Deltek Cobra (cost/value management).

Location: Berlin, Germany

We Say HI*

Senior Platform Engineer GCP (w/m/d)

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Ihre Mission als Senior Platform Engineer GCP:
- Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung hochverfügbarer souveräner GCP-Services mit Fokus auf Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit und Performance

- Überwachung von SLI/SLO-Kennzahlen sowie Analyse und Behebung von Produktionsstörungen im 24x7-Betrieb inklusive Teilnahme an einer Rufbereitschaft

- Zusammenarbeit mit globalen SRE- und GCP-Expertenteams zur schnellen Incident-Analyse, Fehlerbehebung und nachhaltigen Service-Optimierung

- Dokumentation von Betriebswissen, Standardisierung von Prozessen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Automatisierungs- und Operational-Playbooks

- Durchführung von Post-Mortem-Analysen nach Incidents zur Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen und Förderung einer kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Systemlandschaft

Darauf freuen wir uns:
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder ein vergleichbarer Masterabschluss

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) sowie in der Automatisierung von Betriebs- und Incident-Management-Prozessen

- Kenntnisse in regulierten Branchen mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen, z.B. Banking, Versicherungen, Healthcare oder vergleichbaren Umfeldern mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen

- Erfahrung in internationalen Arbeitsumgebungen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Erfahrungen mit Google Cloud Platform (GCP) sowie eine hohe Lernbereitschaft und Begeisterung für moderne Cloud-Technologien

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2025 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.
Für mehr als 85.000 Mitarbeitende in 65 Ländern eröffnen wir zukunftsweisende Perspektiven, verwirklichen individuelle Karrierewege und ermöglichen kreative Freiräume. Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.

Location: Ottawa, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

For decades, Ottawa has been a global technology leader. Today, Canada’s capital holds one of the brightest and most diverse technological ecosystems in North America. Voted as Canada’s best place to live 2017 by Maclean's, Ottawa offers a low cost of living with a high quality of life. Position Summary
In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

For decades, Ottawa has been a global technology leader. Today, Canada’s capital holds one of the brightest and most diverse technological ecosystems in North America. The Thales Ottawa office has been a major supplier and long-term trusted partner to DND, enabling the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard to achieve mission success.

Thales has a vacancy for a Senior Project Buyer to support the AJISS Engineering Changes Team across the Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ship In-Service Support (AJISS) program. As a Senior Project Buyer, you will translate engineering change requirements into purchasable, executable work packages—ensuring Purchase Orders (POs) are issued on time, supplier commitments are aligned to delivery and milestone expectations, and risks/issues are identified early and resolved decisively. You will also increase organizational knowledge by mentoring, improving practices, and strengthening end-to-end purchasing/supply execution. You will act as an experienced and independent owner for purchasing execution and supply readiness that enables engineering change delivery and act as the interface between the AJISS engineering team, procurement, and suppliers, ensuring projects meet their targets, risks are managed, and communication remains transparent.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and /or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Own end-to-end AJISS engineering-change procurement/supply execution: manage sourcing, PO creation/issuance, supplier documentation, and ensure technical/contractual alignment (scope, quantities, specs, terms, lead times, quality/compliance, delivery).
- Drive schedule and milestone performance: track work package progress, proactively identify risks (lead time slippage, capacity, technical clarifications, documentation readiness), and lead recovery actions/escalations to protect AJISS deliverables.
- Manage defense-approved/program-relevant suppliers: build and maintain relationships, support readiness and delivery planning, and ensure suppliers meet commitments for delivery dates, quality, and required documentation.
- Serve as cross-functional purchasing interface: partner with engineering, program/project management, category management, quality, operations, finance, legal, and bid/capture; provide transparent status, forecasts, and risk reporting with timely escalation.
- Run post-award supplier execution & performance management (where applicable): monitor delivery performance, execute supplier recovery/containment support, conduct performance reviews, and ensure corrective actions are initiated, tracked, and verified.
- Support change governance and continuous improvement: represent procurement interests in change review boards and cross-functional meetings; continuously improve purchasing/supply execution workflows to reduce cycle time, rework, and schedule variance (including lessons learned and templates).
- Ensure compliance and audit-ready evidence: maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready records of orders, compliance artifacts, correspondence, and acceptance evidence; ensure all interactions meet contractual, ethical, and regulatory requirements.
- Escalate and lead resolution of systemic issues: identify root causes of purchasing/supply bottlenecks and propose practical mitigations (alternative suppliers, revised delivery sequencing, PO scope/terms updates, revised recovery plans).
- Be a go-to resource and (where needed) mentor others: support the team proactively, reduce friction between functions, and share process knowledge/best practices.
Engagement Points:
Internal:
- Work Package Manager (WPM) / Project Manager (PM): alignment on scope, schedule, risks, issues, and supplier performance; ensure purchasing actions support recovery and commitment management.
- Engineering Design Manager (EDM) / Engineering: Collaborate to clarify technical requirements, manage Statement of Work (SoW) deliverables, and ensure seamless management of technical interfaces.
- Procurement / Category Management: Ensure sourcing strategies are aligned, coordinate handover from pre-award activities, and provide feedback on supplier performance for future sourcing decisions.
- Project Manager: Track and forecast costs, support and manage budgets/EAC, and control milestones and payments related to supplier contracts.
- Quality / Safety / RAM / Industrial / Operations: Monitor and manage supplier performance in quality, safety, industrialization, compliance and timely delivery.
- Legal / Commercial: Support contract variations, claims, disputes, and escalations, ensuring adherence to contractual and legal requirements.
- Bid / Capture Teams: Provide insights on supplier performance, risks, and costs to inform bids and proposals for future projects.
External:
- Key suppliers / subcontractors: Manage day-to-day commercial, and performance relationships to ensure project success.
- Customer representatives (where appropriate): Coordinate supplier-related matters impacting project delivery and customer commitments.
- Auditors or regulatory bodies (as required): Provide evidence of supplier compliance with contractual, ethical, and regulatory requirements.

Minimum Qualifications
- 8+ years’ relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, commercial or contract management, with clear exposure to post award supplier management.
- Experience in procurement or supply chain within the defense or high-compliance industry, ideally supporting in-service support or engineering change programs.
- Strong project management and milestone tracking skills using relevant tools (e.g., SAP, MS Project).
- Excellent supplier engagement and relationship management abilities.
- Proactive risk identification and mitigation skills; able to challenge delays constructively.
- Effective communicator in cross-functional, high-stakes environments.
- Working knowledge of defense industry regulations, government contracting, and AJISS program requirements is highly desirable.
- The candidate must meet all the following criteria:
a) possess a university degree in any field and possess a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 5 years or possess a diploma from a recognized college program in procurement, finance, economics, commerce, accounting or materiel management and possess a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 6 years; and

All applicants must be able to obtain a Canadian NATO Secret clearance and meet the eligibility requirements outlined in the Canadian Controlled Goods Registration Program and ITAR.

Preferred Qualifications
- Professional qualifications or training in one or more of the following:- Procurement / supply chain (e.g. CIPS or equivalent)
- Project management (e.g. PRINCE2, APM or equivalent)
- Commercial / contract management

- Degree (or equivalent experience) in business, commercial, engineering or related discipline.

Values & Behaviours
- Customer focused, delivering on commitments to internal and external stakeholders.
- Collaborative, building strong relationships across functions and with suppliers.
- Accountable, taking ownership for outcomes and driving issues to resolution.
- Agile, adapting quickly to changing priorities, scope and constraints.
- Innovative, seeking continuous improvement in supplier performance and ways of working.
- Ethical and transparent, acting with integrity in all supplier interactions.

Special Position Requirements

- Role will require working from both office (3) and home (2) (hybrid).
- Schedule: 40 working hours per week Monday- Friday. Flexible time, however, accommodating core hours of 9 am-3 pm, project needs and global/international time zones.

Pay Transparency

The anticipated Total Target Compensation (TTC), inclusive of annual salary and bonus eligibility, for this role is $60,000 to 100,000 CAD Annual​. The Company reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, provincial, and federal laws.
AI
We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools as part of our recruitment process to support activities such as candidate discovery, résumé matching, and interview scheduling. These tools may help screen and assess applications and recommend potential matches based on the requirements within the job description. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Our Opportunity
We have a number of Project Controller and Senior Project Controller roles available in A2IS business based in Crawley.

You will be responsible for ensuring best practice Project Controls are deployed across bids and projects in accordance with defined Thales processes and that data from those Controls is interpreted and clearly presented as actionable information for Project Leadership and Senior Management decision-making.

Key responsibilities and tasks:
- Ensure that all Projects have a robust Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and Performance Management Baseline (PMB).
- Deployment and performance of Project Controls within a Portfolio or Project.
- Identifying trends, analysis of variances and recommending appropriate corrective actions with a strong focus on proactive risk and opportunity management, including identification and support to the resolution of cross-portfolio risks/issue themes
- Establishing and operating an appropriate business rhythm/drumbeat E.g. ETC Reviews, Schedule Reviews, Risk Reviews, Reporting Activities. As well as this, consolidate reports, ensuring that reports are issued in a timely manner, and the facilitation of Project reviews. You will also be working with Project leadership to identify and implement appropriate metrics.
- Ensure resource forward load is accurate and timely, including the analysis of resource profiles (labour and material) and making recommendations to reconcile anomalies and optimise deployment.

Experience & Skills:
- You will have a strong track record of successfully designing, deploying, operating and/or improving the full range of Project Controls in a context relevant to Thales.

- You will be able to build strong relationships with key stakeholders in complex environments and working across functional boundaries.

- You will have an awareness and understanding of advanced Project Control techniques E.g. Earned Value Management and Schedule Risk Analysis, with experience of deploying these techniques for more senior positions.

- Lastly, you will be able to define and implement appropriate KPIs to understand progress and provide insight into likely future performance.

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (ISR)

Above Water Systems (AWS)
- Above Water Systems is one of our newest domains in the UK. It was created in 2021 to capitalise on the success of the Type 31 programme awarded in November 2019. AWS UK will conduct Combat system integration in the UK which will be able to deliver and support Combat systems through life into and from the UK.

Flight Avionics (FLX)
- Shaping future skies together for a sustainable and safer planet. We have presence on all major aircraft programmes: Air Transport, Business Jets, Military Aircraft, Helicopters, eVTOL and UAVs. We are committed to developing more sustainable and connected avionics.

Secure Communications & Information Systems (SIX)
- We operate through two portfolios which support key strategic growth areas of Secure Communication & Protection. The Land Communications team specialise in tactical radio and electronic countermeasures (ECM) for UK and Export markets. The Security and Naval Communications team continues to build on our 100-year history of supporting the Royal Navy with portfolio of products providing integrated voice and data communications.

Training & Simulation (TTS)
- We help seasoned staff keep up-to-date and equip the next generation of armed forces across the World, from fighter pilots to front-line soldiers. Providing nations with products ranging from computer-based training (CBT), through to full-motion flight simulators and fully equipped in-theatre replica armoured vehicles.

Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Engineering Delivery Manager – Identity Platform (AI-Driven SDLC)
Overview
We are looking for an Engineering Delivery Manager to lead delivery across multiple squads building and evolving a cloud-native Identity Platform. You will drive predictable outcomes, high engineering quality, and adoption of our AI-driven SDLC—improving speed, reliability, and compliance through modern ways of working.
You will lead a delivery organisation of ~20 engineers, shaping squads around product priorities, coaching delivery discipline, and ensuring teams use AI tooling (coding, test generation, documentation, triage) to raise throughput and quality.
Partner with Product, Architecture, Security and Platform stakeholders to translate roadmap intent into executable plans, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on leadership role focused on delivery excellence and AI-enabled transformation.
Key Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery across multiple squads (scope, plan, dependencies, risks, and outcomes).
- Lead, coach and develop ~20 engineers; set clear expectations and give timely feedback.
- Establish delivery discipline: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
- Champion an AI-first engineering culture; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.
- Ensure engineering excellence: quality, security, reliability, and operability by design.
AI-Driven SDLC & Transformation
- Embed our AI-driven SDLC (AI-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day-to-day delivery.
- Drive adoption of AI ways of working (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.
- Measure impact and improve (cycle time, defect escape rate, automation coverage, and developer experience) and act on insights.
- Ensure responsible use of AI aligned to security, privacy, and compliance expectations.
Delivery Execution
- Shape and adjust squads based on roadmap priorities, skills, and capacity.
- Run planning and execution rituals; manage dependencies and cross-team alignment.
- Remove impediments, manage delivery risk early, and drive predictable releases.
- Use metrics to improve flow efficiency, quality, and operational readiness.
Stakeholder Partnership
- Partner with Product to clarify scope, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
- Provide clear delivery commitments, trade-offs, and status—no surprises.
- Align with Architecture/Security/Operations to ensure designs are scalable and compliant.
People, Talent & Operations
- Hire and retain diverse talent; build capability plans with explicit AI upskilling.
- Set performance expectations, coach growth, and build a feedback culture aligned to Thales leadership.
- Own capacity and execution tracking; escalate risks with options.
- Ensure operational excellence (on-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).
What You Bring
- 7+ years in software engineering with 3+ years leading delivery and/or people in multi-team environments.
- Track record delivering cloud-native, distributed and security-sensitive platforms (identity experience a plus).
- Strong delivery management: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.
- Modern SDLC practices (CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps).
- Proven change leadership: scaling new tools and practices, including AI-assisted development.
- AI fluency: hands-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach safe, effective adoption.
Success Looks Like
- Predictable delivery: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on-time releases with transparent trade-offs.
- AI-driven SDLC adopted across squads with measurable improvements in cycle time, automation coverage, and quality.
- Strong engineering outcomes: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.
- High-performing teams: clear expectations, visible growth, and healthy engagement/retention.
Reporting Line
This role reports to the Engineering Director.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Senior Security Architect
postings.legal_entity: THALES DIS TECHNOLOGY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
postings.description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Position Summary
Thales Cyber Security Products (CSP) is securing the world’s cryptographic infrastructure – the keys, the algorithms, and the business logic. We are safeguarding some of the biggest names in technology, and are securing over 80% of the world's banking transactions.
Security Architects in the Product Security Group are part of a global team supporting product development as subject matter experts in topics such as threat modeling, security architecture, secure coding, cryptography, and vulnerability assessment. We assist in all elements of product security; help teams make risk-based decisions; and educate and elevate the security maturity of the teams in a manner that will scale.
Key Areas of Responsibility
- Function as a technical security architecture and security engineering resource primarily in support of teams building applications and services in the Data Security or Application Security product lines.
- Work closely with security champions and product teams to enable and support risk-based decision-making that pragmatically balances security, performance, and compliance to ensure that products are not just secure, but usable for real world use cases.
- Educate the engineering organization to improve their security maturity, awareness, and judgement during all phases of product development.
- Contribute to the development of a high-quality product security program to help address CSP’s top product security priorities, including research, selection, and implementation of tooling and process improvements.
- Act as a mentor to Security Champions and Security Architecture Team members.
- Research and provide analysis on security trends, products, and the evolving threat landscape.
- Explore security topics that interest you and develop your skills in those areas.

Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
- Bachelor’s degree in information security, information technology, computer science, computer engineering or another equivalent field of study; or equivalent work experience.
- 9-14 years of experience applying security skills to solve challenging security problems using knowledge and/or skills in multiple security domains, including threat modeling/risk assessment; applied cryptography; cloud security; and tool development, usage, configuration, and deployment
- Experience building tools, products, or services in at least one high-level programming language, and ability to read (and identify security flaws in) languages such as C/C++, Java, or Go.
- Ability to collaborate successfully in a team environment, be sensitive to needs of the teams, and effectively develop relationships across disciplines.
- Demonstrated verbal and written communications skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in information security, information technology, computer science, computer engineering or another equivalent field of study; or equivalent work experience
- Smarts, curiosity, humility, and a positive personality; an open-minded approach to work; and equal willingness to both learn and teach.
- Strong desire to help develop members of the security community, both within the team as well as across organizational boundaries.
- Experience in one or more of the following domains:- Professional software development, modern programming and frameworks, and agile development practices
- Developing, deploying, and/or automating security tools to identify security flaws in products.
- Web application security technologies, frameworks, protocols, API Security, mitigation techniques, and potential pitfalls.
- Security testing, CICD Pipelines, and automation
- Cloud deployments, GCP and/or AWS cloud platforms, cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, and relevant security concepts.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Location: Berlin, Germany

We Say HI*

Site Reliability Engineer / Cloud Operations Engineer (f/m/d)

German companies and public administrations in this country are ready to accelerate their digital transformation and the use of AI—but they will never compromise on the security of their most sensitive data. This is where Thales in Germany, in partnership with Google Cloud and our new company currently being established, comes into play. With a new, 100% German business unit, we are providing a concrete response to the strict requirements of the BSI. What we are creating is a locally and fully autonomously operated “Trusted Cloud”. It provides access to the broadest service portfolio on the market, while everything remains strictly under European jurisdiction. By combining German and French standards such as SecNumCloud, C5 and C3-A, we offer our customers unequaled resilience and business continuity. This is a turning point for our industry and a decisive step towards a strong, sovereign digital Europe.

Your mission as Site Reliability Engineer:
- Operate and maintain mission-critical sovereign cloud services with availability targets of 99.99% and above.

- Monitor service health, reliability, scalability, latency, and performance using Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

- Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents across large-scale distributed cloud environments.

- Participate in a structured 24/7 on-call rotation (approximately one week every six weeks) to ensure continuous service availability.

- Collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers, Cloud Infrastructure Specialists, and Product Experts across international teams to mitigate incidents and drive long-term solutions.

- Build a deep understanding of Google's cloud technologies and distributed systems through an intensive training program covering technologies such as Borg, Colossus, Spanner, and other core GCP components.

- Drive operational excellence by creating and maintaining technical documentation, standardizing incident response procedures, and continuously improving operational playbooks.

- Lead and contribute to post-incident reviews, root cause analyses, and the implementation of preventive measures to improve platform reliability.

- Identify opportunities for automation and contribute to improving operational efficiency, scalability, compliance, and service reliability.

- Support the operation of highly secure cloud environments designed to meet stringent regulatory and sovereignty requirements.

We are looking forward to:
- Several years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Operations, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Production Support, Network Operations (NOC), Technical Operations, or a comparable role.

- Experience operating and supporting business-critical production systems with demanding uptime and availability requirements.

- Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills in complex technical environments.

- Experience monitoring, operating, and maintaining distributed systems, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, or large-scale applications.

- Familiarity with reliability engineering concepts, observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis.

- Experience working with automation, scripting, operational tooling, or Infrastructure-as-Code approaches.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and methodical approach.

- Professional proficiency in both German and English.

- Willingness to participate in a regular on-call rotation.

- Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn and work with hyperscale cloud technologies.

The Group invests more than €4,5 billion per year in Research & Development in key areas, particularly for critical environments, such as Artificial Intelligence, cybersecurity, quantum and cloud technologies.
In 2025, the Group generated sales of €22.1 billion.

For our more than 85,000 employees in 65 countries we open up visionary perspectives, realise individual career paths and enable creative freedom. This is achieved with courage, versatility and the firm intention to make the demanding challenges of our time safer and more inclusive. With our sustainable value-focused management we support diversity actively.

Qualifications
Relevant bachelor’s degree or Master Degree

Technical skills

- ATM Domain experience

- Familiarity with safety-critical standards like DO-278/DO-178

- Experience in software development in a safety-critical environment

Thales IAS provides advanced surveillance solutions designed to ensure the security and safety of airspace. Your role will focus on designing, developing, and integrating embedded software solutions for high-tech sub-systems and processor-driven boards. - Proficiency in procedural (C) and object-oriented (C++) languages.
- Understanding of data communications (e.g., 1553, RS422) and networking principles.

Desirable:
- Knowledge of UML and Agile development methodologies.
- Experience in Graphical User Interface design and development.
- Understanding of software configuration control.
- Ability to undertake roles beyond software development, such as Software Architect or Software Engineering Manager.
- Practical experience in model-driven software development, using change management and version control systems, and developing under a range of software methodologies.

Values & Behaviours:
- Display innovation and self-motivation.
- Possess a passion for software engineering and a willingness to stay current with industry developments.
- Work efficiently both within a team and individually.
- Demonstrate dedication and determination in task completion.

Qualifications:
Essential:
- A BEng/BSc (Hons) degree or equivalent in computing or a computing-related subject, or an alternative qualification with relevant experience.

Desirable:
- A degree in Micro Electronics & Computing/Software Engineering.

postings.title: Senior Solution Architect
postings.description:
Location: Praha, Czechia

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billons of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language.

The Senior Solution Architect sets the technical vision and roadmap for our next-generation Identity & Access Management (IAM) platform. You will drive strategic direction, architecture, and delivery of secure, scalable, and developer-friendly identity capabilities across workforce and customer identities. This includes Zero Trust-aligned access, passwordless authentication, fine-grained authorization, identity governance, and AI-driven threat detection. You will identify and validate new product opportunities through proof-of-concepts (POCs), leveraging modern AI tools with strong privacy and compliance guardrails. The role requires leadership, cross-functional influence, and excellent communication to align engineering, product, and stakeholder teams around a cohesive architectural strategy.

Day in the life of Senior Solution Architect:
- Partner with product management and leadership to shape the technical direction and future of the solution.
- Research industry trends and recommend strategic architectural approaches.
- Architect and develop scalable, high-quality software using industry-standard, repeatable methodologies.
- Drive solution design aligned with enterprise strategy and architectural best practices.
- Mentor architects and developers; review designs and code for alignment with patterns and frameworks.
- Identify critical architecture components and guide teams in building solutions that enable reliable deployments.
- Produce clear documentation, best practices, and architectural guidance for stakeholders.
- Serve as a subject matter expert with strong domain ownership and the ability to influence and educate others.
- Deliver complex integrations and partner engagements with minimal direction, ensuring stakeholder alignment.
- Design and build distributed applications (e.g., .NET, Java, Node.js), including architecture, prototypes, production code, and test frameworks.

Requirements and Skills:
- Deep experience with Identity & Access Management platforms.
- Strong expertise designing and developing complex software in .NET and/or Java, with flexibility to work across both.
- Proficiency with microservices, web applications, modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular), NoSQL and SQL databases.
- Solid understanding of web protocols, architectures, servers, proxies, load balancing, and high-availability patterns.
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed systems, and persistence technologies.
- Strong knowledge of OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and architectural best practices.
- Skilled in Agile/Scrum, test-driven development, and building resilient, observable systems.
- Strong grounding in REST, JSON, SOAP, and modern integration patterns.
- Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, architecture, and code.
- Excellent debugging abilities and comfort solving complex, multi-layered problems.
- Familiar with UML, sequence diagrams, and producing architecture blueprints.
- Able to create maintainable, optimized, well-structured code.
- Demonstrated thought leadership (speaking, writing, community involvement).
- Strong communicator with clear leadership abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with NoSQL databases and Elasticsearch.
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized architectures.
- Awareness of performance engineering and web security best practices.
- Experience defining NFRs for product-centric development.
- Knowledge of event-driven architectures and messaging platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS).
- Background in large-scale, high-transaction systems.

postings.title: Senior System Integration Engineer

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Senior Integration Engineer is responsible for the integration of software and hardware components within a complex software centric ATM system. The role involves coordinating and executing integration activities, troubleshooting system issues and ensuring the various components are working seamlessly together while satisfying functional and performance requirements.
Working within a Integrated Product Team, the role may also involve Verification and Validation activities.

KEY ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
As a Sr. Integration Engineer, you are accountable for:
- Conduct the successful integration and the test of incremental software releases for systems and/or subsystems, in accordance with the schedule set by the Technical Leads and WPM
- Manage and/or contribute to the setup of environments to facilitate the integration, testing and acceptance activities required by the program. Provide instruction on the setup of environments to support validation activities.
- Define and/or contribute to testing activities across multiple platforms (regression, interface, simulation scenarios and test tools) to support project milestones and deadlines
- Able to analyse System/Subsystem technical and functional issues, ensuring they are identified early, captured fully and logged according to internal processes.
- To collaborate with System, Subsystem and Infrastructure teams to ensure that the integration activities are in line with the design and specifications
- Output documentation and engineering artefacts (E.g. System Integration Test Documentation) with the expected level of compliance (functional, performance, robustness, security and quality) that are aligned with internal configuration management processes.
- Produce scripts in order to automate system administration tasks.
- Manage and/or implement test & measuring tools used for system performance, loading and response-time assessment
- Provide technical support to junior integrators and the V&V teams
- Support Technical Leads and WPM through:- Making recommendations on strategies to improve performance or productivity
- Identify risks, and proposing effective solution early and executing mitigation actions
- Providing input into the planning and coordination of program integration activities

Qualifications

Essential Experience
- 5 years minimum experience holding similar positions integrating complex software-centric real-time systems
- Ability to understand the structure of and troubleshoot Virtualisation Platforms/Operating Systems (Clients/Servers): 3+ years- Linux/Unix Operating Systems, SNMP Services, RSYSLOG
- Windows Operating systems
- VMWare

- Scripting: Python, Shell, XML: 3+ years
- DevOps and Automation Tools: Ansible, Jenkins
- Configuration Management: GIT (Bitbucket), JIRA
- Cybersecurity: LDAP, AD, PKI
- Network Protocols and technologies: SNMP, UDP, TCP, IP

- A positive attitude combined with excellent interpersonal and motivational skills.
- Ability to effectively communicate complex engineering issues and concepts both verbally and written - tailored appropriately for the stakeholder
- Work experience in integrating large projects, preferably ATC-related (Military of Civilian).

Desirable:

- Knowledge of networks and network configuration / exposure to distributed systems

GENERAL

- An advocate for a culture of continuous improvement
- An advocate for Accountability, transparency and curiosity

- Comply with all relevant Company policies and procedures.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
- Be eligible for Security Clearance from the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs (CAT2)
