postings.title: Senior System Safety and Environmental Engineer (IAS)
postings.description:
Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Senior System Safety & Environmental Engineer (IAS)
Known internally as System Safety & Environmental Engineer
Location: based in Belfast, 4.5 days/ week onsite, with travel
Other: permanent, full-time, for eligible candidates, relocation support can be provided

Help shape the safety of next-generation defence technologies, ensuring mission-critical systems are safe, compliant and certifiable throughout their lifecycle.

What the role has to offer

- Lead safety strategy on complex, mission-critical programmes – operate at a principal level, providing technical leadership and influencing the safety assurance approach across some of the UK's most advanced defence systems
- Shape safety across the entire system lifecycle – from concept and architecture through to certification, in-service support and disposal, you'll have a unique opportunity to influence product development end-to-end and leave a lasting impact on system design
- Drive innovation in a rapidly evolving environment – join a growing business delivering next-generation capabilities at pace, where you'll tackle complex safety challenges, mentor others and help define the future of systems safety engineering within Thales

Our Opportunity

As a Senior System Safety & Environmental Engineer, you'll ensure Thales products achieve certification, meet stringent safety standards and perform safely in operational environments. You'll lead hazard analysis, define safety requirements and drive risk reduction activities across complex engineering programmes. From concept and design through to verification, certification and deployment, you'll provide technical leadership on safety-critical hardware and programmable elements, influencing engineering decisions and developing compelling safety cases backed by robust assurance evidence. Your work will directly enable the delivery of safe, compliant and trusted solutions for our customers.

We're seeking candidates with a strong Systems Safety Engineering background, ideally with experience in software safety assurance. While software safety expertise is highly desirable, we are also keen to hear from experienced Safety Engineers from aerospace, defence or other highly regulated industries.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) - our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

What we offer you

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing and professional growth, which includes:

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

Main Responsibilities

- Lead and deliver all Safety & Environmental Management (S&EM) activities within integrated project teams, ensuring compliance with the IAS Safety Management System and the effective assurance of safety-critical programmable elements
- Conduct hazard identification, hazard analysis and risk assessment activities, defining robust safety and environmental requirements across system performance, design, integration, interfaces and verification activities
- Influence multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, developing clear, evidence-based safety arguments that ensure S&EM requirements are understood, implemented and maintained throughout the product lifecycle
- Champion compliance with relevant safety and environmental standards, legislation, policies and governance processes, acting as a trusted subject matter expert and promoting best practice across IAS programmes
- Plan and manage S&EM work packages, including estimating engineering effort, producing high-quality hazard analysis reports and safety cases, and generating the assurance evidence required to support certification and customer confidence

About You

At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Ideal Experience & Skills

- Proven academic background in Engineering or Science, supported by relevant safety training and professional development; Chartered Engineer status or professional institution membership is highly desirable
- Proven experience leading Safety Engineering activities within complex, highly regulated engineering programmes, delivering risk reduction, compliance and successful project outcomes
- Demonstrated expertise in hazard analysis, risk assessment and safety case development, creating robust safety arguments and assurance evidence to support certification
- Proven knowledge of safety-critical systems engineering, including the development and assurance of programmable elements and the application of SILs, DALs and related assurance methodologies
- Demonstrated understanding of product safety standards, legislation and environmental management principles, including experience applying Defence Standard 00-055 and associated standards
- Acquired capability to apply a whole-life systems engineering approach, influencing design decisions and supporting products from concept through to certification and in-service operation

Ready to influence the safety of some of the world's most advanced defence systems? Join Thales and play a key role in delivering the next generation of safe, compliant and mission-ready technology.

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of MIL-STD-882, ISO21448 and ISO 26262 is highly desirable.

Victoria, B.C., Ottawa, ON., Halifax, N.S., (CAN.), Hybrid

Position Summary

Thales Canada, Defence & Security is engaged in supporting the Canadian Army’s Land Command, Control, Communications & Computers (C4) Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (LC4ISR) systems which enable critical decisions on a daily basis. Together with industry partners, Thales is building on the existing networks and applications to enhance digitized operations, support communications between joint and allied forces, and monitor and defend against the threats and evolving capabilities of potential adversaries.

Thales has a vacancy for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our Innovation team, supporting the development and integration of autonomous systems and LC4ISR solutions. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of customer needs, business opportunities and product development. They will collaborate closely with Business Development, Product Engineers, Software Engineers and other technical stakeholders to understand operational needs, derive system and software requirements, and manage those requirements throughout the solution lifecycle. This role is well suited to a systems thinker who is comfortable working in a fast-paced innovation environment where requirements may initially be incomplete and must be progressively refined through customer engagement, prototyping, demonstrations and technical analysis.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement
This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access

Key Areas of Responsibility

In their efforts to develop and sustain mission systems, a Systems Engineer will be called upon to integrate a variety of hardware, software, and firmware, and apps on commercial and military platforms. The essential functions and responsibilities of a Systems Engineer include:
- Tailor the system engineering process, practices and tools.
- Provide timely and accurate status updates.
- Develop the preliminary and detailed designs for system and subsystem elements.
- Review and validate internal and subcontractor designs, plans, and schedules.
- Identify, characterize, and describe issues in the system or its design through problem reports and document and design reviews.
- Author technical documentation to capture the system and subsystem designs including the architecture, interfaces, and installation elements.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure the designs are consistent with needs, desires, and concerns of the end-users.
- Support the development of verification and validation artefacts including plans and procedures.
- Collaborate with other functions during the implementation and integration of the system and subsystem designs.
- Resolution of technical issues arising during the implementation, integration and testing of the system and subsystem elements.
- Support the installation and/or integration testing of the systems remotely or on customer site and/or technical subcontract management including management of work scope and compliance of the (subcontractor) supplied solution;

For this specific project, typical duties will include:
- Engage with Business Development, customers, end users and technical stakeholders to understand operational needs, use cases and capability gaps.
- Translate customer and operational needs into clear, measurable and verifiable system and subsystem requirements.
- Develop and maintain requirements documentation, including operational concepts, use cases, system requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
- Manage requirements traceability from customer needs through design, implementation, integration, verification and validation.
- Facilitate requirements workshops and technical discussions with internal teams, partners and customers.
- Work closely with Product Engineers, Software Engineers and Solution Architects to ensure requirements are technically feasible and aligned with product capabilities and roadmaps.
- Support system architecture development, functional analysis, interface definition and trade-off studies.
- Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, conflicts, assumptions and technical risks, and coordinate their resolution.
- Support the integration of autonomous platforms, command-and-control applications, sensors, communications systems and mission-management capabilities.
- Contribute to technical proposals, statements of work, estimates, product demonstrations and customer briefings.
- Support system integration, test planning, verification and validation activities.
- Maintain requirements baselines and manage changes throughout iterative and agile development cycles.
- Support field trials, demonstrations and experimentation activities in Canada and internationally, as required.

Minimum Qualifiacations

Skills and Abilities:
- At least 10 years of professional experience in the design and integration of complex systems in commercial and/or military domains.
· At least 3 to 7 years of relevant systems engineering, requirements engineering or complex software/system integration experience.
· Demonstrated experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting and managing technical requirements.
· Experience translating operational or business needs into system and sub-system requirements.
· Understanding of systems engineering principles, including system decomposition, interface management, traceability, verification and validation.
· Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams in an iterative or agile development environment.

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

Special Position Requirements

Full time, standard business hours.

Possibility of travel to east or west coast sites for technical support / installation onboard ships in dock.

Pay Transparency

The anticipated Total Target Compensation (TTC), inclusive of annual salary and bonus eligibility, for this role is $120,000 to 170,000 CAD Annual​. The Company reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, provincial, and federal laws.

All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf.

Job Title: Sr. Lead Engineer – Frontend Platform

We are building a foundational Core UI Platform Team to own, scale, and govern the frontend ecosystem for our enterprise SaaS product suite. Working closely with the UI Architect and reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will translate architectural direction into scalable, production-ready implementation plans. You will lead day-to-day technical execution, own core platform delivery, and ensure solutions align with the platform roadmap and engineering standards.
Decision Making & Ownership
- Own technical implementation decisions within the established architecture.
- Recommend improvements to platform capabilities and engineering practices.
- Escalate architectural trade-offs and major technology decisions to the UI Architect.
- Drive engineering excellence through technical leadership and mentorship.
Success in this Role
Success in this role means delivering high-impact platform initiatives, increasing adoption of shared frontend standards, and enabling product teams to build consistent, secure, and scalable user experiences more efficiently.
- Successful delivery of platform initiatives within sprint commitments.
- High adoption of reusable components and platform standards across feature teams.
- Reduction in duplicate implementations.
- Improved engineering productivity and faster onboarding for new developers.
- High code quality and test coverage standards maintained across the team.
What You Will Do (Responsibilities)
- Implementation Ownership: Lead the implementation of complex features, shared components, and platform tooling for an enterprise-grade SaaS product.
- Technical Leadership: Lead technical execution for sprint commitments by:- Translating architectural designs into implementation plans.
- Breaking down complex epics into technical tasks.
- Coordinating implementation across developers.
- Identifying and mitigating technical risks early.
- Driving technical discussions during sprint execution.

- Platform Ownership: Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of shared components, Storybook, reusable utilities, frontend frameworks, and developer tooling. Create technical documentation and support developer onboarding.
- Collaboration: Partner with the UI Architect, Product Managers, Backend, QA, UX, and DevOps teams to deliver platform initiatives. Support technical estimation and sprint planning with the Engineering Manager.
- CI/CD & Tooling: Support the evolution of frontend build pipelines, dependency management, release automation, and CI/CD processes to improve developer productivity, build reliability, and deployment efficiency.
- Quality & Testing: Drive quality by implementing and reviewing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests while promoting test automation best practices across the team.
- Production Support: Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root cause analysis for critical frontend incidents.
- Mentorship & Code Quality: Conduct rigorous PR reviews, enforce strict TypeScript/React standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers.
- AI-Enabled Development: Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve implementation speed, code quality, testing efficiency, documentation, and developer productivity. Build reusable AI skills, prompts, agents, or integrations where they add clear engineering value.
What You Bring (Must-Have Qualifications)
- Engineering Leadership: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading frontend development for enterprise-scale applications; strong communication, mentoring, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
- Frontend Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in modern React, JavaScript, and strict TypeScript, including hooks, context, performance optimization, component composition, and scalable application patterns.
- Architecture & Platform Engineering: Hands-on experience building scalable microfrontends, shared component libraries, internal design systems, reusable utilities, and frontend platform capabilities for enterprise SaaS products.
- SaaS, Security & Reliability: Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architectures, frontend security best practices, MFA, secure session management, production troubleshooting, and client-side observability.
- Testing & Quality: Strong experience with modern testing practices using Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress, API mocking with MSW, code review discipline, and automated quality gates.
- AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini, with practical application in development, testing, code review, documentation, or productivity workflows.
- Frontend Ecosystem & Tooling: Practical experience with Redux Toolkit, styled-components, Axios, Zod, react-router-dom, internal NPM packages, GitLab CI/CD, Vite/Webpack, single-spa, ESLint, Prettier, Husky, and related tooling.
Nice to Have (Bonus Points)
- Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
- Data Visualization: Experience with charting libraries such as D3.js for analytics or dashboard-heavy features.
- Experience with accessibility standards, inclusive design practices, and WCAG-aligned frontend development.
- Experience with frontend performance profiling, bundle optimization, and runtime performance tuning.
- Experience with monorepo-based frontend development and shared package governance.
- Experience with enterprise design system governance, contribution models, and adoption tracking across multiple product teams.

Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager / Project Manager
Position Overview
The Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager / Project Manager is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity services and projects. The role acts as a key interface between customers, cybersecurity teams, technical stakeholders, and management.
The position combines service delivery management, project management, customer relationship management, operational governance, and cybersecurity expertise to ensure that contracted services are delivered according to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), quality standards, timelines, and business expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Service Delivery Management
- Act as the primary point of contact for customers regarding cybersecurity service delivery.
- Ensure cybersecurity services are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments, SLAs, KPIs, and agreed service levels.
- Monitor service performance and identify deviations, risks, and improvement opportunities.
- Coordinate operational activities across SOC, CSIRT, SIEM, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and other cybersecurity teams.
- Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of incidents, service issues, and customer escalations.
- Prepare and lead regular service reviews and operational governance meetings with customers.
- Consolidate service KPIs, performance indicators, highlights, risks, and points of attention for management reporting.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase service quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Cybersecurity Project Management
- Plan, coordinate, and manage cybersecurity projects from initiation through completion.
- Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, resources, dependencies, and timelines.
- Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
- Manage project risks, issues, actions, dependencies, and change requests.
- Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and according to agreed quality standards.
- Establish project governance and reporting mechanisms.
- Prepare project status reports and communicate progress to customers and management.
- Coordinate technical teams during cybersecurity implementations, migrations, upgrades, and transformation projects.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
- Understand customer requirements, expectations, priorities, and business objectives.
- Act as an escalation point for service delivery and project-related matters.
- Communicate complex cybersecurity topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Manage customer expectations and ensure transparency regarding service performance, risks, and challenges.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and expand cybersecurity services where relevant.
Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Define and maintain service delivery standards, processes, templates, and workflows.

- Track KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, project milestones, and service quality indicators.

- Lead service improvement initiatives and process optimization.
- Ensure appropriate documentation of processes, procedures, decisions, and lessons learned.

- Project plans and project status reports
- Risk and issue registers
- Action and decision logs
- Cybersecurity dashboards
- Continuous improvement plans

Professional Experience

- Ability to manage complex projects involving multiple technical teams and stakeholders.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
- Strong leadership and coordination skills.
- Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. "As market leader within Digital Identity and Security, Thales makes personal digital interaction simple and secure in an increasingly connected society. From secure software to biometrics and encryption, Thales provides technologies and services that enables business and governments to authenticate identities and protect data, enabling its clients to offer trusted digital services to billions of individuals. Located in Älvsjö since 2012, the site houses both a commercial office as well as two productions within Identity & Biometric Solutions, and Banking & Payment Services. Working commercially across all business areas within Digital Identity and Security, Thales has become a trusted partner within various businesses as well as governments throughout the Nordics.

Role: Service Delivery Manager
Base location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)

Security process: This position requires that you undergo and be approved in accordance with the applicable regulations for security protection. For positions where Thales has requirements for security clearance, this may entail a requirement for local citizenship.

Identity & Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line
Thales Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) Business Line is part of the global Thales Group, which employs more than 80,000 people in 68 countries.
Thales delivers identity and biometric solutions to governments, public authorities, and private entities in civil identity and public security. We do this by providing highly secure documents, such as passports, ID cards, driver’s licenses, etc., at the heart of identity schemes. We also provide solutions for verifying people’s identities, for example, when they cross borders and enrolling them in national registers. Both of these are built on our expertise in biometrics.
And, as governments go through a digital transformation, we support them by delivering secure, convenient, and feature-proof mobile identity, digital identity wallet, platform, and services. We also address public security and law enforcement challenges by offering the latest in criminal forensics and real-time facial recognition.

Description
Thales Cybersecurity & Digital & Identity (CDI) provides Customers with technology to assist them in Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line.
Service Delivery Manager (SDM) shall manage the support and maintenance contracts related to Government Solutions (including Software and equipment supplied by Thales as well as third parties). SDM will ensure customer satisfaction in respect of contractual commitments, and the fulfilment of Service level agreements (SLA). SDM will be mainly involved in governance of incident, problem, and change management on the complete solution with contribution to upsell and new opportunities.
The installed Biometric and Public Security Solutions with associated software, hardware and peripherals are integrated with the Customers processes. SDM work with the Customer, Thales Internal and External Partner Suppliers and Thales Development/Senior Technical Teams (Level 2 and Level 3 Support) to ensure our response and restoration processes are aligned to contractual SLA and Availability and Reliability are maximised.

The role will work closely with different departments at our Älvsjö Office. The Line Manager is located abroad and so is several of the other Service Delivery Managers in the Manager’s team.

Key responsibilities include:
- Act as the primary customer interface for Support and Maintenance (S&M) contracts.

- Manage customer accounts by providing regular activity reporting, including weekly and monthly updates, steering committee materials, KPI reports, and SLA reports; recommend service improvements; and support contract renewals and new commercial proposals in coordination with Sales.

- Monitor incident resolution, ensure SLA compliance, and manage escalations whenever required.

- Monitor contract financial performance and maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction.

- Manage third-party contracts, communications, and performance monitoring where applicable.

- Coordinate and follow up on actions involving third parties and internal support teams, ensuring alignment with Thales processes.

- Prepare, plan, and manage the execution of changes in coordination with technical teams.

- Coordinate contractual activities such as preventive maintenance operations.

- Provide internal reporting on account activities and profitability; manage the contract using Thales tools in accordance with Thales processes.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
- An engineering degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

- At least five years of experience in service delivery management or project management for IT solutions.

- Strong customer relationship management skills.

- ITIL Foundation certification.

- Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish.

- Ability to travel at short notice within Europe.

- Eligibility for security clearance for Swedish customer.

- Experience working with remote teams.

- Experience in government-related activities is a plus.

What we offer:
- Competitive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives.

- A key role in shaping the company’s presence in a strategically important region.

- Opportunity to work with innovative technologies and cross-border teams.

- Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities.

postings.title: Service delivery manager
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Performance & Contract Delivery
- Own end‑to‑end delivery of contracted AMS services to Customers.
- Control requirements, costs and schedule during all the contract life cycle
- Manage project quality and customer and stakeholders overall satisfaction
- Manage legal and contractual requirements including handling disputes
- Conduct regular progress review meetings, reporting the project progress to the company senior management
- Manage risks and opportunities
- Ensure all services meet defined SLA and KPI performance metrics.
- Produce and present regular service performance reports, dashboards, and trend analyses.
- Drive proactive service improvements to enhance stability, resilience, and Customer satisfaction.
- Oversee the financial management of contracts by monitoring budgets, controlling costs, and ensuring profitable delivery.
- Continuously identify opportunities to optimize resource allocation, reduce expenses, and improve project margins without compromising service quality and client satisfaction.
2. Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management
- Act as the primary contact for Customers regarding service delivery, service performance and improvements.
- Lead regular service review meetings, ensuring transparent communication and alignment with Customer expectations.
- Manage escalations and ensure timely, accurate communication during service disruptions.
- Build strong, trust‑based relationships with operational, technical, and commercial stakeholders within Customer organisations.
- Regularly measure customer satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement actionable plans to enhance service quality and client relationships.
3. Incident and Request Management
- Oversee the management of incidents affecting Customer services, ensuring rapid coordination across internal teams and suppliers.
- Ensure root‑cause analysis and corrective actions are completed for all significant events.
- Ensure timely and value-based answers to Customer requests.
- Be actively involved within the change process to ensure modifications to systems or services are controlled, tested, and communicated effectively to Customers.
- Ensure continuity and resilience plans are maintained and tested.
4. Compliance, Safety & Regulatory Alignment
- Ensure service delivery processes align with relevant ATM regulatory frameworks.
- Maintain full compliance with Thales quality standards by implementing consistent processes, conducting regular audits, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
- Ensure that all service delivery processes strictly adhere to Thales cybersecurity standards and best practices to protect client data and maintain system integrity.
- Support audits, safety assessments, and compliance reporting.
- Maintain accurate service documentation, configuration records, and evidence required for regulatory oversight.
5. Internal Coordination & Service Governance
- Interfaces with internal Services Managers and their service delivery capabilities who are responsible for delivering the various services of the catalogue.
- Manage performance of suppliers delivering components of the delivered services.
- Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive service delivery for Customers.
- Ensure service readiness prior to new deployments, upgrades, or transitions.
- Support lifecycle planning for systems and services delivered to Customers.
- Contribute to internal governance forums, risk reviews, and service improvement boards.
6. Service Sales & Customer Business Growth
- Proactively engage with Customers to identify opportunities for selling additional AMS services that meet their evolving operational needs.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to develop and present compelling service propositions and commercial offers.
- Lead service consultations and discussions with Customers to articulate the benefits, value, and competitive advantage of AMS service offerings.
- Support contract negotiations and renewals by aligning service delivery capabilities with Customer business objectives.
- Foster strong Customer relationships to drive trust, loyalty, and long-term business growth through service adoption and expansion.

Required Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in service delivery, project delivery, operations, or customer management within safety-critical or highly regulated industries such as ATM, aviation, defence, telecommunications, rail, or energy sectors.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex service environments involving multiple parties and suppliers.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a particular aptitude for engaging operationally focused Customers.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities focused on driving measurable business outcomes.
- Familiarity with Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems including surveillance, communications, navigation, network infrastructure, command & control systems, or data services.
- Desirable: knowledge and practical application of service management frameworks such as ITIL, CMMI-SVC, or equivalent.

Personal Attributes
- Safety-first mindset with an unwavering commitment to compliance and risk management.
- Customer-centric approach, emphasizing relationship-building and responsiveness.
- Calm, structured, and decisive when managing crises or working under pressure.
- Proactive, continuous improvement-oriented, and willing to challenge the status quo constructively.
- Skilled in influencing and persuading stakeholders without direct authority.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: Service Delivery Manager
postings.description:
Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales currently have an opportunity for a Service Delivery Manager (SDM), based out of our Belfast site.

Service Delivery Managers are responsible for managing and delivery of Service-related Programmes and work packages into key customers. These services range from providing Software and Hardware upgrades to Customers, providing Spares and Repairs, to the provision of an overarching support capability.
The SDM plays a vital role in developing the business as a long-term progressive service provider, building strong customer relationships, acting as the bridge between the Customer and our operational delivery teams.
As an SDM you’ll report into the Head of Service Delivery IAS UK and will support the Service Delivery team to ensure the service delivery as agreed in the contract(s) and ensure SLA’s and customer satisfaction are achieved or exceeded.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS)
Our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

What will you deliver?
- Monitor, control and delivery of the Service programme and related work package commitments, using effective planning methodologies.
- Maintain the Service Management Plan.
- Permanently update the Service File and ensures it is continuously adapted.
- Interface with the Customer about the technical & operational subjects relating to the capture and processing of requests.
- Guarantee service delivery according to Service Level Agreements.
- Develop innovative solutions to improve effectiveness and efficiency.
- Ensure that incidents are managed and that the service is continuously available.
- Classify incidents, find the root cause and propose Engineering Change Request if needed.
- Ensure that service requests are managed properly.
- Optimise the experience feedback.
- Analyse customer feedback, performance indicators and operating reports.
- Produce and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPI).
- Identify sources of improvement and their priorities, which might be converted into product or system change by the System Engineering Manager (SEM).
- Coordinate the technical activities conducted by the teams involved in the provision of Customer Services.

Who are we looking for?
This position requires expert experience in either a service management or technical solution role. The Key skills and experience required includes the following:
- Experience of working in a Product Support and or service environment is essential.
- Experience in delivering and managing a programme or significant workpackages within an Engineering/Defence/Manufacturing sector.
- Experience in delivering competitive bids in short timescales.
- Broad commercial and financial awareness.
- Able to operate effectively under project constraints and pressure and able to display sound judgement.
- Strong customer focus with the ability to build relationships at all levels.
- Degree level qualification or equivalent in a technical or business subject.
- A programme management qualification or equivalent would be of benefit.
- The SDM should have flexibility to travel often at short notice.

What can we offer you?
On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;
- Annual Performance Bonus
- Matched Pension up to 7%
- 28 days annual leave (Plus Bank Holidays)
- Life Cover equivalent to 2X times annual salary
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.
Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Plus précisément, vous devrez démontrer un haut niveau d'expérience et de compétences dans les systèmes de gestion des services ainsi que dans la gestion des niveaux de service.
Vous devez également charger d'établir une relation de confiance avec nos clients en tant qu'interlocuteur principal pour le périmètre de la prestation de services, tout en veillant à l'implication et à la responsabilisation des équipes internes et externes.

Préparation de la fourniture des services et gestion des changements

- Mettre en place un système de pilotage de la performance (tableaux de bord de suivi).
- Veiller à la bonne gestion de la configuration maintenue et tenir à jour le dossier de service.
- Mettre en œuvre le Plan de Management des Services (Service Management Plan).
- Identifier les écarts opérationnels par rapport au contrat et les communiquer au Chef de Projet.
- Analyser les résultats opérationnels du contrat.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Position Title - Industrial Site Manager
Industry– Electronics & Avionics Manufacturing
Location - Bengaluru & Mysore

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Industrial Site Manager to lead the planning, construction, commissioning, compliance, administration, and operational management of a greenfield manufacturing facility specializing in electronic assemblies, PCBA production, avionics products, and other high-reliability aerospace and electronics components.

The role requires a seasoned professional with 18–20 years of industrial leadership experience, including successful management of greenfield projects from concept through operational readiness.

The candidate must possess deep knowledge of Indian statutory regulations, factory compliance requirements, industrial infrastructure development, manufacturing operations, supply chain management, project execution, and workforce leadership.

The Industrial Site Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the facility is delivered on time, within budget, fully compliant with regulatory requirements, and capable of meeting aerospace-grade quality, safety, and production standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Greenfield Project Development & Site Operations Management
- Lead the end-to-end development of the manufacturing facility from site selection through operational handover.
- Coordinate land development, civil construction, utilities installation, and infrastructure readiness.
- Manage EPC contractors, consultants, architects, and engineering teams.
- Oversee factory layout planning, production flow design, warehousing, utilities, and office infrastructure.
- Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, milestones, and risk mitigation plans.
- Ensure timely commissioning and operational readiness of all manufacturing areas.
- Establish and manage manufacturing operations for:- Electronic assemblies
- Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) lines
- SMT and through-hole manufacturing
- In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems
- Avionics products and subsystems
- Aerospace-grade electronic equipment

- Develop production strategies to achieve quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
- Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement programs.
- Ensure production capacity planning and resource optimization.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Governance
- Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian laws, regulations, and statutory requirements, including:- Factories Act and related State Factory Rules
- Industrial Safety Regulations
- Labour Laws and Employment Regulations
- Environmental Regulations and Pollution Control Board requirements
- Fire and Life Safety requirements
- Electrical Safety Regulations
- Hazardous Waste Management Rules
- Building approvals and occupancy certifications
- ESI, EPF, Professional Tax, and other statutory requirements

- Manage interactions with government authorities and regulatory agencies.
- Maintain all permits, licenses, approvals, and certifications required for factory operations.

3. Real Estate Project Management & Execution
- Develop comprehensive project plans and governance structures.
- Manage project budgets, capital expenditures, and resource allocation.
- Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to executive leadership.
- Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
- Lead cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.

4. Site Management, Infrastructure and Maintenance:
- MUST Oversee operation and maintenance of:- HVAC systems
- Cleanroom environments and compliances
- Compressed air systems
- Power distribution systems
- Backup power systems
- Water treatment facilities
- Fire protection systems
- Security and access control systems

- Ensure uninterrupted utilities and facility support for manufacturing operations.
- Manage Facility management company and provide end to end guidance to support local business sites including FM leadership in terms of managing local supplier relationships specific to the local business sites. Must be expert in soft skills including management of site security, physical security, housekeeping, offce boys etc for smooth functioning of complete Thales facility.
- Expertise in security systems including CCTV and access systems, housekeeping and office maintenance including zeal to drive innovation, transformation, change and efficiency strategically within organization.
- Understanding of Building infrastructure & back up source to provide non-stop service to the site in regards of Electrical, Water, power redundancy, Building Genset failures, electrical panel failures, Earthing, Air Conditioning etc.
- Day to Day Office Facilities and Maintenance, Vendor Management & rate contracts.
- Expertise in handling critical infrastructure like critical labs, SFC (frequency convertors) isolation transformers, various powers frequencies, UPS, VRF, VRV, PAC Fire System, WLD, Humidity control and HEPA filters given technical work site etc..and all associated AMC contracts.
- Make sure to take care of security of office employees at site, manage accidents, issues and complaints, and handle medical emergencies for the office through continuous improvements.
- Take initiatives including use of technology to improve site efficiencies, managing KPIs and continuous improvement in administration operations.
- Propose & Implement cost saving measures at site.
- Stakeholder Management
- Ensure all site related compliances are checked and adhered.
- Exemplary behavior in regards with Business Ethics and patience levels.
- Must exercise solid judgment and perform as a team player while executing duties.
- Must possess excellent interpersonal and written communication skills, be detail and results oriented.
- Demonstrated ability to interface with employees at all levels in the organization.
- Problem Solving Approach, highly organized and analytical strong work ethic.
- Possess a collaborative personality and be open to suggestions.
- Proficiency in PowerPoint presentations, excel reporting’s, word, Outlook, software’s like autocad, 3D graphics etc.
- Workplace 5S
- Timely monitoring and ensuring of calibration / servicing for essential equipment
- Inventory Management (e.g. all kind of Inventory management, Storage 5S, Cycle-count, Support Inventory Audit, etc)- Maintain accurate records of repair orders, Invoices, inventory, transactions
- Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement strategies to enhance overall operational efficiency.
- Oversee the maintenance of tools and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition.
- Collaborate with the finance team to manage budgetary aspects related to all suppliers, vendors timely payments.
- Ensure strict HSE and Quality compliances including ESD lab related with safety regulations and industry standards processes.
- Ensure to adhere the timelines for different tasks.

- Proactive approach to identifying process improvements and cost-saving opportunities

5. Support for Aerospace Quality Compliance
- Support implementation and maintenance of:- AS9100 Quality Management Systems
- ISO 9001
- ISO 14001
- ISO 45001
- ESD Control Programs
- IPC Standards for Electronics Manufacturing
- Aerospace customer requirements

- Ensure readiness for customer, regulatory, and certification audits.

6. Supply Chain & Vendor Management
- Develop strategic relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers.
- Manage procurement activities related to facility setup and operations.
- Evaluate vendor performance and ensure contractual compliance.
- Support localization and supply chain development initiatives.

7. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
- Establish and promote a strong safety culture.
- Implement occupational health and safety programs.
- Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.
- Lead emergency preparedness and business continuity planning.
- Drive incident prevention and risk management initiatives.

8. Financial & Administrative Management

- Manage site operating budgets and capital expenditure plans. Need to prepare annual budget, Site CAPEX, Site opex and actuals In conjunction with MYB (Multi Year Budget), the REM shall optimize and propose the real estate budget as a whole (rent payments, charges, investment and conversion work, transfer).
- Drive cost optimization and operational efficiency initiatives.
- Oversee site administration, security, logistics, and support services.
- Ensure effective asset management and inventory control.

9. Physical Security & Site Protection
- Design and management of complete industrial security architecture.
- Perimeter security, fencing, gates, and guard force management.
- Security policies, procedures, and risk assessments.
- Visitor, contractor, and employee access management.

Electronic Security Systems

- Biometric Access Control Systems.
- CCTV Surveillance and Video Analytics.
- Security Control Room Operations (24×7).
- Intrusion Detection Systems.
- Alarm Monitoring Systems.
- Security Event Investigation and Incident Management.

Security Technologies Knowledge

- Glass Break Sensors.
- Door and Window Contact Sensors.
- Panic Alarms and Emergency Response Systems.
- License Plate Recognition Systems.
- Visitor Management Systems.
- Integrated Security Management Platforms.

10. Asset Protection & Business Continuity
- Protection of high-value inventory and electronic components.
- Intellectual Property (IP) protection.
- Prototype and engineering asset security.
- Crisis Management and Emergency Response.
- Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Planning.
- Theft prevention and loss-control programs.

Required Qualifications
Education
- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related discipline).
- Master's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or MBA preferred.

Experience
- 18–20 years of progressive industrial manufacturing experience.
- Minimum 10 years in senior plant management, site leadership, or factory management roles.
- Demonstrated experience leading greenfield manufacturing projects from concept through production startup.
- Experience in electronics manufacturing, PCBA operations, aerospace electronics, avionics, or related high-reliability industries.
- Proven track record managing large industrial facilities and multidisciplinary teams.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Your responsibility will be to help design and build tools and infrastructure that we use to support our teams and our customers. These tools will have to scale with our growing platform and customer base, and will drive operational excellence for the company’s globally distributed network. The person taking this role will have input in decisions that will have a major impact on the infrastructure and how we serve our customers. As an SRE in the ICO organization, you will work with your team solving problems, supporting and optimizing the infrastructure programmatically. You will work with your team to improve the overall availability, reliability, performance, and security of the infrastructure under control.

Special Position Requirements
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday with on-call work over some weekends

Work Travel: Domestic and international travel will be required from time to time to meet with colleagues, attend conferences etc etc.

While we have some flexibility about our working locations it is important that we meet face to face from time to time to properly build relationships and get to know each other. Therefore you may be required to travel internationally up to 5 times a year for department conferences, team meetings or group working sessions. You will also be required to attend your registered Thales / Imperva office. A few times a week to work directly with colleagues.

Key Areas of Responsibilities

● Work with other teams across the company to build and deploy infrastructure that supports our platforms.
● Apply SRE core tenets of measurement (SLI/SLO/SLA), eliminate toil, and reliability modelling
● Establish metrics for data-driven decisions to increase availability, reliability, and velocity

● Assist with go/no go preplanning, verification/validation, and review of existing and new product/services

● Experience with Python and Go. C/C++ a plus
● Expert knowledge of Linux systems, network programming and protocols TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP
● Experience with BGP and Anycast routing is a plus
● Experience with DevOps principles and concepts such as Infrastructure as Code (Ansible/Saltstack), CI/CD (Gitlab, Jenkins, Git), monitoring
and visualization (Prometheus, Grafana)
● Experience with big data technologies such as NoSQL/RDBMS, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka
● Experience with containers and container management (Docker, Kubernetes)

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Site Reliability Engineer afin d'assurer un haut niveau de service et d'excellence opérationnelle pour le développement d'une solution télécom innovante et ambitieuse (forte disponibilité, contraintes de haute performance) déployée dans le cloud public.
Ce produit nécessite la mise en place d'une équipe SRE dédiée.

Fonctions Essentielles
- Automatisation & Infrastructure as Code : Concevoir, construire et maintenir une infrastructure évolutive en utilisant des outils tels que Terraform, Ansible et Kubernetes. Développer des pipelines CI/CD automatisés via GitLab pour réduire le travail manuel répétitif.

- Disponibilité & Ingénierie de la Fiabilité : Définir et surveiller les Objectifs de Niveau de Service (SLO) et les Indicateurs de Niveau de Service (SLI). Gérer les "Error Budgets" afin d'équilibrer la vitesse d'intégration des nouvelles fonctionnalités avec la stabilité de la plateforme.

- Gestion des Incidents & Support en Astreinte : Participer aux rotations d’astreinte 24/7 pour fournir une réponse d’urgence et effectuer des diagnostics approfondis des problèmes en production.

- Performance & Planification de la Capacité : Réaliser des analyses de performance système, identifier les goulets d’étranglement et planifier la capacité pour garantir que l’infrastructure supporte la croissance et les pics de charge.

- Observabilité & Monitoring : Mettre en œuvre et affiner les alertes basées sur les symptômes et des stratégies de surveillance complètes en utilisant des plateformes comme Datadog, afin d’assurer une visibilité élevée sur la santé du système.

- Amélioration Continue & Postmortems : Animer des revues sans blâme après incidents pour identifier les causes profondes et mettre en place des corrections techniques pérennes afin de prévenir la récurrence.

- Sécurité & Conformité : Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité cloud pour appliquer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité, gérer les contrôles d’accès et répondre aux incidents ou vulnérabilités de sécurité.

- Support de la relation client

- Interface avec d’autres parties prenantes pour définir un plan d’amélioration de la solution

- Vous aurez la responsabilité de la disponibilité du service de la solution.

Votre Profil

Formation Ingénieur ou équivalent vous disposez :
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que SRE

- Compétences en développement Java requises.

- Vous êtes familier avec le Cloud Public (GCP, AWS), les conteneurs et microservices (Docker, Kubernetes, Java), CI/CD et automatisation (Jenkins, GitLab, Helm), bases de données NoSQL.

- Vous êtes fluent en anglais.

Merci de postuler avec un CV en Anglais.

Certification :
La certification Architecte Cloud GCP est un plus.
- Vous avez déjà mis en place la surveillance produit et l’infrastructure sous-jacente.

- Vous avez une expérience de développement dans un contexte de systèmes distribués et/ou de haute disponibilité.

- Vous êtes familier avec le développement de microservices.

- Vous avez participé à la définition d’architectures, structures de données, algorithmes avec des contraintes de performance, sécurité, fiabilité, etc.

- Certification architecte cloud public.

- Vous vous intéressez aux aspects Site Reliability Engineer : CI/CD, automatisation, monitoring et observabilité, amélioration continue.

- Vous êtes un ingénieur développeur accompli, polyvalent et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Darauf freuen wir uns:

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) sowie in der Automatisierung von Betriebs- und Incident-Management-Prozessen

- Kenntnisse in regulierten Branchen mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen, z.B. Banking, Versicherungen, Healthcare oder vergleichbaren Umfeldern mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen

- Erfahrung in internationalen Arbeitsumgebungen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Erfahrungen mit Google Cloud Platform (GCP) sowie eine hohe Lernbereitschaft und Begeisterung für moderne Cloud-Technologien

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2025 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.

Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.

postings.description:
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Dlaczego potrzebujemy właśnie Ciebie?
Thales od ponad 30 lat rozwija swoją działalność w Polsce, dostarczając zaawansowane technologicznie rozwiązania dla sektorów, które mają kluczowe znaczenie dla bezpieczeństwa i przyszłości świata: obronności, tożsamości cyfrowej, cyberbezpieczeństwa, lotnictwa i kosmonautyki. Dziś tworzymy zespół ponad 1200 specjalistów pracujących w Tczewie, Gdyni i Warszawie.
W tak wymagającym i odpowiedzialnym środowisku bezpieczeństwo jest czymś więcej niż procedurą — to fundament zaufania naszych klientów, ochrona naszych produktów oraz warunek sprawnego działania całej organizacji. Dlatego szukamy osoby, która potrafi patrzeć szeroko, działać strategicznie i skutecznie przekładać standardy bezpieczeństwa na codzienną praktykę biznesową.
Jeśli chcesz mieć realny wpływ na bezpieczeństwo międzynarodowej organizacji technologicznej, potrafisz szybko identyfikować ryzyka i skutecznie im przeciwdziałać, a zarządzanie bezpieczeństwem firmy jest obszarem, w którym łączysz doświadczenie, odpowiedzialność i pasję — to może być rola właśnie dla Ciebie.

Twoje kluczowe obowiązki:

- kształtowanie i wzmacnianie kultury bezpieczeństwa w całej organizacji,
- identyfikowanie, analizowanie i przewidywanie potencjalnych zagrożeń dla firmy, jej pracowników, klientów, produktów i procesów,
- wspieranie lokalnych zespołów operacyjnych w zakresie bezpieczeństwa fizycznego, logicznego oraz organizacyjnego,
- zapewnianie zgodności z wewnętrznymi i zewnętrznymi wymaganiami bezpieczeństwa, w tym standardami ISO27001, ISO14298, GIE CB, PCI, GSM, politykami bezpieczeństwa Thales DIS oraz wymaganiami klientów,
- współpraca z jednostkami certyfikującymi oraz koordynowanie wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych audytów bezpieczeństwa,
- opracowywanie, wdrażanie i doskonalenie procesów, praktyk oraz polityk bezpieczeństwa służących ograniczaniu ryzyka,
- zarządzanie programami budowania świadomości bezpieczeństwa dla pracowników, wykonawców i gości, obejmującymi polityki, procedury i najlepsze praktyki firmy,
- projektowanie, rozwijanie i nadzorowanie systemów bezpieczeństwa fizycznego, w tym kontroli dostępu, monitoringu wideo, systemów wykrywania włamań, zarządzania tożsamością oraz systemów monitorowania,
- kierowanie pracą zespołu oraz wspieranie jego rozwoju, zaangażowania i skuteczności działania.

Nasze wymagania:

- minimum 3 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku Dyrektora ds. Bezpieczeństwa lub w podobnej roli w korporacyjnym środowisku bezpieczeństwa,
- doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem, budowaniu zaangażowania oraz motywowaniu pracowników,
- dobra znajomość języka angielskiego, co najmniej na poziomie B2, oraz płynna znajomość języka polskiego,
- praktyczna znajomość systemów zarządzania bezpieczeństwem informacji, sieci i infrastruktury IT,
- doświadczenie w obszarze systemów zarządzania bezpieczeństwem fizycznym,
- bardzo dobre umiejętności interpersonalne oraz zdolność jasnego komunikowania zagadnień związanych z bezpieczeństwem i ryzykiem zarówno odbiorcom technicznym, jak i nietechnicznym,
- doświadczenie w negocjacjach z dostawcami oraz w obszarze uzgodnień kontraktowych,
- wysoki poziom uczciwości, odpowiedzialności i dojrzałości zawodowej, w tym umiejętność profesjonalnego postępowania z informacjami poufnymi,
- umiejętność spokojnego, zdecydowanego i skutecznego działania w sytuacjach kryzysowych,
- wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane w obszarze administracji biznesowej, technologii, bezpieczeństwa lub pokrewnym,
- mile widziane certyfikaty z zakresu zarządzania bezpieczeństwem, takie jak Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),
- zamieszkanie w pobliżu lokalizacji firmy, w okolicach Tczewa lub Trójmiasta, albo gotowość do relokacji.

Co możemy Ci zaoferować:

- Oferujemy strategiczną i wpływową rolę w organizacji produkcyjnej, w której Twoje decyzje będą miały bezpośredni wpływ na efektywność operacyjną, jakość dostaw oraz rozwój zespołów.
- Pracę z doświadczonymi zespołami w środowisku nastawionym na jakość, bezpieczeństwo i ciągłe doskonalenie.
- Udział w projektach transformacyjnych o wysokim znaczeniu dla organizacji.
- Przestrzeń do rozwijania przywództwa, wdrażania usprawnień i budowania kultury zaangażowania.
- Międzynarodową ekspozycję i rozwój w ramach programów korporacyjnych
- Stabilne środowisko pracy w firmie technologicznej o wysokich standardach operacyjnych
- Zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę;
- Samochód służbowy;
- Prywatna opieka medyczna współfinansowana przez firmę, ubezpieczenie na życie, fundusz socjalny, stołówka firmowa, zajęcia sportowe, imprezy integracyjne i charytatywne;
- Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym (częściowo z domu, częściowo z biura zlokalizowanego w Tczewie, niedaleko Gdańska).

Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie?

Jeśli chcesz objąć odpowiedzialność za kluczowy obszar naszej firmy, rozwijać zespoły i mieć realny wpływ na skuteczność naszych działań, zapraszamy do aplikowania. Dołącz do nas i współtwórz środowisko, w którym technologia, jakość i ludzie są podstawą sukcesu

With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

Votre quotidien

Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.

Au sein de Thales, nos équipes de Thales Cyber Solutions fournissent un large spectre de services de cybersécurité, allant de la gouvernance cyber à l’expertise technique pointue en passant par les services de détection et de réponse qui sont délivrés à partir de nos SOC, ou encore l’analyse forensics et l’intelligence sur la menace.
Nos clients sont des grands groupes, des OIV, des OSE ayant à protéger des systèmes IT ou OT critiques ou encore des organisations gouvernementales.

Votre quotidien

Au sein de de Thales, notre équipe assure la surveillance (Monitoring de sécurité 24/7, Log Management, Orchestration, Sondes), la prévention (Veille en relation avec un CERT) et le management des systèmes de sécurité de nos clients (Audits de vulnérabilités, Gestion des Identités et des Accès, Reportings de sécurité).
Intégré(e) à l’équipe « Service Delivery Manager » du SOC, vous synchronisez toutes les parties prenantes, équipes, fournisseurs, clients en vue de réaliser les objectifs d’un contrat. Vous en êtes le chef d’orchestre !

Dans ce contexte, vos missions principales consistent à :

- Assurer la relation client et le suivi du contrat

Participation aux instances de gouvernance avec le client
Suivi de la qualité de la prestation avec l’élaboration et surtout l’exploitation de différents indicateurs
Amélioration continue de la prestation pour accroitre la valeur ajoutée des services et leur productivité
Rapports réguliers : Fournir des rapports détaillés aux parties prenantes sur l'état des projets, incluant les performances actuelles par rapport aux objectifs prévus
Prise de décision : Utiliser les indicateurs de performance pour informer les décisions stratégiques, optimiser les ressources et ajuster les plans de projet au besoin
Pilotage des améliorations continues : Mettre en place des actions correctives et d’amélioration basées sur l’analyse des indicateurs pour garantir l’efficacité des projets et accroitre la valeur ajoutée des services

- Conduire les projets confiés dans les délais et conformes au contrat

Vous êtes amenés à conduire des projets techniques lors des phases de BUILD et lors des phases de RUN, vous assurez les tâches suivantes :
Piloter l’équipe transverse et les prestataires ainsi que les acteurs collatéraux internes Thales (services achats, services juridiques...);
Suivre les jalons de réalisation ;
S’assurer de la conformité des livraisons et encadrer les recettes client.

- Soutenir l’élaboration des offres et la conduite des avant-ventes

Dans le cadre de la préparation d’une offre, vous êtes amené(e) à intervenir afin d’apporter votre expertise pour assurer la cohérence des hypothèses prises par les équipes avant-ventes. Vous assurez également une représentation auprès du client notamment lors de la défense d’offres.

- Foisonner, identifier les nouveaux besoins

Via des points réguliers avec vos clients sur votre périmètre, vous identifiez leurs nouveaux besoins et proposez des nouveaux services adaptés. Vous présentez les nouvelles offres de services et solutions et pilotez la remise d’offres commerciales.
Vous vous appuyez sur les fonctions de support nécessaires pour assurer les activités de foisonnement en dehors des outils disponibles au contrat :
Experts techniques pour les sujets innovants, nouvelles solutions et offres de service.
Equipes commerciales et BID Management pour la livraison des propositions commerciales (SoW, tarifs...) mais également des éléments budgétaires requis par les processus Thales (Gate, PCS...).
Services achats, juridiques...

- Veille technique active sur les nouvelles technologies autour des activités SOC, de la cybersécurité en générale et de l’intelligence artificielle

Votre profil

Issu(e)d’une formation supérieure (Ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5), vous avez déjà une expérience technique au sein d’un SOC d’au moins 5 ans.

Vous maitrisez la gestion de programmes complexes, les aspects de structuration et de planification des projets, la gestion des risques et les mécanismes financiers. Par ailleurs, vous avez une excellente compréhension des problématiques liées à la cyber sécurité.
Vous êtes capables d’intervenir sur des sujets transverses tout en maitrisant les risques et en vous adaptant pour faire face aux imprévus et urgences.
Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour accompagner au mieux les équipes.
Au-delà de vos compétences professionnelles, on vous reconnait pour votre aisance relationnelle, votre communication structurée et ciblée permettant d’être en interface avec des clients d’un haut niveau d’exigence. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome, aimez le travail en équipe, faites preuve de curiosité pour apprendre davantage et êtes en capacité de partager vos connaissances.
Vous êtes sensibilisé(e) à la protection de l’information et faites preuve de discrétion.
Votre niveau d’anglais (écrit comme oral), vous permet d’intervenir dans un contexte international.

Lieu : Elancourt/ Helios (Vélizy)

Innovation, passion, ambition : rejoignez Thales et construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

- Prioriser les éléments du backlog produit et maintenir un backlog à jour pour l'équipe
- Co-réaliser des études de marché et collecter les données nécessaires par le biais d'études, d'enquêtes, de programmes alpha/beta et de mesures à bord pour analyser et identifier objectivement les besoins des utilisateur(ice)s
- Rester disponible pour l'équipe tout au long du sprint
- Interface avec les fonctions du groupe et les principales parties prenantes

- Vous justifiez d'une expérience d’au moins 6 ans dans le pilotage et le suivi des activités de développement logiciel sur systèmes complexes de grande envergure.

At Thales, we develop technologies that help governments, critical infrastructure operators, and organizations protect their most valuable assets. Our cybersecurity and digital engineering teams design and deliver innovative solutions that strengthen cyber resilience, secure information systems, and support mission-critical operations.
As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our engineering team in Belgium. - Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications using Python and Django.

- Author and maintain unit tests, and where relevant browser-driven end-to-end tests, as part of every feature.

- Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge-sharing activities.
- Continuously improve technical knowledge and stay informed about emerging technologies and development practices.
- Actively participate in Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices to accelerate the delivery of new features.

Skills, Competencies & Requirements
Required Experience
- 2–3 years of professional experience in software development.
- Strong practical experience with Python programming.
- Proven experience developing backend applications using Django.
- Practical experience with Django REST Framework (DRF) and OpenAPI/schema tooling.
- Familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Experience with Docker and containerized environments.
- Comfortable working in a Linux environment (bash, log inspection, container-level troubleshooting).
- Experience using Git and collaborative development workflows.
- Awareness of static analysis / linting tooling (Ruff, Flake8, or equivalent) and comfort working in a warnings-as-errors development posture.
- Knowledge of software testing principles and development best practices.
- Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments.
Preferred Experience
- Familiarity with asynchronous task frameworks (Celery) and broker technologies (Redis / Valkey).
- Familiarity with enterprise SSO integration (OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML).
- Familiarity with browser-driven end-to-end testing (Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent).
- Familiarity with legacy frontend stacks (jQuery, Bootstrap, server-rendered templates) for maintaining and modernizing existing UIs.
- Vulnerability Management Concepts: Familiarity with CVE/CWE/CVSS, common security scanner output formats (SARIF, XML/JSON reports from SAST/DAST/SCA tools), and finding lifecycle concepts.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
- Exposure to Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
- Understanding of secure development principles and cybersecurity fundamentals.
- Exposure to or strong interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) applied to software engineering.
Language Requirements
- Fluent English, both written and spoken.
- Fluent French or Dutch, both written and spoken.
- Knowledge of the third national language is considered an advantage.
Personal Competencies
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
- Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to share knowledge.
- Ability to work autonomously while contributing to collective objectives.
- Attention to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
- Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies.

Why Join Us?
Joining Thales Cyber Solutions Belgium means contributing to technologies that protect critical infrastructures, sensitive information, and digital ecosystems. You will work on impactful projects alongside highly skilled professionals in cybersecurity, software engineering, and digital innovation.
At Thales, we foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where continuous learning, technical excellence, and professional growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to expand your expertise, work with modern technologies, and contribute to solutions that help create a safer and more secure digital world.
