postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Praha, Czechia

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language.

Build security-critical backend system that millions of users rely on - with modern Java, modern Spring, and a team that ships, owns, and continuously improves the platform.
We’re a product company in the cybersecurity/identity space. That means real engineering problems (security, scale, correctness, reliability), real ownership (you build it, you run it), and real influence (strong partnership with Product, not ticket-taking).
Why this role is different
- Modern stack, by design: We stay on the newest Java LTS and the newest Spring Framework (security expectations make this non-negotiable - and it’s a great side effect for engineers).
- Pragmatic testing: We value confidence over coverage. Integration-first where it matters. Minimal mocking. Tests that catch real issues.
- Strong CI/CD culture: Automated pipelines, multiple test layers, fast feedback, high signal.
- True ownership: We deploy to production ourselves and own the full lifecycle.
- AI-enabled engineering (for real): Company-backed initiative with tooling, guidelines, and people driving adoption - great opportunity to level up how you use AI effectively.
- Voice and influence: Engineers are expected to speak up, challenge solutions, and improve the platform, even beyond our team boundaries.
What you’ll do
- Design and deliver backend services where security, correctness, and maintainability are first-class requirements.
- Break down ambiguous, high-impact problems into a clear plan and ship iteratively.
- Collaborate closely with Product to craft solutions that are both technically sound and user-aware.
- Improve platform-wide concerns: reliability, observability, performance, developer experience, and deployment safety.
- Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, pragmatic architecture decisions, and knowledge sharing.
Our tech stack (high-level)
- Java (latest LTS), Spring Framework (latest)
- Kubernetes, Helm, Skaffold, GitOps
- AWS
- CI/CD with extensive automated testing
- Strong automation mindset across build, deploy, and operations
What we’re looking for
Must-haves
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Deep expertise in Java and strong hands-on experience with Spring
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Fluent English (spoken and written)
- Ability to work autonomously: you can take a big problem, de-risk it, and drive it to completion, while pulling others in when needed
- Strong engineering intuition: you challenge weak solutions, avoid “bare minimum,” and care about long-term quality
How you work
- You like clarity, but you’re not blocked by ambiguity
- You optimize for outcomes, not just activity
- You enjoy improving shared foundations (platform, tooling, patterns), not only “your” service
Bonus points (nice to have, not required)
If you don’t have these yet - curiosity and the willingness to learn matter more. We’ll help you grow through hands-on work with experienced engineers.
- AuthN/AuthZ flows: OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, WebAuthn, SAML, SCIM
- Interest in CIAM/IAM concepts: consent, identity lifecycle, federation, credential management, RBAC, token-based security
- Distributed systems / event-driven experience where scale, availability, and consistency matter
- Observability & performance tuning: metrics/tracing, JVM optimization, load testing
- Cryptography fundamentals: key management, secure hashing, TLS, JWT signing
- Multi-tenant architectures, data isolation, secure configuration management
- IaC / DevOps: Terraform, CloudFormation, GitOps workflows
- Balanced testing strategy: contract tests, integration-first, minimal mocking, maintainable test suites
What you get
- High-impact work in a security domain that genuinely matters
- Modern Java + Spring, with a team that actively keeps tech current
- A culture of ownership: build, ship, operate, improve
- Strong DevEx focus and automation mindset
- Free access to Udemy courses
- Mentorship, onboarding, and an environment where learning is expected and supported
Hiring process (transparent and respectful)
Typical steps:
Intro call (mutual fit, expectations) Technical conversation focused on real-world backend engineering with practical exercise and deep-dive discussion (designed to be relevant, not “leetcode theatre”) Final team / culture conversation
Ready to build secure, modern backend systems in Prague?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If you’d rather start with a conversation, send a short note with:
- what you’re building now,
- what kind of problems you want next,
- and what “great engineering culture” means to you.

Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

Software Engineer C++ (junior-mid)
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

For the SMU Team (sensor management unit) we are looking for a software engineer (C/C++) with strong analytical skills and effective communication abilities. You will not only be a developer writing software but also be involved in integrations and troubleshooting, primarily ensuring the software operates correctly across various radar systems. In this role, you will act as a connector across disciplines and work within a close-knit team.

About Thales
Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.
Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.

About the job
Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.

About you
Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.
The requirement is a completed Master’s degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (minimum 2 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus.
You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.
Screening Criteria
- Minimum of 2+ years of experience in C++ software development
- Experience with Real-Time Software development
- Proficiency with Linux operating systems
- Experience working as part of a large software development organization
- Effective team player
- Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven
- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent
- Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
- Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification
What's in it for you
- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
- A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
- You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
- A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
- 40 days paid-time-off per year.

Interested?
Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.
To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.
Diversity Statement
We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.

This vacancy requires a security clearance which can require further evidence to be provided. postings.title: Software Engineer C++ (TRK)
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (TRK)

Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that form part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds to thousands of kilometers.
Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for the software development of optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is performed in multidisciplinary teams alongside specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.

About the job
Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes several domains such as controlling the radar systems, managing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the development toolchain, and the Agile process.

About you
Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.
The requirement is a completed HBO (higher professional education) or WO (university) degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (5 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus.
You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.

Screening Criteria
- Minimum of 5+ years of experience in C++ software development
- Experience with Real-Time Software development
- Proficiency with Linux operating systems
- Understanding of Mathematics relevant to software development
- Ability to work effectively as a team player
- Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent
- Reskilling possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
- Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification

What's in it for you
- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
- A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
- You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
- A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
- 40 days paid-time-off per year.

Interested?
Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.

To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.
Diversity Statement
We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Sur un Campus Bordelais à la pointe de la technologie, entre océan et vignes, nous concevons et développons des systèmes, des équipements et services pour garantir le succès des missions aéroportées de nos clients.

Sur le Campus Thales Bordeaux, nous concevons, développons et livrons des systèmes, des équipements et des services pour assurer la réussite des missions aéroportées de nos clients, dans les domaines du transport, de la surveillance et du combat.
Le Centre de Compétences SAF (Fonctions Logicielles Aéronautiques) de Thales AVS France recherche un ingénieur logiciel IHM F/H expérimenté, en CDI basé(e) à Bordeaux.
Nous vous accueillerons au sein de notre équipe, dont la mission est de développer les logiciels des interfaces graphiques des cockpits permettant au pilote de conduire son vol tout en interagissant avec la machine.
Notre ambition, connecter l'homme et la machine autonome à un écosystème ouvert en constante évolution.
Nos méthodes de travail reposent sur les principes Agile, où autonomie, prise d'initiative et adaptabilité sont de mise. Nous avons à cœur de respecter l'équilibre vie pro/vie perso dans un climat de confiance et de flexibilité.
En tant que Software Engineering Manager, vous devrez piloter le développement de la solution logicielle d’IHM répondant aux besoins du client.
Vos missions principales seront
• Définir une logique de développement répondant au mieux aux enjeux industriels de la BL FLX et aux besoins du Client
• S’assurer du déploiement et de la bonne compréhension de la stratégie de développement au sein des équipes
• Tenir les engagements financiers, les jalons et les objectifs de qualité
• Partager de manière continue les éléments/indicateurs permettant de montrer et démontrer l’avancement et la tenue des objectifs
• Garantir la performance de son équipe en s’appuyant sur une démarche d’amélioration continue
• Partager, promouvoir et déployer des actions de compétitivité
• Garantir l'utilisation des bonnes pratiques logicielles de sa discipline métier au sein de son équipe de développement
• S’assurer de l’adéquation des compétences versus le besoin du projet en collaboration avec son responsable métier
• Piloter les risques et opportunités
• Assurer la réponse aux différentes offres liées à son produit

La compréhension du contexte projet vous donnera une vision moyen/long terme des enjeux et perspectives. Le développement incrémental du produit, orienté fonctions/opérations, avec des livraisons en continu, vous permettra de comprendre l'intérêt de vos réalisations pour le pilote et la manière dont ils opèrent vos IHM, le tout contribuera à donner du sens à vos actions.
Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler en équipe intégrée dans un contexte international et multiculturel.

Qui êtes vous ?
- Issu d'une formation BAC+5, Vous avez des expériences réussies dans le pilotage de développement logiciel temps réel critique ?
- Vous avez de solide connaissance en Agile Mindset (Scrum), GIT, GITLAB, JIRA, processus de développement DO178C, DO330 ?
- Des connaissances en C, C++, Technologie orientée Frameworks, Technologie à base de Composants, OS Temps Réel (ARINC653), IA seraient un plus.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Solution Architect
postings.description:
Location: Cheadle, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Under Water Systems (UWS)
Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

Primary Purpose of the Role
- Perform the development and implementation of solution architectures supporting the Project Design Authority (PDA).
- To design systems to meet the project needs, optimising the design through trade-offs to maximise customer and Thales’ value. Work closely with Hardware and Software teams to align the solution and detailed Architecture.

Principal Relationships

As part of the Thales Systems Engineering team, you will interact with the following key roles:
- Bid team members
- Project team members
- Testing team members
- Installation team members
- Project Planners
- Sales and Marketing
- Supply Chain
- Commercial
- Major Stakeholders / Clients

Key Responsibilities and Tasks:
- Creating, managing, promoting and delivering Architectures for MCM projects.
- Analyse Customer needs/requirements and assesses Solution architecture and technical choices. Understanding and embracing customer needs and advising customers.
- The development and management of Requirements Specifications for the System and Subsystems level.
- Good understanding of the development lifecycle and lifecycle products and the ability to support gated reviews.
- Interfacing with the client, to define standards and architectural frameworks.
- Impact Analysis / Variation
- Compliance / Customer requirement resolution
- Ensures Solution compliance with Customer needs, Product Policy, MTB Strategy & applicable legislation, rules & regulations.
- The defining and authorising of Design Descriptions and Verification objectives.
- Interaction with key stakeholders.
- Provide technical specifications and Interface Control Documentation
- Support acceptance and certification
- Maintain baselines
- Keep abreast of technical development both within and outside of the company.
- Reviews the technical risks and opportunities and the related mitigation plans throughout the bid or project.
- Responsible for ensuring, with the support of Specialty Engineering experts & Safety/HSE stakeholders, that the Solution design considers contract requirements and applicable legislation, rules & regulations, including product safety & security and Environmental/HSE requirements & standards, and that related certification activities are performed adequately and correctly.

Key performance Indicators against Responsibilities and Tasks:
- Quality of work produced against agreed standards
- Delivery to timescales
- Delivery to budget
- Performance against Thales key values

Skills:
- Leadership skills – with natural ability to build and sustain good working relationships at all levels.
- Has a sound ability to define the use of System Engineering tools, in particular modelling and requirements management.
- Able to use a range of IT tools.
- Has knowledge of configuration control processes.
- Can manage a complex project through a defined design process and is able to tailor CHORUS2 to project needs.
- Can define and use metrics as part of Quality assurance & control to change and re-model a System Engineering process.
- Working knowledge of project plans.
- Has knowledge of Engineering Safety Management in the context of architectural design
- Good technical writing skills and good interpersonal communication skills.
- First class presentation skills.
- Provide value to the customer
- Effective personal organisation and an ability to remain composed and focused under pressure.
- Experience of defining solutions to address obsolescence whilst minimising impact
- Understanding and application of UK MOD standards and equivalence
- Experience in driving hardware teams to provide suitable electrical and mechanical solutions within given systems constraints
- Ability to work between HW and SW teams to define processing and deployment solutions
- Understanding of environmental standards and requirements and application to deliverable solutions

Experience:
- The Solution Architect is the technical focal point for the solution design and framework, and must be able to resolve all issues, problems, questions and conflicts in the entire system. This requires frequent handling of new and unusual issues therefore a proven record of working in combat systems is required.
- Experience of collaborative working with cross-industry/customer teams, desirable for this to be multi-national.
- Sound knowledge of MCM solutions.
- The post holder should have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate at all levels in the spoken and written word. A good outward appearance, self-motivation and the ability to work under pressure are vital.
- The success of the Systems Engineering job family relies on the interaction of its engineers at all levels; therefore, evidence of team working is required.
- Experience in the developmental lifecycle disciplines, e.g. Requirements Capture, Modelling & Analysis, System Design, Product Development, and IV&V.
- Experienced and knowledgeable of whole systems engineering lifecycles for complex systems.
- The success of the Systems Engineering job family relies on the interaction of its engineers at all levels; therefore, evidence of team working is required.
- Knowledge of requirements toolsets (e.g., IBM DOORS)

Values & Behaviours:
- Innovate – Be motivated to search for novel and unique design solutions.
- Team working – Maximise the use of the wider Thales community to produce winning solutions.
- Develop people – Be prepared to share your ideas and experience with the wider Thales engineering community.
- Focus on customers – Be driven to deliver quality solutions to clients.
- Safety – Totally embrace the Thales safety culture to provide a safe and healthy working environment for all.
- Ethics - Thales employees must be exemplary in their ethical conduct and social responsibility.
- Job holders will be expected to perform in line with the Thales Code of Practice, Policies and Procedures.

Desirable Qualifications and Certification:
- Engineering Degree or equivalent

Essential:
- Have attained, or working towards an appropriate professional status (CEng) or equivalent

Financial / Budgetary Responsibility:
- The post holder will be expected to deliver designs/projects to an agreed budget.

UK Eyes Only:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.description:

About IS/IT
In rapidly changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a place where talented people come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make tomorrow possible.

Our Thales Netherlands IS/IT team operates at the heart of Thales’ digital transformation. Positioned between IS/IT and the business, we support more than 3,000 colleagues across multiple Business Lines and functions. We also work closely with international IS/IT teams within the Thales Group. Our mission? Providing secure and reliable access to information in one click, while continuously improving and taking pride in what we achieve together. We embrace agile principles, learn from experimentation and strive for a modern, future‑proof IT organisation.

About your future job
As a Solution Architect for the SID squad, you will be part of the IS/IT Business Applications domain. You help drive the digitalisation, standardisation and modernisation of our organisation. Your focus lies on integrations, Industry 4.0 solutions and designing robust, scalable application architectures, including shapingigital solutions on leading low‑code platforms such as Mendix and ServiceNow.

You are a leading force within the team: a sparring partner who provides direction, makes decision. You actively bring the team along in architectural choices, create clarity and ensure everyone understands why certain solutions are chosen. You work full‑time on Solution Architecture and act as a key link between the business, IT and our enterprise architecture, ensuring strong alignment, communication and collaboration across squads and stakeholders.
The SID squad operates at the centre of our digital landscape, connecting business needs, IT capabilities and architectural direction to ensure coherence and shared understanding across the organisation.

Your contribution:

- Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, challenges and needs

- Translate business questions into clear, future‑proof IS/IT solutions

- Design application, data and integration architectures using modelling techniques such as ArchiMate

- Drive Industry 4.0 initiatives by designing and implementing integrated solutions across smart mobility, IoT (including platforms such as Cumulocity), industrial networks and process automation, including the introduction of RPA (UiPath), ensuring these innovations strengthen and standardize our application landscape

- Collaborate with the Lead Engineers to shape the squad’s technical and architectural roadmap

- Collaborate with other architects and international Thales teams to exchange best practices and tooling

- Contribute to our ramp‑up by delivering solutions that help our users work more efficiently

Why you'd be a good match
- You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- You have experience with:
- API architecture and integration patterns

- Application design and solutioning

- Integration technologies such as SOAP, REST and Kafka

- Basic networking and security concepts

- Modelling (e.g. ArchiMate)

- You are a strong communicator and sparring partner for both business and IT

- You work transparently, predictably and take ownership

- You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch and English

What’s in it for you
- Become part of a close‑knit team within an innovative, international high‑tech organization

- (International) growth opportunities in technical, managerial or commercial roles

- Room for personal development, initiative and craftsmanship

- A modern, open working environment with attention to work‑life balance and flexibility

- 40 days of leave, travel reimbursement and a flexible à‑la‑carte package (including additional leave, internet allowance, bicycle plan, company fitness, union contribution)

Sovereign Cloud System Engineer (m/w/d)

The Information Security Officer is responsible for implementing, executing, monitoring, and continuously improving the logical security controls applicable to manufacturing and card personalization activities, in alignment with PCI Card Production Logical Security, customer requirements, and Thales CDI Information Security policies. The role protects production operations, personalization data, cryptographic assets, systems, networks, and supporting processes by ensuring that security controls are documented, implemented, monitored, evidenced, and maintained in an audit-ready condition. The position also supports risk identification, risk treatment, security procedure development, incident escalation, access governance, change control, secure configuration, vulnerability and patch follow-up, and compliance readiness for internal and external audits.

Main Responsibilities:

- Maintain the Information Security Management System updated and aligned with the evolution of Iztapalapa manufacturing and personalization activities, DIS Information Security Policy, PCI-CP Logical Security and applicable customer requirements.

- Identify, assess, document, and monitor security and operational risks impacting logical security, production systems, customer data, and personalization operations.

- Maintain certification readiness for PCI-CP, EMVCo + CC, customer audits, and internal security assessments. Coordinate evidence preparation, local team readiness, procedure updates, control walkthroughs, and remediation follow-up to ensure the site supports certification activities effectively and autonomously.

- Ensure findings from: internal, customer, certification, and compliance audits are reviewed, assigned, prioritized, and closed according to severity and committed deadlines. Validate action plans, track progress, document delays, maintain evidence, and escalate overdue or high-risk items.

- Coordinate and support internal control reviews to verify that logical security controls are implemented, operating effectively, and evidenced. Use SCART and internal audit results to detect gaps early, define sustainable corrective actions, validate closure evidence, and prevent recurrence.

- Monitor vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation, exception handling, and compensating controls for assets supporting manufacturing and personalization operations. Ensure serious and high vulnerabilities are treated within defined timelines or covered by documented risk-based waivers and approved compensating measures.

- Coordinate the annual penetration test ensuring that all in-scope systems, applications, network segments, infrastructure components, and personalization environments are tested. Ensure penetration test findings affecting production systems, network segmentation, applications, infrastructure, and personalization environments are assigned, risk-rated, remediated, retested, or formally accepted through approved exception processes.

- Ensure firewall configurations are regularly reviewed, optimized, and documented. Identify unused, obsolete, redundant, shadow, unknown, overly permissive, or unauthorized rules and ensure they are removed, corrected, or justified through approved local policy exception or waiver.

- Ensure security incidents are identified, classified, escalated, contained, investigated, and documented according to DIS policy, PCI-CP expectations, and local procedures. Coordinate root cause analysis, corrective actions, lessons learned, and recurrence prevention for incidents impacting operations, systems, data, cryptographic material, or customer obligations.

- Verify that critical suppliers supporting manufacturing, personalization, IT, infrastructure, logistics, maintenance, or security activities are assessed, monitored, and covered by appropriate contractual security requirements, including data protection, incident notification, audit rights, and confidentiality obligations.

- Ensure that site security and operational personnel understand their information security responsibilities, receive role-based training, and actively contribute to sustaining the Information Security Management System through proactive ownership, risk awareness, and continuous improvement in daily operations.

Minimum Requirements:

Formal Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field
Languages:
Spanish fluent; English intermediate to advanced
IT/Software:
Microsoft 365, ticketing tools, access management tools, SIEM/log review tools, vulnerability & firewall management platforms, evidence repositories
Experience in years:
5 years in information security, IT security, compliance, audit, or secure manufacturing environments

Technical Knowledge:
PCI-CP logical security; risk assessment; access control; network segmentation and firewall governance; vulnerability and patch management; security procedure writing

postings.description:
Lieu : Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages
- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

En tant que spécialiste des procédés de traitement de surface et peinture, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l’amélioration de la maîtrise des procédés spéciaux, la définition du standard Groupe, la performance industrielle des sites de production (internes et fournisseurs) et le déploiement des bonnes pratiques industrielles.
Vous accompagnez la montée en maturité de nos sites, assurez la qualité de nos produits et soutenez les entités sur les choix techniques.

Vos missions :
- Vous êtes en charge de définir le standard de maîtrise des procédés de traitement de surface et de peinture : flow chart, AMDEC process, caractéristiques clés, plan de contrôle, capabilité, équipementiers préférentiels et d’en assurer le déploiement sur les sites de production internes
- Vous supportez la résolution des problématiques rencontrées par les entités dans votre domaine et la mise en place d’actions correctives
- Vous supportez les entités lors de l’industrialisation pour orienter les choix de procédés et matériaux (Design for Manufacturing)
- Vous pilotez les qualifications procédés/fournisseurs et réalisez des audits techniques de fournisseurs
- Vous assurez une veille technologique et industrielle pour identifier les ruptures et établir la roadmap des années à venir
- Vous animez un réseau d’expert au sein du Groupe

Le département Bids and Programs Management (BPM) recherche un.e Spécialiste Project management Office pour le projet ONE PLAN / JV-MPS ( Master Production Schedule), acteur.rice central.e afin d’assurer la supervision de la planification basée sur les données provenant de l’Industrie (Production / MPS – Planning Directeur de Production), de l’Ingénierie et des Achats Externes (Procurement), dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre et de la coordination du Master Planning (JV-MPS), assurant la synchronisation au niveau TAS-JV entre les univers industriels et projets, afin d'améliorer la performance globale de l'entreprise en matière de respect des délais de livraison.

Intégré.e dans une équipe multi-sites et transnationale, acteur.rice clé de l’excellence opérationnelle, vous aurez un rôle majeur dans la conduite du projet ONE Plan / JV-MPS et de sa parfaite exécution dans le tenue des engagements calendaires de la société. En nous rejoignant en tant que spécialiste PMO ONE Plan / JV-MPS, vous serez chargé des missions suivantes :

- Création, maintenance et analyse du Master Planning de supervision ainsi que des rapports réguliers sur l’avancemen et les indicateurs clés de performance

- Conseil et accompagnement des équipes projets dans les processus, méthodes et outils, en mettant l’accent sur la planification, la gestion des risques et l’amélioration continue

- Identification et mise en œuvre des potentiels actions d’optimisation pour accroître l’efficacité et l’efficience dans les projets

- Développement des règles de bonnes pratiques, outils et leurs interfaces ainsi de soutenir activement la conduite du changement et les initiatives de bonnes pratiques du groupe

Votre rôle d’expert fonctionnel auprès des équipes projets est déterminant pour la réussite des projets :

Vous contribuez activement au pilotage de l’avancement du projet en assurant la consolidation et la qualité des données transmises , en mettant en œuvre les actions :
- Intégrer les dates de besoin des projets dans la planification prioritaire (Master Planning) à partir des plannings directeurs des projets ;
- Pour chaque projet, créer une cartographie de toutes les interdépendances entre les Centres de Coût (CC) industriels et Ingénierie concernant les équipements livrés/reçus ;
- Pour chaque élément final (équipements, sous-équipements, PECT), consolider la date engagée du CC, la date de début si requise, ainsi que la date de besoin du programme ;
- Coordonner les principaux acteurs (contributeurs de données, responsables de département, PMO et chefs de programme) afin d’assurer la disponibilité et la qualité des données ;
- Mettre à jour le Master planning JV MPS dans Primavera, en utilisant le processus existant de collecte des données OTD (On Time Delivery) ;
- Vérifier les écarts entre les livraisons d’équipements et les besoins des programmes ;
- Interagir avec les équipes des différents pays (France, Italie, Belgique, Royaume-Uni, Espagne, Suisse) pour assurer la cohérence et une compréhension globale ;
- Préparer les données permettant la génération de rapports d’écarts/alertes incluant les conflits d’équipements multi-programmes ;
- Gérer la mise en œuvre et le déploiement des solutions digitales en collaboration avec le Responsable Processus JV et les équipes opérationnelles ;

- Alerter les parties prenantes (Centres de Coût, Domaines, Programmes) sur les problèmes détectés (phases de mise en œuvre et de suivi)

postings.description:
Location: San Jose, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary

San Jose, Hybrid

Thales is looking for a Sr Engineer, Advanced Security Response Team (ASRT), who will work with a team which is dedicated to providing first response to security incidents and focused on the operational aspects of web application security: analyzing threats, suggesting direct methods of remediation and mitigation, and actively working to block attacks in real time.

In this customer-facing role, you will continuously interact with customers to mitigate security attacks while creating long lasting relationships through your technical expertise and engagement. Manage technical escalations, and work closely with Product and CS teams for our application security products (Value Added-Services, Dev, Support, Security, Sr. Management) in order to get issues resolved.

You will be a technical authority of Imperva’s Application Security suite, while constantly improving best practices for solutions and services. You will work closely with Management to implement and expand the global Advanced Security Response program.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Serve as a senior technical resource for the Americas Advanced Security Response (ASR) team, providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and promoting best practices in incident response and application security.

- Own the technical resolution of complex customer issues, escalations, and critical incidents, acting as a trusted advisor while ensuring timely communication, root cause analysis, and customer satisfaction.

- Collaborate with customers, Services Teams, Customer Success, Security Threat Research, Product Management, Product Development, and Engineering teams to resolve high-impact issues and drive product and service improvements.

- Analyze customer traffic, logs, attack trends, security alerts, and case history to identify risks, recommend security improvements, and strengthen customers' overall application security posture.

- Design, implement, and optimize custom security policies that detect, prevent, and mitigate application-layer attacks while minimizing false positives and ensuring optimal application availability.

- Serve as technical escalation point during sophisticated application attacks, including large-scale Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) incidents, zero-day threats, and advanced web application exploits.

- Perform forensic analysis of application logs, security events, and attack payloads to identify vulnerabilities, validate attack patterns, and provide actionable remediation recommendations.

- Document technical findings, create knowledge base articles, and share best practices that improve operational consistency, accelerate incident resolution, and enhance the technical capabilities of the ASR team.

- Develop and maintain automation solutions to streamline ASR workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve incident response efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications
- Minimum of 4 year bachelors degree in Information Systems or Computer Science or Telecommunications or any Technology field and minimum of 6 years experience in application or network security in a customer facing role with at least last 3 years in Security Engineering/Threat Mitigation role OR 4 years’ experience in application or network security with a Master’s degree in a technology field with at least 2 years in Security Engineering/Threat mitigation role.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving approach alongside self-learning ability. Passion for customer success/advocacy.

- Demonstrated experience in working with Internet Security and Networking Technologies such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL/TLS, Proxies, Firewalls, OWASP Top 10, and OWASP Automated Threats to Web Applications.

- Hands-on experience in identifying BOT behaviors and mitigating BOT attacks. And with web application vulnerabilities and common attack techniques (SQLi, XSS, OWASP Top 10, etc).

- Experience with one or more scripting languages (i.e. python, bash, java, etc).

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications
- Expertise with network security architecture, engineering, and security frameworks.

- Ability to anticipate customer and team expectations/needs and communicate effectively with relevant teams to resolve technical issues.

- A degree of flexibility to take appointments evenings and mornings, as required.

- Bilingual (English and Spanish or Portuguese) working/professional proficiency

postings.title: SRE COMPUTE
postings.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

S3NS est né du partenariat industriel entre Thales, leader mondial de la cyber sécurité, et Google Cloud, leader mondial des solutions cloud. Nous avons pour ambition d’offrir le meilleur des deux mondes à l’ensemble des organisations soucieuses de protéger leurs données sensibles (institutions publiques, OIV, OSE…). C’est-à-dire une solution équivalente à Google Cloud Platform (incluant à la fois les services IaaS et PaaS de GCP) et respectant les exigences du label SecNumCloud.

Une première offre, ‘Contrôles locaux avec S3NS’, est déjà disponible depuis février 2023 pour permettre à nos clients de bénéficier d’un premier niveau de transparence et contrôles additionnels, et d'accélérer la trajectoire vers le cloud de confiance.

Votre Quotidien

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) SRE Compute, votre mission sera au cœur de l'exploitation de notre univers GCP :
- Vous serez responsable du maintien en condition opérationnelle, de l'exploitation et de la gestion de l'ensemble des plateformes Compute (GCE, GKE, Vertex AI…), au sein d'un environnement équivalent à l'univers GCP.

- Vous gérerez les incidents de production 24h/24 et 7j/7, et développerez une compréhension approfondie des services techniques qui constituent l'épine dorsale des services GCP utilisés par des millions de clients.

- Grâce à notre partenariat privilégié, Google nous partage ses connaissances et vous ouvre les portes de sa pile technique interne (Borg, Colossus, Spanner, Sawmill, etc.). Vous bénéficierez d'un programme de formation accéléré et intensif, dispensé au contact direct des experts Google et de nos équipes S3NS déjà formées par leurs soins, pour maîtriser des technologies d'exception habituellement réservées aux ingénieurs internes de Google.

Responsabilités Clés :
- Monitoring SLI/SLO : Surveiller la disponibilité, l'évolutivité, la latence et l'efficacité des services souverains GCP liés au COMPUTE en traitant les incidents de production.

- Gestion d'Infrastructure : Gérer le parc de machines et les stacks de compute sous-jacentes (Borg et les différents control plane de Google) pour garantir une performance optimale.

- Diagnostic et Résolution d'incidents : Garantir la fiabilité maximale de la plateforme. Afin d'assurer un maintien en condition opérationnelle 24/7 de notre cloud, le poste implique des permanences en journée ainsi que des astreintes de nuit par roulement.

- Collaboration d'équipe : Collaborer avec des experts des services GCP à travers le monde pour aider à mitiger et à résoudre les incidents.

- Automatisation & Connaissance : Documenter les connaissances pour s'assurer que tous les SRE S3NS travaillent avec la même information, standardiser les flux de résolution et améliorer les playbooks opérationnels.

- Revues Post-incident : Après un incident, réunir les équipes pour effectuer un post-mortem, comprendre les causes, tirer des leçons et encourager l'amélioration continue.

Conformément aux exigences de qualification SecNumCloud de nos services, délivrée par l'ANSSI, ce poste est soumis à des exigences de sécurité renforcées. Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une enquête de sécurité menée par nos services, conformément à notre politique de sécurité du personnel.

Votre Profil

Ce qui vous passionne et vous motive :
- L'innovation technologique, le Cloud, et l'exploitation de services et d'infrastructures en mode "as code".

- L'excellence opérationnelle à grande échelle : L'exploitation et la haute disponibilité (≥ 99,99 %) de bases de données critiques et de moteurs analytiques à forte volumétrie.

- L'ADN de l'ingénierie Compute chez Google : La curiosité d'explorer comment un hyperscaler gère des millions de cœurs et l'envie de maîtriser plus de 20 ans d'innovation en systèmes distribués (GCE, GKE, Borg, Colossus, Spanner, etc.).

- L'impact au sein d'un collectif d'experts : La perspective de rejoindre une équipe spécialisée au cœur des enjeux Compute (parc de machines, control plane, virtualisation et orchestration).

Expérience :
- Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un Master.

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en SRE et automatisation des opérations. Poste ouvert aux profils juniors justifiant d'une expérience significative en alternance dans un périmètre similaire.

- Exposition à un environnement international avec un bon niveau d’anglais requis.

- Bonus: Une expérience précédente sur GCP est un plus mais votre soif d'apprendre notre propre Cloud est primordiale !

Le mot de l'équipe

« Envie de rejoindre une équipe passionnée à taille humaine ? Intégrez notre équipe SRE Compute : un collectif de 7 ingénieurs au cœur du moteur de notre cloud de confiance. Votre mission est critique : piloter le parc de machines et les stacks de compute sous-jacentes (Borg, control plane). Si vous aimez l'infrastructure pure et les systèmes à grande échelle, venez faire vibrer votre expertise avec nous ! »

postings.title: SRE Trusted Platform

Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun.

Au sein du centre de compétence HTE (Hardware technologies, Tools & Engineering), vous intégrerez une équipe du service TCP (Traitement, Capteurs & Propagation) en charge de la définition et de la conception de solutions algorithmiques, modules logiciels et démonstrateurs dans les domaines des communications, du traitement du signal, du traitement de données, de la guerre électronique, de la radionavigation, de l’acoustique aérienne et de la conception de systèmes d'antennes dédiés à ces domaines.

Vos missions

Ce stage de 6 mois porte sur la goniométrie qui a pour objectif l’estimation des directions d’arrivée d’émetteurs radioélectriques à partir des signaux reçus sur un réseau d’antennes.
Outre les méthodes de goniométrie classiques telles que le beamforming et MUSIC développées entre les années 60 et 80, de nouvelles méthodes sont apparues au début des années 2000 : les méthodes de goniométrie parcimonieuse. Ces méthodes présentent des performances supérieures en comparaison aux méthodes classiques. Elles permettent notamment d’estimer plus de sources que d’antennes. Ces méthodes estiment les directions d’arrivée des sources en exploitant la parcimonie en angles du modèle d’observation. Ce stage prendra la suite des travaux issus de deux thèses effectuées au sein du service [A. Delmer 2021 & T. Aussaguès 2026].
La mission proposée consistera à prendre en compte l’incertitude autour de la réponse du réseau d’antennes dans les algorithmes de goniométrie parcimonieuse. Cette incertitude est appelée erreur de modèle et a plusieurs origines : erreur sur les positions des antennes, déphasage additionnel, couplage mutuel etc. En présence d’erreurs de modèle, les performances des méthodes de goniométrie parcimonieuses se dégradent.

Vous contribuerez à l’analyse et l’amélioration d’un traitement de goniométrie parcimonieuse en présence d’erreurs de modèle. Spécifiquement, vous aborderez les points suivants :
- Adapter et améliorer l’algorithme développé dans les thèses [A. Delmer 2021 et T. Aussaguès 2026] en présence d’erreurs de modèle. Spécifiquement, l’étape de blanchiment de l’erreur d’estimation sur l’observation devra être adaptée ;
- Analyser les performances statistiques de la méthode proposée.

Les objectifs du stage seront :
1 - de mettre au point les réseaux de neurones correspondants à différents algorithmes itératifs parcimonieux
2 - d'évaluer l'apport des méthodes de dépliement des algorithmes parcimonieux en goniométrie en présence d'erreurs de modèles
3 - d'évaluer l'apport de ces méthodes pour la diminution de la complexité.

Votre profil

De formation Bac+5 (ingénieur ou équivalent), vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois pour finir votre cursus. Vous justifiez d’une première expérience en traitement du signal, manifestez un intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificielle et êtes passionné par les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité.

Maîtrisez-vous l’algèbre linéaire appliquée au traitement d’antennes, notamment le calcul matriciel et la décomposition en éléments propres ?

- Quantifier la sensibilité de l'attaque aux paramètres opérationnels (altitude, angle de visée, …) et identifier les régimes où la robustesse se dégrade.

- Proposer et implémenter des stratégies de durcissement et évaluer leur impact sur la précision nominale du détecteur.

- Rédiger un rapport technique détaillant (protocole expérimental, les résultats chiffrés et les recommandations ) et fournir le code reproductible et la documentation associée.

- Formalisez vos résultats et recommandations pour les futurs développements.

Automatisation et tests

• Intégrer des scanners de vulnérabilités (ex : Trivy, Grype) dans le pipeline Nix.
• Générer des rapports SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) et des analyses de licences.
Documentation et présentation
• Rédiger un comparatif technique NixOS vs. OS traditionnel
• Présenter les résultats (démonstrations, arguments techniques).

- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre un processus d'extraction, de transformation et d'intégration des données de l'instance ServiceNow North America, en collaboration avec les équipes américaines, tout en respectant les exigences de sécurité et de confidentialité.
- Faire évoluer le tableau de bord Power BI existant afin de consolider les données des instances Global et North America et de fournir une vision unifiée des équipements, logiciels, incidents et problèmes, grâce à de nouveaux indicateurs et visualisations.
- Documenter les développements réalisés, les procédures de migration et d'intégration des données, puis présenter les résultats, les livrables et les recommandations aux équipes projet afin de faciliter leur appropriation et leur maintien dans le temps.

En nous rejoignant, vous intégrerez le laboratoire High Performance Computing (HPC) de cortAIx, au sein du centre de recherche Thales Research & Technology de Palaiseau. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement de recherche dédié au développement de solutions innovantes pour les systèmes embarqués, avec des expertises en intelligence artificielle embarquée, en conception de calculateurs à haute performance énergétique, en développement logiciel parallèle et en conception matérielle ASIC/FPGA.

Vous contribuerez à des travaux autour du processeur RISC-V CVA6, une plateforme d'étude utilisée pour l'exploration de nouvelles techniques micro-architecturales.

Dans les processeurs modernes, les performances sont souvent limitées par les accès mémoire. Les mécanismes de préchargement (« prefetching ») permettent d'anticiper les données nécessaires à l'exécution afin de réduire les latences mémoire. Toutefois, les approches traditionnelles présentent certaines limites dans des cas d'usage spécifiques.

Des travaux récents menés au laboratoire ont exploré la prédiction d'adresses mémoire à partir du compteur ordinal (Program Counter) d'instructions de chargement. Cette approche ouvre la voie à de nouvelles architectures de préchargement capables d'initier les accès mémoire avant même que l'adresse effective ne soit calculée par le pipeline.

Vos travaux porteront sur l'étude, la conception et l'évaluation d'un mécanisme de préchargement mémoire reposant sur cette prédiction d'adresse et son intégration au sein du processeur RISC-V CVA6. Ils viseront notamment à améliorer les performances des architectures RISC-V et à analyser leur impact sur la hiérarchie mémoire.
Dans ce contexte, vous aurez pour missions :
- Réaliser une étude bibliographique sur les techniques de prédiction d’adresses, de prédiction de valeur et de pré-chargement mémoire matériel. Une attention particulière sera portée aux mécanismes permettant d’anticiper les accès mémoire à partir d’informations disponibles très en amont dans le pipeline.
- Analyser l’architecture du processeur CVA6 ainsi que l’infrastructure de la Load Store Unit (LSU) afin d’identifier le meilleur point d’intégration d’un mécanisme de pré-chargement basé sur une prédiction d’adresse.
- Concevoir une architecture de pré-chargement exploitant les adresses prédites afin de déclencher proactivement des accès mémoire. Plusieurs problématiques de recherche pourront être étudiées :- Conception d’un indicateur de confiance permettant d’évaluer la fiabilité des prédictions
- Limitation des effets de pollution dans le DTLB et les caches de données
- Étude de mécanismes permettant d’annuler ou retarder certains pré-chargements lorsque leur probabilité de succès est faible
- Analyse des interactions entre l’unité de pré-chargement et les mécanismes de dépendances mémoire déjà présents dans le processeur
- Exploration des synergies possibles avec l’unité de pré-chargement afin d’améliorer les performances globales du pipeline
- Enfin, vous implémenterez la solution proposée en SystemVerilog, l’intégrerez au sein de CVA6 et évaluerez expérimentalement son impact sur différents benchmarks.

Une poursuite en thèse CIFRE pourra être envisagée à l’issue de ce stage.

Les méthodes de Neural Architecture Search (NAS) permettent d'automatiser la conception d'architectures neuronales en explorant de vastes espaces de recherche. Dans ce contexte, vous aurez pour missions :
- Réaliser une étude bibliographique des approches NAS récentes couvrant plusieurs tâches ou contraintes matérielles.
- Prendre en main une méthode de référence afin d'étudier comment les connaissances produites lors de la recherche peuvent être représentées, transférées et réutilisées.
- Développer, à partir de cette analyse, une approche de Metamorphic NAS basée sur un LLM afin d'explorer efficacement différents espaces de conception, puis comparer les performances obtenues à celles de méthodes NAS classiques.
- Rédiger des tutoriels et de la documentation afin de favoriser l'adoption de la solution développée. Le code produit devra être rigoureux, reproductible et maintenable.

postings.category: HSE, Real Estate, Security, Personal Assistance, Medical Welfare
postings.description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

Over Thales
In Nederland, waar meer dan 2500 medewerkers werkzaam zijn, hebben we vestigingen in zeven steden: Huizen, Amersfoort, Rotterdam, Delft, Breda, Eindhoven en Hengelo (hoofdkantoor). Samen met een uitgebreid ecosysteem van kennispartners, klanten en leveranciers werken we aan radars voor zeeschepen, cybersecurity-oplossingen, transportsystemen, communicatieapparatuur voor landstrijdkrachten, cryogene koeloplossingen en onderzoek & ontwikkeling voor radartechniek (in samenwerking met TU Delft).

De afdeling en het team;
De Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) afdeling is een belangrijke speler bij Thales als het gaat om het beheren van onze demand en supply op middellange en lange termijn. In de snelgroeiende defensiemarkt is dit proces voor Thales cruciaal. Deze afdeling, sinds 2020 actief en nog steeds in ontwikkeling, heeft een belangrijke rol binnen onze organisatie.

De S&OP afdeling, bestaande uit 9 medewerkers, zorgt voor het plannen en sturen van het demand- en supplyproces. Regelmatig levert de afdeling een gevalideerd demand- en supplyplan, dat door de interne organisatie wordt opgevolgd. Daarnaast helpt de afdeling bij het nemen van beslissingen over toekomstige verschillen tussen demand en supply.

Over de opdracht
De S&OP afdeling bestaat nu vier jaar en maakt de overgang van projectmatig naar procesgericht werken. Door de complexe en specifieke aard van het S&OP proces is het essentieel om alle procedures, regels, criteria en werkwijzen duidelijk en concreet vast te leggen in een handboek.

Wij zijn op zoek naar iemand die deze informatie overzichtelijk kan samenvoegen. Dit handboek moet een nuttig naslagwerk worden voor iedereen die betrokken is bij het S&OP proces, met uitleg en toelichting voor alle relevante onderdelen.

Het proces omvat een breed scala aan aandachtsgebieden en er zijn veel interne afdelingen bij betrokken. Tijdens het opstellen van het handboek heb je regelmatig contact met onder andere Sales, Finance, de Supply Chain en vanzelfsprekend het S&OP team.

Affiniteit
- Organisatie en processen
- Sales
- Productie
- Forecasting
- Marketing
- Finance

Je bent veelzijdig, hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, een helicopterview en kunt gedetailleerde informatie omzetten naar een geordend geheel.

Wat krijg jij ervoor terug
- Een interessante stage-/ of afstudeerplek binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving;
- Een comfortabele, flexibele werkplek in een moderne omgeving;
- Een prima stagevergoeding;
- Een eigen studentenvereniging waarbij je kunt deelnemen aan educatieve en leuke activiteiten.

Houd er rekening mee dat we alleen studenten accepteren die zijn ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling gedurende de gehele stage- of afstudeerperiode.

postings.title: STAMP Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

We are looking for an experienced Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer to join our Air Traffic Control and Network Infrastructure team. This unique role combines overseas operational support in the Falkland Islands with project engineering and system development activities in the UK, offering an exciting opportunity to work on mission-critical communications and air traffic management infrastructure.
This position is ideally suited to someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working independently, and has a passion for maintaining and developing complex technical systems in challenging environments.

Location: Falkland Islands & Crawley

What the role has to offer
You'll play a key role in maintaining and supporting critical network infrastructure and air traffic control systems, ensuring operational availability in a demanding and remote environment.
The role includes rotational deployments to the Falkland Islands, typically comprising 10-week assignments, working alongside a team of engineers to provide continuous support. When not deployed, you will be based in the UK, supporting engineering projects, future network solutions and technology transition activities.
Flights to and from the Falkland Islands are provided, with accommodation and meals supplied whilst in territory.

What you'll be doing
As an Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer, you will:
- Deliver Level 1 and Level 2 maintenance activities, with occasional involvement in Level 3 support activities.
- Perform corrective maintenance including fault diagnosis, troubleshooting, equipment repair and replacement of Line Replaceable Units (LRUs).
- Carry out software updates, system configuration changes and testing activities.
- Undertake preventative maintenance to ensure equipment performance remains within operational parameters.
- Complete planned maintenance tasks including equipment inspections, cleaning, battery checks and system housekeeping activities.
- Produce maintenance reports and provide timely updates to Thales stakeholders.
- Collaborate with remote specialist engineers during complex fault investigations.
- Support engineering project activities, planning and service improvement initiatives.
- Contribute to the development, verification and transition of future network solutions and replacement SDH technologies.
- Support the delivery of critical communications and air traffic management services in a highly operational environment.

About you
We're looking for a motivated engineer who can work independently, solve problems effectively and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues alike.
- Minimum 4 years' experience working with SDH or similar telecommunications/network infrastructure equipment.
- Experience in fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and equipment rectification.
- At least 1 year's experience in an airside engineering maintenance environment.
- Experience working within military or civil Air Traffic Control environments.
- Experience supporting system development, integration or transition into service activities.
- Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Clearance (SC).

Desirable knowledge
Experience with one or more of the following:
- SDH systems
- Air Traffic Control Tower systems
- Air Navigation or Navigational Aid systems
- Communications and network infrastructure technologies

Skills and behaviours
You'll be someone who demonstrates:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong report writing and documentation skills.
- Good IT proficiency including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio.
- High levels of self-motivation and initiative.
- The ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
- Adaptability and willingness to work in remote locations.
- A collaborative and team-focused approach.

Security Clearance Requirement
UK Eyes Only:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.
