postings.title: SubContract Manager
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

ABOUT THE ROLE / WHO ARE WE

We are seeking a Subcontract Manager to lead the contractual management of major subcontractors supporting the delivery of the CAAS NexGen Air Traffic Management System (ATMS), a strategic, long-term programme within the Airspace Mobility Solutions (AMS) Business Line.

Embedded within the Project team, you will serve as the contractual focal point for assigned subcontract packages, ensuring that subcontract obligations are effectively negotiated, administered, and managed throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Project Controls, Commercial and Legal teams to develop subcontracting strategies, manage contractual risks, administer changes and claims, and ensure subcontractor performance aligns with the project's technical, commercial, schedule and quality objectives. The role is critical to protecting Thales' interests, maintaining robust subcontract governance, and supporting the successful delivery of this mission-critical systems integration programme.

You will report hierarchically to the Senior Contract Manager of NexGen, part of the Legal, Contract & Compliance Department of Thales international division (DGDI) for Southeast Asia, supporting all Thales’ businesses in Southeast Asia and Taiwan (“the Region)

Thales has been present and has grown from strength to strength in the Asian region for over 50 years, providing state-of-the-art solutions for customers in the avionics, secure communications and information systems, defense mission systems and strategy, research and technology, and digital security domains.

WHO YOU ARE
- You hold an advanced academic background in Law, Contract Management, Business, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Engineering, or a related discipline, equivalent to a Bachelor's degree qualification (EU/UK/SG/US or other comparable higher education systems).

- You have 8+ years of experience in Subcontract Management, Contract Management, Procurement, Commercial Management, or Legal Counsel roles within complex international industrial environments such as aerospace, defence, transportation, infrastructure, energy, EPC, systems integration, or technology sectors.

- You demonstrate capability to manage large, multi‑stakeholder, long‑cycle contracts with both strategic and have the maturity to operate autonomously and proactively with senior internal and external stakeholders

- You have strong analytical, problem‑solving, and synthesis abilities, with the capacity to translate complex contractual frameworks into actionable guidance

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multi-cultural teams and influence senior and executive stakeholders

- Strong interpersonal skills to resolve issues constructively while protecting the company’s position.

- Comfortable working with digital platforms and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CLM systems, collaborative environments).

- Strong communication skills, intercultural awareness, and the ability to operate within diverse teams.

- You may be required to travel from time-to-time.

WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGETHER

1. Subcontract Management Throughout Project Execution
- Establish, manage, and continuously update the sub contractual baseline from subcontract award to closeout, ensuring alignment with the main contract and project objectives.

- Ensure that all subcontract agreements appropriately incorporate flow-down obligations from the prime contract while protecting the organization's commercial and contractual interests.

- Ensure full contractual awareness across the project and procurement teams, enabling the correct application of subcontract obligations, rights, milestones, deliverables, and commercial terms.

- Proactively anticipate and manage subcontract deviations through notices, change orders, amendments, claims, requests for information (RFIs), waivers, and other contractual mechanisms.

- Identify, assess, and drive subcontract-related risks and opportunities in close collaboration with project, procurement, and commercial teams, including claim preparation, dispute avoidance, cost recovery, and value protection initiatives.

- Oversee all contractual communications with subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring consistency, traceability, compliance, and alignment with project and contractual requirements.

- Coordinate with the Legal and Contract Management teams when subcontract disputes arise, supporting fact-finding, documentation, evidence management, negotiation, and dispute resolution strategies.

- Monitor subcontractor compliance with contractual obligations, including scope, schedule, quality, HSE, insurance, bonds, warranties, and reporting requirements, escalating issues proactively.

- Ensure subcontract change management is effectively administered, including the evaluation, negotiation, documentation, and implementation of variations and commercial adjustments.

- Manage subcontract closeout activities, including final account settlement, resolution of outstanding claims, completion of contractual deliverables, and archiving of contractual documentation.

2. Subcontract Strategy, Tendering & Commercial Support
- Identify opportunities to protect or enhance project financial performance through effective subcontract management, commercial negotiations, and risk allocation.

- Support procurement and project teams during tendering activities by developing contractual terms, evaluating commercial and contractual deviations, and participating in bidder clarifications and negotiations.

- Ensure full contractual alignment between the prime contract and subcontracts by cascading applicable obligations, risks, and entitlements, while managing the back-to-back implementation of contract variations.

- Assess the impact of customer-initiated changes on subcontract scope and commercial terms and ensure corresponding subcontract amendments are negotiated and executed. Likewise, identify subcontractor-initiated changes or claims that may give rise to upstream variations, claims, or relief under the prime contract, ensuring timely notification, recovery, and protection of the project's contractual and financial position.

- Support the preparation, evaluation, and negotiation of subcontract variations, change orders, extensions, and additional work packages throughout the project lifecycle.

- Recommend subcontracting and commercial strategies that optimize competitiveness while ensuring compliance with the prime contract, applicable regulations, and internal governance.

- Prepare and present contractual and commercial recommendations for internal approval, including subcontract award decisions, variation approvals, claim strategies, and risk assessments.

3. Governance, Leadership & Coordination
- Act as the reference point for all contractual matters related to subcontractors and suppliers throughout the project, ensuring consistent interpretation and application of subcontract provisions

- Provide strategic and operational contractual advice to internal stakeholders

- Participate in departmental initiatives such as improving templates, tools, and best practices, contributing expertise linked to complex project execution

- Ensure subcontract management activities comply with corporate governance, delegation of authority, ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

4. Compliance Activities
Although the role is primarily focused on contract management, you will:
- Support relevant compliance processes for the program (e.g., third‑party screenings) in coordination with the NexGen Contract Manager and the Compliance Officer.

- Escalate any potential non‑compliance issues where required.

WHAT WE OFFER
- A unique opportunity to manage the contractual dimension of a flagship, technically complex program in Singapore.

- High impact, visibility, and autonomy within the organization.

- Exposure to senior internal stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.

- A collaborative and international working environment.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.description:
Location: Gorgonzola, Italy

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Gorgonzola hosts Navigations Air Systems (NAS) domain. The activity of NAS domain: avionics, navigation and radar systems for civil air traffic and technologies supporting the activities of civilian and military pilots, ATC controllers and technicians of several airlines, air traffic control agencies and Air Force around the world. Italy is the Group’s Competence center for the design, production and delivery of Navigation Aids products and Competence Centre for the delivery of non-Radar Surveillance Products.

The Supplier Performance Manager organization is responsible to manage and improve the operational performances of key suppliers (On Time Delivery and On Conformity deliveries).
A Supplier Performance Manager is appointed for several suppliers at local level entity/region as soon as needed according to context (High technical stakes or Risky technology or Mass production or Performance below objective reached).

The main missions of a Supplier Performance Manager are :
- Manage operational performances for some selected Thales suppliers in close relationships with Procurement, Industrial, Engineering, Services and Quality teams and ensure that all the conditions, internal and external, enabling performances are in place.
- Initiates improvement plans for the selected suppliers in terms of quality and on time deliveries during the execution phase
- Defines and controls the SKPIs (Suppliers Key Processes Indicators) objectives with the GBUs organization: punctuality, quality....

Experience:
- Understanding and knowledge of Quality Management principles and systems.
- Broad industrail process knowledge including mechanical and electronical assembly and test.
- Awareness and use of continuous improvement techniques and practical implementation of lean manufacturing.
- Experience of operational management, manufacturing and ERP systems, including routings, BOM`s & Concessions etc.;
- The job holder is also expected to have the ability to communicate clearly and freely as well as to have the ability to produce high standard documentation for project and external use.

Mission & Responsabilities:

In agreement with head of local entity operations, the Supplier Performance Manger main activities are:
- Anticipation and Continuous Improvement, In order to manage the continuous improvement, put in place the Thales best practices, including lean manufacturing, within Suppliers portfolio
- Responsible for the deployment, within the selected suppliers, of corrective and preventive action plans which address process, product, or component alerts from industrial operations, customer line fit manufactures, or the field support organization.
- Act as a conduit to improve the overall interface between Thales and the Supplier, using lessons learned for the continuous improvement of both parties. Develop and execute plans, within the selected suppliers, to eliminate non-value add activities (e.g. the Seven Wastes, MUDA) in both Thales and Supplier processes, consistent with improving the quality and reliability of procured items
- Deploy, within the selected suppliers, techniques including Six Sigma, DMAIC or Process Failure Mode Effects Analysis (PFMEA) to identify and evaluate the potential failures of process, prioritize actions to alleviate risk in both Thales and Supplier activities.
- Participate to the transverse optimization actions such as Air Supply deployment (internet portal for exchanging data for Purchase Orders and forecasts), specific programs (ramp-up, ramp-down), new KPIs implementations, Reach (Registration, Evaluation and Authorization of Chemicals) regulations, logistics …
- Establish high level communication and intimacy with supplier's leadership team
- For anticipation, identify transformation targets, support associated roadmap deployment through weak signals awareness and risk mitigation plans
- For anticipation, set up subtiers mapping to assess risk exposure and propose ad hoc securization

Reviews, SKPIs and reporting
- Organize and conduct the Suppliers PERFormance REViews with the purchase department
- Validate and issue the SKPIs for own portfolio
- Establish a monthly reporting for own portfolio
- Prepare and participate to the local Suppliers Performance Committees and category performance reviews if needed
- Transmit the SKPIs to the group level
- Monitor and report on a regularly basis the global performance action plan addressing two main topics: quality and punctuality

Relationships with the global SPM organization and BLs
- Support Group initiatives in order to improve supplier performances for the Group
- Throughout his network, he/she escalates the identification of weak signals (in coordination with Industry,Engineering, Services , Quality and Purchasing departments) to the head of entity/region SPM when needed
- Reports the performance of his/her suppliers in category performance reviews when requested by Global SPM for suppliers with very low OTD/OCD
- Contribute to the knowledge of the complete Supply Chain starting from the tier one supplier and identify the weaknesses
- May participate to the Thales IPCA Audit (Industrial Process Control Assessment) and support auditors for the closure of the findings

Requirements:

- Experiences in Industry in supply chain > 4 years of experiences
- Demonstrable history of managing performance improvement projects preferably in Defence, Aerospace, & Security sectors.
- Understanding and knowledge of Quality Management principles and systems.
- Supply chain engineering experience within a low to medium volume environment, light mechanical / electro-mechanical production environment or other relevant sectors.
- Awareness and use of continuous improvement techniques and practical implementation of lean manufacturing.
- Experience of operational management, manufacturing and ERP systems, including routings, BOM`s, Concessions, Change Requests etc.

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

As the Supply Support Manager, you’ll lead the teams responsible for warehousing, receiving, inventory, distribution and shipping, ensuring the right materials are in the right place at the right time to support our production and repair activities.

- Work closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning and operational teams to resolve issues and improve performance

- Experience across inventory management, warehousing, receiving, distribution and shipping

Parlons missions !

Vos missions :

En rejoignant l'équipe d'Ingénierie Logicielle de CortAIx Factory, le centre d'innovation en intelligence artificielle de Thales, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans l’accélération et l’industrialisation des technologies d'IA au cœur des systèmes critiques des forces armées, de l’aviation civile et de l’aérospatial. Ces défis incluent la détection et la qualification d’unités mobiles en temps réel, la fusion de données et la simulation de situations, la détection des dangers intrusions et menaces, l'aide à la prise de décision pour les opérateurs, ainsi que le suivi et le contrôle des actions déclenchées.
Au sein de votre squad agile, vos missions consisteront notamment à :

- Participer activement à la mise en œuvre des cas d'usage et leurs pilotage

- Assurer l’intégration de la solution avec la cible de production et contribuer à la définition du maintien en condition d’opération et de sécurité (MCO/MCS) en accord avec les spécifications du client.

- Contribuer à la communauté de pratique pour les Technical Leads, visant à encourager le partage de pratiques et la collaboration.

- Organiser des rencontres régulières pour travailler sur l'amélioration des standards de notre environnement d'ingénierie logicielle, incluant, de manière non exhaustive : les normes de codage, la configuration de nos outils technologiques pour optimiser les processus de développement, les meilleures pratiques de développement.

En tant que membre de l’AI delivery team de CortAIx, et rapportant directement au CTO et au Head of Discipline Software, vous serez au carrefour des interactions avec diverses Global Business Units (équipes business et techniques) de Thales, le AI Lab, ainsi que les clients externes. Cette position stratégique vous permet de jouer un rôle clé dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de projets d'IA innovants, en facilitant la collaboration entre les experts techniques internes, les leaders de projet et les partenaires extérieurs pour répondre efficacement aux défis et opportunités émergents. postings.title: System Architect
postings.description:
Location: Templecombe, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Under Water Systems (UWS)

Our purpose is to be the leading provider of underwater sensors and decision superiority, helping navies across the world keep our friends, families and all of us safe. We cover four sectors: Mine Counter Measures, Anti-Submarine warfare, Services and Future Capabilities.

Primary Purpose of the Role:

To manage the Systems Engineering Process to company and international standards for defined packages of work. To provide line management and technical leadership to Systems Engineers.

The Systems Architect typically works with a team of engineers to define what will be designed, how it will perform and how it will be determined that it is working correctly

Key Responsibilities and Tasks:
- Converts requirements into conceptual designs and prepares associated documentation by performing operational analyses, simulations and technical trade-off studies evaluating alternative design configurations and functional features.
- Development lifecycle and lifecycle products.
- Interfacing with the client, to gain approval of test specifications and to host acceptance testing activities.
- Help develop and execute Test Specifications including:
- Support the development of test plans and test strategy documents
- Execute test specifications (according to test plan and project schedule)
- Record and/or authorise results of test execution
- Raise/investigate/verify defects
- Maintain quality target/standard
- Prepares system & subsystem requirement specifications, interface requirements and test requirement documents by analysing, decomposing modelling and refining customer requirements.
- Performs technical/engineering tasks to define system design and subsystem requirements details.
- Analysis and simulations are performed as necessary to identify design feasibility & driving requirements.
- Supervises staff, by defining their work, coaching them on how and what to prepare, monitoring their progress and directing them on priorities.
- Proposes work package estimates and descriptions based on knowledge of the work and project requirements, ensuring that compliant solutions at optimum cost are identified.
- Develop, implement and maintain tools relevant to the Systems Engineering function. Manage the assessment of relevant tools.
- Defines or proposes updates of processes and standards covering the work and its products based on knowledge of systems engineering.
- Keep abreast of technical development in relevant domain (e.g. sonar systems) both within and outside of the company.
- Manage the production of quality metrics to measure the soundness of the System Engineering processes under your control.

Skills:
- Able to use a range of IT tools (e.g. MS Office, MS Visio, etc).
- Has a sound ability to use system engineering tools. (e.g. DOORS, System Architect, JIRA)
- Has a working knowledge of configuration control.
- Can manage a project through a defined process and is able to tailor CHORUS2 to project needs.
- Can define metrics as part of Quality assurance & control.
- Working knowledge of project plans.
- Has a working knowledge of Engineering Safety Management

Experience:
- The Systems Engineers are the technical focal point for the System Engineering process and must resolve all issues, problems, questions and conflicts in the entire system. This requires frequent handling of new and unusual issues therefore a proven record of working in a Systems Engineering environment is required.
- The post holder should have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate at all levels in the spoken and written word. A good outward appearance, self-motivation and the ability to work under pressure are vital.
- The success of the Systems Engineering job family relies on the interaction of its engineers at all levels, therefore evidence of team working is required.

Desirable Qualifications and Certification:
- HNC/HND/Engineering Degree or equivalent

Essential:
- Have attained, or working towards an appropriate professional status or equivalent

Financial / Budgetary Responsibility:
- The post holder may be expected to deliver designs/projects to an agreed budget

UK Eyes Only:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

postings.description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Position Summary

The System Architect, based in Noida, will define the technical vision and target architecture for secure, scalable IAM platforms and AI-native engineering capabilities. The role combines deep systems architecture expertise with hands-on leadership in agentic AI, AI coding agents, and modern software delivery.
The architect will design identity capabilities for workforce, customer, partner, machine, workload, and AI-agent identities, covering authentication, authorization, governance, adaptive access, threat detection, and secure delegation.
The role will lead AI-native practices across architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, and operations. The successful candidate must use and govern AI coding agents in real engineering workflows and design agentic systems with bounded autonomy, traceability, and enterprise-grade quality, security, privacy, and compliance.

Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
- Own the target architecture and roadmap for IAM and AI-enabled platforms, aligned with business strategy, Zero Trust, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
- Architect identity, lifecycle, credential, authorization, delegation, governance, audit, and threat-detection capabilities for human and non-human identities.
- Design agentic AI systems that plan, use tools, collaborate, and execute multi-step workflows within defined security and operational boundaries.
- Define guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, human approval, tool access, runtime isolation, context, observability, auditability, and safe failure.
- Lead AI-native engineering across requirements, architecture, coding, testing, reviews, documentation, deployment, and operations.
- Use AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and delivery automation.
- Govern AI-assisted development through approved-tool controls, data protection, output validation, secure review, provenance, and traceability.
- Translate business outcomes into reference architectures, decision records, quality attributes, service objectives, and implementation guardrails.
- Architect resilient cloud-native, distributed, event-driven, and API-first systems with strong production readiness and cost efficiency.
- Lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, technical discovery, proofs of concept, build-versus-buy analysis, and cross-functional decisions.
- Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, compliance, and legal teams to deliver secure, auditable, resilient solutions.
- Mentor architects and engineers and produce clear, reusable architecture guidance, threat models, diagrams, evaluations, and runbooks.

Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
- 12+ years designing and delivering complex software platforms, with substantial architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional delivery responsibility.
- 7+ years in IAM across customer or workforce identity, federation, SSO, MFA, password less access, lifecycle governance, privileged access, and fine-grained authorization.
- Minimum requirement: hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI solutions using planning, tool invocation, retrieval, context or memory, multi-step workflows and human or policy controls.
- Minimum requirement: hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, reviews, documentation, or delivery automation.
- Experience governing AI-generated code through human review, automated testing, security scanning, secrets and dependency checks, provenance, and auditability.
- Strong generative AI knowledge covering models, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, model and tool selection, evaluation, observability, cost, and responsible AI.
- Practical understanding of agent risks, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, data leakage, identity spoofing, supply-chain compromise, and unsafe actions.
- Strong experience with cloud-native, distributed, multi-tenant systems, APIs, asynchronous messaging, containers, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, and observability.
- Deep IAM knowledge, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, PKI, workload identity, secrets, and policy-based authorization.
- Strong system-design fundamentals across domain and API design, resilience, consistency, scalability, performance, security, privacy, data architecture, and operations.
- Hands-on capability across modern programming ecosystems, quality engineering, threat modeling, technical specifications, architecture decisions, and reference implementations.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders, lead technical decisions, mentor engineers, and align product, engineering, security, and operations.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience architecting identity, authorization, delegation, and governance for AI agents and other non-human identities.
- Experience with secure agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent integration, including Model Context Protocol or equivalent approaches.
- Experience with specification-driven development, reusable AI workflows, and organization-wide AI-assisted engineering adoption.
- Experience evaluating, red-teaming, monitoring, and responding to incidents involving generative or agentic AI systems.
- Experience with AI-enabled identity or security capabilities, including adaptive access, behavioral analytics, threat detection, fraud, risk scoring, or identity proofing.
- Experience designing model-agnostic AI platforms, enterprise knowledge integration, reusable agents, and cost-aware model routing.
- Experience with software and AI supply-chain security, regulated platforms, or contributions to architecture communities, standards, publications, or open source.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: System Architect - Weapon Systems
postings.description:
Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Systems Architect - Weapon Systems (IAS)
Location: based in Belfast, minimum 3 days/ week in office (hybrid), with
Other: permanent, full-time

Interested in helping shape the future of advanced Weapon Systems? This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation defence capabilities, influencing technical strategy, and delivering innovative solutions for our customers.

What the role has to offer

- Support the development of advanced Weapon System architectures and technology plans
- Work directly with customers, senior stakeholders, and product leaders, acting as a key technical authority across major programmes and strategic initiatives
- Evaluate emerging technologies, de-risk future capabilities, and turn advanced concepts into operational products that deliver real-world impact

Our Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Capability Development - Weapon Systems within the IAS Technical Directorate, this is a rare opportunity to influence the future of advanced defence capability. As a System Architect, you will lead the development of innovative Weapon System solutions, shaping architectures, technology roadmaps, and strategic investment decisions that drive next-generation products. Working across engineering, technology, and customer-facing teams - you will provide technical leadership across bids, programmes, and product development, ensuring solutions deliver operational excellence, performance, and value.

We are looking for an experienced Systems Architect or Technical Leader who thrives on solving complex challenges, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and turning emerging technologies into real-world capability. You will possess a breadth of technical capability, comfortable working with customers and subject matter experts while providing technical oversight throughout the product lifecycle.

If you're passionate about innovation, systems thinking, and shaping the future of Weapon Systems, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) - our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

What we offer you

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing and professional growth, which includes:

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

Main Responsibilities

- Define and evolve Weapon System architectures, including Concepts of Operation, functional partitioning, interfaces, and system-level design to meet operational, technical, and customer requirements
- Develop innovative technical solutions and proposals for complex Weapon Systems, balancing cost, schedule, performance, risk, and compliance within bid and programme constraints
- Provide technical leadership and governance across the development lifecycle, ensuring engineering activities, system designs, and project deliverables comply with requirements, standards, and product policies
- Act as the principal technical interface for customers, partners, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, supporting technical discussions, requirement trade-offs, and the successful delivery of development opportunities
- Maintain and apply domain expertise in Weapon Systems, related sub-systems, speciality engineering disciplines, and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance capability and competitive advantage
- Support Design Authority activities and communicate technical solutions effectively, using system architecture tools and methodologies to capture, develop, and present system designs to stakeholders across the business and customer community

About You

At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Ideal Experience & Skills

Essential

- Degree-qualified in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline, with the ability to obtain and maintain UK SC clearance
- Significant experience in senior engineering, systems architecture, technical leadership, or product development roles within a complex technology environment
- Proven expertise in architecting, developing and managing complex systems, including ownership of technical solutions across the product lifecycle
- Experience developing and delivering technical roadmaps, aligning technology, product strategy, and business objectives
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, suppliers, and senior internal stakeholders
- Demonstrable leadership capability, able to work independently, provide objective technical direction, manage technical risk, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional leadership teams

Desirable

- Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or equivalent professional accreditation
- Experience in a Design Authority, Chief Engineer, or similar technical governance role, providing oversight of complex programmes or products
- Knowledge of Weapon Systems and Short-Range Defence, including operational concepts, relevant sub-systems, emerging technologies, and product lifecycle management

If you're a technically minded leader with a passion for complex systems and emerging technologies, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us deliver the next generation of world-leading defence capabilities.

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

postings.title: System Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Responsibilities:
- Elicit, analyses, specify, and manage system and software requirements across the lifecycle, following ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 (requirements engineering) and the INCOSE Guide to Writing Requirements (GtWR) — every requirement necessary, unambiguous, singular, feasible, and verifiable, and every requirement set complete, consistent, and able to be validated.
- Maintain bidirectional traceability: stakeholder need → system requirement → architectural element → implementation → verification evidence. This is the artefact an auditor asks for, and it must exist as a living structure, not a retrofit.
- Operate the requirements process within an ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 lifecycle-process frame (as codified in the INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook, 5th edition): stakeholder needs & requirements definition, system requirements definition, architecture definition, verification, validation, transition, operation.
- Run a digital requirements engineering toolchain rather than documents-in-a-folder: requirements held in a managed repository with change control, baselines, and query-able trace links (e.g. Jama Connect, Polarion, DOORS or an equivalent the organisation standardises on.
- Author and own verification & validation strategy: define acceptance criteria at requirement-authoring time (not after the fact), and map each requirement to its verification method — inspection, analysis, demonstration, or test.
- Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement
- Contribute production code across the stack — able to read, review, and where needed write both service-side and client-side code well enough to keep requirements honest against implementation reality.
- Design and review APIs and service contracts as first-class interfaces (a system interface is a requirements artefact, not just a coding detail).
- Work fluently with the platform's delivery mechanics: version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and the review gates that make changes auditable.
- Translate abstract non-functional requirements (latency, availability, recoverability, security posture) into concrete, testable engineering targets and confirm they are met.
- Architect and review solutions on cloud infrastructure with an emphasis on security, data residency, resilience, and cost — and record those decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) with the trade-offs made explicit.
- Design for the platform's operating constraints: identity and access, secrets management, encryption with organization-controlled keys, network segmentation, and infrastructure-as-code as the source of truth.
- Own or contribute to non-functional architecture: availability and recovery targets, capacity and scaling models, and observability — and ensure they trace back to stated requirements rather than being asserted.
- Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform-component decisions on evidence (supportability, licence terms, security maintenance status), not vendor narrative

Requirements:

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related discipline

Essential Skills/Experience
- Demonstrable experience across at least two of the three core stacks (systems/requirements engineering, full stack, cloud) at depth, with working competence in the third and a credible path to depth.
- Requirements engineering competence evidenced by real artefacts: requirement specifications, trace matrices, verification plans — ideally under a recognized standard (INCOSE GtWR, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148).
- Hands-on software engineering experience: has written and shipped production code, understands testing, CI/CD, and code review as engineering controls.
- Cloud architecture experience on at least one major cloud, with security and resilience as design drivers rather than afterthoughts.
- Fluency with traceability and evidence as a working practice — comfortable being asked "how do you know this requirement is met?" and having an answer that points to an artefact.
- Clear technical writing. In a regulated context, the specification is the deliverable.
- Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-disciplinary environment.
- Good communication skills.

Essential / Desirable Traits
- Possess learning agility, flexibility and pro-activity
- Comfortable with agile teamwork and user engagement

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

- Experience in the use of a wide range of Test equipment (Fluke, Optical Power meter, Oscilloscopes, Spectrum Analysers)

Platform Experience
- Experience of working in Naval Dockyards
- Knowledge of common acoustic surface ship or submarine sensors (Sonar, Echo Sounder, Side Scanner, Conductively Temperature Depth (CTD), Doppler Velocity Log (DVL), Command System).

- Experience in the conduct of platform trials and the required processes to ensure they are conducted safely and the required data is captured

Tools
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products to generate and update technical documentation
- Experience of fault reporting tools such as JIRA
- Experience of requirement capture tools such as DOORS

Soft Skills and Tools
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- An ability to work as a key member of the team
- A methodical and structured approach to problem investigation

Qualifications and Certification:
- Technical Degree/HND/HNC or equivalent in Electrical & Electronic or Mechanical Engineering.
- Three years or greater experience in an equivalent role or transferable knowledge and experience from relevant underpinning roles e.g. Systems/Hardware/Firmware/Software engineering.

UK Eyes Only:

This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. Join Thales and play a pivotal role in shaping the safety, compliance and certification of cutting-edge products that protect and enable our customers around the world!

What the role has to offer

- Make an impact where it matters most – At a time of increasing global security challenges, you'll help deliver the next generation of defence technologies, ensuring critical systems are safe, certifiable and ready for deployment in demanding operational environments
- Be part of rapid growth and innovation – Join a business experiencing significant growth and accelerating product development, where you'll thrive in a fast-paced environment, tackle complex challenges and see your work translated into real-world capability
- Influence the full product lifecycle – Enjoy a uniquely broad role with visibility from concept and design through to certification, operation and disposal. You'll play a key part in shaping safety across the entire system lifecycle, offering exceptional scope, variety and career development opportunities

Our Opportunity

As a System Safety & Environmental Engineer, you'll ensure Thales products are safe, compliant and certifiable, influencing engineering decisions from concept through to deployment. You'll lead hazard analysis, drive risk reduction, define safety requirements and develop robust safety cases that support certification and customer confidence.

This is a technical systems engineering role, not a traditional NEBOSH-style health and safety position. We're looking for engineers with experience of complex product development who can apply safety principles to influence design, integration and delivery across the full lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine strong engineering expertise with experience in hazard analysis, risk assessment and safety assurance, alongside the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and drive a safety-first approach across complex programmes.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) - our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- Pension scheme
- Life cover

Main Responsibilities

- Drive hazard analysis, risk assessment and mitigation activities, defining and managing safety and environmental requirements throughout design, integration, verification and testing
- Provide expert leadership and influence across multidisciplinary teams, embedding safety into engineering decisions and developing robust, evidence-based safety arguments throughout the product lifecycle
- Champion compliance with safety and environmental legislation, standards, policies and governance requirements, acting as the subject matter expert across IAS programmes

postings.title: System Solution Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Opportunity:

As a System Solution Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in bridging commercial strategy and technical design. Working closely with sales, solution architects, and engineering teams, you will evaluate solution architecture, analyze technical requirements, and develop accurate cost models. You will also focus on the design, integration, and validation of complex technical solutions to ensure solutions meet functional, performance and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities:

- Analyze customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into system and cost implications
- Collaborate with architects and engineers to assess scalability, integration, and deployment strategies
- Prepare total cost of ownership (TCO) models
- Support bid and proposal teams with cost estimates and work package definitions
- Engage with customer to explain the efforts for solution costing
- Develop and maintain technical documentation related to proposals (e.g., scope statements, input/output specs, interface specs, integration assumptions)

- Collaborate with internal team members/contractors to ensure timely delivery of technical work packages
- Oversee, execute and implement the awarded Variation Orders by managing the requirements

Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related discipline
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in systems engineering/analyst role
- Strong analytical and communication skills—able to translate between technical and business audiences
- Experience preparing cost or effort estimates for technical projects
- Experience with sub-contractors / vendors management, security projects, complex IT projects or government systems is a plus
- Exposure to systems engineering frameworks (e.g., INCOSE ASEP/CSEP) or government IT projects is a plus

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

postings.title: System Test Engineer
postings.description:
Location: Den Helder, Netherlands

Over het team:
In de huidige wereld van dreiging is de operationele beschikbaarheid van onze klanten van groot belang en daarmee het verlenen van een goede service. Binnen Thales Hengelo is Services een domein wat sterk groeit en is één van de speerpunten voor de toekomst. De services worden geleverd op de geleverde radarsystemen, waaronder technische assistenties, reparaties, overhauls en modificaties/ upgrades. De totale Services-afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 100 mensen.

Over jouw toekomstige baan
In de functie van System Test Engineer maak je deel uit van een team van engineers en monteurs die werkzaam zijn namens Thales Hengelo bij de onderhoudsorganisatie van de Koninklijke Marine (DMI) in Den Helder. De Marine heeft meerdere schepen die zijn uitgerust met high tech radarsystemen van Thales en gedurende de gehele levenscyclus ondersteuning nodig hebben. Daarnaast wordt in Den Helder ook voor de Koninklijke Landmacht de radarsystemen onderhouden. Je bent met het team verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoer van verschillende services activiteiten.

We bieden de mogelijkheid om te werken in een boeiend en technisch uitdagend domein met integratie van radar- en elektro-optische systemen. Deze systemen omvatten ultramoderne radarantennes, verwerkings- en ondersteunende systemen. In de rol van System Test Engineer werk je gedurende de gehele levenscyclus aan deze systemen en zelfstandig integreren en testen van radar- en elektro-optische systemen.
- Uitvoeren van testen op locatie, aan boord in de haven en op zee
- Evaluatie van de prestaties van het systeem in zijn operationele omgeving
- Optreden als troubleshooter bij technische en/of performance problemen
- Diensten verlenen zoals systeemgezondheidscontroles, onderhoud en reparatie.

Het onboardingstraject voor de functie vindt plaats bij Thales in Hengelo voor een periode tussen de 6 en 12 maanden afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Gedurende deze periode zul je diverse trainingen volgen en inwerken op de GM200-systeem. In Den Helder zul je daarnaast inwerken op andere systemen van Thales.

Na de eerste 6 tot 12 maanden werk je hoofdzakelijk op het terrein bij de Marine en eventueel op klantlocaties over de hele wereld om onze services aan de klanten te leveren om ervoor te zorgen dat de systemen operationeel beschikbaar blijven. Incidenteel zul je bij Thales in Hengelo werken.

Belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
- Verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van een of meerdere servicecontracten binnen de gestelde tijd, kwaliteit en budget.
- Het operationeel leiden en vertegenwoordigen van het test engineering supportteam.
- Actieve rol in het bepalen van de productbeleid en instandhoudingsstrategie.
- Ondersteuning in het opzetten van calculaties en analyse van de financiële resultaten.
- Op tijd signaleren en proactief oplossen van blokkerende problemen.
- Continue verbeteren van processen en leveringsresultaten.
- Rapporteren aan het de Project Manager en Workcell Leider van de voortgang van het contract.

Waarom ben jij een goede match:
- In bezit is van een MBO, HBO of WO diploma en bij voorkeur op het gebied van Elektrotechniek, Elektronica, Informatica, Technische Natuurkunde of Mechatronica.
- Affiniteit met radarsystemen, affiniteit met analoge technieken, de Linux terminal of computernetwerken zijn een pré.
- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en in staat om in multi-disciplinaire teams te werken.
- Vloeiend in Engels en Nederlands woord en schrift, andere taalvaardigheden zijn een pré.
- Analytisch en probleem oplossend vermogen.
- Stressbestendig en zelfstandig.
- Inlevingsvermogen in andere culturen en gebruiken.
- Klantgericht en professionaliteit in omgang met de externe klant.
- Beschikbaarheid tot (internationale) reizen.

Wat krijg jij er voor terug
- Een uitdagende baan in een leuk team binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving. Inclusief alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën.
- Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, commercieel of internationaal vlak.
- Waardevolle internationale samenwerkingen met collega’s en klanten.
- Een comfortabele werkplek in een moderne omgeving, met aandacht voor flexibiliteit en de juiste work-life balance.
- Werken mag meestal waar en wanneer je wil. Binnen Thales mikken we op een 60/40 balans, waarbij je in elk geval twee dagen in de week thuis kunt werken als je rol dit toelaat.
- Een goed salaris, passende reiskostenvergoeding en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden te personaliseren: je kunt bijvoorbeeld vrije dagen ruilen voor internetkosten, ons fietsenplan, bedrijfsfitness en verhuiskosten.
- 40 vakantiedagen per jaar. Ja, echt.

Interesse?
Solliciteer nu door hieronder op ‘Apply now’ te klikken!
Om er zeker van te zijn dat we een goede match vormen kunnen we je vragen deel te nemen aan een assessment.

Diversiteitsstatement
We vinden dat je baan de juiste work/life balance moet ondersteunen en het platform is om jóuw ambities waar te maken. Dat betekent dat gelijke kansen, inclusiviteit en een informele cultuur een essentieel onderdeel uitmaken van ons succes. Maar ook dat jouw gezondheid en geluk voor ons erg belangrijk zijn! Daarom bieden we je de flexibiliteit om te doen wat voor jóu belangrijk is; of dat nu parttime werken is, of werken vanuit huis, of de mogelijkheid om flexibel te zijn in je start- en eindtijden, we denken met je mee.

Security Requirements
In lijn met de basisbeveiligingsvereisten van Thales vragen wij kandidaten mogelijk om bewijs omtrent identiteit, werkvergunning en arbeids- plus opleidingsgeschiedenis. Sommige vacatures vereisen ook een security clearance die verdere informatie vereist. Voor meer informatie over wat er nodig is voor bepaalde security clearance, raadpleeg dan de General Intelligence and Security Service.

Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Opportunities have arisen for experienced systems engineers to deliver the role of Systems Engineer in Thales OME Glasgow.

Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME)
We enable forces to gather timely, meaningful information so they can make thoughtful, decisive choices that safeguard communities. For more than 130 years, we’ve championed the development of Optronics for military, scientific and commercial applications. Our expertise covers three sectors: Air, Land and Sea

The successful candidate will be a talented Systems Engineer with experience of conceptual and detailed design, Integration and verification, coupled with a proven capability of delivering mission systems.

The candidate will have demonstrable experience interfacing with internal and external customers, understanding system requirements, working with other design engineers to specify and accept sub system designs as well as creating verification and validation programs in the defence domain.

The role holder reports to the Systems Engineering Discipline Manager.

We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer with a strong background in conceptual and detailed design, integration, and verification of mission-critical systems. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully delivering complex mission systems within the defence sector.
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the design, integration, and verification activities for mission systems, ensuring they meet all performance and reliability requirements.
- Collaborate closely with internal teams and external customers to gather and understand system requirements.
- Work alongside design engineers to specify, review, and approve subsystem designs.
- Develop and implement robust verification and validation programs to ensure compliance with defence standards and operational needs.

Security Clearance Requirement:

postings.title: Systems Engineer
postings.description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

Benefits @ Thales:
- ThalesFlex – flexible working is our everyday
- Fitness Passport discount
- Employee discounts with a range of partners (travel, car hire, tech, and more)
- Modernised paid parental leave
- Novated lease options
- Family support through our partnership with Parents At Work

Our Team:

Our Engineering team delivers innovative and complex solutions across Defence, Aerospace, and Critical Systems domains. Working alongside multidisciplinary engineering professionals, we support the design, integration, testing, and delivery of leading-edge technologies that help our customers solve some of their most challenging operational problems.

The Role:

Join our team as a Systems Engineer in a full-time, permanent position.
This position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your systems engineering expertise across the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through to integration, verification, validation, and customer acceptance. Working within multidisciplinary teams, you'll play an important role in developing innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges while ensuring technical integrity and successful project outcomes.
If you're passionate about solving problems, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and delivering high-quality systems that meet customer needs, we'd love to hear from you.

Duties will include:
- Analysing customer needs and operational requirements to support the development of effective system solutions.
- Defining system architectures, requirements, and specifications that support project and customer objectives.
- Supporting system integration activities and ensuring technical coherence across design, interfaces, and performance requirements.
- Developing and executing integration, verification, validation, and testing activities throughout the project lifecycle.
- Collaborating with engineering teams, project stakeholders, and customers to resolve technical challenges and optimise system performance.
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methodologies, and technical solutions.

How about you?
To be successful in this role, you will bring:

- A Degree or Master's qualification in Systems Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Experience in Systems Engineering, including requirements management, system design, integration, verification, validation, and testing activities.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex systems and identify effective solutions.
- Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary engineering teams and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders.
- Knowledge of engineering and requirements management tools such as DOORS, Polarion, JIRA, TFS, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication skills, combined with a proactive attitude, curiosity, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning.

The following will be highly regarded:
- Experience with network configuration and administration.
- Experience leading engineering activities, work packages, or technical projects.
- Experience working within Defence, Aerospace, Space, or other highly regulated industries.
- Knowledge of systems architecture, command and control systems, or complex integrated solutions.

Good to Know:

You'll receive an email acknowledgement after you've applied. Thales strives to provide a personalised experience for all suitable applicants.
As a Defence security clearance may be required for this role, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate Australian Government Security Clearance.

It’s easy to dismiss the perfect opportunity if you don’t see yourself as the perfect fit. If this role feels right – no matter your background or personal circumstances – please introduce yourself or join our community. We’re committed to supporting a diverse workplace, and that starts here.

We’re proud to be endorsed by WORK180 as an Employer for All Women, but we know there’s always more we can do. We’ll continue to foster industry partnerships, employee resource groups (ERGs) and development opportunities to make Thales a genuinely equitable employer, for everyone.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

postings.title: Tactical Buyer Manager
postings.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

As Individual contributor, He/She The Tactical Buyer Manager is responsible for leading Order Management activities within a region. The role will be required to provide prioritize activities on Order management, Stakeholder Management and Supplier follow ups on a regular frequency. Additionally, the Tactical Buyer Manager will need to establish SLAs or KPIs for the tactical procurement team which meet or exceed the expectations of the region/service and support GBUs/BLs.

Duties and responsibilities

- Establish KPIs and SLAs for Tactical Buyers
- Manage the ERP and Purchasing tools for analytics and reporting.
- Maintain Dashboards and report the Procurement performance through Dashboards.
- Liaise with internal stakeholders for streamline processing of Orders
- Liaise with Suppliers for streamline processing of Orders and Delivery monitoring and further dispute management.
- Manage and resolve internal and external conflict as an escalation path
- Provide general supervisory and instructional direction to the order management activities
- Interface with IS/IT on issues or required modifications to local ERPs
- Capture and cascade knowledge of global/regional commodity strategies to their respective teams
- Ensure accuracy of order placement and cancelation
- Interface with other shared services (Accounting) to capture required changes or modifications to purchase order documents
- Ensure proper execution to process and procedure as per Chorus 2
- Maintain regulatory compliance to Thales, regional, federal, or local laws & requirements
- Develop, lead and execute purchasing strategies
- Track and report key functional metrics to reduce expenses and improve effectiveness
- Forecast price and market trends to identify changes of balance in buyer-supplier power
- Monitor and forecast upcoming needs

Qualifications

- Good understanding of various Tools and ERPs
- Good Analytical Skills and Reporting methodologies
- Proficient with Stakeholder Management.
- Avid learner and inclined to Grow.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
